name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: Long bana: 1 600-1 900 kr; Kort bana: 1 000-1 200 kr
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic relay in the spring, organized by Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets. The race is offered in two variants: a long course with eleven legs totaling about 67.5 km and a short course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. Start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, and the race suits both experienced runners and beginners as there are legs of different lengths. GPX files for all legs are available to download, and the organizers offer a shared warm-up and extensive service along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden with crowd encouragement along the course
Long course: 11 legs (2.7 - 8.5 km), total about 67.5 km; Short course: 6 legs (2.7 - 5.4 km), total 23.5 km
Leg 3 (Glömminge - Högsrum) has a detour via Rönnerumsvägen due to road construction
additional: Bib pickup: Friday May 8 from 15:00 to 17:00 and competition day May 9 from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen (start location). Changing and showers are available in the sports hall 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad (opening hours 08:00 - 10:00 and 14:00 - 17:00). Wellness Studio will hold a group warm-up before the start. The long course has a women's class and an open class; the short course has an open class. GPX files are available to download for all legs. The registration fee includes service and bib pickup; times for bib pickup and start times are at Hamnplanen; changing and showers in the sports hall near Ölands Köpstad; Leave valuables at the meal tent; EKERUM RESORT offers meals and lodging during the weekend.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs and a start and finish in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The race is open to both recreational runners and elite and offers a community-filled competition format for teams. The course is flat with varying surfaces of gravel and asphalt, and timing is done with a chip so both total finish times and individual leg times are measured. Welcome to register your team and experience both racing joy and community in the heart of Bromölla.
course_highlights: Six legs with start and finish in Bruksparken, Bromölla
Flat course with varying surfaces: gravel and asphalt
Water stations at start and finish, and approximately 3 km on legs 1 and 4
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken; shower and changing facilities in Sparbankshallen; timing is done with a data chip and both total times and leg times for all six participants are registered; the bib must be attached to the chest and be fully visible; runners who want to take it easy are encouraged to stay to the right during turns; placement prizes for the top three in each class as well as a raffle of larger prizes. 6 legs per team; anniversary celebration for 20 years; balloon rides as prizes; start at 09:00, bib pickup; registration via humlestafetten.se; shower and changing in Sparbankshallen

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Östhammars Stadslopp is organized by Östhammars Friidrott and takes place in Östhammar. According to the club's website, the 2026 race is listed with a start at Frösåkersvallen. The page presents the event as a local Stadslopp and contains information about the club's handling of personal data and image usage in connection with the competition.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: Contact details provided at registration are used only for contact regarding the competition. After the competition, information that is no longer needed is removed, but some information such as name, age and results may be kept for result lists and competition statistics. Photos taken during the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook page and Instagram; participants can contact the club to have photos removed. The start list, registration and results are available for Stadsloppet on Östhammars Friidrott's website.

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a welcoming fun run with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town with music and pep stations along the course, and there is also a shorter three-kilometre loop (KyrkRundan) as well as a free children's race. The event emphasizes community, movement, and a family festival and is organized with local partners and warm-up before the runs.
course_highlights: Approximately 99% asphalt; fast surface with both uphill and downhill sections
Running along the Svartån for about half the course
The last kilometer through Mjölby center via Gästisparken back to Stadsparken
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at Intersport Friday May 8 from 12:00–18:00; bib numbers not collected there will be distributed in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. Late registration can be done via the website April 30 – May 7, as well as at the bib-number distribution on May 8 or on race day (Swish only). The small tab on the bib is the chip that records the time; without it, no time will be recorded. Warm-up is handled by Fitness4You 15 minutes before the first children's start and 15 minutes before the main race. After finishing, ICA Supermarket Mjölby and Finspångs Brunnsborrning will provide something to eat/drink; children receive a medal after finishing. 2025 results are published on mjolbystadslopp.se; corporate/booth packages are offered through partner Möllers Sverige.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp
price_range: 10 km: 200-350 kr; 5 km: 200-350 kr; Ungdom (5 km): 120 kr; Minimara: 60 kr; Funkislopp: 60 kr
description: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp is organized by Mariestads AIF (together with Korpen Mariestad) and is a welcoming city run held in early May. The competition offering targets both recreational runners and competitive runners with 10 km and 5 km, as well as special races for children (Minimara) and people with disabilities (Funkislopp). The race has been held since 1982, and in 2026 Springtime is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen. Start and class divisions exist for senior, junior, veterans, and open recreational classes.
course_highlights: The 10 km distance is run as 2 x 5 km (two laps of 5 km).
City race courses in Mariestad (urban environment).
Separate short loops for children and Funkislopp: approx. 500 m and approx. 2000 m.
additional: Start times and classes: Funkislopp starts at 10:30 (500 m or 2000 m, possibility to have accompanying runners/escorts), Minimara starts at 11:15 (approx. 500 m for preschool children, approx. 2000 m for grades 1–6). For participation in senior and veteran classes, a competition license is required via a club affiliated to Svenska friidrottsförbundet. Springtime 2026 is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen. Chip timing; Start and finish at Torget; Fluids at 5 km and at the finish; Changing rooms and showers at Korpen Mariestad; The competition is included in Västra Löparcupen; Prize giving and raffles.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a well-attended running event in Stockholm offering both a half marathon and a 10K, with start and finish at Rålambshovsparken. The course is described as flat and fast and suited for runners aiming for a personal best; the event is also marketed as a festival around the island. There is also a children’s race. The organizers publish course information and GPX files for download on the website.
course_highlights: Flat courses, good for personal best (PB)
Loop around Kungsholmen with start/finish in Rålambshovsparken
Kids' race offered
additional: Course map and GPX files are available for download (including KR23gpx_v2.zip and KR23HMgpx.zip); information on the start and finish area is published on the invitation/course pages; a separate children's race is listed on the course/information pages. Registration takes place via the Runners' Store; cash payment is required; late registration costs 400 SEK for the half marathon and 300 SEK for the 10K, and 100 SEK for the Kids' Run; three forms are required for late registration; on-site starting spots may be available on Saturday at the competition site (Rålambshovsparken) from 08:30; updates on the registration status are followed closely.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen in Hultsfred is a recurring running event on a nice, flat course along Lake Hulingen. The event offers a 10 km course for adults and two children’s races in different age categories, and is open to everyone, including those who are not members of any club. On the registration page there is information about start times and pre-race information for the race. You are warmly welcome to participate!
course_highlights: Nice, flat courses along Lake Hulingen
10 km course for adults
Two children’s races (different age groups, e.g., 0–6 and 7–12 years)
additional: The children's races start from 10:00 and the 10 km starts at 11:00. You do not need to be a member of any club to participate. There is a PM with more information linked from the registration page. Participant lists are published (page for Strandmilen registered participants). Registration opens via the club's page; the 2026 edition is planned with registration open on May 9.

description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a popular running event with several distances for different target groups: the classic 10 km, a shorter 5 km, MiniSpringtime for children, and the inclusive "All Can Run" race. The 10 km distance is Springtime's backbone and has been part of it since 1981, while team competitions provide the opportunity to compete together in mixed teams. The event is organized by IFK Helsingborg and offers a medal, bib number, as well as water and fruit at the finish.
course_highlights: The Classic 10 km – Springtime's backbone since 1981
A shorter and fast 5 km, also possible to run in a team competition
MiniSpringtime 1 km for children born 2016-2020; the same course is used for the "All Can Run" race
additional: There is an option to purchase insurance via Startklar.nu at registration. The price includes bib number and medal, as well as water and fruit at the finish. Start spots can be transferred to another runner by contacting ifk.helsingborg@springtimeihelsingborg.se no later than 20/4. Team competitions consist of four runners per team (mixed teams allowed) and the times are equalized with a handicap factor to ensure equal conditions between women and men. Registration is open via the website, and the event includes multiple categories such as Corporate/Team, MiniSpringtime and All Can Run, as well as Open IFK Championship.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a welcoming cross-country race in the forests around Lockmora in Kungsör, volunteer-run by Kungsörs SK. The course runs over a pine-covered esker and offers trails and gravel roads with gentle elevation changes and a few technical sections, suitable for both runners and MTB cyclists. The race has a long tradition and is open to everyone — children, recreational runners and seasoned runners — where the sense of community is as important as the competition. The organizers also offer the MTB + running combination ('Dagens Dubbel') for those seeking a greater challenge.
course_highlights: Cross-country running along a pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör
A mix of trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes and a few technical sections
MTB + running combination available (18 km MTB in Dagens Dubbel)
additional: Registration is handled via RaceId (a link from the organizer's registration page). There is a virtual Björnlunken for those who cannot participate on site. Group discount: register 10 people and pay for 8 - after registration, email info@bjornlunken.se with the group details. Late registration can be done on the competition day, no later than 60 minutes before the respective start. Bib numbers are distributed at the respective start; the Björnlunken medal is awarded to all who complete. Parking is at the finish area in Lockmora; free buses transport participants to the respective start. Changing and shower facilities are available, outerwear can be left at the start and picked up at the finish. For MTB, a helmet and a regulation-compliant bicycle are required. Virtual Björnlunken is available; group discount at 10 registrations (pay for 8); registration via RaceId; free buses from the competition center to the start; bibs distributed at the start; water stations, showers and catering after the race.

name: BLK Trailen (Bredared)
location: Björkehovsgården, Bredared, Borås, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: Borås Running Club, in collaboration with Bredareds IF, invites you to a delightful trail race in beautiful and undulating nature around Bredared's fitness track. The race offers several distances so that both experienced trail runners and recreational runners can find a race that fits. Start and finish are located at Björkehovsgården, and parts of the course run on the blue terrain trail. The event is presented as a club-organized event with a local character and a focus on varied terrain.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around Bredared's fitness track
Parts of the course on the blue terrain trail near Björkehovsgården
Start and finish on the grass behind Björkehovsgården
additional: The events are held around Bredared's fitness track with varying trail lengths; several distances are offered. The club uses the blue terrain trail at Björkehovsgården and may include a small extension on the grass behind the grounds where the start and finish are also placed. Backyard race on the national day, June 6; scoring system: 2 points per month for around one long course or both short courses.

description: Kurt 300 Marathon is a privately organized marathon held on Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday, open to all and sanctioned with a measured course. The course consists of park roads along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred and is run as a 5-lap course (the last lap shorter). Both full and half marathons are offered, with timing and service at the turnaround, and a post-race gathering for participants.
course_highlights: The course runs on park roads along Lake Hulingen.
A 5-lap course where the last lap is 3 km shorter.
Approximately 20% asphalt; two drink stations along the course.
additional: Start and finish at the Knektavallen entrance by Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers available at the start from 08:00. Timing by Reima and Peter. At the turnaround there is water, sports drink, cola, bananas and candy; at 4 km there is water, sports drink and cola. Registration to Kurt by phone 070-628 57 28 or email kurt.gustavsson@hotmail.com. Swish payment provided for registration (0706285728). For Backyard Ultra: 6.7 km laps every hour, the course consists of park roads (gravel only) and is flat; pancakes are served after 5 hours, sausages with bread and coffee are offered, and a medal is awarded to all who complete at least one lap. Backyard Ultra: 6.7 km laps; start every full hour until participants can continue; results from previous years and registration information are available.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Växjö edition of Vårruset is part of Sweden's large spring race for girls and takes place on Monday, May 11, 2026 at 18:30 with start and finish at Strandbjörket. Participants can choose 2.5 km or a measured 5 km, and the race is suitable for those who want to run, jog, or walk around the beautiful Växjösjön. In individual registration, a medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz, bib, and timing are included (timing can be opted out). A team of five people can register and will receive a picnic after finishing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket
The course runs around Växjösjön
Selectable distances: 2.5 km or a measured 5 km
additional: Registration is digital and can be completed up until race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years old (11 years old in the company of an adult); 2.5 km from 11 years old (7 years old in the company of an adult). It is possible to opt out of official timing in the registration; team registrations (5 people) include a picnic after finishing. A digital option is offered for those who cannot attend in person (digital participants will have a medal mailed after June 4). The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; start/finish at Strandbjörket; the course goes around Växjösjön; team consists of 5 people; digital registration; option to opt out of timing; post-finish picnic for teams.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Uddevalla – a local Blodomlopp where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km in and around Museiparken. The race is organized to raise awareness for life-saving blood donation and welcomes both individual and team registrations (team 3–5 people). The courses offer a varied urban environment with uphill sections, old embankments, and long downhill stretches toward the hospital area. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years and a picnic tradition after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Museiparken; the course follows Kungsgatan and passes Sinclair as well as under the railway at Östra station
10 km: continues uphill Dynamitbacken toward Bjursjön and along the old embankment (Lelångebanan)
5 km: turns toward Bleket with the highest point at Norrskolan, then mostly downhill toward Uddevalla Hospital and through a long tunnel under road 44
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3-5 people); team registrations include a picnic bag and the last day for team registrations is May 4. A 40 SEK discount for blood donors is offered at registration. Wellness benefits (Epassi, Wellnet, Benify) are accepted and payment can also be made via Swish, email invoice, or e-invoice. Late registration in Museiparken can be done on race day (listed from 16:00 on the page). Wellness benefits accepted; registration open with late registration until 16:00 on May 11; team registration (3-5 participants) includes a picnic bag; blood donor discount applies.

name: Varvetmilen (Malmö)
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med Heleneholms IF
description: Challenge yourself in the 10 km Varvetmilen Malmö – a faster race where your result seeds you for Göteborgsvarvet 2026. Start and finish are at Heleneholms IP and the race is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with Heleneholms IF. The event also features a Mini Run (210 m) for children aged 0–6 that takes place on-site. The information on the page encourages runners to seize the chance to secure a better starting group for Göteborgsvarvet.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heleneholms IP
The course runs south through Nydalaparken and circles the Almvik area
Water station at 5 km, the course returns through Nydala towards Heleneholms IP
additional: Seedings-based for Göteborgsvarvet 2026. Mini Run for children aged 0-6, 210 m, sign-up on-site (80 kr via Swish). Bib collection, bag drop-off and start/finish area are at Heleneholms IP. A water station is indicated at 5 km. The Mini Run for children (210 m) runs concurrently; bib number (the day before at Stadium Södergatan 10:00-19:00) and on race day at Heleneholms IP (09:00-10:30); showers/changing rooms, bag storage and warm-up offered; beverages at 5 km and at finish; net time is recorded. Varvetmilen seeds automatically into a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)
description: Welcome to Startmilen i Örebro - an open mass-participation race that fits many levels and often marks the start of the outdoor season. Start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen / Örebro University, and the course runs on the streets of Almby. The 2026 edition has a new course layout due to roadworks: 5 km run on one lap and 10 km on three laps, and both the 5 km and 10 km are course-measured. The race includes divisions for both recreational runners and competitors; the 10 km is also the DM for Southern Svealand.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
Course on streets in the Almby district: 5 km = one lap, 10 km = three laps
Both the 5 km and 10 km are course-measured (by a federation course measurer)
additional: Bib numbers are distributed at Tybblelundshallen on race day from approximately 10:30 a.m. Timing is done with a transponder attached around one ankle and loaned at bib distribution (a lost transponder incurs 800 SEK); KnatteStarten has no timing. Registration opens from 6 April and can be completed via the registration system or on site up to 60 minutes before the start at Tybblelundshallen, for an increased fee and subject to availability. Start times: KnatteStarten 12:30, 5 km 13:00, 10 km 14:00. New course in Almby; the 10 km is sanctioned by Svenska Friidrottsförbundet and included in Södra Svealands Löparerie and DM; start and finish at Tybblelundshallen; transponder timing; bibs distributed in Tybblelundshallen; KnatteStarten 1 km 12:30, 5 km 13:00 and 10 km 14:00; registration via AnmälMigNu; late registration before start for an increased fee.

name: Varvetmilen Göteborg
description: Varvetmilen Göteborg is a seeding-based 10 km race that gives participants the opportunity to seed into a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start is at Slottsskogsvallens entrépark, and the course runs through central Gothenburg as you pass iconic locations in the city. The registration fee is 349 kr until January 31 and 449 kr from February 1. There is also Digitala Varvetmilen, a digital seeding race on April 18–26 that allows participants from around the world to participate and seed into Göteborgsvarvet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km course starting at Slottsskogsvallens entrépark and finishing in the same area
Seeding-eligible results for Göteborgsvarvet 2026
Opportunity to participate digitally via Digitala Varvetmilen (April 18–26) for international participants
additional: 10 km course with start at Slottsskogsvallens entrépark; water station at 5 km; seeding rules mean that the result is automatically seeded into a better starting group for Göteborgsvarvet 2026; registration takes place via the website; the start confirmation is sent by e-mail; bib collection according to the schedule at Friidrottens Hus and Stadium Run Nordstan. Varvetmilen starts at Slottsskogsvallens entrépark and has seeding rules that automatically give a better starting group in Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start times are 11:00–11:20 and the start confirmation with detailed starting group information is delivered about two weeks before the race; the mini race for children (210 m) can be registered on-site for 80 kr (Swish).

name: Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race at Hovdala Castle organized by Hässleholms AIS with three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. The courses offer soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings and beautiful scenery around Hovdala. The 21 km is part of Spring in Skåne's Trailcup 2026 and targets runners who want a bit more elevation and technical challenge, while the 5.4 km is a shorter and less technical nature experience. Registration is done via Neptrons Entrysystem from the organizer's registration page.
course_highlights: Soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings
The 21 km route on Hovdala begins with sections of the 10 km course and features more elevation gain
The 5.4 km offers a beautiful nature experience with an easier technical course and less elevation gain
additional: Max 400 participants; late registration via the website and from Monday of the same week as the race a late registration fee of 50 SEK applies; name changes can be made via the registration page (cost 100 SEK); bib numbers must be collected on site no later than 30 minutes before the start and must be worn visibly; timing is electronic; hydration stations with water and sports drink (Umara) are available on all three courses; no changing facilities or showers are available, but a toilet is available; results are posted on-site and published live on the website. Start times: 5.4 km at 11:40, 10 km at 11:50, 21 km at 12:00. Max 400 participants. Late registration adds 50 SEK. Bib numbers on-site no later than 30 minutes before start. Hydration (water and sports drink) at the indicated stations. Showers/changing facilities are not available. Results are published on the website; 21 km results are reported to Spring in Skåne's Trailcup.

name: Blodomloppet
price_range: Individuell 5 & 10 km: 350 kr till 29 april, 400 kr till 19 maj, 450 kr tävlingsdagen; Laganmälan 5 personer: 1750 kr till 29 april, 2000 kr till 13 maj; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr till 9 maj, 120 kr till 20 maj; blodgivare/ICA-medlemmar rabatt 40 kr per person.
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona — an open fun run for everyone where you can walk, jog, or run to raise awareness for the vital blood donation. We offer short, accessible courses that suit both competition-focused runners, recreational walkers, and children. The courses are measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and the event has a strong social character with team registrations and a picnic afterwards. The event is locally organized by a sports club together with blood centres and is welcoming for both individual participants and teams.
course_highlights: Measured race courses of 5 km and 10 km (certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation)
Separate 5 km walking course so walkers can start earlier for a joint picnic afterwards
The children’s race of about 800 meters for the youngest participants
additional: Teams may consist of a maximum of 5 participants, and team members may participate in different distances. For larger registrations there is an Excel template for import into the registration system and an option for a customer page for companies/organizations. Blood donors and ICA members receive a 40 SEK discount per person. Contact for Blodomloppet in Karlskrona: KA 2 IF, email karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, phone 0793-299924. Short course of 800 m; start times and warm-up will be announced later; registration is done via the website; the starter kit with a T-shirt, bib and medal will be delivered about two weeks after completed registration; the distance run May 17 – September 7; Excel template for larger registrations and the possibility of a corporate customer page and discount codes; contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se.

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Vårruset in Gothenburg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for girls and is held in Slottsskogen with the start and finish beneath the Björngårdsvillan. The race is held as an evening event with distances of 2.5 km and a measured 5 km, and it is open to everyone who wants to run, jog, or walk. All participants receive a medal, a goody bag, and a bib; there is also the Vårruset music quiz and prizes as well as the option for timing on the 5 km. Team registrations (teams of five people) are invited to a picnic after the finish to celebrate together.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km or a measured 5 km
Start and finish in Slottsskogen, beneath the Björngårdsvillan
Evening run that is part of Vårruset's tour for girls
additional: Registration is digital and accepted up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. All individual registrations receive a medal, a goody bag, and a bib; team registrations (five people) also receive a picnic after the finish to celebrate together. Timing is offered for the 5 km but can be opted out in the registration; results are published only for those who choose timing. Recommended ages: 2.5 km from 11 years old (from 7 years old with an adult), 5 km from 13 years old (from 11 years old with an adult). There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digitalt) where a medal is mailed home after the tour ends; digital participants cannot participate in the physical events. Distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; teams consist of five people; start and finish located beneath the Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen; digital registration; picnic after the finish; timing can be opted out; medal, goody bag, music quiz and prizes included.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly recreational running event organized by the non-profit association Löparakademin. On May 16, 2026, the 14th edition will feature a timed 5 km race (for participants aged 13 and older), a Fun Run of 1.6 km for all ages, as well as the Lilla and Mini Skärholmsloppet for children. Start and finish are at the Puckelbollplanen, and there will be DJs and music stations along the course for extra motivation. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and everyone who finishes will receive a specially designed medal.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen
DJs and music stations along the course
Available events: timed 5 km, Fun Run 1.6 km, and Lilla Skärholmsloppet (~1.6 km) and Mini (500 m) for children
additional: Registration for the race is free and includes a bib number, a medal, and energy at the finish. Registration on the website closes Thursday, May 14 at 17:00 and late registration can be done at the bib-number pickup on Friday (May 15) and on race day (May 16), subject to availability. Start times: Skärholmsloppet Mini (500 m) starts at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet begins the first start at 11:30 (several children’s classes according to color code); Fun Run 1.6 km starts at 12:25; 5 km starts at 13:00. A race-PM with map, pictures and instructions will be sent to registered participants about one week before the race. At Lilla Skärholmsloppet fruit and drinks are provided at the finish. The race also offers MINI-lopp and Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children; registration is free and includes bib, medal and energy at the finish; after registration there is the possibility of on-site activities; start times: Fun Run at 12:25 and 5 km at 13:00; start/finish at Puckelbollplanen.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: Täby Extreme Challenge (TEC) is a well-known ultrarace that runs on a recurring loop course in the Täby forests with start/finish at the Ensta Krog recreation farm. The event is held over a weekend in mid-April (TEC 2026 is listed for April 17–19) and offers several distances - including 50, 100 and 200 miles as well as Backyard/loop course and a shorter intro ultra. The course is about an 11.5 km long loop that combines asphalt, gravel roads/fitness trails and forest paths and suits runners who seek a technical yet clearly marked course early in the season. The organizers welcome participants and emphasize that the course may be icy or cold early in the season and that the race may require endurance even in difficult conditions.
course_highlights: Loop length approximately 11.5 km (the runner completes 4/7/14/28 laps for Baby/50/100/200 miles)
Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads/fitness trails and forest paths
Approximately 126 m of positive elevation gain per lap; start/finish and the race's only aid station at Ensta Krog
additional: Start and finish at Ensta Krog (easy to reach by public transport); the race's only aid station at Ensta Krog where runners have access to drop bags; the course is marked and signposted where route choices may be uncertain; risk of wintry/icy surfaces early in the season and the organizers may adjust the course if needed; GPX for the course is available. The weekend's distances include Backyard, 100 miles and 200 miles; Pace on Earth team were present in various roles according to a blog article.

name: Kajenloppet
location: Kajen, Nacka Strand, Nacka Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand that offers a beautiful route along the water with views of Stockholm's inlet. The course passes historic sites and has start and finish at the Kajen in Nacka Strand, in the midst of the festivities. The race offers several distances - 10 km, 6 km, as well as children's races of 1,200 m and 400 m - and is suitable for both recreational runners and families. During the day, a family festival with activities, music and entertainment for all ages takes place.
course_highlights: Beautiful waterfront loop with views of Stockholm's inlet
The route passes historic sites along the coast
Start and finish at the Kajen in Nacka Strand with a family festival, activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, Children's race 1,200 m and 400 m. Start and finish at the same location at Kajen in Nacka Strand. Family festival on-site with activities and music. Contact: info@kajenloppet.se. Children's race starts at 10:30 (300 m) and 10:45 (800 m). Distances 10 km and 6 km are on the program.

name: Premiärloppet
description: Premiärloppet in Gothenburg is organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott and takes place on April 18, 2026, with start and finish at Skatås Motionscentral. The race is offered in two distances: 10 km on gravel surfaces and 5 km that is more hilly terrain up to the highest point of Brudarebackens. Medals are awarded to all participants and there are prizes from Löplabbet. Bib-number pickup takes place before race day at Löplabbet in Gothenburg (valid for those registered before April 3) and on race day in Skatås between 10:00–13:15; water is available at 6 km in the 10 km race.
course_highlights: 10 km on gravel with water at 6 km
5 km of hilly terrain up to the highest point of Brudarebackens
Start and finish at Skatås Motionscentral; medals to all participants and Löplabbet prizes
additional: Bib numbers must be picked up before race day at Löplabbet in Gothenburg for those registered before April 3, and on race day in Skatås at the start/finish between 10:00–13:15. Medals are awarded to all participants. Water at 6 km for the 10 km race. Race director Cecilia Hallin (cecilia.hallin@saik.nu). Great prizes from our partner Löplabbet. The distances are 5 km and 10 km with light undulation; water at 6 km and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected before race day at Löplabbet in Gothenburg if registered before April 3, and also on race day in Skatås at the start/finish between 10:00–13:15.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a cross-country race in Västervik, organized by the Tjust Bike & Running Club. The eleventh edition is planned for April 18, 2026, and the course winds through forest trails as well as across rocky outcrops in the Småland landscape. The race offers distances of 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 23 km, and 46 km and is suitable for both families and experienced ultrarunners. The start time is on Saturday at 08:00, and the event is a full-day experience in the area.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails through the beautiful Småland countryside
Rocky outcrops that challenge runners
A distance range spanning from family-friendly 2.5 km to ultralong 46 km
additional: The distances are 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 23 km and 46 km; start time is Saturday at 08:00; the event is described as a full-day experience in the area. There is a cut-off time on the longest distance (The Long Run) — you must be at the turnaround by 11:45 (3 h 45 min after the start) to be allowed to go out on a second lap. The organizer recommends trail shoes and a mobile phone; no special equipment is required but the bib must be clearly visible.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a Backyard Ultra race organized by Högby IF and run on a loop in Stensö/First Camp Stensö in Kalmar. The race is run on a 6,706-meter loop with the first start at 10:00 and a new start every full hour — each lap must be completed in at most one hour. Runners who do not finish a lap within the hour are forced to withdraw; those who continue are tied for first after each lap, and the winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. All levels are welcome, from those aiming to become ultrarunners to participants with lower ambitions.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter loop (lap)
Start at 10:00, then a new start every full hour
Lap max 1 hour - 24 laps equals approximately 100 miles (161 km)
additional: Location: First Camp Stensö / Stensö jogging track, Kalmar. Laps are run on a 6,706 m loop; 12 laps ≈ 50 miles, 7 laps ≈ marathon distance. Next start every full hour – runners who cannot complete a lap within the hour must withdraw. Volunteer registration is via WordPress (login required). The course is 6,706 meters long and runs on the Stensö jogging track; during evenings and nights the course switches to the illuminated trail. Energy and drinks are provided at the finish between each start. Bib numbers can be picked up at the start/finish area at Stensö from 08:00. Accommodation is offered nearby with discounts (cabins/camping) and special discount codes.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med Turebergs Friidrottsklubb
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km seeding race that takes place on April 18, 2026 in Sollentuna. The race automatically seeds you into a better start group for Göteborgsvarvet 2026 based on your time. The start is at 11:00 and goes from Strandvägen 65 to the finish at Sollentunavallen; the course passes central Sollentuna along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with an aid station at the 5 km mark and a finish along the water. There is also a mini-race for children, bib pickup and bag drop on race day. The organizers are Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with Turebergs Friidrottsklubb.
course_highlights: 10 km course in central Sollentuna
aid station at 5 km
seeding race for Göteborgsvarvet 2026
additional: Start time 11:00; start area at Strandvägen 65; finish at Sollentunavallen; bib pickup and bag drop-off; mini-race for children; seeding rules for Göteborgsvarvet. The result in Varvetmilen Sollentuna 2026 is seed-based for Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The mini-race is held concurrently (210 m for ages 0–6) with on-site registration for 80 SEK (Swish); bib distribution and bag drop-off take place at Sollentunavallen.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very beautiful, approximately 15 km long course. Each lap will offer around 500 meters of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and a tough run, mostly in hilly terrain, mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail but also on a couple of gentler stretches where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred meters.

New for 2026
• Be at the starting line already in April! This time we’re kicking off in early spring, so mark April 18 in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race that lasts 18 days where the entire registration fee goes to Hjärnfonden and vital epilepsy research.
• Course trial runs. On two occasions we will run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual training sessions in the Heyey app that ensure you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What is not new for 2026
• The course, a tough and very beautiful course in the surroundings around Flatensjön.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test that we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honor and fame and also some prize money.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km per lap (loop)
Approximately 500 meters of elevation gain per lap
Tough and beautiful trail around Flatensjön
additional: All information on the organizer's website.

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: Rock The Trail
description: RockTheTrail is a family-friendly trail race organized by Ultra Uppsala with courses through varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten. The competition offers shorter and longer distances for different levels - from a children's course to a new 45 km classic - and aims to be both challenging and fun to run. The starting location is listed as OK Linné (Tallbacksvägen 68), and the organizer invites runners to sign up via Ultra Uppsala's pages.
course_highlights: Course through Hågadalen/Nåsten with varied trail terrain
Starting at OK Linné (Tallbacksvägen 68)
New 45 km challenge in addition to 7.5 km, 15 km, and a children's course (approximately 1–1.5 km)
additional: Date set for Saturday, April 18. Distances: 7.5 km, 15 km, new 45 km and the children's distance approximately 1–1.5 km. Organizer: Ultra Uppsala. Registration and invitation linked from the Rock The Trail pages to Ultra Uppsala's event page. GPX link, UL 100 bus toward Björklinge, toilets at the start/finish, hamburgers and drinks after finishing, parking at Ärentuna IP

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
description: Krogsereds Trailrun is organized by Krogsereds IK and presented as a fitness event with the slogan 'Motion on your terms'. On the club's website it states that the race is included as the first race in this year's Tour de Falkenberg. The page is informative and welcoming from the organizers' side, with links to contact and social media channels.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Lyngsjön with forest trails and coastal views
Several distances for the whole family: 400 m, 2,500 m, 5.6 km and 10 km
Clear logistics: registration via Google Docs, Swish payment and start times on Saturday
additional: Organizer: Krogsereds IK. The race is presented as the first event in Tour de Falkenberg. The website's meta-text contains the text 'To sign-up' followed by a YouTube link; the page also refers to the club's Facebook channel. The club mentions roller-ski training on Wednesdays at Ätrans IP at 7:00 PM (club activities on the page). No shower facilities. Swish number: 123-6408447. Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Motion 10:30, Main class 10:30. Registration via Google Docs; registration and payment via Swish.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 350 kr, lunch på Hellekis Kök & Trädgårdscafé ingår.

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a guided trail run from Trailrunning Sweden that takes you into Kinnekulle's spring greenery. The race is 13 - 15 km long, divided into 2 - 3 pace groups, and suitable for runners who want to experience nature, trails, and great views together with others. After the run, a locally produced ramson soup is served at Hellekis Kitchen & Garden Café. The event is marketed as a weekend activity with the option to carpool and a communal lunch.
course_highlights: Spring trails lined with ramsons and birdsong
Passing the stone quarry with views of Vänern
Trail run of 13-15 km in 2-3 pace groups
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Hellekis Kitchen & Garden Café. Lunch (locally produced ramson soup) included in the registration fee. Carpooling is recommended; the organizer can help coordinate carpooling. Distance 13-15 km, 2-3 pace groups; carpooling is recommended; lunch included (ramson soup) after the run on-site at Hellekis Kitchen & Garden Café.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
location: Norra Djurgården, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Vårruset i Stockholm is an evening race for girls held in Norra Djurgården. The race is offered in the distances of 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and targets both recreational runners and teams who want to participate together. In addition to running, a bib, medal and goody bag are included; teams of five people are also offered a picnic after finishing. It is a lighthearted and social event in Sweden's largest recreational tour for girls.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
The race runs in Norra Djurgården, a green, nature-rich environment
Nearest subway station: Universitetet (follow the signs)
additional: Registration is digital and closes on race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing is included for those who chose it in the registration (can be opted out), medal, goody bag and bib; team registrations also include a picnic after finishing (team of five). Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with an accompanying adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with an accompanying adult). There is also a separate Vårruset Digitalt where a medal is mailed home and the race can be completed between May 4 and June 4. Bib distribution: participants registered before May 1 will have the bib mailed to the provided address. The date for Vårruset in Stockholm is shown within the Vårruset collaboration's route for spring/summer 2026. More information on the official page as well as your city page.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5 & 10 km – 350 kr t.o.m. 28 april; Efteranmälan: 400 kr fr.o.m. 29 april; Lag: 1 750 kr t.o.m. 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr t.o.m. 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj.
description: Blodomloppet Kristianstad is a welcoming fun run held in Tivoliparken and offers 5 km and 10 km as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children. The courses run partly into the picturesque Vattenriket and vary in surface between grass, gravel, and asphalt. The event suits both individual participants and teams (up to 5 people) and combines exercise with the purpose of raising awareness of blood donation. The event has a family atmosphere with a post-race picnic tradition.
course_highlights: Scenic course out into the Vattenriket
Surface varies between grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet (100–1100 m) runs inside Tivoliparken for ages 0–12
additional: Registration is individual or in teams (max 5 participants). Last day to register a team is May 12. Last regular registration day (individual) for all runs: May 19; Late registration at Tivoliparken on May 19 from 16:00. Bag storage is available; bags are left at your own risk. Start and finish near the main stage in Tivoliparken.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and invites you to a spring evening with a 2.5 km or a measured 5 km course. Start and finish are at Lögastrand, and the race runs through central Västerås. All participants receive a bib, a finish bag and a medal; teams registering are offered a picnic after the finish. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers and welcomes both experienced and new participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km course is measured (timing optional)
additional: What is included: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib and timing for those who choose it (timing can be omitted and results are not published); team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing; recommended ages: 5 km: from 13 years (11 years in the company of an adult), 2.5 km: from 11 years (7 years in the company of an adult); registration can be made up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; a training session is offered before the race (for example, March 19 at 6:30 PM at Intersport Erikslund according to local information). DISTANCES: 2.5 or 5 km; team registration for five people with a picnic after the finish; individual registration includes a medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing on the 5 km (can be omitted) and bib.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
price_range: Gratis för barn/ungdomar och kommunanställda; övriga deltagare: prisuppgift inte angiven
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a team relay in Folkparken where four people form a team and take turns running or jogging a fast four-kilometer distance. The competition is suitable for both recreational participants and runners, and has a social, team-oriented character. Children and youths participate for free thanks to HSB. The organizers also offer rental solutions for tents and event equipment via Rent a Tent for those who want to set up on the competition grounds.
course_highlights: Four-kilometre distance in Folkparken (each team member runs one leg).
Four-person team relay — take turns to jog or run.
Children and youths participate for free thanks to HSB.
additional: Team of four people; each leg is about 4 km in Folkparken; children and youths participate for free thanks to HSB; Rent a Tent offers tents and event products with the last booking date for guaranteed access May 5 (contact: norrkoping@rentatent.se). Medal after finish; picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria; a small educational exhibit of the surroundings; possibility to rent a tent via Rent a Tent (booking no later than May 5); Fiskeby has been the main partner since 2018 and Toyota Askling Bil is the event's car partner.

name: Stafettvarvet
description: Stafettvarvet is a cheerful relay race for teams of four who run the same 3.2 km course around Slottsskogen, with start, handover and finish inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The event offers strong atmosphere before, during and after the race, and each team receives a picnic bag included in the registration. The race is also a popular corporate event with the possibility to book a tent site in the corporate village and pay via invoice at team registration. The organizer's text on the site states Stafettvarvet 20 May 2026 as the date for this year's edition.
course_highlights: A fast 3.2 km course around the beautiful Slottsskogen
Start, handover and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
The course goes through Slottsskogen and returns to the entrance park near Slottsskogsvallen
additional: Each team consists of four participants; baton, bib number and picnic bag are picked up outside Slottsskogsvallen in the entrance park. Registration is via the website and is open until 17:00 on race day (subject to the race selling out earlier). Companies can register the number of teams (not individual runners), pay by invoice and book tent packages in the corporate village. The race is part of Varvetveckan and encourages both team spirit and activity; age is recommended to be over 15 years; possibility to book corporate villages/tents; start time of the first race: 18:00; finish at Slottsskogsvallen

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland
price_range: Rabatt 40 kr per person för blodgivare; full pris ej angivet
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Linköping – a charity run to raise awareness of the need for blood donation. The race offers the distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet, and welcomes walkers, joggers, and runners in both women's and men's divisions. Many participants take part in teams of five, and the event traditionally ends with a large communal picnic. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and several practical instructions (bib numbers, late registration, public transport tickets, and more) are available on the info page.
course_highlights: Offers 5 km and 10 km as well as Lilla Blodomloppet (women's and men's divisions)
Road race – separate course maps for 5 km and 10 km are attached
The event traditionally ends with a large communal picnic
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3-5 people); you always pay for five people in a team, and it is possible to complete to a full team no later than April 30 at no cost by emailing linkoping@blodomloppet.se. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount per person. All participants who register by May 14 and provide a mobile number will receive an SMS link to an Östgötatrafiken ticket valid for 6 hours on May 21. Bib-number distribution and the possibility for late registration are offered on specified dates and locations (e.g., GeBlod and Saab Arena; times and days are listed on the info page). For large registrations there is an Excel template for import and the possibility of a customer page / discount codes — contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se for corporate solutions. Registration takes place in three steps; teams can consist of 3-5 people; the last day for team registration is May 14; start and timing classes and information about bib numbers and changes are in the PM; training evenings before the race are offered free of charge; approximately 12,300 pre-registered participants are mentioned in the material

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Vänersborgs AIK
description: Welcome to the premiere of Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan on April 21, 2026. The race is designed for you to run a fast 10 km, and the course is course-measured. The route runs on fast cycle paths around Stallbacka and consists of a 3.3 km loop that is run three times. Start and finish are at the tennis hall, and the event is organized by Vänersborgs AIK together with Trollhättans IF Friidrott.
course_highlights: Course-measured 10 km (3.3 km loop x 3)
Runs on fast cycle paths around Stallbacka
Start and finish at the tennis hall; pacers 35–60 minutes
additional: Gathering at 17:00 at Bäckelycke Park. Registration is via RaceID and can be completed up to a half hour before the start; no late-entry surcharge. Bib numbers are available to collect near the start and finish. A practice run is organized on March 25, 2026 at 18:00 (gathering at the tennis hall). Opportunity to simultaneously register for Digital Varvetmilen for seeding to Göteborgsvarvet. Gathering 17:00 at Bäckelycke Park; Start at Kardanvägen 2, 461 38 Trollhättan; start time 18:00–20:00; bib numbers collected at the start and finish.

name: Kolmården Vertical
location: Hults Bruk gamla fotbollsplan, Kolmården, Sweden
price_range: 100 kr (till 19 april); 150 kr (efteranmälan/vid tävlingsdagen); försäkring 155 kr; startklar paket 275 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a short but steep trail race: 5 km with about 300 metres of elevation gain, held on 22 April 2026. The course consists of pleasant trails and technical sections on singletrack where strong legs and fast feet are rewarded. You pass Koklämman, Jakobs cave, and enjoy views over Ågelsjön. The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk, and the organizer welcomes both experienced trail runners and strong beginners who enjoy challenging terrain.
course_highlights: 5 km with around 300 metres of elevation gain – short but very hilly
Nice singletracks and technical sections, including 'Koklämman' (Timtomara's stairs) with a rope
Views of Ågelsjön and a stretch by Jakobs cave/grill site
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk (the football field is located about 200 meters from the parking). Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class as well as raffle prizes. Cancellation and accident insurance is offered for 155 kr, or a variant that also covers training for 275 kr. Late registration is available from 20 April and on race day at the venue for 150 kr. Early and late registration options, as well as separate insurance and a start-ready package as add-ons.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is an urban quarter marathon offered in two distances: 5 km and 10 km, with start and finish in Eskilstuna City Park in central Eskilstuna. The race is organized by the Municipality of Eskilstuna in collaboration with Eskilstuna friidrott and includes Knatteknatet for children on the same day. The race is marketed as Sweden's most beautiful quarter marathon and follows a course of approximately 10,549 meters through the urban environment. Official information is available at avarvet.se and in Visit Eskilstuna's events calendar, and the event is also on Facebook.
course_highlights: Urban course through central Eskilstuna
Start and finish in Eskilstuna City Park
Knatteknatet for children on the same day
additional: 5 km and 10 km distances; start and finish in Eskilstuna City Park; Knatteknatet for children on the same day; course approximately 10,549 meters; marketed as Sweden's most beautiful quarter marathon

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a charming street race in Bromma, starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan. You can choose between a certified 12 km competitive course and an easier 6 km for recreational runners, as well as several children’s classes from 150 m up to 6 km. The course is demanding with several steep climbs and strong spectator support along the way, and the event is organized by Bromma IF for the benefit of the children and youth activities. At the start/finish, festival atmosphere awaits with Stadium Active Zone, music and activities for families.
course_highlights: Measured 12.0 km (asphalt), shaped like an eight with the finish at the start
Steep climbs, especially the two hills on Grönviksvägen (the last quarter)
Four water stations along the course; sports drink at Ålstensgatan/Grönviksvägen
additional: Start and finish on Ålstensgatan; the first 600 m go straight down Ålstensgatan. Timing with a data chip on the bib (Racetimer). Minimum age 14 years (running 16+ recommended); wheelchairs cannot be accommodated; runners with strollers require special permission (contact johan@tolvanloppet.se). Bib number pickup and start confirmation information will be sent by email; group registration for 10+ runners is available with a discount (contact johan@tolvanloppet.se). Stadium Active Zone at Ålstensskolan’s schoolyard with activities for families. Four water stations; timing by Racetimer; bib distribution 08:00 - 12:00 on race day; start/finish area on Ålstensgatan; parking very limited; medal for all finishers; nyttbanedebatt 2026 according to competition information; directions by tram (Nockebybanan) to Ålstensgatan.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is an urban running event with start and finish at Charlie Normans Square in Ludvika. The day offers races for children and youths as well as 5 km and 10 km for adults, with the option to participate with or without timing. There are separate children's races—the Knatteloppet for ages 0-6 and the Lilla Stadsloppet for children up to 12. For the 10 km race there is an extra reward if the course record is broken.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans Square in Ludvika.
Kids' races: the Knatteloppet (0-6 years) and the Lilla Stadsloppet (up to 12 years).
5 km and 10 km with the option to participate with or without timing; a 10 km course record can earn extra prize money.
additional: Registration via Google Form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Start times: 11:00 Knatteloppet (0-6 years), 11:30 Lilla Stadsloppet (up to 12 years), 13:00 5 km and 10 km. 10 km offers the possibility to break the course record and win extra prize money. Distances include the Knatteloppet, the children's race, and the adult distances (5 km and 10 km). Registration takes place via Google Form. The 10 km course is presented as a route where course records and prize money may occur. According to Ludvika municipality, food and coffee are offered on event day; past years' activities also included various community initiatives such as kettlebell-walk via Ludvika Insamlingsstiftelse.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå Stadsmara is one of Norrland's largest and oldest running festival events, designed to suit both recreational runners and competitive runners and children. The event offers several races in varying distances—from children's races to the half marathon—and is characterized by a family-friendly festival atmosphere. Choose your distance and run along both nature trails and classic urban routes in Luleå. Welcome to participate and experience the city's running festival!
course_highlights: New Half Marathon route along the water around the city of Luleå
Scaniamilen: classic 10 km to Storgatan and back
5 km course around the illuminated loop at Mjölkuddsberget (JIAB Ställningsmontageloppet)
additional: Listed races and their start times: VR-Profil Knattelopp 800 m (start 10:00), MAX-loppet 3 km (start 10:30), JIAB Ställningsmontageloppet 5 km (start 11:00), Renta Halvmaraton 21 km (start 11:30), Scaniamilen 10 km (start 12:30). The event is described as suitable for all levels of ambition and as a festival for everyone; the Half Marathon has a new route along the water and the 5 km course runs around the illuminated loop at Mjölkuddsberget. Contact via StiL Sportcenters reception: phone 0920 - 50 21 20. New start and finish area; new course layouts; Corporate Challenge; Corporate Village; Food court; T-shirt and logo

name: Uka Pain
description: Uka Pain is a series of off-road races in Älvdalen with distances from about 12 km up to 100 miles. Sweden Runners IF organizes the event which in 2026 also includes Trail-SM/VSM at 28 km and JSM at 12 km. The races run on marked trails with finish at Hotell Älvdalen and are designed to provide both challenge and experience in Dalarna. The event welcomes runners in several classes and offers services such as water stations, timing and finisher medals.
course_highlights: Trail in varied forest- and mountain terrain in Älvdalen
Finish at Hotell Älvdalen (competition center)
Orange course markings and orange Uka Pain bands on trees/guideposts
additional: Bib numbers, timing, energy and water stations, and finisher medal are included. A participant T-shirt is included if you are registered by 30 April 2026. Bus transport is offered for 100 Miles (departing from Hotell Älvdalen around 15:10 to Boggberget). Bib-number pickup at The Running Company on Friday 22/5; GPS trackers are issued to 100 km/100 miles participants. Mandatory equipment applies for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles. No on-site late registrations. Competition center and finish at Hotell Älvdalen; bib pickup at The Running Company about 100 m from the hotel; distance options include 12 km, 28 km, 52 km, 102 km and 100 miles; drop bags are allowed for 100 km and 100 miles; GPS trackers are used for 100 miles and 100 km; mandatory equipment applies for 50–100 km as well as 100 miles.

description: Welcome to Stadionloppet, organized by Djurgårdens IF Friidrott with start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadium. The main race is 5 km on a two-lap course through the Stadium's scenic surroundings, and there are also classes for children and youth. The race is chip-timed (the bib contains the chip) and is held on the same day as the cycling event Stadiongirot. For questions contact info@stadionloppet.se.
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadium
5 km main race on a two-lap course around the Stadium's scenic surroundings
Children and youth classes with shorter distances (some races not timed)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; thereafter only on-site registration. The chip is in the bib, and both net and gross times are used. Start confirmations can be collected on race day from 10:00 (show the start confirmation via email/SMS or a form of identification). Payments are accepted by card and Swish online; on race day only Swish. Members of Djurgårdens IF Friidrott can register for free with a special code. All registered receive two football tickets (one men's match and one women's match). Medical staff are on site. Medical staff are on site. Registration closes at 09:00 on race day via RaceID; after that registration takes place on site. All registered get two tickets to two football matches (men's and women's).

name: Skrylleloppet
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Björnstorps IF invites you to the 54th Skrylleloppet on April 25, 2026. The races are offered at 3, 5 and 10 km, with a new recreational class for men and women at 3 km. The courses run on Skryllegården's recreational loops in varied forest terrain and have gravel surfaces. Here you will find practical information on registration, bib numbers, parking, and race day.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km on Skryllegården's loop courses
Varied forest terrain with recreational trails
Surface: gravel
additional: Online registration can be made up to 30 minutes before start; Early Bird until 22/2, regular until 19/4 and late registration until 25/4. On race day you can register on-site and make name- or class-change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; on-site you can only pay with Swish. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be picked up at Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race from 10:00 - 18:00 (20% discount on pickup). 10 km results can be used for seeding to the TCS Lidingöloppet. Participants who cycle to the event can register this at number-lap distribution for entry into a prize draw. Online registration open until start; Early Bird prices until 22 February, regular until 19 April and late registration until start. On race day you can register on-site and Swish payment is available. Bib numbers are sent by email or collected at Löplabbet in Lund. Bag drop-off is available.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly running event in Kalmar organized by Högby IF on April 25, 2026. The race offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge), as well as youth classes from 600 m to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs in the Skälby area with gravel and park paths and a short asphalt section, and water is available at the turnaround and finish. A medal is awarded to all who complete the race, and registration takes place according to the schedule provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 or 2 laps over the bridge)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and forest paths with a short asphalt stretch
additional: Water is available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge; start times are according to the schedule and there is the possibility of late registration as per the organizers. The course layout for the 4 km and 8 km is standard (1 and 2 laps over the bridge). On-site presence is required for certain volunteer registrations in accordance with RF's norms. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge on Friday, April 24, 15:00–17:00 and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at bib-number pickup no later than 1 hour before the start. Water is available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish; medal to all who complete.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a 21.1 km half marathon to be held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 and has a time limit of three hours, with the start and finish area at Biskopsudden and a course that goes around Southern Djurgården and passes scenic areas near central Stockholm. The race is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good warm-up for adidas Stockholm Marathon, while welcoming all who want to experience spring in a beautiful urban-adjacent half marathon. Registration is available in different price levels (495-745 SEK) and bib and start information are distributed in advance; water stations and medical personnel are along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
A mixed surface with asphalt, gravel and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a warm-up for adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as information about the start. Water stations and medical personnel are along the course. The time limit is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single-loop 21.1 km circuit on Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and a sports drink from Enervit is offered along the course.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and will take place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, starting in Olshammar. On the race page there are maps, an elevation profile and a GPX file that can be downloaded to plan your run. The invitation and a link to registration are published for the current year in the menu on the club's page. Welcome to participate and review the course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map 1 and Map 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available for download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: The invitation and link to registration are published for the current year in the menu on the page. Course information includes Map Part 1 and Part 2 as well as the elevation profile. GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available for download. The race runs from Olshammar by the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. The teams consist of 2-5 runners with a baton exchange at any point along the course. An SI pin is recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at Laxå OK's clubhouse.

name: Utö Backyard
description: Utö Backyard is a backyard trail race on the beautiful Utö in Stockholm's archipelago that welcomes both social runners and competitive ultrarunners. You can run one lap, several laps or as many as you can – in Backyard 3.3K 15 laps are run for a total of 49.5 km and in Utö Backyard Extreme includes a warm-up lap followed by 7 laps of 6.4 km. The rules are simple: each lap must be completed within the maximum time (30 minutes for 3.3K, 60 minutes for 6.4K) and the fastest on the last lap is declared the winner. The organizers encourage turning the weekend into a mini-weekend with accommodations at Utö Värdshus and socializing after the race.
course_highlights: Backyard 3.3K: 3.3 km hilly trail run along the northern part of the island (15 laps = 49.5 km)
Extreme 6.4K: 6.4 km technical trail around the eastern and northern Utö with a mix of trail and gravel road (one warm-up lap + seven laps)
Beautiful archipelago setting with varied terrain, elevation changes, and views over the island
additional: Starter: Backyard 3.3K starts every 30 minutes (first start 10:30, last start 17:30). Extreme 6.4K starts every hour (same first start time). Prize ceremony at 18:00 and food served at Utö Värdshus after the prize ceremony. Transport: recommended with Waxholmsbolaget's boat Silverpilen from Årsta Brygga (departs 09:20, arrives 10:00); last boat back goes 19:50. Practical: bib pickup at start/finish, limited ability to leave belongings indoors (bring a trash bag/cover), energy stations at start/finish with drinks and snacks. Age rules/offers: youths up to and including 18 years have 50% discount on 3.3K with the code UTÖUNGDOM2026; 6.4K has an age limit 18+. Accommodation discount 25% at Utö Värdshus with the code UtöBackyard. Two distances: Utö Backyard 3.3K and Utö Backyard Extreme 6.4K; Backyard Ultra‑style format; full support with food, drinks and energy; youths up to 18 years get 50% discount on 3.3K with code UTÖUNGDOM2026; age limit 18+ for 6.4K Extreme; start/finish at Utö Värdshus; accommodation options and transport to Utö (Waxholmsbolaget) are available; this year's edition is limited to about 250 participants (150 in 3.3K and 100 in 6.4K).
