description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a spring 5- and 10-kilometer race with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is known as one of Stockholm’s most beautiful mile courses and runs through winding forest paths, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, for the most part on soft trails and occasionally hilly. The race serves as a seeding event for the TCS Lidingöloppet, and is suitable for both those who want a form check and those who want to secure a better starting wave. Before and after the races there is fika and lighter food available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Primarily soft surfaces; hilly (10 km: 127 m ascent, 5 km: 52 m ascent)
Water stations at 5 km and at the finish; the course is marked with red-and-white tape and kilometer flags
additional: Bib-number distribution from 09:30 on race day and up to 30 minutes before start. On-site registration is done at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor (My Pages) for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on site for a higher fee. Free bag drop is available; valuables drop-off costs 20 kr (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 kr via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + buses 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers and a sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Knattarnas Vårmil for younger participants; water station at 5 km and hydration items at the finish; seeding for the TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: Retrovarvet 2026
description: Retrovarvet is a running event held on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Heden in Gothenburg. Gathering is at 07:45 and the event lasts approximately 07:45–09:00. Registration is open to the club's members and is done via the specified email; more information is on the club's page and the Facebook event.
course_highlights: Start and gathering at Heden in Gothenburg
Approximately 10 km (Trailvarvet trial) to prepare for the Varvet
Part of Göteborgsvarvet's spring training program with a focus on warm-up and camaraderie
additional: Registration is open only to the club's members; the page indicates registration via email (premiarbanan1980@gmail.com) and that you should log in to the club's member site. Gathering at Heden 07:45. A Facebook event is linked from the event page. Contact details for the club's office are on the contact page. Gathering 07:45 at Heden; 25 April 2026; registration requires login and is for club members. Retrovarvet serves as a warm-up for Göteborgsvarvet and is linked to spring training sessions and varvet training.

name: Vårruset (Jönköping)
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and invites you to a cheerful and accessible evening run by Rocksjön in Knektaparken. The race offers a 2.5 km option and a measured 5 km course, and welcomes both individual runners and team registrations. Everyone who signs up receives a medal, bib, and finish bag, and a team of five people is invited to a picnic after finishing.
course_highlights: Course around Rocksjön in Knektaparken
Available distances: 2.5 km or a measured 5 km
Evening start in a park-adjacent, nature-rich setting (start 6:30 PM)
additional: What is included (individual registration): medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing for the 5 km* and bib. For team registrations, a picnic after finishing (team of five) is included, along with a medal, finish bag, music quiz + prizes, and bib. It is possible to opt out of official timing for the 5 km; the price is the same regardless of timing. Recommended ages: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with an adult); 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with an adult). Registration is done digitally and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. There is also a digital race (2.5 km or 5 km) conducted between May 4 and June 4 with a medal mailed afterwards; digital participants cannot participate on site. 2.5 km or 5 km; a team of five people provides the opportunity for a picnic; digital registration and the option to opt out of timing; age recommendations: 5 km 13 years (11 years with an adult), 2.5 km 11 years (7 years with an adult).

name: Lindeborgs Nature Run
location: Lindeborgs Eco Retreat, Vrena, Södermanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to Lindeborgs Nature Run at Lindeborgs Eco Retreat – a personal trail race where nature, health, and sustainability are at the heart. The race centers on a beautiful 5 km loop that winds through soft forest, open meadows, and over stone slabs with archaeological remains. The course is open for a period, so you choose how many laps you want to run, and the event combines the running experience with meals from the farm kitchen and access to the farm’s eco pool, showers, and sauna. With only 120 places in the first year, we aim to create a close, family-like atmosphere where every completed lap also generates a donation to the World Wildlife Fund (WWF).
course_highlights: 5 km loop through varied nature: soft forest, open meadows, and stone slabs with archaeological remains
The race runs as an autonomous loop open from 10:30 to 13:00 — choose the number of laps yourself
Expansive views over the nature reserve and a nature-rich farm environment around Lindeborgs Eco Retreat
additional: Date for the Nature Run weekend: 25–26 April 2026. Maximum 120 participants in the first year. For each completed lap, sponsors donate money to WWF. Before the start, simple refreshments are served and after the finish a warm organic lunch from the farm kitchen (farm-to-table). Participants have access to Lindeborgs' eco pool, showers and sauna. Lindeborgs offers accommodation packages for participants who want to extend their stay. Advice: dress according to the weather; the course goes through forest and meadows and requires shoes suitable for terrain. Lindeborgs Eco Retreat offers Nature Run weekend with accommodation package (overnight stay, sauna, natural pool, breakfast and a 3-course vegetarian dinner); booking via info@lindeborgs.com

name: Göteborg City Run 2026
description: Gothenburg City Run is a cheerful and social city race that takes place on 25 April 2026 and offers about 6 km through Gothenburg's city center. The start is at 9:00 AM from Brofæstet on Gullbergs Strandgata, and the focus is on community rather than timing — everyone is encouraged to run, jog, or walk and have fun. Along the course you will meet local members who offer activities and tastings, and after the finish all participants receive a goodie bag and have a chance to win in draws.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km through Gothenburg's city center
The route passes by and through certain buildings
Local members offer activities and tastings along the way
additional: Start and finish: Brofæstet, Gullbergs Strandgata 2. Start groups will be announced closer to the race. Photography takes place during the race. All participants receive a goodie bag and prizes are drawn. Approximately 6 km course through Gothenburg's inner city; start at 9:00; activities along the way; post-race goodie bag and raffles; focus on experience and community rather than timing.

name: Ältasjön Runt 2026
location: Älta IP, Älta, Nacka kommun, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Ältasjön Runt is a family-friendly running race organized by Älta IF and typically takes place on the last Saturday in April (2026: 25/4). The race offers several distances for all ages—from 850 m for the youngest to 13.4 km for those who want to run two laps around the lake. The aim is a local jamboree with a festival-like atmosphere at Älta IP where both seasoned runners as well as recreational beginners and children should enjoy themselves. Many participants return year after year, which the organizing committee regards as a sign of a pleasant event.
course_highlights: The course runs around Ältasjön - one lap is 7.2 km
Start and finish at Älta IP in connection with a festival-like event
Several distances: 850 m (children 3-7 years), 2.5 km (children 7-15 years), 7.2 km (1 lap) and 13.4 km (2 laps)
additional: The event is family-friendly: 850 m for 3-7 year-olds (no timing, medal for participants), 2.5 km for 7-15 year-olds (timing but no prizes). 7.2 km corresponds to one lap around the lake and 13.4 km two laps. The organizing committee invites to a local festival at Älta IP and many runners return annually. Registration is via the link on the page; 850 m: 3-7 years without timing; 2.5 km: 7-15 years with timing but without prize distribution; 7.2 km and 13.4 km: timed longer distances; gathering for the 7 km race at 11:30 at Älta IP; start window 12:15 - 13:30; the 7 km race will also be offered T-shirts in various sizes.

name: Lerumsloppet 2025
description: Lerumsloppet is a traditional spring race organized by Lerum Friidrott with several distances from 250 m up to 10 km, with the finish and competition center at Bagges Torg in Lerum. The race is described as hilly and spectator-friendly and suitable for both recreational runners and competitive runners. Start and bib distribution are centered around Brobacken/Bagges Torg and the organizer highlights good service with water stations, medical care, and changing and shower facilities in close proximity to the competition area. A welcoming text on the page invites registration via partner EQ Timing and to register early for a lower starting fee.
course_highlights: Hilly 10 km course with the steep 'Kyrkbacken' and a long ascent up toward Laggarns väg
Mixed surface: flat asphalt sections along Säveån/Aspen and gravel road around Stamsjön and Laggarns väg
Beautiful views along Säveån/Aspen and passes through picturesque residential and rural areas
additional: Start for all courses takes place at Brobacken next to the competition center at Bagges Torg. Bib numbers can be collected Friday evening (listed 17-20) at the municipal building on Bagges Torg or on the morning before the start from 09:30; race documents will also be sent by SMS/email (for example Friday 2/5 at 12:00 for later registrations). Changing and shower facilities are available in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset near the competition center (bib number shown at the reception). Approximately 55 course marshals and road stewards, as well as bike marshals and sweep cyclists, are used along the courses. Water stations: Vattenpalatset (~2.5 km / 0.8 km for the 1.6 km course), Laggarns väg (after ~5 km for the 10 km) and water directly after the finish. Medical tents are at the competition center and course officials carry first aid equipment. Lerumsloppet is a family-friendly festival with several distances for both children and adults, where start lists and information are available on the authorities' platforms and the official website.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varmt välkomna till Lerum och Lerumsloppet lördag 25 april 2026.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta Stadslopp, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests—the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown each year since its start in 2019. The competition format offers Sparbanksloppet 5 km (one lap possible) and 10 km (two laps) with finish inside Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizers emphasize speed, joy, and a pleasant event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run one or two laps (giving 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have set personal bests and several course records have been documented
additional: Bib pickup is inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally, subject to availability, up to 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens idrottsplats (Badhusvägen); the commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about an 850 m walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100–900 meters distance; Badhusvägen is closed off on race day. There is clothing drop-off (instruction to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities and toilets in connection to the arena. Sports drink (Umara) and water are available at the 5 km turnaround. A team competition on the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race set in a scenic environment by Landsjön lake in Kaxholmen outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages - 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults/youth as well as several children's classes including Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake with start and finish at Vistavallen, and musicians and water stations along the course contribute to the atmosphere. The event encourages both individual registration and four-person relay teams.
course_highlights: Road race in a scenic setting around Landsjön, start/finish at Vistavallen
Distances of 12.5 km and 5.5 km along the lake; the course is run clockwise, so climbs come early
Music along the course and aid stations for participants
additional: Parking at Vistavallen is available (recommendation to use public transport or park at Hunnerydsbadet); relay teams consist of four people who all run the same distance and the total time is reported; teams receive a bag from Rudenstams gårdsbutik; for a course record on 12.5 km a prize of 5,000 SEK goes to the runner's association; payment is via Swish to 123 429 98 22 and there is no automatic confirmation - you are registered if you have received a six-digit number and paid; IK Vista members participate for free if you register by 20 April (the site's text also mentions 19 April in one line); registration closes 25 April at 17:00, but registration on race day can take place at least one hour before if there is space; registration closes 25 April 17:00. Payment is made via Swish. An IK Vista member participates for free if you register by 20 April; write IK Vista as the club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is possible with a common goal/result.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics' running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels with both shorter recreational runs and technical trail options. The event offers a kids' class, recreational runs of 3 and 5 km and trail runs of 7 and 17 km, and welcomes both recreational runners and more experienced trail runners. The course mostly runs on smaller forest paths and includes sections of technical terrain with rocks, roots and steep hills, as well as several scenic portions. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several categories, and everyone who completes the race receives a medal.
course_highlights: Mostly on small forest trails, partly very technical with rocks, roots and steep hills
Several scenic sections along the course
17 km follows Gömmaren's black-and-white trails 'SKATAN'
additional: Date and location: April 26 at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Kids class 700 m at 11:00; Trail 17 km at 11:10; Recreational runs 3 and 5 km at 12:00; Trail 7 km at 12:00. Prizes: Trophy to the first woman and first man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km and Trail 7 km and 17 km; medals to all finishers. A large prize table from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva where the bib number functions as a lottery ticket; prize ceremony around 13:00; spot prizes and a medal for the kids' class directly after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Register by 19 April 2026; team discounts for at least 5 participants; bib numbers can be collected on race day; results list available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows nature trails along the river and passes a waterfall as well as a sea of wood anemones, and can be completed as running or walking. The organizers, OK Orion, welcome participants to a scenic off-road experience on April 26, 2026. The event focuses on an easy to moderately demanding course in a beautiful environment near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river with varied surfaces
Waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in springtime natural environment
additional: Booking is via the MittLopp link. Off-road running on trails in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
location: Graalstugan, Strömsnäsbruk, Ljungby kommun, Kronobergs län, Sverige
description: SK Graal invites you to Strömsnäs Trailrun, a trail race organized on 26 April 2026 with start and finish at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. The courses run mainly on trails and forest roads with sections of unpaved terrain in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd. The event is open to both competitors and recreational runners; timing is electronic with a chip and all finishers receive a medal. The race director and club inform continuously via SK Graal's website.
course_highlights: Mainly on trails and forest roads
Sections through the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd, with some unpaved parts
Road crossings occur – traffic rules apply
additional: Start and finish at Graalstugan. Pre-registration via the website no later than 23 April (payment can be made to bank giro 879-0545, mark with name and year of birth); late registration is accepted only on competition day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before each start, payment by Swish or cash. Late registration fees are listed differently on the site (+50 SEK and +60 SEK beyond the regular fee). Electronic timing with a chip in the bib number (to be returned at the finish). Prizes for 1st-3rd in each class, prize draws and a medal for all who complete; prize giving around 12:30. Limited changing and shower facilities; cafeteria available at the finish. Clubs registering more than 3 participants may send a registration list to info@skgraal.se and will be invoiced afterwards. Race director: Jonas Almarsson (phone and e-mail on the website). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; start times generally between 11:00 and 14:00; start lists and results published on the website; late registration accepted on competition day no later than 30 minutes before the start; changing/shower facilities are limited and a cafeteria is at the finish; participation at your own risk.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Uppsala - a community festival race to raise awareness of the vital blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and there is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for other target groups. The event is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott together with local blood centers and traditionally ends with a joint picnic. Registration is open and you can register individually or as a team.
course_highlights: The 10 km course will be officially measured.
Estimated length for 5 km: approx. 4,950 m
Estimated length for 2.5 km (Lilla Blodomloppet): approx. 2,440 m
additional: The 10 km course is measured; the other courses are not measured. Estimated course lengths: 5 km ≈ 4,950 m, 2.5 km ≈ 2,440 m. For mass registrations there is an Excel template that is imported in step 2 of the registration; contact uppsala@blodomloppet.se for help with the customer page or discount code. The blood centers in Uppsala can be reached at phone 018-611 41 00 and email blodcentralen@akademiska.se. The event traditionally ends with a joint picnic. Course layout: 10 km controlled course; other courses not controlled. Estimated lengths 5 km approx 4950 m, 2.5 km approx 2440 m. The blood donor gift is handed out at GeBlod's blood trailer. Dogs allowed in the walking category. Start at Gränby sports field near IFU Arena. Excel template for group registration is available. Contact: uppsala@blodomloppet.se. The run is part of a national collection and awareness around blood donation.

name: Vårruset — Norrköping
description: Vårruset i Norrköping is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and invites you to an evening in Himmelstalund with a start near Stadium Arena. The race is offered at 2.5 km or a measured 5 km course and suits both recreational runners and those who want to compete. Registration can be done individually or as a team (a team of five people will receive a picnic after finishing) and the organizer is Tjalve OK in Norrköping. Start time for the 2026 event is Tuesday, May 26, 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: Optional distance: 2.5 km or a measured 5 km
Start/finish area in Himmelstalund, next to Stadium Arena
Short, city-friendly routes suitable for recreational runners
additional: Registration includes a medal, finish bag, and bib; timing is offered as an option (the same price regardless of whether you choose timing or not). The team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing. Recommended ages: 13 years and up for the 5 km (in the company of an adult from 11 years), 11 years and up for the 2.5 km (in the company of an adult from 7 years). Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Contact for the local organizer: Tjalve OK (phone 0705-173173). Distances are 2.5 or 5 km; digital registration up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; after finishing the team is offered a picnic; event area at Himmelstalund; option to opt out of timing in the registration.

name: Trollhättan 5k - 2026
description: A warm welcome to Trollhättan 5K — a city race in Trollhättan held on an officially measured and fast course. The 2026 race is the fifth edition on the established course, where the course record is highly attractive for fast runners. The aim of the course is to offer a fast 5 km race that suits both those who want to prepare for longer competitions and those who want to perform their best at 5 km. The course layouts and invitation are published on the competition page.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Fast urban running course suitable for a personal best
Courses and the invitation are linked from the competition page (THN5K courses)
additional: Invitation: "Invitation Trollhättan 5K 2026 V1 260311" is published. PR (PR v1.0 250310) is provided and should be updated for 2026. The courses are shown via a link (THN5K courses) that opens in a new window. The date of the event is 2026-04-26. The race is conducted on a controlled 5 km course (THN5K courses) and aims to give runners good opportunities for fast times and a solid preparation for continued competition.

name: SpriT Frontyard - Staffanstorp (NY)
description: Welcome to SpriT Frontyard Staffanstorp on April 26, 2026. The race is a 1 km easy trail course (Light Trail) where participants run as many laps as they can on the Truckstigen in Staffanstorp. The course is 100% trail with small technical paths and no big hills. The first lap is estimated at 10 minutes, the second at 9:40, the third at 9:20, with the possibility of reaching a total of 20 km; water and soda are available at the turnaround and after the finish. Registration is via Sports Timing and spots are limited.
course_highlights: 1 km easy trail course (Light Trail)
Run as many laps as you can — up to about 20 km
100% trail with no big hills and small technical paths
additional: The course is a 1 km loop (Light Trail) on the Truckstigen; participants run as many laps as they can until the clock stops the race. The first lap 10 minutes, the second 9:40, the third 9:20; scaling up to a full 20 km is possible. Limited number of spots. Water, cola, and other refreshments are available at the turnaround and after the finish. Registration is binding after payment and participation is at your own risk; insurance is recommended.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a cross-country race in Northern Djurgården in Stockholm where you can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The courses offer beautiful forest terrain and technical sections along Fisksjöäng, with a start area at Norra Djurgårdsstaden. The race is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK and offers classic timing, a medal and finish-line services. Start times are 11:00 for the 5 km and 12:00 for the 10 km; age limits are 13 years (11 years with a guardian) for the 5 km and 15 years (13 years with a guardian) for the 10 km.
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trail through Northern Djurgården with natural terrain challenges
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Easily accessible by public transport (reachable from Ropsten; bike access near Stureplan)
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 11:00, age limit 13 years, 11 years with a guardian) and 10 km (start 12:00, age limit 15 years, 13 years with a guardian). Event area: Fisksjöäng, Norra Djurgårdsstaden. Medal, finish-area service, race bib with timing and fluids along the course. Registration is personal and can be completed digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: Swish, Visa/MasterCard, Klarna invoice. Start times: 5 km 11:00 (age limit 13 years, 11 years with a guardian) and 10 km 12:00 (age limit 15 years, 13 years with a guardian). Includes: medal, finish-area service, race bib with timing and fluids along the course; registration possible up to 1 hour before the first start.

name: Vårruset — Karlstad
location: Mellan Sundstagymnasiet och Sundstabadet, Karlstad, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and offers a pleasant spring evening with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km. The race takes place in the area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet and is suitable for those who want to walk, jog, or run. Registration can be made individually or as a team (team of five people gets a picnic after finish) and timing is optional in the registration. The event is locally organized by IF Göta Karlstad in cooperation with Vårruset/Marathongruppen.
course_highlights: Distance options 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is measured)
Event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet in Karlstad
Suitable for all levels - walk, jog, or run; timing is optional
additional: Includes a medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib number and (for those who opt for it) timing. Team registration (5 people) provides a picnic after finish; a team consists of five people and all team members can run different distances. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years in the company of an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years in the company of an adult). Registration is digital and can be done up until race day, at the latest 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IF Göta Karlstad, phone 054-21 23 27, address Johan Banérs väg 5, 653 48 Karlstad. The distance lies between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet; registration digital and binding no later than race day about 1 hour before the first start; age recommendation: 5 km 13 years (11 years in the company of an adult), 2.5 km 11 years (7 years in the company of an adult). Training sessions: 15 April and 6 May at 18:00 at Skutberget. Payment is by card only. In collaboration with Barncancerfonden as part of the Vårruset concept.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp
description: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp is an annual recreational event with start and finish in Bruksparken in Finspång, and offers a 7 km city loop through central parts of the city. The race welcomes walkers, joggers and runners of all ages and also includes AktivRundan (approximately 3.8 km) as well as the XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan for children. Participants receive a medal at the finish and the organizer offers energy products from sponsors. In 2026 the race celebrates its 10th anniversary, and the course is lined with crowds and music that pep up runners and spectators.
course_highlights: 7 km through central Finspång on a flat surface, lined with spectators and music
AktivRundan approximately 3.8 km without timing for those who want to walk or jog
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan children's run (approximately 1.7 km) with multiple starts from 17:00
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken. Bib number distribution takes place at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, May 26 from 15:00 to 19:00; bib numbers not collected there will be distributed at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The small tab on the bib is the chip - without it no time is registered. No shower facilities. Payment of the registration fee is done via a secure online payment solution; it is also possible to pay with Swish at bib pickup. Online late registration 18–25 May costs 395 SEK; late registration at bib pickups 26–27 May costs 425 SEK. Medal and energy products from sponsors are handed out at the finish. Start on May 27, 2026 at 19:00 in Bruksparken, XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan starts at 17:00 (four starts). Bib numbers are collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday May 26 15–19. At bib pickup you can also register and pay on site (Swish). The chip is registered via the tab at the top of the bib.

name: Vårruset (Örebro)
description: Vårruset i Örebro is an evening race at Gustavsviksbadet with the distances of 2.5 km and an officially measured 5 km course. The race welcomes both individual participants and teams - a team consists of five people and teams that sign up are invited to a picnic after the finish. Participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; timing is offered as an option in the registration and can be opted out. The event is family-friendly with recommended age limits per distance and a festive atmosphere with a music quiz and prizes.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Selectable distances: 2.5 km or 5 km
Event area at Gustavsviksbadet
additional: What is included for individual registration: a medal, a finish bag, timing (if selected) and bib. Team registration includes a picnic after the finish (team of five). Recommended age: 13+ for the 5 km (11+ when accompanied by an adult), 11+ for the 2.5 km (7+ when accompanied by an adult). Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. There is also a digital race (May 4 – June 4) where the medal is mailed home, but team registration is not possible for that option. EVENT AREA: at Gustavsviksbadet. Team consists of five people. Digital registration and the option to opt out of timing without price change. Any surplus goes 100% back to sport.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Borlänge – a welcoming recreational run where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in a walk or the Little Blodomloppet. The race is organized to raise awareness of life-saving blood donation and is run locally by Stora Tuna OK and Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott in cooperation with local blood centers. The event offers both individual registrations and team registrations (3–5 people), with teams receiving a picnic bag. On-site there is a simple kiosk, water stations and prizes/medals for participants.
course_highlights: Running loops for 5 km and 10 km go north over the Sports Field and split at Storsvängen
The walking loop leads down toward central Borlänge and ends at the fruit and medal boards (no finish line arch)
The Little Blodomloppet is about 800 m and runs in the area around the event site
additional: Registration can be done individually or as a team (3–5 people); team participants may run different distances. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person. Late registration for individual participants is possible in the system until May 28 at 12:00 and on competition day at the arena from 15:00 to 17:00 (Swish only). Bib number distribution/changes are offered at Friskis&Svettis (Skomakargatan 9) on May 24 from 13:00 to 16:00. A simple kiosk is available at the event area (Swish only). Organizers: Stora Tuna OK and Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott (tel: 070-7541610). Team with picnic bag; blood donor discount 40 kr per person; Swish at late registration; start times around 17:00; warm-up at 16:45 with Friskis&Svettis; includes a functional t-shirt, bib number and medal.

description: The Värmlandsstafetten in Karlstad is a two-hour relay where teams of 5–15 participants pass the baton around Sundstatjärn on a flat loop course approximately 1,270–1,300 meters long. The race starts at 18:00 and the goal is to transport the baton to the finish within two hours, at the arena in Karlstad, with start and finish at the arena. Teams decide how many laps each person runs and exchange after each lap; in the first year a logo relay baton is purchased that stays with the team each year. Register your team and take part in a social, health-promoting evening as you contribute to community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Sundstatjärn, about 1,270–1,300 meters per lap
Team competition for 5–15 participants with baton exchanges after each lap and two hours on site at the arena
Start and finish at the arena; option to order a logo relay baton that follows the team
additional: The course runs around Sundstatjärn, around 1,270 meters per lap (just under 1,300 meters), asphalt. Team tents and parking at the arena/Sundstabadet. Start/finish at the arena; two hours to transport the baton to the finish. The course goes around Sundstatjärn in Karlstad and the lap measures approximately 1,270 meters. Each team consists of at least 5 and a maximum of 15 participants, and the start is at 18:00 with two hours to transport the baton.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: Get a taste of the unique marathon atmosphere by running the adidas Shake Out Run. The race is 5 km and starts and finishes at Stockholm Stadium. It is the perfect warm-up for you who will run the marathon the day after, but also a chance for those who are not running the marathon to experience the event weekend. The first 1,000 registered participants are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
Perfect warm-up for the marathon
additional: The first 1,000 registered participants are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt in the chosen size (the T-shirt will be handed out in connection with the race; others can register on-site at the information desk to see remaining sizes). Age limit 13 years (11 years if accompanied by a parent/guardian). Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the first start and is done digitally via the regular registration page. Payment options: online banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish or Klarna invoice. Registration is binding and the registration fee is non-refundable. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. Part of the Stockholm Marathon weekend; start and finish at Stockholm Stadium; minimum age 13 years (11 years with a guardian); the registration fee is binding.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö Stadslopp is a festival in Eksjö's timber town held on Friday, May 29, 2026. The race offers 10 km, a 5 km leisure run, and children's and youth races at 1000 m and 600 m, with finish at Stora Torget in the city center. The course runs through historic quarters and is measured/certified for both the 10 km and 5 km. Proceeds go to Eksjö Södra IK's children's and youth activities.
course_highlights: Run through Eksjö's historic timber town
Certified courses for 10 km and 5 km
Finish at Stora Torget in the city center
additional: Bib numbers can be picked up at Snäckan (next to the swimming hall). Pick-up: Thursday, May 28 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Friday, May 29 from 14:00; changing facilities in Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Course maps are available to pick up at Snäckan. Medal for all finishing the 600 m or 1000 m; plaque for all finishing the 5 km or 10 km. Sprint prize in the 10 km after about 1.2 km (first man and woman; must finish the race). Group registration by invoice via tavling.esik@gmail.com. Regular registration open until May 23, 2026; late registration from May 24 with increased fee and possible until up to one hour before the respective start via the same registration link. Proceeds go to the club's youth and children's activities. Registration via mittlopp.se; late registration from May 24 with increased fee; group registration by invoice via tavling.esik@gmail.com. Bib numbers can be picked up at Snäckan (by the swimming hall). Courses are certified for both long and short distances.

name: Helsingborg Night Run
description: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run is an evening run along the city’s promenade offering both 5 km and 10 km on a fast, flat and spectator-friendly course. Start and finish are at Gröningen, and the race is built for both speed and festivity with music, lights and a strong after-run atmosphere. The event is aimed at both runners chasing personal records and participants who want to experience an energetic running evening in Helsingborg.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Gröningen, running along Helsingborg's Strandpromenad with sea views
Fast and almost completely flat course (5 km: 2 m total elevation gain, 10 km: 4 m total elevation gain)
Surface: approx. 90% asphalt, 8% hard-packed gravel, 2% grass
additional: Bib pickup is available at Löplabbet in Helsingborg Wednesday–Friday from 10:00–18:00 or on-site at the start/finish area from 20:00. Bag storage opens at 20:00 and is labeled with a sticker in the envelope. Löplabbet pacers are on-site with the indicated pace setters for both the 5 km and 10 km. After Run offers products from partners (including Lindahls kvarg, Ramlösa, non-alcoholic Erdinger, Dole products) and an official afterparty with special prices at Culise. The event is certified as a World Athletics Road Race 2026 and the number of start positions is 1500; participants receive an exclusive gold medal. Distance options: 5 km or 10 km. Night run with music and lights in the city’s nighttime scenes. You can choose between timed or untimed. For corporate registration and invoicing there is a downloadable Excel file via the registration page. Results, start lists and photos are available on the website.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: The Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland, starting at the Långe Erik lighthouse. The competition options are 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km, and the course features coastal stretches, meadow and forest sections, as well as alvar landscapes with views over the Baltic Sea. The race is organized by Högby IF and offers a medal and a T-shirt to all finishers. Information, PM, maps and GPX files are published on the participants' competition page.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik lighthouse and a coastal stretch along Kalmar Sound
Alvar landscapes with views of the Baltic Sea, as well as meadow and forest areas
Finish points: 50 km in Djupvik, 50 miles in Lindby, 100 miles at the Långe Jan lighthouse
additional: Medal and a T-shirt to all finishers; hydration stations/energy depots approximately every 20 km; PM, detailed maps and GPX file published (PM updated 2026-03-13, maps updated 2026-03-12); labels for drop bags available; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand (enter "Lighthouse Challenge"); late registration until May 27, subject to availability and the possibility to pick up bibs/registration on Friday from 13:30; payment at late registration/kiosk: cash, card or Swish. 15% discount on Böda Sand accommodation over the weekend (enter Lighthouse Challenge when booking). Registration by May 22, 2026; thereafter, availability until May 27. Late registration fees: 100 miles 1590 kr, 50 miles 1090 kr, 50 km 690 kr.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
location: Markaryd, Markaryds Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: The Sparbanksloppet in Markaryd is organized by Markaryds FK in collaboration with Markaryds Sparbank and SK Graal. The race takes place in central Markaryd and is offered in three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 1.6 km. The news post describes the race as recurring and refers to the organizer's and Sparbank's information page for more information and registration. The information on the association's page is brief and refers to an external page for the complete invitation and registration.
course_highlights: The course runs in central Markaryd
Three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 1.6 km
Organized in collaboration with Markaryds Sparbank and SK Graal
additional: The news post refers to Sparbanksloppet's information and registration page on Markaryds Sparbanks website. Results and photos from Sparbanksloppet 2025 are linked via SK Graal. The club lists its mailing address (Snapphanestigen 10, 285 34 Markaryd) and that the clubhouse is located at Ola Mårtens väg 2. New for the year: free membership in 2026 for all youths. Part of the Sparbanks jubileumsprogram 2025; Sparbanksloppet is planned in connection with the spring market in Markaryd; a portion of the proceeds goes to clubs that participate or organize.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: adidas Stockholm Marathon is the city race that offers a new course through central Stockholm with a start at Östermalms IP. The course is 42,195 meters long and measured in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Federation and the IAAF. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport. The website contains participant information, course maps, and information about runner services along the course.
course_highlights: Start on Lidingövägen next to Östermalms IP
The course is 42,195 meters long and measured in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Federation and the IAAF
Passes Odengatan and Sveavägen as well as landmarks such as Gunnar Asplund's City Library; world-class runner services along the course
additional: The website states that the event is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and that any surplus goes back to sport; contact via customer service 08-545 66 440 (Tue-Thu 9-15). Course profile, kilometer-by-kilometer description, and participant information are available as a PDF on the site; the organizer highlights 'world-class runner service' along the course. On the main page there is also a notice that the event in 2026 is sold out. Any surplus goes back to sport; number of starters around 20 000 - 25 000 and 25 000 registered according to press releases (figures vary between sources).

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: BUM Borås Ultramarathon is an ultramarathon in Borås organized by SOK Knallen. The race offers three distances - 50 km, 21 km and 10 km - with start and finish at Kypegården in Borås. The organizers state that the competition follows a Backyard Ultra-like format, which provides a unique racing format for runners at different levels. The race has existed since 2012 and has since 2018 been run by SOK-Knallen; the 2026 edition is planned for April 30 in Borås.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Kypegården in Borås
Distances of 50 km, 21 km and 10 km
Backyard Ultra-like format
additional: SOK Knallen lists no e-mail addresses on the contact page, but provides payment details: Plusgiro 38 64 13 9 and Swish 123 671 50 49. The association also organizes Borås 6-hour (a 1,892 m loop; packed gravel with about 30 m of asphalt; almost flat) and Knallen's Backyard Ultra (start interval announced 08:00 - 19:00). In the PM for Borås 6-hour, the race directors are Torbjörn Svensson 0703 - 15 26 70 and Lars Karlsson 0709 - 66 46 92. Club address: SOK Knallen C/O Lars Karlsson, Åsbogatan 20, 50456 Borås. Behind the race is SOK Knallen; the event focuses on runners at different levels and has historically been seen as part of the Borås ultrarunning scene. The 2024 PM and earlier posts mention updated details and the organizers' guidelines.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on May 1, 2026 - a running festival for the whole family with distances from children's races up to the half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. Start and finish are in Strandbjörket with the start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; the course features both forest paths through the scenic Bokhultet and asphalt sections around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run as two laps on largely the same course, which provides variation and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course that passes Bokhultet (mostly deciduous forest) and transitions to a forest road after the first kilometer
Final approx. 3.5 km are asphalt around Växjösjön with a finish on Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and several children’s distances in Lilla Växjöloppet (no individual timing for the children's races). The 21.1 km is run as two laps (first lap a little over 11 km, second lap 10 km). Water stations: on the 10 km there are four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km and 6.5 km); on 21.1 km there are opportunities for fluids eight times (e.g., 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, 16.5 km). Lilla Växjöloppet: participants in certain children's races receive bib number, medal and fruit; Tidningslöpet provides a T-shirt and a diploma. It is possible to use a wellness subsidy for the registration (registration via mittlopp.se and the receipt is used toward the employer's wellness subsidy). Team competition exists; starting lists and participant information are available on the official website. The distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet; water stations along the course (4 on the 10 km; up to 8 water stops on 21.1 km); Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and the tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; the finish closes at 14:30.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat and fast course through the city's heart and the beautiful Mälaren shores. The course is a loop where you run 10 km per lap. 
Experience running joy in a well-organized race for all levels.

The race is intended for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elites. All ages and paces are welcome, and we will provide ample time to complete the race.

A warm welcome!
course_highlights: Flat and fast course along Mälaren's shore with little elevation variation
Passes Lögarängsbadet, Aseatornet, Turbinhuset, Isbrytaren, The Steam Hotel, Friidrottshallen and the graffiti wall
The race runs counterclockwise with a twisty tunnel section and the steepest hill about 400 m from the start
additional: Bib pickup and bag drop-off opens from 07:00 in the City Hall restaurant. Water stations: 2 at 10 km, 4 at the half marathon and 8 at the marathon; water and sports drink (Umara) offered along the course. Toilets are at the start on Fiskartorget and public toilets after about 2 km and 9 km. The Central Station is about 300 m from the start/finish; parking is available in the city and several parking garages. Starts can be held in groups/waves (e.g., 21k-A 10:00, 21k-B 10:05). Access to seedings for the Stockholm Marathon, timing with C-time, pacers (including virtual pacers for 3 h, 3.5 h and 4 h; contact for other pacers), start around 09:00, planned finish 16:30 with a maximum of 7 h 30 m. The roads pass by Lögarängsbadet and other Västerås landmarks; water stations: 2 at 10 km, 4 at the half marathon and 8 at the marathon. A children’s run in Vasaparken is also mentioned in sources.

images.alt_text: Affisch för Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare och en glad gurka.
Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare, publik och stadssilhuett.
Västerås Marathon logotyp med löpare och en gurka.

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Rolfstorp, Varbergs kommun, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Welcome to Pop up Run Åkulla beech forests - a guided run of 15-17 km through the magical beech forest landscape near Åkulla. We will run past small lakes, Bexell's 'speaking' stones, and through dense beech forest, in 2-3 pace groups so that everyone can keep up. After the run we finish with a locally produced picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café. We recommend carpooling and can help coordinate this.
course_highlights: Running in Åkulla's beech forest
Passing by small, cozy lakes
Bexell's 'speaking' stones along the course
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. Distance 15-17 km with 2-3 different pace groups. Picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café included in the price. The organizer recommends carpooling and offers help coordinating. Carpooling is recommended and can be coordinated; picnic/meal at Öströö Fårfarm Café after the run

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen in Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with fundraising for #Run4Diabetes. The race runs on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken with mixed terrain and a new start every full hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next lap. The event offers an energy station, medal, goodie bag and organizer support throughout the competition. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop course around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed surface: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads and paved walking/cycling paths
A steep uphill at Örnberget and a lit trail along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens on August 1. Name changes can be made until 2026-04-17 for a fee of 150 SEK (done via info@runraisers.com with the new participant's details). Bib-number distribution will take place on Thursday, April 30. Race format: common start every full hour; those who do not complete the loop within 1 hour are out. The registration fee includes an energy station, race photos, a medal and a goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity run in support of Run4Diabetes; 20% of the registration fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; includes aid station, medal, race photos, goodie bag and prizes for the winners.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail race in scenic areas around Vessigebro, with start and finish at Gurkbänken on Brovallen. The race offers adult distances of 5 km and 10 km as well as several children’s classes (1,000 m and 2,000 m). The start times are family-friendly: children's start at 10:00, adult start at 11:00, and participants with dogs start in waves from 11:30. Registration is via the RaceID app/website or by emailing the organizer according to the information on the page.
course_highlights: The race runs on trails and in forests in scenic areas around Vessigebro.
Start and finish at Gurkbänken at Brovallen in central Vessigebro.
Adult distances of 5 km and 10 km; children's classes of 1,000 m and 2,000 m.
additional: Children's start 10:00. Adult start 11:00 for participants without dogs; participants with dogs start in waves at 1-minute intervals from 11:30. It is allowed to start with a dog - send a message to contact@hallandsloppet.se for registration in the dog start. Registration can be done via the RaceID app or website, or by email with personal details if you do not want a RaceID profile. Registration via RaceID; a Facebook post mentions that the entry fee will be raised shortly.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund organized by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course that mostly runs on narrow trails in the beautiful Småland landscape—through dark, fairy-tale forests, along lakes, and over long escarpments with fast downhill running. There are categories for men and women at 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children's race of about 1 km. Everyone is welcome to sign up until race day; the children's race is free and awards a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails in Småland countryside
Through dark, fairy-tale forests and along lakes
Long escarpments and fast downhill running
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. Registration is via email to sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com and payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration can be done on-site on race day. The children's race is about 1 km; all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish; a parent may accompany the child around. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 record number of participants about 45; 2024 women's course record on 26 km 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children's race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
location: Karlsrofältet, Linnéplatsen, Botaniska Trädgården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a 12.5 km trail race in Gothenburg's Änggårdsbergen nature reserve, organized by Språng Träning & Äventyr. The one-lap format offers technical trails, climbs and several viewpoints—a true trail race in the middle of the city. The race suits both those who want to push themselves and those who want to enjoy nature; start and finish are at Karlsrofältet near Linnéplatsen/Botaniska trädgården. The organizers welcome participants with a focus on adventure and nature-based experiences.
course_highlights: Technical trails, hills and fast descents
Varied surfaces: soft, bare and moss-covered trails, as well as shorter gravel sections
Several viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg, in a nature reserve in the middle of the city
additional: Start and finish at Karlsrofältet (about 300 m from Linnéplatsen/Botaniska Trädgården). Seeding in three start groups: 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. Bib numbers can be collected from 09:30 on race day; race numbers are also sent via SMS on Friday. Trail shoes with a sturdy sole are recommended; spikes are forbidden. A water station is available about halfway along the course and after the finish; energy partner Moonvalley provides sports drinks and bars. Wooden medal inspired by Vitsippsdalen. Possibility to change name/transfer start position via Eq-Timing for 100 kr (name change/transfer no later than 27/4). Practice runs offered (21 March: hill technique; 12 April: practice run of the whole course). Start and finish at Karlsrofältet near Linnéplatsen/Botaniska Trädgården. Start groups at 11:00 - 11:03 - 11:06. Trail shoes with a sturdy sole are recommended; spike shoes forbidden. Bib numbers collected from 09:30 in the event area at Karlsrofältet. Medal for all participants. Water station roughly halfway. Moonvalley as energy partner. Medical personnel in the finish area. Transfer of start position via Eq-Timing for 100 kr. Transport: tram to Linnéplatsen/Botaniska Trädgården; bus to Linnéplatsen. Parking around Slottsskogen; avoid parking in the Änggården residential area. Children from 8 years old may run with a guardian; the guardian is responsible for the child.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a light and fast loop course in central Trosa where each lap is 6.706 km and the race continues as long as participants complete the lap within an hour. The start takes place on May 2, 2026 at 10:00, and the concept follows the Backyard format: those who complete a lap within an hour get to start again until only one participant remains. The race is public and family-friendly with Mini-TUB for children (start 12:15) and prize ceremonies for the top three in the men's and women's classes. The organizer offers sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches at the loop, and ongoing raffles during the race.
course_highlights: 6.706 km lap (full-length course)
Runs mostly along the Trosa River and is very flat and easy (approximately <10 meters of elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: about a 700 m course for children (Mini-TUB follows the main course for 700 m before diverging)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on the Facebook page Trosa Ultra Backyard; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition where the three top results from each club are counted (the club with the three top results gets 20% off next year); tent spaces outside the start pen; limited motorhome spots; no caravan spots; food and energy support at the meals (candy, sports drink, fruit) and Selfie Corner after the race; free silicone mug from Umara for all participants in the main race.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly trail race at Nordens Ark, organized in collaboration with IK Granit. The courses suit all levels—from 1 km for the youngest to a challenging 30 km for the most enduring—and wind through Ekoparken. The race is highlighted as a festival for both participants and spectators where you can enjoy the park's scenic surroundings and the arrival of spring. Warmly welcome to Nordens Ark TrailRun - see you at the start line!
course_highlights: Courses winding through Ekoparken (forest terrain around Åby säteri)
Routes for all levels: from 1 km up to 30 km
Scenic views and a springtime atmosphere in Nordens Ark's surroundings
additional: Organizer: IK Granit in collaboration with Nordens Ark. Location: Nordens Ark / Åby säteri (Zooliden). The event is described as a festival for participants and spectators. Park entrance tickets are purchased on site (see Nordens Ark's opening hours and prices). Courses from 1 km to 30 km through Ekoparken; the organizer IK Granit is behind the competition; paralympic-style classes are available.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://nordensark.se/besok-oss/trailrun/): 2026-05-02 — "Lördagen den 2 maj går den femte upplagan av Nordens Ark Trailrun" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners, and families. In 2026, a half marathon (competitive and recreational classes) as well as 10 km and 5 km recreational races are offered, and this year's edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. A joint start takes place at 13:00 at the respective starting locations and the finish is at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is marketed as a competition in beautiful Swedish nature and also offers the option of team registration.
course_highlights: The race runs along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
A scenic stretch in beautiful Swedish nature along the canal route
additional: Transport: a bus is arranged from Borensberg to the respective starting locations (half marathon to Ljungsbro, 10 km to Sjöbacka, 5 km to Brunneby) and booked/paid in connection with registration (no transport is offered after finish; space may be available on race day). The bus fee on the registration pages is listed as 100 SEK. Team registration: a team consists of 5 runners, all in the same class; price per runner is 20% lower than individual registration and team registration can only be done online. Bib numbers are collected at the respective starting locations. Registration is valid only after payment has been received; if payment has not arrived within 10 days, the registration will be canceled. A PM with more details will come later. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka Bridge, 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; bus to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bank giro; late registration between 11:30 - 12:30 with price increase; bib numbers collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organized by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the competition in Säter. On the club's website there is an invitation with the course layout, the race program and start list as well as results lists from previous years. The information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in news. The club urges participants to review the race program before the competition.
course_highlights: Course layout published (see invitation/course layout)
Race program and start list available on the event page
Results lists from 2025 and earlier years are published
additional: The invitation, course layout, PM and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results lists from earlier years are collected. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration. Official hashtag for the association: #sätersfriidrott. Contact via the club's office (siffriidrott@telia.com) and responsible web contacts are listed on the contact page. In the 2024 results lists for SäterMaran there are entries for the half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions as well as various age groups, which indicates that both distances may be offered within the race.

name: Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen i Halmstad, Sweden
description: Vårruset Halmstad will be held on May 6, 2026 at the Civila flygfältet near Aleskogen in Halmstad. The event offers the distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured and timing included. A medal, a finish bag and a bib are included for individual participation, while team registrations include a picnic after the finish as well as a medal and a Vårruset music quiz/prizes. Registration is digital and the last day to register is race day, no later than one hour before the first start; age recommendations follow the distances and adult accompaniment. Vårruset is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with several athletics clubs; the event emphasizes an inviting, family-friendly atmosphere with the possibility to socialize afterwards.
course_highlights: 2.5 or 5 km course at the Civila flygfältet near Aleskogen
Timing on the 5 km, plus medal and bib
Team registration with a picnic after finish, plus Vårruset music quiz and prizes
additional: Digital registration; last registration day is the same day as the race, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Age recommendations: 5 km up to 13 years (11 years with an adult); 2.5 km up to 11 years (7 years with an adult). Team registration provides extra benefits such as a picnic after the finish. A team of 5 people is offered a picnic after finishing; all registrations include a medal and a finish bag. Timing for the 5 km is optional (can be opted out) and registration can be done no later than race day, 1 hour before the first start.

name: Avloppet
location: Sobacken Energi- och Miljöcenter, Borås, Sweden
description: Avloppet is a 5 km short race held in conjunction with Kretsloppet in Borås and carried out in cooperation with Borås Energi och Miljö. Registration and payment take place directly on the organizer's website up to race day, and Svenska Friidrottsförbundet's rules apply. The field is limited (max 150 participants) and the organizer offers optional chip timing. Event information and confirmation are sent to the email address you provide at registration.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with a hilly gravel course
A unique theme where the course runs out toward the sewer pipes to Sobacken Energi- och Miljöcenter
Limited field (max 150 participants) with parking at Sobacken
additional: Chip timing is available as an option; if the chip is not returned, a 200 SEK charge applies. Results are published on Kretsloppet's website and parking is available at Sobacken.

name: VAIS-loppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Loppet är gratis för medlemmar i Växjö AIS.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: För dig som inte är medlem är anmälningsavgiften 50 kronor.

description: VAIS-loppet is a nice cross-country race in the Fylleryd nature reserve organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km, where the long course follows much of the Trestugespåret and becomes hilly toward the end, while the short one follows elljusspåret. A common start for both courses is at VAIS-torpet at 18:30, and the event ends with fika. The race is free for members of Växjö AIS; for non-members the registration fee is 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
The long course (8.4 km) follows much of the Trestugespåret and is especially hilly toward the end
The short course (4.4 km) follows the elljusspåret, and both courses finish with a long climb up to VAIS-torpet
additional: The information memo will be published on April 28; a map and course profile are available as a PDF; registration opens via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event ends with fika at VAIS-torpet. Trail race in the Fyllerydsskogen with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the participation fee.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women's running event organized by Marathongruppen in Uppsala on May 7, 2026. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. Participants can register as individuals or as part of a team of five, and timing can be omitted if you prefer a simpler experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are treated to a picnic, and the sense of community is central.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Team registration (five people) or individual participation with an option to choose timing
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; digital registration; early registrations encouraged; teams consist of five people; after the finish, a picnic is provided for the team. Distance options 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km is measured); start and finish at Studenternas IP. Team registrations (teams of 5) include a picnic after the finish; registration can be made up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start, and timing can be omitted.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset Vänersborg is part of Sweden's largest women's fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 7, 2026, with start and finish at Sanden along the Vassbottenleden. Participants can choose 2.5 km or a measured 5 km course; timing is optional when registering. Team registrations of five people include a picnic after finishing, making the event social and family-friendly. The event is offered by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Vänersborgs SK and targets recreational runners of all ages according to the recommended age limits.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden)
Selectable distances: 2.5 km or measured 5 km course
Nice team spirit - picnic after finishing for teams of 5
additional: What's included (individual registration): medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing for those who chose it, and bib number. For team registrations (5 people): picnic after finishing, medal, goody bag, timing (if chosen) and bib number. Recommended age: 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years with an accompanying adult); 5 km: 13 years (11 years with an accompanying adult). Registration is digital and can be done up to race day (latest 1 hour before the first start). Contact via Vänersborgs SK: varruset.vbg@gmail.com; Vårruset main switchboard: +46 8 545 66 440 (Tue - Thu 09:00 - 15:00). The surface is partially asphalted and partially gravel, both flat and easily passable. Distance option: 2.5 km or 5 km (measured 5 km course). For individual registrations, medal and goody bag plus music quiz/prizes; for team registrations, picnic after finishing, medal and goody bag. Digital registration is available up to race day, at least 1 hour before the first start.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is Hand in Hands' running initiative where every kilometer is linked to the work to fight poverty, with a special focus on women's entrepreneurship in Kenya. The initiative functions both as a virtual running journey where participants log kilometers in a shared Strava club and as a way to raise visibility for the organization's work during larger running events. You can participate anytime and anywhere - run, walk or cycle - and thereby contribute to fundraising and the spread of knowledge. The initiative often culminates in a final in conjunction with the Stockholm Marathon, where Run for Change is showcased at the expo and in the race.
course_highlights: Virtual distance – run whenever and wherever you want
Join the organization's Strava Club where every kilometer counts
Final and visibility through the Stockholm Marathon (previous finals have been held there)
additional: Participation is flexible – you can run, walk, or cycle and log your kilometers in a shared Strava club; Run for Change uses a temporary tattoo as a symbol and has previously had a booth at the Stockholm Marathon expo; the initiative aims both to fundraising and to spreading knowledge about Hand in Hands' work with women's entrepreneurship. Virtual run with Strava Club; fundraising and awareness around entrepreneurship as well as support for Hand in Hands' work in Kenya; the final has previously taken place in connection with the Stockholm Marathon

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early-Bird pris fram tills 31 december 2025: 275 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: OBS! Early-Bird pris fram tills 31 december 2025: 145 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift: 195 kronor fram tills onsdag 29 april.

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly fun run with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town, there is also KyrkRundan of about three kilometres and a free children's race. The event offers music and activities along the course and is a local folk festival that encourages walking, jogging and running. A warm welcome to a day of movement, sociability and joy on Saturday, 9 May 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometres with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the course runs close to Svartån
99 percent asphalt; a few challenging uphill sections and the last kilometre through central Mjölby toward Gästisparken
additional: Bib numbers are picked up at Intersport Friday 8 May 12:00–18:00 (discount coupon 25% at pickup). Bib numbers not picked up will be distributed at Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The topmost tab on the bib is the chip - without it no time is recorded. Late registration runs 30 April – 7 May via the website and can also take place at the bib distribution on 8 May or in Stadsparken on 9 May (Swish only). Warm-up is handled by Fitness4You; the event offers refreshments from, among others, ICA Supermarket Mjölby and water/sports drink from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. The number of participants has been high previously, with 1,074 runners mentioned in reports about the event; registration for 2026 opens and results as well as record descriptions are published by the organizing media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred that runs along Lake Hulingen on a nice, flat course. A 10 km course is offered for adults and two children's distances are available, and the organizers welcome both club and recreational runners. Children can also sign up for the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizers refer to the PM on the competition page.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children's races
Friendly, family-oriented race atmosphere at Herrstorpet
additional: The children's race starts at 10:00 and the 10 km starts at 11:00. You do not need to belong to any club to participate. The organizers refer to a PM for more information. The children's race starts at 10:00 according to the program; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet's new-build day with dressin cycling, guided tours and a concert in the morning.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a running race on Kungsholmen in Stockholm offering the half marathon and 10 km distances. The event is described as a festival, and the courses are flat and fast, suitable for those looking to try to beat their personal best. The website provides information about the course, a course map, as well as details about the start/finish area and a children's race.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course suitable for personal bests
Distance options: half marathon and 10 km
Course map available; the course runs around Kungsholmen and there is also a kids' race
additional: The website includes a course map, information about the start/finish area and offers a children's race for kids. Start and finish at Rålambshovsparken; the distances are 10 km and the half marathon; membership discount on the registration fee; registration via a link.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra is a completely new running and relays event taking place on May 9, 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden between Gothenburg and Alingsås — both individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km) where the legs vary from about 4.5 to 12 km. The courses feature varied terrain and beautiful nature, and the finish in Nolhaga Park will be a festive finale with prize ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event caters to everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden between Gothenburg and Alingsås, featuring beautiful nature and industrial heritage sites.
Varying surfaces: trails, gravel and asphalt.
The ultramarathon has a substantial total ascent (approximately 1,403 m) and peaks at around 185 m above sea level.
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from 14 years, Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from 17 years. Relay 75 consists of 9 legs (2-9 runners per team) with legs of 4.5-12 km; Relay 35 has 4 legs (2-4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, surfaces asphalt/gravel/trail, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage starts are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start via registration. Finish in Nolhaga Park offers prize ceremony, food, showers and After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and in Floda (Garveriet) for the sprint, with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, a finish party and After Run await, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 in preparation for the competition weekend.

name: Koster Trail
location: Kosterhavets Ekobod, Västra Bryggan, Nordkoster, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race in Kosterhavet National Park, taking place this year on Saturday, May 9, 2026, and celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race is held on Nordkoster and offers Bohuslän cliffs, sandy beaches, trails and several magical viewpoints along a roughly 15 km course. After finishing, a recovery with a salt bath and food awaits at Kosterhavets Ekobod. The race is organized by Kosterhavets Ekobod in cooperation with local actors and has a limited number of starting spots (200).
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km along the coast on Nordkoster (trails, sandy beaches and cliffs)
Technically challenging course with sections of stones and cliffs and many viewpoints
Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan; two hydration stations along the course
additional: Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod at Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. The course is aligned with Kosterhavet National Park and the race has only 200 starting spots. Two hydration stations serve water and the sports drink U Sport from Umara. Bib numbers can be picked up Friday May 8 from 18:00-20:00 or race day from 10:00. After the finish, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and beer from Qvänum bryggeri are served. No shower facilities at the finish; bag storage is available at start/finish. Participants need accident and liability insurance. Travel and accommodation tips are linked on the race page. Maximum 200 starting spots; Age limit 18+; Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster; After the race pizza and fine beer are served; Hydration stations along the course; Registration opens January 10, 2026 at 10:00 via RaceID; Results via RaceID.

name: BUGGIS BACKYARD ULTRA 12h
description: Buggis Backyard Ultra 12H is a 12-hour backyard ultra held in Buggamåla, Holmsjö. The course runs on nicely marked trails through forests and along gravel roads; the course is flat but technically challenging with scrub, roots and stones. The run offers scenic views of lakes and is organized by Karlskrona Judoklubb.
course_highlights: Nicely marked trails through forests
Flat but technically challenging course with roots, stones, scrub, and gravel roads
Fantastic views of lakes and a nature-rich environment free of background noise
additional: Organizer: Karlskrona Judoklubb (contact via email). The course is marked and runs on trails and gravel roads; the surface is technically with roots and stones and offers scenic lake views. Date: 2026-05-09; Location: Buggamåla 114, Holmsjö, Sweden.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: The Åstöloppet Trail is a welcoming trail run through Åstöns Nature Reserve, with the event on May 9, 2026. The event offers four distances (1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km) and features a mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-road terrain. Start and finish are at Skeppshamn, and the race promises a scenic finish by the sea, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The organizer is Tynderö IK and the race director can be reached via the provided contact address.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km
A mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-road terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn with coastal views in Åstöns Nature Reserve
additional: Date: May 9, 2026. Distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, 14 km. Start and finish at Skeppshamn in Åstöns Nature Reserve. Race director Linus can be reached via race.tyndero@gmail.com. The event debuted in 2025 and results from 2025 are published on the page. The distances for Åstöloppet Trail are 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. The terrain consists of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-road terrain along Åstöns Nature Reserve. Start and finish at Skeppshamn; registration is via the link on the organizer's page.
