description: Kolmårdstrailen is a hilly, experience-focused trail run in the scenic Kolmården, featuring technical trails, rocky outcrops, and many meters of elevation gain. You can choose between courses of about 21 km, 11 km, and 6 km (as well as a 500 m children's course). The course is described as challenging but nature-close - passing, among other things, Rödgölens nature reserve and offering fine views from Kolmården's highest point (171 m above sea level). The organizers emphasize the experience and provide services such as a water station and the option to download GPX data for your GPS watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with many elevation gains and rocky slabs
Passes Rödgölen nature reserve and Ågelsjön; Kolmården's highest point (171 m above sea level) with views
Narrow trails and singletracks, a wooden bridge over marshy areas, a rope at 'koklämman', and a final tough, partly unpaved kilometer
additional: Regular registration is open through May 3; online late registration until May 6 and then on-site (race day) 09:00 - 11:00, payment in cash or via Swish. GPX data for the courses can be downloaded. There is a water station after approximately 7.5 km at the Scout hut. A children's race of about 500 m is available for children up to 10 years old. For Kolmården Night Trail: bring a headlamp, the course is marked with reflectors, no shower facilities and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as an add-on. Kolmården runs in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 meters of elevation gain), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km) and Luciatåget (7.5 km). There is a results page, and several distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organized by Östhammars Friidrott and takes place on Saturday, May 9, 2026 with a start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club's competition page and targets local runners and participants in the surrounding area. When registering, the necessary contact information is collected for competition administration and results publication, and images from the event may be used in the club's channels.
course_highlights: Starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club informs that contact details provided at registration are used for competition contact and that name, age and results may be stored for result lists and competition statistics. Images from the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request removal. Club membership 2026 is handled via Svenska Lag. The website contains the start list, registration and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a relaunch of the classic Silverlöpet, organized in cooperation with SHE. The race runs through Sala city center and in beautiful surroundings with start and finish in Stadsparken. You can choose 10 km (officially measured), 5 km, or a 2 km children's race - the race is open to everyone and presented as a festival with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Through Sala city center and around Sala's beautiful surroundings
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course is officially measured (official measurement)
additional: Registration is via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is valid until the beginning of May; on-site registration on 9/5 (5 - 10 km: 08:00 - 09:00, children 2 km: 08:00 - 09:15). Prizes and prize distribution: medal for all participants; prizes for 1st-3rd in the women's and men's 10 km; raffles for the 5 km. Relaunch of Silverlöpet in Sala; the most recent edition of the race was in 1999; the distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is announced by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spånga/Bromstens Bandy Club organizes Spångaloppet, a local running race that returns on May 9, 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and levels with 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga town center, as well as a 2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race. Start and finish for all races are at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to participate, and registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga town center
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race
Start and finish at Spånga IP for all races
additional: Registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026. For questions: spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and finish at Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Welcome to the Vellinge Beer Run 2026 - a pleasant and inclusive running event that combines running with local beer culture. The race is 5 kilometers long and starts and finishes at Vellinge Bryggeri in central Vellinge. The start is at 12:00 on 9 May 2026, and the course takes you through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area. After finishing, beer tasting at the brewery is offered, and the event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners seeking a social and fun challenge.
course_highlights: 5 kilometer running event
Start and finish at Vellinge Bryggeri (Kompanigatan 18)
The course takes you through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area
additional: Date and time: 9 May 2026, start at 12:00. Start/Finish: Vellinge Bryggeri, Kompanigatan 18, 235 32 Vellinge. After finishing, beer tasting at Vellinge Bryggeri. The race is described as suitable for all levels - both experienced runners and beginners. Date: 9 May 2026. The race emphasizes social togetherness and local beer culture as core elements of the experience.

name: Åre Halvmarathon
location: Duved, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Åre Halvmaraton is held in Åre Municipality and is a recurring trail/road race in an alpine environment. The second edition offers the main distance as a half marathon as well as shorter options for runners who want to run 5 km, and two children's races (300 m and 1.7 km). The event is presented by Åre Municipality and is aimed at both recreational runners and families. More information and registration are available via the event's website.
course_highlights: Race in a stunning alpine mountain environment
Main distance is the half marathon; 5 km also available
Children's races at 300 m and 1.7 km
additional: The event is listed as the second edition and is scheduled for May 24, 2025, 09:30 - 14:00. The organizer/information text is published by Åre Municipality; registration is directed to the event's own website. The date for Åre Halvmaraton 2026 is May 9; distances include half marathon, 5 km and two children's races (300 m and 1.7 km); start times are approximately 09:30 - 14:00 and registration takes place via the event's website.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity run in Älmhult that raises funds for the fight against cancer. The run is organized by Aktivitetshuset/IKEA-nätverket and welcomes both the public and IKEA employees and their families. Registration takes place via RaceID where participants choose both distance and start time; online registration is open until May 9 at 20:00, and on-site registration can take place from 08:30, subject to availability. The race weekend is complemented by inspirational lectures and an after-run at Grillen after the finish.
additional: Registration is via RaceID (choose distance and start time). Online registration is open until May 9 at 20:00; on-site late registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. Since the event is a charity event, no fees are refunded upon cancellation. Group registration is supported (add additional participants at payment) and the confirmation email from RaceSupport contains the chosen distance and start time. There are inspirational talks at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on April 10, 17:00–19:00 and a lecture with a researcher on April 24, 17:30–19:00). The after-run at Grillen starts at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page and the IKEA Hotel is recommended for overnight accommodation.

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique and fast-paced running competition in the Sommarro Cultural Reserve in Örebro. The race takes place on a 2.6 km loop in a forest-park setting where each lap must be completed in progressively shorter times (the first lap 25 minutes, the next 24 minutes, the third 23 minutes, etc.), which makes the competition faster with every round. All start on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest - suitable for both fast runners and those who want to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, without timing).
course_highlights: A 2.6 km loop in a beautiful forest-park setting (Sommarro Cultural Reserve)
Undulating course, mostly gravel and jogging paths with sections of terrain
Start/finish on a grassy area; the race runs with progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory pre-race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is performed with a transponder around the ankle (the number of laps primarily determines placement; if laps are equal, the time on the last lap decides). A lost transponder is charged 800 SEK. Water/sports drink (Umara) and energy tables are available, as well as light snacks. No changing facilities or showers are offered; two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus line 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: Long bana: 1600-1900 kr; Kort bana: 1000-1200 kr
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay race organized by Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets that welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. The race is offered in two variants: a long course with eleven legs (total approximately 67.8 km) and a short course with six legs (total 23.5 km). Start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, the race is run with many officials along the course and a communal warm-up before the start. GPX files for all legs are available to download from the organizers' page.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, total approximately 67.8 km (legs 2.7 - 8.5 km)
Short course: 6 legs, total 23.5 km (legs 2.7 - 5.4 km)
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden; leg 3 (Glömminge - Högsrum) runs via Rönnerumsvägen due to construction
additional: Bib collection: Friday May 8, 15:00 - 17:00 and race day May 9, 08:00 - 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden; changing and showers in the sports hall (200 m north of Ölands Köpstad) with opening hours 08:00 - 10:00 and 14:00 - 17:00; Wellness Studio leads a communal warm-up before the start; the long course has women's and open classes, the short course only an open class; GPX files for all legs are available for download. Two courses: long approximately 67.8 km (11 legs) with women's and open class; short approximately 23.5 km (6 legs) with open class. Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. The event is part of Öländska löplopp and historically has around 95 participating teams.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg team relay race with start and finish in Bruksparken, Bromölla. The race takes place on a relatively flat course with varying surfaces (gravel and asphalt) and is aimed at both recreational runners and elites — a social and fast-paced event for colleagues, friends or family. Bib-number distribution begins at 09:00 and timing is chip-timed; there are shower and changing facilities in Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: Six legs with start and finish in Bruksparken, Bromölla
Flat course with varying surfaces (gravel and asphalt)
Water stations at start/finish and along the course; approximately 3 km on leg 1 and leg 4
additional: Bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Shower and changing facilities are available in Sparbankshallen. Timing is done with a data chip; both total times and leg times are recorded (leg times are taken about 20 meters before the exchange line) and the time for the last leg is recorded at the finish. Only runners on their leg may pass through the timing portal. Prizes to the top three in each class. Proceeds go to Rotary International's humanitarian work and Ryssberget IK's activities; the anniversary celebration and prize money to the top three in each class; registration via humlestafetten.se.

description: Lundaloppet is a welcoming recreational race in the heart of Lund with distances for all ages and levels. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the Lilla Lundaloppet for children, mixing urban and park environments. The race has a long tradition and the finish line is inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen. The event page encourages a festive atmosphere and is suitable for walkers and beginner runners as well as more experienced runners.
course_highlights: 10 km through a spring-like Lund
5 km with a course through parks and the inner city
Lilla Lundaloppet - children's race of about 500 meters around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Registration is open all the way up to the start, but the price increases from April 23 and then you can no longer pre-order an official T-shirt, a meal package, or have a name on the bib. Timing is done with a chip on the back of the bib (the time is counted from when you pass the start mat) and the finish is filmed as a safety measure. Bib distribution takes place inside the IFK hall at Centrala Idrottsplatsen, Trollebergsvägen 26. A start proof is sent by e-mail the week before the race and must be shown at pickup. The distances are 2.5/5/10/15 km and Lilla Lundaloppet; corporate and student registrations as well as team registrations; add-ons including an official shirt, meal package and training sessions (10 sessions, first session on March 2); for employees at Lund University there is no registration fee and special conditions.

name: Springtime 2025
description: Springtime Helsingborg is an annual running race in Helsingborg, run under the Springtime brand. This year's edition takes place on May 10, 2026 and offers several start categories, including Corporate/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and Open IFK Championship. The event is open to runners of different levels and offers both competitive and family-friendly elements. Registration is via the website and results from previous years are available online.
course_highlights: Multiple start categories for different groups: Corporate/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and Open IFK Championship
Family-friendly setup with broad participation
Results from previous years and registration via the official website
additional: Registration is via 'Register here!' on the website; results lists are available for several years back (2011 - 2025). The last regular registration day is April 19; late registration on the website runs until May 3, after which you can register late at Löplabbet. The price includes a bib and a medal, as well as water and fruit.

name: Springtime
description:
Helsingborg stadslopp has since its start in 1981 attracted runners from near and far.

The race runs through the city's central areas with start and finish at Stortorget. Distances are 5 km and 10 km.

For children born 2016-2020 there is MiniSpringtime, which is 1 km. Alla Kan Springa is a race for people with disabilities (all ages) and follows the same course as MiniSpringtime.
course_highlights: Two main routes for adults: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km
Children and disability race with loops of about 500 m and 2000 m
The course is measured and certified by federation measurers
additional: Start times (example for 2026): Funkisloppet at 10:30, Minimara at 11:15, 5 km and 10 km (start at 12:00). For participation in senior and veteran classes, representation of a club affiliated with Svenska friidrottsförbundet is required. In the Funkisloppet it is permitted to run together with one or more fellow runners (companion, housing staff, personal assistant or family member). Awards ceremony planned around 13:30; Children and disability loops at about 700 m and 1400 m respectively; Last registration day May 8, 2025; On-site registration until 30 minutes before the start.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset Växjö is the Växjö edition of Sweden's largest women's running tour, which in 2026 visits 19 cities. In Växjö, the distances offered are 2.5 km or 5 km, with start and finish at Strandbjörket by Växjösjön. The race can be registered as an individual or as a team, and a medal, goody bag and Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing can be opted out. Age recommendations apply and digital registration is used; as an additional feature, free HPV vaccination for women born 1994–1999 on site during Vårruset, according to Region Kronoberg.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km around Växjösjön with start and finish at Strandbjörket
Team and individual registration with a post-race picnic for teams
Medal, goody bag and Vårruset music quiz with prizes (timing can be opted out)
additional: Team-based picnic after finish; digital registration; part of the national Vårruset tour 2026 (19 cities). Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (officially measured as 5 km). Start and finish at Strandbjörket; team registrations (5 people) are offered a picnic after finishing. Registration can be completed digitally up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; it is possible to opt out timing in the registration.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Uddevalla on May 11, 2026 — a new local Blodomlopp where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, and allow children to participate in Lilla Blodomloppet. The start and finish are located at Museiparken, and the course runs through central Uddevalla, past, among other things, Östra station and along parts of the old Lelångebanan. The race is organized to raise awareness of blood donation and has both individual and team registrations, as well as a communal picnic after the finish.
course_highlights: Start adjacent to Museiparken, running through Kungsgatan and under the railway at Östra station
The 10 km route runs up Dynamitbacken toward Bjursjön and along the old track bed (Lelångebanan)
The 5 km route turns toward Bleket with the highest point at Norrskolan and mostly downhill toward Uddevalla Hospital via a pedestrian tunnel under Route 44
additional: Team registration: 3 - 5 participants, picnic basket included; teams can register with 1 - 2 vacant spots and be completed no later than May 1; last day for team registration is May 4; individual last registration day is May 11 with on-site registration in Museiparken from 16:00 on May 11; friskvårdsbidrag (Epassi, Wellnet, Benify) accepted; 40 kr discount for blood donors indicated at registration; Lilla Blodomloppet for up to 12 years old (a parent can accompany without registration).

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Vårruset Göteborg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and takes place in Slottsskogen on Tuesday, May 12, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and a measured 5 km course, and the race suits both walking and running. For individual registrations, a medal, goody bag, bib, and the opportunity to participate in Vårruset's music quiz are included; team registrations (5 people) also receive a picnic after the finish. It is possible to opt out of official timing in the registration, and registration is possible all the way up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start.
course_highlights: The course runs in Slottsskogen with start and finish below the Björngårdsvillan.
Available distances: 2.5 km or a measured 5 km.
Park setting and team picnic for team registrations (5 people) after finishing.
additional: Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day (no later than 1 hour before the first start). Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years old (11 years old with an adult present); 2.5 km from 11 years old (7 years old with an adult present). Individual registration: medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib, and timing on the 5 km (can be opted out). A digital option is offered May 4–June 4 (with medal mailed afterwards) and team registrations (5 people) receive a picnic after finishing. Corporate solutions are offered for groups over 25 people via the corporate page.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
price_range: Fri för studenter; övriga deltagaravgifter inte angivna
description: Chalmersloppet is a campus festival at Johannebergs campus that celebrates wellbeing and community. The race welcomes students, staff, alumni and companies to run, network and have fun together in the Chalmers spirit. The distance ranges from 3.14 km (including the walking variant) up to 9.82 km, and as a student you participate in all distances free of charge. The event is organized by Chalmers Studentkårs Teknologbolag and includes both competition and activities in a Runner Zone.
course_highlights: Start at Chalmersplatsen, past Teknologgården and up Olgas stairs (alternative route for rolling participants).
Longer distances consist of several laps (2π = 6.28 km and 3π + extra 400 m = 9.82 km) with hills and a final sprint on Sven Hultins gata.
Finish passes near Mossen/Chabo and the course goes past Kemigården and along Rännvägen.
additional: Runner Zone is held at Geniknölen with activities, mingling and prize distribution. Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen and provides warm-up before the race. Bib numbers and t-shirts can be collected at the tent at Teknologgården: Monday 11/5 09:30 - 13:30 and Tuesday 12/5 09:30 - 13:30. Participants start in groups (waves) and there are options for wheelchairs/rolling participants. Students participate for free; corporate placements are offered in connection with sponsorship and recruitment opportunities. Distance options include 3.14 km, 6.28 km, 9.82 km and a walking option; start groups based on participant groups; focus on health and wellbeing for the entire campus community (students, staff, alumni and companies); includes events such as Runner Zone and warm-up.

name: NTK Duathlon 2026
location: Sturup Raceway, Svedala Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Welcome to NTK Duathlon at Sturup Raceway on May 15, 2026. The competition is held on a closed track with good asphalt, spectator-friendly sightlines, and a unique feel near the airport. The track's character, with short laps, makes the race tight and easy to follow for both participants and spectators. The competition format combines running and cycling on the track according to the specified laps and transition procedures.
course_highlights: Sturup Raceway: paved race track, about 2 km per lap
Spectator-friendly track adjacent to the airport with good visibility of the laps
Race format: 2 laps running, 10 laps cycling, 1 lap running (special cycling and transition rules)
additional: The race is held on a closed track with no traffic signs or speed limits; running always on the left side of the track, cycling on the right side (the first 9 cycling laps), and you never cross the middle of the track. Instructions for entering and exiting the transition zone are posted on the track and in the map on the website. The track is about 2 km per lap, which provides many opportunities for the audience to cheer. The event takes place at Sturup Raceway; the distance is approximately 2 km per lap and the program consists of 2 laps running, 10 laps cycling (right side), and 1 lap running to the finish. Transitions occur in the transition zone and the track is described as spectator-friendly with good visibility.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Skärholmen that, in 2026, will be held for the fourteenth time on Saturday, May 16. The event offers a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and older, a Fun Run at 1.6 km for all ages, as well as Lilla and Mini races for children. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative and all finishers receive a specially designed medal. Löparakademin, a non-profit association that works with youth activities, is the organizer.
course_highlights: 5 km with timing, start and finish at Puckelbollplanen
DJs and music stations along the course creating a suburban festival vibe
Children's routes: Lilla Skärholmsloppet about 1.6 km and Mini about 500 m
additional: Registration on the website closes Thursday 14 May at 17:00, but late registration is possible at the bib pickup on Friday 15 May and on competition day 16 May, subject to availability. A bib number is required for all participants and will be distributed well in advance of the race. All finishers receive a medal; Lilla participants are also offered fruit and a drink at the finish. Start/finish is at Puckelbollplanen and Lilla/Mini have separate start times and divided start fields by age class. The race takes place in Skärholmen, Stockholm, and is free to participate via RUN4ZERO with a medal for all who finish.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: Näsvikens skidstadion, Näsviken, Ljusdals kommun, Gävleborgs län, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a trail race that takes place on Borgarleden between the Dellensjöarna, with the finish in Näsviken. The race is offered in several distances (0.6 km, 2.5 km, 6 km, 13 km and 23 km) and runs as an all-day event. The event is organized by Forsa OK and presented via Trailrunning Sweden.
course_highlights: The course follows Borgarleden
Section between the Dellensjöarna
Finish in Näsviken
additional: Distances: 0.6 km, 2.5 km, 6.0 km, 13 km and 23 km; All-day event; First start is scheduled for Saturday at 09:00; Organizer: Forsa OK; Contact and administrative information via Trailrunning Sweden (Trailrunning Sweden AB, info@trailrunningsweden.se). All-day event; start around 09:00 on Saturday; finish in Näsviken; distances 0.6/2.5/6.0/13/23 km; Borgarleden between Dellensjöarna

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Welcome to Kilsbergen Out & Back in Ånnaboda, a cozy trail run where you decide how far you want to run. The race consists of three out-and-back sections that can be combined to 10, 26, or 54 km and offers hilly trail running in forests and mountains with both technical parts and easy-to-run trails. Everyone starts simultaneously from the same race center, which creates a social atmosphere where runners meet several times during the day. The event is organized by the Trail and Run association and offers an energy station, drop bag option, and simple hot food after finishing.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes from Ånnaboda (choose 10, 26, or 54 km)
Hilly trail running in forest and mountains with technical sections and well-maintained trails
Bergslagsleden included with a turnaround at the Rusakulan viewpoint; all start at the same location, creating a social atmosphere
additional: Max 70 participants. Bib numbers can be collected at the race center from 08:00. The registration fee is paid via Swish to 123 118 33 18 - include your name in the message. All equipment and energy needed on the course must be carried by the runner; no support along the course, only at the race center. Energy stations at the race center with water, Umara sports drink, bananas, candy, etc.; you can place your own drop bag there. After finishing, simple hot meals are offered (vegetarian option). There are toilets in the area; changing and showers at the SM-stugan (lower parking). Recommended parking at the lower parking area. Three out-and-back routes (10/26/54 km) from Ånnaboda; max 70 participants; final registration May 15; start 09:00 on May 16, 2026; energy station, drop bag and meal after finish.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Marathon, 6.7 km, 3.5 km, Backyard Ultra, Backyard Ultra
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organized by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is targeted at those who are a little adventurous and fitness-minded, and it emphasizes the natural experience as much as the performance. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, offering a memorable course in nature-rich, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Undulating trails and hills in a natural setting
Varied surfaces: trails, gravel roads, and asphalt
Beautiful views of Lake Vättern and the surrounding forest
additional: Now organized by Rudu Friskvård. Event hours are listed as 07:00 - 19:00 on May 16, 2026. Bauer Activities emphasizes that their race is suitable for both beginners and experienced participants and that the areas (Östra Vätterbranterna) are a UNESCO-designated biosphere with a strong nature profile. Part of the Gränna City Trail program. Registration/contact: info@baueractivities.se.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: Welcome to the 98th TIF terrain race at Skidstugan in Trollhättan on Saturday, May 16, 2026. The competition is organized by Trollhättans IF Athletics and features four distances: 800 m for children up to 9 years old, as well as 2.3 km, 5.2 km, and 10.4 km (two laps of 5.2 km) depending on category. It is a traditional spring race and results from previous years are published on the club's website. Registration takes place via the competition page (REGISTER HERE) and questions can be directed to the club's contact details.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Skidstugan in Trollhättan
Four distances: 800 m (children up to 9 years), 2.3 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km (two laps)
A traditional spring race (98th edition)
additional: Organizer: Trollhättans IF Athletics. Start and finish at Skidstugan. Results from previous years (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021) are published on the page. Registration text on the page: REGISTER HERE (no direct registration link provided on the scanned pages). Location: Skidstugan in Trollhättan; date May 16, 2026; distances 0.8 km, 2.3 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km (two laps). Registration and results links are on the event page; part of the West Swedish Running Cup.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand on May 17, 2026, offering 10 km, 6 km and two children's races (1200 m and 400 m). The course follows a beautiful loop along the water, passes historical sites and offers views of Stockholm's inlet. The start and finish are at the Kajen in Nacka Strand, and the day is combined with a family festival with activities, music and entertainment. The race promotes local pride and is suitable for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Beautiful loop along the water
Passes historical sites with views over Stockholm's inlet
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand; family festival with activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km and children's races 1200 m and 400 m. Date and location: May 17, 2026, Kajen in Nacka Strand. Start and finish at the same place by Kajen. The day includes a family festival with activities, music and entertainment. A portion of the registration fee goes to Min Stora Dag.

name: Blodomloppet Munkedal
organizer: Föreningen Blodomloppet (i samarbete med Hälle IF)
description: The Blodomloppet in Munkedal returns after its 2024 premiere as part of the municipality's public health initiative and encourages more people to get moving while highlighting the importance of blood donation. The event attracted hundreds of participants the first year and includes Lilla Blodomloppet for children. For 2025, Hälle IF will participate as an organizer and there will be activities and information about blood donation on site. Registration is open and everyone, regardless of age or fitness level, is encouraged to participate.
course_highlights: Several distances including 5 km and 10 km
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Start and finish in Örekilsparken
additional: Lilla Blodomloppet has previously been offered free of charge for schoolchildren thanks to the municipality's support. At the event, there will be activities and information about blood donation. All registered teams receive a picnic bag in the finish area (this applies generally to Blodomloppet). Hälle IF is listed as co-organizer for the event in Munkedal. Registration is open according to official information. Registration is open; the distances include 5 km, 10 km, Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet as well as the long-distance run; participants can participate alone or as a team; the new co-organizer for 2025 is Hälle IF.

name: Berga Brostafett
location: Berga, Laholm Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Berga Brostafett is a revival of a five-leg relay race in Berga along the Lagan, organized by Lagans AIK. The event is planned for May 18, 2026 at 6:00 PM and is expected to attract around 30–40 teams with five runners per team. In total, the distance is about ten kilometers over five legs, with each leg ranging from about 1 km to 3.2 km. Information and registration are communicated via Lagans AIK's page and the event on Facebook.
course_highlights: Relay race over bridges in Berga along the Lagan
Total distance of about ten kilometers with five legs (distances about 1 km to 3.2 km)
Planned participation of about 30–40 teams with five runners per team and support for Lagans AIK
additional: The page contains information about registration for Berga Brostafett but does not show a clear price or registration link. Contact details shown on the page include lagansaik@gmail.com and support@laget.se. A calendar for the event is available and can be subscribed to via webcal://cal.laget.se/LagansAIK-Bergabrostafett.ics. Five runners per team; one team may have a runner who runs two legs if needed; registration information is available via Lagans AIK and updates are shared on Facebook.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5/10 km – 350 kr till 28 april; Efteranmälan 400 kr; Lag: 1 750 kr till 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr till 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Kristianstad in Tivoliparken on May 19, 2026. The race offers 5 km and 10 km for men and women, as well as the Little Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12, and it suits both runners and walking groups, individually or in teams. The course is scenic and runs out into the Vattenriket with varying surfaces (grass, gravel, and asphalt), and the event traditionally ends with a picnic. The event also has a clear community and blood donation purpose and is run by local associations together with the Blood Center.
course_highlights: Scenic course extending into Vattenriket
Surfaces vary between grass, gravel and asphalt
The Little Blodomloppet runs entirely within Tivoliparken; the 5 km and 10 km routes cross the Helge River
additional: The Little Blodomloppet is available for children up to 12 years old; start and finish areas are in Tivoliparken; storage is available (only bags can be checked in); the last day for team registrations is May 12 and the last registration day for all races is May 19; an Excel template for team registrations is available on the registration page.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
description: Vårruset Stockholm is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held on Tuesday, May 19, 2026 in Norra Djurgården. The race offers selectable distances of 2.5 km or a measured 5 km course and is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced runners. The event has a warm, community-focused character with the option to register teams and finish the evening with a picnic after crossing the finish line. Registration is digital and the same price applies whether you choose timing or not.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Norra Djurgården
The 5 km course is measured
Nearest subway station: Universitetet
additional: Included are a medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz with prizes, a bib number and (for those who choose it) official timing; timing can be opted out so results are not published. Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the finish; everyone in the team can run different distances. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (11 years old with an adult), 2.5 km from age 11 (7 years old with an adult). Registration is binding and the registration fee is not refunded upon cancellation. There is also a digital race for participants who cannot attend in person (with a medal mailed after the tour). Bibs are mailed to the address provided in the registration for those registered before a specified date; any surplus goes 100% back to the sport.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten will be held on Wednesday, May 20, 2026 in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a fast 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is marketed as an easily accessible and festive relay race for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and youths participate completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4x4 km total)
Start, exchange and finish in the beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging or running; categories with and without timing
additional: Children and youths participate for free thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (school contact: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organizer offers the possibility to rent tents and event furnishings via Rent a Tent (booking deadline for guaranteed access May 5, contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). Start, exchange and finish are collected in the park, which provides a good spectator and event atmosphere. The team consists of four participants; a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal after the finish are mentioned in the event communications. Over 700 participants and about 180 teams participated in previous years; youths and students participate at no cost thanks to sponsorship from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration can be found at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum provides a picnic for all participants; various sponsors offer tents or gathering spaces.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden's largest recreational running tour for women – a joyful and inclusive spring evening where participants can run, jog, or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event travels as a tour in 19 cities during the period May 4 to June 4, 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a bib, and team registrations (five people) are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been organized since 1989 and targets recreational runners of various ages according to the recommendations for each distance.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
The 5 km course is measured at all locations
Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing
additional: What is included with individual registration: a medal, a goody bag, timing (for those who have chosen it) and a bib. For team registrations, a picnic after finishing, a medal, a goody bag, timing (for those who have chosen it) and a bib; a team consists of five people and a picnic certificate is issued only when the entire team (5 paying) is registered. There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital) where you can run between May 4 - June 4 and have a medal mailed; digital registrations cannot be combined with physical participation in the tour. Payment is accepted via Swish and Klarna; wellness portals Epassi, Benefits and Benifex are supported. The guide for how to register and information on how to add team members is available in the FAQ and in the registration guide on the website. Free training sessions before Vårruset are offered by Falu IK Friidrott in collaboration with Vårruset and Intersport; two training sessions before the race are listed.

name: Stafettvarvet
location: Slottsskogsvallen, Slottsskogen, Göteborg, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: Stafettvarvet is a spectator- and team-friendly relay race that takes place on May 20, 2026, with start and finish inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. Each team consists of four participants, all running the same fast 3.2 km race around beautiful Slottsskogen, with baton exchanges on the arena. After crossing the finish line, a picnic basket is included in the team's registration, and there are opportunities for companies to book tent space in the entrance park for a group gathering and after-run. Registration is via Göteborgsvarvet's website and the price per team changes according to published price periods.
course_highlights: A fast 3.2 km lap around beautiful Slottsskogen
Start, baton exchange, and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
All four team members run the same course; a picnic basket is included
additional: Registration is per team (not per team member); a team consists of 4 participants and is available in the women's, men's, or mixed classes. Pickup of the baton, bib number and picnic basket takes place outside Slottsskogsvallen in the entrance park. Companies can register one or more teams and choose to pay by invoice and book tent space in the corporate villages. Registration is open until 5:00 p.m. on race day, but the race may sell out earlier. The team consists of 4 participants; each runner 3.2 km; start, baton exchange and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen; bib/number pickup 15:30 - 17:30; registration takes place via Göteborgsvarvet's website; corporate teams and invoicing are available as options; a picnic basket is included in team registration.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona on May 20, 2026 – a fitness run that honors the life-saving blood donation. You can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, participate in Lilla Blodomloppet (800 m) or walk 5 km. The courses have been measured by an official from Svenska Friidrottsförbundet and the walking lanes have their own course layout so that participants can finish with a picnic together. The race is organized by KA 2 IF and offers both individual and team registrations as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four courses: running 5 km, running 10 km, children's race 800 m and walking 5 km
Walkers have their own completely separate course so they can be released first and picnic together with the others
The courses are measured by an official from Svenska Friidrottsförbundet and meet the requirements for a competitive race
additional: Organizer: KA 2 IF (contact for Blodomloppet: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel 0793-299924). A team can consist of a maximum of 5 participants and team participants may take part in different distances. For larger registrations there is an Excel template in the registration system for import as well as the possibility of a customer page for companies/organizations for centralized administration and discount codes. Blood donors and ICA members receive 40 SEK discount per person. Picnic after the race is part of the event. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m and walking 5 km; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up will be communicated later in the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening 5 km race with start and finish in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km lap that is completed twice and offers a pleasant backdrop and good atmosphere along the course. You can participate individually or register a team (at least five people) where the five fastest results are counted. Warm welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: 2.5 km lap run twice with a halfway turnaround
Start and finish in Stadsparken; the course runs through central Västervik
Course layout may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Bib number pickup takes place well in advance and numbers must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Pickup: Monday 18 May - Intersport 11-14; Tuesday 19 May - Intersport 11-14; Wednesday 20 May - on stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (a link is provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the sum of the 5 fastest participants; if there are more than 9 participants from the same unit, multiple teams can be registered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; bib numbers collected before 17:30 on race day or according to schedule; start 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the program; team discount 20% with code LAG20.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset i Västerås is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held Thursday, May 21, 2026 with start at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The race offers the distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (5 km is course-certified) and suits both seasoned runners and those who want to jog or walk. All individuals who register individually receive a medal, a finish bag and a bib; teams registering five people are invited to a picnic after the finish. Timing for the 5 km is offered but can be opted out in the registration if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course goes through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is course-certified (2.5 km is also available)
additional: Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, at latest 1 hour before the first start; recommended ages: 5 km: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by an adult), 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years when accompanied by an adult). Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the finish. Included for participants: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes and bib; timing is offered for the 5 km but can be opted out. Local organizer: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training session is published with separate registration via Västerås FK's registration page. Distances are 2.5 or 5 km; a team consists of five people and registration can be done as a team or as an individual; timing can be opted out in registration; the registration is digital and a picnic is offered after the finish.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Join us to mark the vital blood donation in Blodomloppet Linköping! The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 km and 10 km, as well as a Little Blodomloppet for younger participants. The event is team- and company-friendly - many take part in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. Registration can be done individually or in a team, and the organizer offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (option to walk, jog, or run)
Tailored for both individual runners and teams (3-5 people, often teams of 5)
The race ends with a large shared picnic
additional: Registration is done individually or in a team (3-5 people); you always pay for 5 in a team and can top up to a full team at no cost by April 30 (top up via linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all born in 2009 or later) participate at half the entry fee up to April 30. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount per person. The last day for team registration is May 14; registration on the website is open until the start. Anyone who registers by May 14 and provides a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Bib-number distribution: May 19 from 11-19 (GeBlod, Storgatan 32), May 20 from 12-18 (GeBlod) and May 21 from 16-19 (Saab Arena). From May 1, a personal visit may be required for certain changes. Companies can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the race are available. The last day for team registration may be in mid-May and payment methods include Swish, card and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta organized by OK Hällen since 2012. The race suits all ages and running abilities with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, plus shorter children’s classes and a new dog class in 2026. The courses run on a mix of grass, trail and road through forest and a residential area, and the event is popular for both individual runners and for teams/work groups who want to compete together. For teams a picnic basket is included, picked up at the serving tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trail and grass through forest and a residential area
Start and finish on the green area next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill climb: timing in the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Kids 17:40, Lower-/middle-school class 18:00, Dog 18:15 - 18:20 (fast dogs first), Adult (including team competition) 18:45. Participant bag and bib with timing chip must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the respective start. For teams, a picnic basket is included (picked up at the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available as directed along Road 52; cycling is recommended. Dog class limited to 30 participants and dog owners must pick up after their dogs. A dog-friendly variant will be introduced in 2026 with a separate start for dog runners; different ways to participate (running, pulling the dog, or walking) in Stigtomta.

name: Uka Pain (SM Trail)
description: Sweden Runners IF warmly welcomes you to Uka Pain May 22–23, 2026 in the beautiful Älvdalen. The event offers multiple distances from 12 km up to 100 miles and includes Trail-SM/VSM (28 km) as well as JSM (12 km). The competition center and finish line are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses run through Älvdalen's majestic terrain, with both runner-friendly trails and more technical sections. The event provides a substantial challenge and views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The 52 km route has around 1500 meters of elevation gain.
The route leads to the peaks Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget.
Mostly trail with sections ranging from easy-to-run to very technical terrain; orange course markings.
additional: Bib numbers, timing, energy and water stations, finisher medal and participant T-shirt (register by 30 April for the T-shirt). Bib distribution takes place at The Running Company (Dalgatan 81F) from Friday 22/5. Bus transport is offered between Hotell Älvdalen and Boggberget for 100 Miles participants (departing 15:10). No on-site late registration. Name and class changes are possible until May 14. Mandatory equipment applies to 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles. Maximum times and stop times are stated in the PM (e.g., max 9 h for 28 km, 10 h for 50 km, 20 h for 100 km, 34 h for 100 miles). Start times: Friday 16:00 – Saturday 02:00; drop bags allowed for 100 km and 100 miles; GPS trackers provided for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment applies for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; competition center at Hotell Älvdalen.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organized by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly city race with multiple distances for both children and adults. Start and finish are at Charlie Normans Square, and the race includes a Knattelopp, Lilla Stadsloppet, as well as 5 km and 10 km (with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and levels. For the 10 km there is a bonus tied to the course record.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans Square
Knattelopp (0 - 6 years), Lilla Stadsloppet (up to 12 years) as well as 5 km and 10 km
10 km: bonus/prize for a course record
additional: Registration is via a Google Form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Schedule: 11:00 Knatteloppet (0 - 6 years), 11:30 Lilla Stadsloppet (up to 12 years), 13:00 start for 5 km and 10 km (with or without timing). Start/finish is located between the railway station and the small-boat harbor at Charlie Normans torg. Start and finish for all races are at Charlie Normans torg; the day includes multiple races, from shorter Knatteloppet to longer running distances.

name: Cityvarvet
description: Cityvarvet is a shorter version of Göteborgsvarvet at 4.3 km, starting at Götaplatsen and taking you along Avenyn to a mighty finish at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is a festival with a large crowd, music, and pep stations along the course and suits both beginners, fast runners and families. We recommend that children up to 13 years run together with an adult. As a runner you get access to the Runner Zone at the finish for recovery, snacks and drinks.
course_highlights: Start at Götaplatsen and run down Avenyn toward Slottsskogen
4.3 km city course with a large crowd, music and pep stations
Finish inside Slottsskogsvallen and Runner Zone for recovery
additional: Distance 4.3 km. Max 1500 registered. Registration open until 12:00 on race day (2026-05-23). Bib pickup and start documents: collected Thursday - Saturday, May 21-23 at Göteborgsvarvet Expo in Friidrottens Hus (Thursday 11:00 - 20:30, Friday 10:00 - 21:00, Saturday from 09:00). Two hydration stations on the course. Recommendation that children up to 13 years run together with an adult. Max 1500 participants; start time 13:00; bib pickup at the Expo (Friidrottens Hus); bag storage at the start until 12:30; hydration stations along the course; electronic chip timing; maximum time about 50 minutes; information about transport and expo is available on the start documents page; changing facilities are not provided.

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km mass-participation festival in Gothenburg that draws tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race goes through festival atmosphere in Slottsskogen, along the quays of Hisingen and past the pulse of Avenyn. The course is measured by a World Athletics-certified course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and many spectator and music stations along the way. Information about start groups and details is sent in the start packet about two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes along Hisingen's quays and Avenyn
Over 200,000 spectators and many music stations along the course
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m) and the course is measured by a World Athletics-certified course measurer. There are water stations along the course and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to the race. Start groups are arranged according to seed rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the start packet about two weeks before the start. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located in the Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seed rules and start groups exist; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, along Hisingen's quays and past Avenyn; part of Varvet Week.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå Stadsmara is one of Norrland's largest and oldest running events, bringing together participants, partners and spectators for a weekend filled with activity and community. On May 23, 2026, Stadsmaran will celebrate its 45th anniversary and the whole city will be transformed into a shared arena. The event includes races for all ages—from the Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet for children to the half marathon, city run and cross-country run—and is designed as a festival where both runners and spectators are welcome.
course_highlights: City run that transforms large parts of the city into a track and spectator areas
JIAB Ställningsmontage-loppet is a challenging cross-country race
Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet give kids their own peppy start to the day
additional: Stadsmaran traditionally opens with Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet. The organizer is StiL Sportcenter (Universitetsvägen C11, 977 54 Luleå). Contact via the reception: 0920 - 50 21 20. Information about opening hours/reception may vary on holidays. The race offers several distances from short children's races to the half marathon; bib pickup takes place at StiL Sportcenter, Universitetsvägen 11C; start and finish in Luleå City with spectators along the course; the anniversary year 2026 with new elements that enhance the overall experience.

name: Uka Pain
description: UKA PAIN is a trail- and ultrarace in Älvdalen, Dalarna, held during the weekend of May 22-23, 2026. The race offers several distances - 12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles - of which 28 km constitutes the Trail-SM/VSM and 12 km JSM on May 23. Start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses wind through forest terrain in the area, marked with orange color. For longer distances, GPS trackers and drop bags are offered, as well as information on accommodation and registration via the official pages; some distances require special equipment and participants are encouraged to have their own cup at energy stations.
course_highlights: Multiple distances to choose from: 12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles
Trail-SM/VSM classes over 28 km and JSM over 12 km on May 23
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen with orange course markings and logistical support such as drop bags and GPS trackers for longer races
additional: Competition center at Hotell Älvdalen; bib-number pickup at The Running Company near the hotel; drop bags allowed for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment applies only for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; own cup required at energy stations; GPS trackers offered for 100 miles and 100 km; start times include May 22 at 16:00 for 100 miles and May 23 at 09:00/10:30/23:00 for the other distances; orange course markings.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
location: Vänge, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Backyard Ultra Vänge is a unique ultrarunning event organized by Hagunda IF where participants run a 6.7 km loop every full hour until only one runner remains. The race is held in Vänge, about 7 km outside Uppsala along National Road 72, and combines challenging terrain with a nature-friendly environment and a strong sense of community. There is also a team competition with a scoring system that rewards fair average times and larger teams; registration opens on 18/9, and the upcoming race is planned for May 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop of approximately 6.7 km (6,706 meters)
Trail running in a scenic natural setting with challenging sections
A new loop starts every hour - complete the loop before the hour ends to continue
additional: Maximum capacity is listed as 180 participants (the page shows 179/180 places filled). The race uses a team competition with a scoring system that discards extreme results for a fair average time and provides bonuses for larger teams. The loop runs every hour, and only those who complete the loop before the end of the hour may start the next loop. Results and previous races are published on the competition's results page. Capacity 180 participants; 179 places filled and 1 place left.

name: Sidsjö Trail
description: Sidsjö Trail is a nature-focused trail race around Sidsjön and Södra Berget in Sundsvall, held on Saturday, May 23, 2026. Runners can choose between a children's race and courses of about 3 km, 6 km, and 12 km—the courses offer forest trails, hilly terrain, and beautiful lake views. The race is suitable for both experienced trail runners and beginners and is organized by Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 together with morron. Mass start is at 10:15 and the race is conducted without official timing.
course_highlights: Courses around Sidsjön and Södra Berget with lake views
Varied trails and hilly terrain through forest
Start and finish at the Sidsjöns outdoor recreation area
additional: Regular registration closes Friday, May 22 at 18:00; late registration online until 08:00 on race day and on-site 09:30 - 10:30. Start and finish at the Sidsjöns outdoor recreation area; bib numbers collected upon presenting a payment receipt. The organizers have medics on site and all registered participants receive a medal (wooden medals with jute cords). Sustainability measures: source sorting at stations and minimization of disposable items. Photography/filming may be published; if you do not wish to be seen, please inform event@morron.se. Recommended public transport: Bus 142 (Sundsvall Böle) and Bus 3 (Mårtensro stop). ICA near Sidsjö offers participating children Kexchoklad at the finish. Mass start 10:15; no timing; registration takes place on site; children's race is available. Image and film material may be published in media; inform if you do not want to be in the picture.

name: VirsboRUN
location: Skräddartorpet, Virsbo, Fagersta Municipality, Västmanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN - a family-friendly cross-country race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, May 23, 2026. You can choose to run 1–4 laps on the 5.3 km loop course (maximum 21.2 km) or have the kids participate in the free kids' race of about 800 meters. The course runs through pristine nature and Hälleskogsbrännan with varied trails and fine views; after the finish, a medal and freshly grilled hamburgers await the participants.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop course (max 4 laps) - you choose how many laps you want to run
Challenging terrain with about 101 meters of elevation gain per lap, including rocky sections and forest trails in Hälleskogsbrännan
Kids' race about 800 m (free) and an extra water station about halfway (around 2.5 km)
additional: Bib numbers can be picked up at Stora Ladan from 10:00. The kids' race is limited to 50 participants and the women's and men's divisions are limited to 150 starters. Late registration is offered until about 1 hour before the start on race day. All finishers receive a medal and a goodie bag; freshly grilled hamburgers are also provided (including veggie options). Relays are allowed (2–4 people), maximum time for the competition is 3 hours, and participation is at your own risk (no refunds). Participants must wear a bib visibly on the chest; dogs are not allowed. Virsbo Rescue Service is on site. Cross-country race in the forest near Virsbo at Skräddartorpet; 5.3 km loop courses with 101 m elevation gain per lap; kids' track free (800 m); medal for everyone; freshly grilled hamburgers for all competitors; outdoor gym, parking, changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets and refreshments on site.

name: Å-Varvet
description: The Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is a city running race where runners can choose between the distances of 5 km and 10 km. The race has start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers running through a beautiful urban environment, according to official information sources. For the 2026 edition, the date is given as May 23, and the organizer is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. According to the official Facebook page, a quarter marathon of about 10,549 meters is also marketed, which provides an additional option for the distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Running through a beautiful urban environment
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (with consideration for different courses and experiences)
additional: The distances offered according to official sources are 5 km and 10 km; start/finish in the city park; the 2026 edition is planned for May 23. According to the Facebook page, a roughly 10,549 m quarter marathon is also marketed.

description: The Stadion Race will be held on Sunday, May 24, 2026, with start, lap, and finish at the historic Stockholm Stadium. The main race is a 5 km run on a two-lap course around the Stadium’s scenic surroundings, and there are also categories for children and youth. The race is family-friendly and community-oriented, organized by Djurgårdens IF Friidrott with chip timing and prizes for the top three.
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadium
Main race 5 km on a two-lap course around the Stadium
Children and youth categories (shorter courses, some categories not timed)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; after that, on-site registration only. The chip is attached to the bib, and both net and gross times are used; placements are based on net time. Start packets will be distributed from 10:00 on race day. Payments by card and Swish before race day, on race day only Swish. Members of Djurgårdens IF Friidrott can register free via a code sent out. All registered participants receive two football tickets (one men's match and one women's match). Medical staff will be on site. During the spring, trial practices on the competition track are offered by DIF Running. Distance options mentioned include 5 km and shorter distances (400 m, 1.2 km, 2.6 km); the first start is at 12:00; trial practices on the competition track during the spring.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
description: Vårruset i Jönköping is an evening race held at Rocksjön in Knektaparken with the distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is measured). The race is open to participants of different ages and offers a medal, finish bag, and bib to registered participants. Timing is optional, and team registrations (teams of five) include a picnic after finishing. The event is organized locally by IKHP Huskvarna and welcomes both recreational runners and experienced runners for a pleasant spring evening.
course_highlights: The course runs along Rocksjön in Knektaparken.
Optional distances: 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is measured).
Timing is optional – you can opt out so your results are not published.
additional: Team registration (five people) includes a picnic after finish; individual registrations and team registrations receive a medal, finish bag and bib. It is possible to opt out of timing in the registration so that your result is not published. Age recommendation: 5 km: 13 years (11 years if accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years if accompanied by an adult). Free training session is held before the season (for example March 19 at 6:30 PM at Rocksjöstadion). Registration is digital and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IKHP Huskvarna. Distances are 2.5 km or 5 km. Team consists of 5 people; the team leader fills in details and the members fill in their details before team registration is made. Picnic after finish. Event area: Rocksjön in Knektaparken.

name: Blodomloppet Uppsala
price_range: 5 km och 10 km: 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 7 maj; 450 kr fr.o.m. senare); Promenad: 350 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 135 kr; Specialomloppet: 135 kr; Laganmälan: 1750 kr
description: Blodomloppet Uppsala is a community running event that raises awareness of blood donation. It offers 5 km and 10 km runs as well as Lilla Blodomloppet at 2.5 km and Specialomloppet. Start and finish are at Gränby sportfält near IFU Arena in Uppsala, and dogs are allowed in the walking class. A blood donor gift is handed out in the finish area and registration may require information about blood donation. The event is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott in collaboration with Blodomloppet and is part of Sweden's largest blood donation run.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on a controlled course
Lilla Blodomloppet at 2.5 km for children
Start and finish at Gränby sportfält near IFU Arena in Uppsala
additional: Course layout: the 10 km course is controlled; the 5 km is about 4950 m; the Lilla Blodomloppet is about 2440 m. Start area at Gränby sportfält/IFU Arena. Dogs are allowed in the walking class. Blood donor gift is handed out at GeBlod's blood trailers. Registration may require information about blood donation.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Hudiksvall - a recreational run that highlights the importance of blood donation. Participate by walking, jogging or running 5 km or 10 km (both timed) or register your children for Lilla Blodomloppet. Locally, the event is organized by Strands IF Friidrott in collaboration with GeBlod Gävleborg and traditionally ends with a communal picnic. Registration is open and there are opportunities for team registrations and group-adapted solutions.
course_highlights: Available distances: 5 km and 10 km, both timed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Ends with a traditional picnic after the race
additional: Timing is offered for the 5 km and 10 km. Team registration is available (1750 kr) and an Excel template can be downloaded for large registrations; the organizer can assist with a customer page or a discount code for groups over 50 participants. GeBlod Gävleborg is named as the local blood donor partner with contact phone number and office hours. Bib numbers, storage, changing facilities, toilets, water stations and parking information are listed on the information pages. The team-building and team-competition efforts are mentioned; picnic baskets for teams; limited storage near Ishallen/Holmen Arena; parking may be limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is an accessible fitness race for women organized as part of Vårrusets national tour. The race runs 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and suits both competition-oriented runners and those who want to take an evening spring stroll. Team registrations (5 people) are offered a picnic after the finish, and individual registrations receive a medal, a goody bag, and a bib. The event is organized in collaboration with the local club IF Göta Karlstad and has the event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km course
Event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Option to opt out of official timing (same price)
additional: What is included: medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing for the 5 km for those who choose it, and bib number (team registrations include a picnic after the finish). Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years old (11 years with an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years old (7 years with an adult). Registration is digital and can be done up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. It is possible to participate digitally in Vårruset during the tour (May 4 - June 4) – digital participants will have a medal mailed home but cannot participate at the local event. Includes pre-race meetings in Skutberget (April 15 and May 6 at 18:00); recommended age per distance: 5 km – up to 13 years (11 years with an adult); 2.5 km – up to 11 years (7 years with an adult). Also in partnership with Barncancerfonden.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,5–3,8 km)

description: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp is a pleasant and festival-like recreational race with start and finish in Bruksparken in central Finspång. The main race is 7 km on a flat surface through an urban environment, and there is also a shorter AktivRunda and a children's run (XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan). All participants receive a medal at the finish, and the event is characterized by strong crowd support, music, and prize ceremonies. In 2026 the race celebrates its tenth anniversary and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners as well as families and children.
course_highlights: 7 km through central Finspång on a flat, smooth surface
The course is lined with spectators and music that cheer on the runners
Shorter AktivRundan (~3.8 km) with no timing and a children's run 1.7 km
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken; bib distribution at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, May 26 from 15:00 to 19:00; bib numbers not collected at Coop are distributed at the start- and finish-area no later than one hour before the start; the top flap on the bib is the chip that records the time; no shower facilities; everyone who walks/jogs/runs to the finish receives energy products from COOP and a water bottle sponsored by Finspångs Brunnsborrning; medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet; late registration via the website 18–25 May costs 395 SEK (web); and registration on-site during bib distribution 26–27 May costs 425 SEK (on site). 7 km course through central Finspång (start/finish Bruksparken); AktivRundan approximately 3.5–3.8 km; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan 1.7 km for children. Bib pickup at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga; the chip is registered via the top flap on the bib; registration and payment via Swish possible; race day opens at 15:00 in Bruksparken. This year's edition 2026 is the 10th anniversary; start for XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan at 17:00, main start at 19:00.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott
description: The Blodomloppet in Borlänge is an open mass-participation race where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in Lilla Blodomloppet (about 800 m). The race is organized locally by Stora Tuna OK and Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott and has a strong social profile with team registration options and a concluding picnic. The event aims to raise awareness of blood donation and welcomes both individual participants and teams. Information and practical details (bib numbers, storage, start areas) are published on the event page.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running loops that go north over Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking loop goes down toward Borlänge center and ends at the fruit and medal boards
Lilla Blodomloppet is about 800 m and runs in the area around the event site
additional: Registration can be done individually or in a team (3 - 5 persons, picnic basket included). Team registrations cannot be late-updated after May 21; individual participants can late-register in the system up to May 28 at 12:00. On race day, late registration takes place at the arena area from 15:00 - 17:00 and only via Swish (400 SEK). Bib number pickup is available at Friskis&Svettis (Skomakargatan 9) on May 24 from 13:00 - 16:00. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount per person. The kiosk at the event area accepts only Swish. Team registration for 3 - 5 participants includes a picnic basket. Individual registration is also available; blood donor discount 40 SEK per person. Start time is 17:00 with warm-up at 16:45 (according to information). The course includes 5 km, 10 km and Lilla Blodomloppet (approximately 800 m); registration takes place via the website or on site at Sportfältet from around 15:00. Start packages sold include a technical T-shirt, bib number and medal.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Örebro is part of Sweden's largest running tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at Gustavsviksbadet. Runners can choose between a 2.5 km or an officially measured 5 km course; both individual registrations and team registrations (team of 5) are welcome. The event offers a medal, finish bag, bib number, and optional timing—and teams that register are invited to a picnic after the finish. The event is organized locally by KFUM Örebro Friidrott in collaboration with the Marathongruppen and other local clubs.
course_highlights: Available distances: 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km
Evening run at Gustavsviksbadet with start at 18:30
Team picnic after finish for teams of five
additional: Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, no later than one hour before the first start. For individual registration, a medal, finish bag, bib number, and (if chosen) timing are included—timing can be omitted so that results are not published. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years in the company of an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years in the company of an adult). There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital) where the medal is sent after the tour ends and team registration is not possible. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team registrations include a picnic; age recommendations: 5 km 13 years (accompanied by an adult 11 years); 2.5 km 11 years (accompanied by an adult 7 years). Event area at Gustavsviksbadet; digital registration and binding enrollment.

name: S:t Hans Extreme

description: S:t Hans Extreme is a welcoming yet challenging trail race at S:t Hans Backar in Lund, held on Thursday, 28 May 2026. The race offers several classes for different levels and ambitions: Ultra (6 h), 10 km, 5 km and a shorter lap of 2.5 km as well as relay teams. The course is technical with significant climbs per lap and suits both competitive runners and those seeking a tough training challenge. The organizer welcomes everyone and provides practical information about registration, payment and start times on their information page.
course_highlights: The course runs on S:t Hans Backar: a technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation (10 km = approximately 10.2 km, 560 m elevation gain; 5 km = approximately 5.1 km, 280 m elevation gain)
The ultrarace is 4.38 km (out-and-back section so runners can cheer each other); ultraclass runners complete as many laps as possible within 6 hours
additional: Registration is via Mittlopp.se (link from the organizer's registration page). Online regular price applies until 18/5; after-online registration 18–25/5 at an increased price and it is also possible to register late at Löplabbet in Lund on 26/5 from 16:00 to 18:00 (in-store discount) as well as at the competition site on 28/5 (ultra classes 13:20–13:50, others 16:45–18:20) - payment preferably by Swish (Lund OK's Swish number: 123 303 6787), cash in exact amounts in exceptional cases. Runners from Lunds Orienteringsklubb pay a reduced fee (50:-). Relay teams: the fastest team is counted over 40 km and there is also a relay for the longest total distance. Course information: lap-based course at S:t Hans Backar, 2.55 km per lap with about 140 meters of elevation gain; ultraclass run within 6 hours. Registration and payment via Mittlopp.se; Swish payment; live results link available on the race page. Ongoing roadworks on Svenshögsvägen between Norra Ringen and Magistratsvägen may affect accessibility; it is recommended to use cycling or public transport.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Eksjö Stadslopp on Friday, May 29, 2026 – an evening race in the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö. The race program includes the classic 10 km, 5 km recreational run, and children’s and youth races (1000 m and 600 m). The finish line is on Stora Torget, and the proceeds from the event go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children and youth activities. The course is officially measured for both the 10 km and 5 km, and the event is open to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: The race runs through Eksjö's historic wooden town
Finish on Stora Torget in Eksjö
