The course is officially measured for both 10 km and 5 km
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at Snäckan (next to the swimming hall). Pickup times: Thursday, May 28 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Friday, May 29 from 14:00; changing rooms in Prästängshallen until 21:30 on the competition day. Late registration is available from May 24 at an increased fee and is possible no later than one hour before the start for each class via the same registration page. Medal to all who complete the 600 m and 1000 m; plaque to finishers of the 5 km and 10 km. Sprint prize in the 10 km after about 1.2 km (first man and first woman; must finish the race). Class divisions are determined by year of birth. Group registration via invoice to tavling.esik@gmail.com. Course maps are available to pick up at Snäckan on Thursday and Friday. Late registration from May 24 at an increased fee; bib numbers collected at Snäckan by the swimming hall; parking is available at Storegårdsgatan 3A, Eksjö; changing in Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day.

name: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run
description: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run is an evening race in the city’s night lights where music, light, and a festive atmosphere are at the center. You can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast and almost flat course with start and finish at Gröningen, just a short walk from Helsingborg C. The race suits both you who are chasing a personal best and you who want to experience a great running festival together with friends. The event is certified as World Athletics Road Race 2026 and takes place on 29 May 2026 with a start time of 22:00.
course_highlights: Fast, nearly flat course along Strandpromenaden (5 km; 10 km = 2 laps with a turnaround at Gröningen)
Surface: approximately 90% asphalt, 8% compacted gravel, 2% grass
Start and finish at Gröningen with strong crowd, music, and lighting
additional: Start and finish at Gröningen (about a 10-minute walk from Helsingborg C). Bib pickup at Löplabbet in Helsingborg Wed–Fri 10:00–18:00 and on site from 20:00. Bag drop opens at 20:00 and uses a sticker with bib number. Löplabbet pacers offered at several finish times for both 5 km and 10 km. After Run and refreshments/products from partners (including Lindahls quark, SP Chark sausages, Erdinger non-alcoholic beer, Ramlösa, Dole, KitKat). Maximum number of starters: 1500. Distances: 5 km or 10 km; evening race in Helsingborg city centre with music and lights; date 29 May 2026; registration offers options for timing or without timing; entry fee 500:-; corporate invoicing via downloadable Excel form.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: Get a taste of the unique marathon atmosphere by running the adidas Shake Out Run. The race is 5 km long and starts and finishes at Stockholms Stadion. It is a perfect warm-up for those who will run the marathon the day after, but also an opportunity for others to experience the atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 to register are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt in the chosen size.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholms Stadion
5 km course - a short race perfect as a warm-up
Participation gives a foretaste of the marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: The race is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. Age limit 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a guardian). The first 1,000 registrants are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt that will be distributed in connection with the race; others can after the race visit the information desk to see which sizes are still available. Payment options: online bank transfer, Visa/MasterCard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Late registration is possible digitally up until 1 hour before the first start. Minimum age 13 years; environmentally friendly transport options to the event area (subway/bus or bicycle); registration is done via a participant account; first-come-first-served shirts and sizes are distributed at the information desk.

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: Welcome to Nya BUM - Borås Ultra Marathon, organized by SOK Knallen. The race takes place on Sunday, May 30, 2026, with start and finish at Kypegården in Borås. The event offers courses of 50 km, half marathon (21.1 km), and 10 km; the courses are being surveyed and finalized during the spring. Registration is via mittlopp.se, and according to the federation participants must be at least 17 years old in the year of the half marathon and longer distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Kypegården in Borås
Three distances: 50 km, 21.1 km (half marathon), and 10 km
The courses are surveyed and finalized during the spring – you can follow or join reconnaissance runs via the club's Facebook
additional: Registration is via mittlopp.se. According to the Swedish Sports Confederation's rules, participants must be 17 years old in the relevant year to run the half marathon (21.1 km) and longer distances. The courses are under construction/measurement and reconnaissance runs are conducted during the club's Sunday trainings; the organizer encourages following the club's Facebook for information about reconnaissance. The start and finish area and practical information will be located at Kypegården. Age limit of 17 years for longer distances.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
location: Markaryd, Markaryds Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: The Markaryd Sparbank Run is a long-distance race held in Markaryd in connection with the Sparbank's anniversary celebrations and the spring market. The race is mentioned as part of the anniversary program and is planned together with other activities during the anniversary year. According to sources, participation is funded through a registration fee that benefits local associations, making the race a community-strengthening effort. The event is highlighted as a welcoming opportunity to participate in a local setting and contribute to community life.
course_highlights: Event in May in Markaryd, in connection with the spring market
Part of Markaryd Sparbank's 150th anniversary program with several activities
The registration fee goes to support local associations
additional: Registration is carried out by filling out the form on the registration page. The competition date is 2026-05-30 and the last day for pre-registration is 2026-05-27. Start lists will be published closer to the start date (an archived start list for 2025 is available). The Sparbank Run is mentioned as an activity with a registration fee that benefits participating associations; planned anniversary activities include lectures, treasure hunts and a family day.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon race that this year takes place on May 30, 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 meters long, officially measured according to applicable regulations, and runs through central Stockholm on a new course. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organizers highlight extensive runner services along the course. Start takes place from Stockholm Stadium and the race offers seedings opportunities via among others adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 meters, officially measured according to the Swedish Athletics Federation and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen, Kungsgatan) with city passage
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Stadium. Start in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. Maximum marathon time is 6.5 hours and there are four check points with stop times along the course. Seedings: the last day to report a seed time is May 3, 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan are seedings-based. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) runs in Norra Djurgården, has total ascent 117 m, mixed surfaces and tentative start time 11:00; maximum time 2 hours and contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for May 30, 2026. The course goes through central Stockholm and ends at Stockholm Stadium; runners have the opportunity to participate in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: The Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland starting at the Långe Erik lighthouse. The race is offered in three distances—50 km, 50 miles and 100 miles—and runs along coastal stretches, meadow and forest terrains with views of the alvar and the Baltic Sea. The race is well organized with hydration stations and energy depots along the course; a medal and a T-shirt are awarded to all finishers. The organizer is Högby IF, and the event suits both experienced ultrarunners and long-distance-trained recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start at the Långe Erik lighthouse with coastal running along the Kalmar Strait to Sandvik (50 km finish)
Stretch through meadow and forest areas to Lindby (50 miles finish) and on to Långe Jan for 100 miles
Views of the alvar and the Baltic Sea; hydration stations/energy depots approximately every 20 km
additional: Bib pickup on Friday from 13:30; race maps and GPX file (updated) are available on the race page; labels for drop bags are provided; a medal and a T-shirt are awarded to all finishers; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); payment for late registration/bib pickup: cash, card or Swish. Training and running info is available; energy depots approximately every 20 km; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); start at Långe Erik and finish at Långe Jan; medal and T-shirt are included in the registration fee; late registration possible until 27 May according to PM

name: Skatås ryggar
location: Skatås, Gothenburg, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Skatås ryggar is a large trail race in Gothenburg that runs on winding trails in the Delsjöområdet and Knipeflågsbergens Nature Reserve. The race is offered on courses that go over five, four, or two ridges and has course lengths that suit both experienced trail runners and youth (ages 10–16). The event is just a few kilometers from Gothenburg's city center and includes services such as water stations and coffee breaks. Welcome to participate in a technical and nature-close trail experience near the city.
course_highlights: Winding trails in the Delsjöområdet and Knipeflågsbergens Nature Reserve
Courses that traverse five, four, or two ridges
The race is just a few kilometers from central Gothenburg
additional: There is information about water stations, coffee breaks and start times on the competition page. Pre-race runs and training sessions are organized before the race (announced on the website). Youth classes for ages 10–16 are offered and there is a page for group registration. Results are published and updated during the race day. The distances correspond to two, four, or five ridges; youth classes for ages 10–16; water stations and coffee breaks during the race; pre-race and trail training at Skatås Motionscentral before the competition.

name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Welcome to Seskarö Trailrun - a family-friendly cross-country run in the Haparanda Archipelago that offers courses for all levels. There are adult distances of 3 km, 7 km and 12 km, as well as children’s courses of 500 m, 1,000 m and 2 km. The courses run on existing trails and vary between easy-to-run paths, technical sections, sand and rolling stones. All proceeds go to the maintenance and development of the Seskarö Trails outdoor recreation area.
course_highlights: Varying surfaces: forest trails, gravel, rolling stones, and sand
The 7 km and 12 km routes begin with about 400 m of asphalt, followed by easy-to-run trails and later more technical terrain with log hops and clear-cut areas
Specific routes: 12 km (Tre Vikar), 7 km (Kenkälahti-slingan), 3 km (Tipsrundan and Naturstigen)
additional: Bib pickup: Friday 29/5 from 17:00–20:00 and Saturday 30/5 from 08:00 at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping; start numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before start. All participants receive a participation medal. There are toilets adjacent to the finish area. No refunds of the entry fee for missed registration. Courses: 3, 7 and 12 km; children's courses 0.5, 1 and 2 km. Bib pickup Friday 17:00 - 20:00 and Saturday from 08:00; latest 30 minutes before start. Water stations at the finish; showers are available at the finish (limited). Accommodation is offered via Seskarö Havsbad & Camping; offers via Haparanda Stadshotell. Participation supports Seskarö Trails.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
distance_verbose: 6.7 km, 3.7 km, Backyard Ultra, Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Welcome to the Highland Charity Backyard Ultra in Sävsjö - a charitable and challenging backyard ultra where Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö and the Highland Trail Club collaborate. The race is run as hourly start loops with a shared start at 09:00 and a new start every hour; the person who does not complete the loop within 60 minutes is out. Participants can choose between an easy 3.7 km loop around the lake or the tougher 6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan, and the money from the race goes to charitable causes.
course_highlights: 3.7 km around the lake (gravel road, trail, asphalt) - easy course with good footing
6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan (gravel road, forest trail) - technical and hilly forest running
Loop format: new start every full hour; 15 loops equal approximately 55 km and approximately 100 km, respectively
additional: Parking at Slottsruinens parking (toilets available); bib number, water bottle, food and coffee/bun included in the registration fee. Food is served for participants at 11:30, 15:30 and 19:30. Bib numbers can be collected 07:30 - 08:30 on race morning. Late registration is open May 24 - May 30 at 08:30 (late registration 350 SEK). The winner is the last person remaining to complete a lap, or the first to finish on lap 15 if several remain. Participants choose the distance before each hourly start; prize money is awarded only to the person who runs the long course. The Backyard Ultra format with two distances; max 15 laps; start at 09:00 and finish no later than 00:00; advance registration and late registration up to race day; start and finish area at Slottsruinens parking in Sävsjö.

name: Säffle Stadslopp 2026
location: Medborgarhuset i Säffle, Säffle Municipality, Sweden
description: Säffle Stadslopp is a public- and family-friendly festival in central Säffle organized by Säffle SK. The event offers several classes for all levels, including a tough yet moderately challenging 10 km race, 5 km for runners or walking, shorter races for children, and Boxen Race, a 5 km obstacle-filled race. Expect strong spectator support along the course and a pleasant atmosphere in the town center. Welcome to participate whether you compete or exercise for leisure.
course_highlights: Race in central Säffle with strong spectator support
Beautiful, spectator-friendly course through the city center
Boxen Race: 5 km with challenging obstacles
additional: Start times according to the pages: ST-Loppet 10:30 (mass start); 10K Team Sportia Loppet 11:00 (mass start); 5K Running 11:00 (mass start); Sibyllapromenaden 5K 11:00. Competition classes include children's race and Boxen Race (5 km with obstacles). Partner/communication: Team Sportia Säffle is named as the contact point and RaceID handles questions about changing or transferring of a start place via support@raceid.com. Contacts on the page: Magnus (overall questions), Stefan Guttman (organizer role) and Mattias (Boxen Race). Registration is online via RaceID and the price increases on May 10. Start/finish at Medborgarhuset in Säffle. Bib numbers can be picked up at Team Sportia Säffle or at the secretariat on race day. Courses: 10K/5K along the Byälven waterfront and central Säffle; ST-Loppet about 1.5 km; Paprica-Loppet 300 m; Boxen Race about 2.5 km per lap, two laps.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset in Sundsvall is a local edition of the national Vårruset tour, taking place on Monday, June 1, 2026, with start and finish at Hamnträdgården. The race offers two distances, 2.5 km and an officially measured 5 km, and the course runs through the city center and along the Selångersån. All participants receive a medal, a goody bag, and a bib number; teams of five also receive a picnic after finishing. There is an option to opt out of timing in the registration, and the organizers welcome both individual registrations and teams of five.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnträdgården
The course runs through the city center and along the Selångersån
Two distances: 2.5 km and an officially measured 5 km
additional: Bib pickup at Intersport Sundsvall: Thursday, May 28, 18:00–20:00; Friday, May 29, 18:00–20:00; and Saturday, May 30, 11:00–14:00. A team consists of five people and team registrations include a picnic after finishing. Recommended age: 13 years for the 5 km (adult with an 11-year-old) and 11 years for the 2.5 km (adult with a 7-year-old). There is a digital option (Vårruset Digitalt) running May 4–June 4 where the medal is mailed home and official timing, goody bag, marked course, and picnic are not included. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing; digital registration for the race must be completed no later than 1 hour before the first start; bib distribution via Intersport Sundsvall; recommended age: 13 years for 5 km (adult with an 11-year-old) and 11 years for 2.5 km (adult with a 7-year-old).

name: Blodomloppet Örebro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 13 maj – 26 maj:  400 kr (Lag: 2000 kr t.o.m. 26 maj)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 maj: 0 kr (upp till max 200 deltagare, därefter 100 kr)

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Örebro - a festival-style race that highlights the life-saving blood donation. The event offers competition/festival for both 5 km and 10 km (women/men), a short Special race and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. Registration can be done individually or in teams of five people and the race is suitable for both walking and running at all ages. The organizers also encourage community and often finish with a large picnic.
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (team = 5 participants, 1-2 spots may be vacant). Team fee and the possibility to mix classes apply; an Excel template for mass registration is available. Lilla Blodomloppet is for ages 1-12 (adults may accompany) and the first 200 children who register no later than 2026-04-30 will participate for free according to the organizer's offer. Discounts: blood donors, ICA regulars and a campaign via Nerikes Allehanda (40 SEK, some restrictions - not valid for late registration). Last day for team registration is 2026-05-26; individuals can register up until the race (about 30 minutes before start) but usually at a higher fee. Contact for registration/assistance: orebro@blodomloppet.se or kansli@blodomloppet.se.

name: Vårruset Östersund
description: Vårruset i Östersund is a local heat in the nationwide Vårruset tour that invites an easily accessible 2.5 km or 5 km evening race along the shores of Storsjön. The event is open to runners of various ages and offers both individual registration and team registration (team of five) with a picnic after finish for the team. For the 5 km distance, official timing is offered, which can be opted out in the registration; all participants receive a medal, a goody bag, and a bib. Start and finish are located at Storsjön and the event area is north of Badhusparken at the old Yrancamping.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shores of Storsjön.
Start and finish at Storsjön, in the event area north of Badhusparken (the old Yrancamping).
Available distances: 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km.
additional: What is included (individual registration): medal, goody bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib and (for those who chose it) timing for the 5 km; for team registration, a picnic after finish is included. Bib distribution at Intersport Östersund May 23, 11:00–17:00 and May 30, 11:00–17:00. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with an adult). Registration can be completed digitally up to race day, at the latest 1 hour before the first start. There is also a separate Vårruset Digital (2.5 km or 5 km) that can be completed May 4 – June 4; digital participants receive a medal mailed home and cannot participate in physical events. Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km (officially measured 5 km course); teams consist of five people and a picnic after finish; digital registration with the option to opt out of timing; medal, goody bag and bib included; bib distribution via Intersport Östersund.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
description: Blodomloppet Stockholm is a festival-style run organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation. The event offers 5 km and 10 km for runners and walkers, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children, and traditionally ends with a picnic. Competitive classes are available with timing and prizes for the three fastest runners. Everyone is welcome—run, jog, or walk for a good cause.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km - options to walk, jog, or run
Walking class 5 km where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children: 1.1 km (7-12 years) and 800 m (1-6 years)
additional: A team consists of 5 people (at least 3 names are required at registration) and team registration must be completed no later than May 28; team registration includes a picnic bag. Extra picnic bags cost 250 kr and can be added until May 28. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount (stated at registration) and a blood donor gift is distributed at the GeBlods tent; distance participants receive an ICA gift card (250 kr) instead of a picnic bag. Invoice payments are offered only for orders over 1500 kr. Walking poles are only allowed in walking classes; baby strollers are not allowed during the race but are welcome in the event area. Arena at Djurgårdsbrunn; the start corral opens about 20 minutes before the start; the walking class is untimed; no access to changing rooms or showers; blood donors receive a discount on registration (40 kr).

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
description: Vårruset in Luleå is an evening run in Sweden's largest mass-participation running event for women and is scheduled for Thursday, June 4, 2026, with the arena at StiL Sportscenter. The race is offered at 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is measured) and is open to participants of all fitness levels. Individual registrations include a medal, a goody bag, and bib; team registration (team of five) includes a picnic after finishing. The event combines running enjoyment with social elements such as Vårruset's music quiz and the option to opt out of official timing.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is measured
Available distances: 2.5 km or 5 km
Venue/start at StiL Sportscenter, Universitetsvägen 11 (Luleå)
additional: Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, at the latest one hour before the first start. Individual registrations include a medal, a goody bag, and bib; timing can be optional (for those who choose it) so that results are not published. Team registration (five people) includes a picnic after finishing. Recommended ages: 5 km from 13 years (or 11 years in the company of an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (or 7 years in the company of an adult). The event also offers a digital race (2.5 or 5 km) where a medal is mailed after the event ends; digital registration does not include a picnic, music quiz, or official timing. Training sessions are organized on the same day/time at several locations (in Luleå: March 19 at 6:30 PM at StiL Sportscenter). Registration is binding and the registration fee is non-refundable. Distances: 2.5 or 5 km; team registration - picnic after finish; digital registration; provision of time; age recommendations: 5 km 13 years (11 years in the company of an adult); 2.5 km 11 years (7 years in the company of an adult); training opportunities including training sessions at 19 locations.

name: Jernbrukets backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad 150 kr som betalas direkt till The Tannery Club.

description: Jernbrukets Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultramarathon with start and finish at Restaurang Jernbruket in Floda. The race runs on a 6.7 km loop that must be completed in under 60 minutes; thereafter the next loop starts every full hour and the last runner remaining wins - the race lasts as long as the participants can endure. The course runs in hilly forest terrain in the area around the Säveån valley and Nääs Castle, and the organizers plan both day and night running. The restaurant at the station serves as the competition center and the organizers highlight good food and a genuine early-summer forest experience for both runners and spectators.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop (backyard format, must be completed within 60 minutes)
Hilly forest terrain with many elevation changes; areas around the Säveån valley and Nääs Castle
Start and finish at Restaurang Jernbruket, about 150 meters from Floda railway station
additional: The start and finish of the race are at Restaurang Jernbruket (Floda Stationsväg 3), near Floda railway station; the main race is limited to 100 participants. Backyard Ultra variant has starts at 10:00 and the last start at 15:00 (run as many laps as you want during these hours) and offers blueberry soup, sports drink (Umara) and snacks. After the race, a wood-fired sauna and bathing are offered at The Tannery Club (fee 150 SEK paid directly to the club). Backyard Ultra format; 6.7 km loop under 60 minutes; start every full hour; the last runner remaining wins; two courses (night and day running); location: the Floda area with Restaurang Jernbruket as the competition center; start time per the Facebook page: 18:00 on 6 June.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a night race in Sundsvall's urban environment with a street party, after-run and start/finish at Stora torget. The event is held on June 5, 2026 with a joint start at 22:00 and offers both 5 km and 10 km with timing as well as the option to run any distance without timing. The race is organized by Morron in collaboration with restaurant Bloco and local sports clubs and offers an experience in the beautiful stone city Sundsvall. The organizer documents the event in photos and film; if you do not want to be visible, inform this via event@morron.se.
course_highlights: Running through Sundsvall's beautiful stone city
Start and finish at Stora torget (mass start)
5 km and 10 km with timing (also the option to run any distance without timing)
additional: Late registration: online registration possible up to 30 minutes before start if spots remain. Bib pickup at Stadium City during race week or on-site between 19:00 - 21:30 on race day. Timing with a numbered chip and start/finish mat; everyone receives a medal. Hydration check available (water and sports drink). Age limits: from 12 years in the company of an adult or from 14 years on your own. Option to transfer entry to Thursday June 5, 23:59 for a fee (100 kr) via event@morron.se. Accommodation offer at Scandic City (booking: event.sundsvallcity@scandichotels.com). Mass start, timing; START at 22:00; distances 5 km, 10 km or 5/10 km without timing (and FunRun according to some sources); finish area with a bar; after-run; documentation of the competition (photos/video) and opt-out info

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a 10 km evening race that goes one lap around Södermalm and is consistently described as both beautiful and very fast. The fourteenth edition takes place on Saturday 6 June 2026 with the first start preliminarily at 19:45. The course is measured, flat and easy-to-run along the water, which makes the race popular for personal bests. After the finish, an After Run party with food, drinks and music is held.
course_highlights: 10.00 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat and easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
Water stations after 4 km and at the finish
additional: Age limit 14 years (After Run 18 years); strollers and dogs are not allowed; all who complete the race receive a medal and products at the finish; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; volunteers mainly from Löparakademin and Fredrikshofs FIF; payment via online banking, card, Swish or invoice/bank giro for larger group registrations. Start at Tantolunden; finish at Hornstulls strand; course asphalt and gravel, flat; age limit 18 years; strollers and dogs not allowed; After Run party; sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Eketånga trail Halmstad
description: Come and experience the incredibly beautiful and fun trails in Eketångaskogen and between the golf courses in Tylösand/Frösakull! Here you run on flowing trails, over roots and stones, on a varied course in a fantastic environment that will not disappoint you! In 2026 you can choose whether you want to run 10 km or 21 km. Start and finish just by the sea at Wakeparken in Grötvik's harbor. About 400 enthusiastic runners usually line up at the start; join the running festival by the sea and in the forest as well! It will be fun! Registration is open.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the sea in Grötvik's harbor
Winding trails through Eketångaskogen and the Eketånga nature reserve – roots, stones and flowing sections
Loop around the dramatic stone quarry with a great view (starts and finishes there); the 21 km also includes sections by Tylösand's golf courses and Nyrebäcken
additional: Race bib, medal, and Eketånga trail bag included. Water/energy at 1 station for 10 km (at 5.5 km) and 2 stations for 21 km (at 5.5, 10 and 15 km); Umara sports drink provided during the race. Timing and live results; cash prizes for the top 3 women and men as well as prize draws. Race bibs collected at Sportringen May 30 – June 5 or at Wakeparken before the start. Valuables can be handed to a staff member (at your own risk); medical staff are on site, and warm-up is led by instructors from Actic. Trail running on dirt paths and gravel roads; opportunities for guided tours along the trails; children's races offered during Halmstad Outdoor Weekend; bib pickup and energy stations are on site; bag drop-off in Wakeparken; museum visits and after-race hangout in Wakeparken.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
description: Björnfrossa ultramarathon is a scenic yet challenging off-road race of about 65 km in Gästrikland's bear country, with start and finish at the Kungsberget recreation facility. The course mainly follows Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden and Fäbodleden, offering technical trails, gravel roads and several nice viewpoints, as well as about 1200 m total elevation gain. The race is organized by the Björnfrossa organizing association and has a strong local origin - the idea was born in 2017 by a group of runners from Sandviken. All levels wanting to experience long-distance running in nature in the region are welcome, but the race is not a sanctioned event.
course_highlights: Approximately 65 km along Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden and Fäbodleden
Approximately 1200 m of total elevation gain; a mix of technical trails and gravel roads
Several viewpoints along the course
additional: Maximum time: 12 hours. Four staffed aid stations along the course with water, sports drinks and light refreshments; trash bags are available for rubbish. Bib numbers are distributed at the start area and must be worn visibly for the duration of the race. No drop bag service is offered - everything you want to bring with you must be carried from the start. Recommended equipment: mobile phone with a map and an emergency number to be announced later; no formal equipment requirements but be prepared for several hours between stations. Medical personnel are present at the start/finish; out on the course you are responsible for yourself and in case of emergency call 112. Four staffed aid stations; drop bags are not offered; about 15 km between each aid station; medical care at start and finish; 112 in case of emergency; not a sanctioned race.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet - tre hamnar
description:
Fiskebäcksloppet - three harbors
The race where you run for others. The entire entry fee goes to the Salvation Army's social work.

Fiskebäcksloppet - three harbors
10 km on a hilly and scenic course where you pass the harbors of Önnered, Hinsholmen and Fiskebäck.

Little Fiskebäck Race
2.5 km on gravel roads and trails in the Sjöbacka nature reserve (children's race)

Fiskebäcksloppet - Sjöbacka
5 km (two laps on the Little Fiskebäck Race course)
course_highlights: Course route passes through three harbors
Beautiful nature in Sjöbacka nature reserve
Multiple distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and a mini run (~500 m)
additional: The event area is open 11:30–17:00. Bib pickup takes place on-site and it is possible to register children for the Mini Run on-site. There is the possibility to buy food on-site, a stage for communal warm-up and prize giving, as well as volunteers, medical staff and crossing guards. Additional facilities such as a bouncy castle, bicycle parking, toilets and the possibility to drop off bags are available. There is also a team competition where the teams with the most registered runners win prizes. Open between 11:30 and 17:00 for bib distribution, timing, food sales, warm-up on stage and prize distribution.

images.alt_text: Löpare på podiet med Fiskebäcksloppets logotyp och priser.
Barn med nummerlappar höjer händerna före Fiskebäcksloppet.
Deltagare springer i Fiskebäcksloppet, en väg- och terränglopp med nummerbrickor.
Löpare i ett väglopp, med nummerlappar synliga.
Fiskebäcksloppet medalj med blått band och en löpare som motiv.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet 2026 (Önnered)
description: Fiskebäcksloppet is Räddningsmissionen's running festival in the Sjöbacka nature area, held on Saturday, June 6, 2026. The race offers multiple distances - 10 km (Three Harbors), 5 km (Sjöbacka), 2.5 km (Little Fiskebäcksloppet) and a mini race - and the course passes through three harbors with beautiful nature. The starting fee goes entirely to Räddningsmissionen's social work, and the event welcomes both new and returning runners.
course_highlights: The course passes through three harbors
Beautiful nature in the Sjöbacka nature area
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km and a mini race (approx. 500 m)
additional: Event area is open 11:30–17:00; bib numbers can be collected on site; a group warm-up and prize ceremony take place on stage; volunteers, medical staff and traffic marshals are on site; bike parking, toilets, a bouncy castle and bag drop are available; a team competition is available and participants can start their own fundraising for Räddningsmissionen. Three harbors along the course; open area 11:30–17:00 with bib-number distribution, opportunities to buy food, group warm-up, prize ceremony, a bouncy castle, medical staff and traffic marshals; opportunities for team competition and own fundraising for Räddningsmissionens social work.

name: UppLoppet
description: On June 6, 2026 we invite you to UppLoppet - a wonderful running event of 3 km and 10 km filled with running joy, community, and festive atmosphere. Whether you are aiming for a personal best, want to run at a relaxed pace, or simply enjoy the atmosphere, UppLoppet is for you. In addition to the race, we offer several pleasant side-events for both participants and spectators. Welcome to celebrate movement, health and community together with us on National Day!
course_highlights: 10 km and 3 km through central Uppsala
Routes along the Fyris River and through Stadsskogen
Finish at Studenternas IP with spectators, music and activities
additional: The race takes place in the morning of June 6, 2026. The recommended minimum age for the 10 km is 15 years; younger participants may participate accompanied by an adult or choose the 3 km. There are several side-events and activities at the arena for participants and spectators. National Day celebration; central Uppsala location description; views along the Fyris River and Stadsskogen; side-events for participants and spectators

images.alt_text: Löpare med svenska flaggor springer, UppLoppet 3 km & 10 km, 6 juni.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
location: Kungsgatan, Borgholms Idrottsplats, Borgholm, Kalmar County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Lilla Victorialoppet (2 km / 1,5 km) & Parasport (2 km)

description: Victorialoppet in Borgholm is Öland's biggest running festival and offers races for the whole family—from Mini for the youngest to the main race of 9 km. The running competition has a long tradition and donates portions of the proceeds to the Crown Princess Victoria's Fund; there is also a virtual running option. The start for Mini, Lilla and Victoriajoggen takes place from Kungsgatan by Borgholm's sports ground, and the event is characterized by a festival-like atmosphere with spectators, music and seaside views. All participants receive information about bib collection, changing facilities and prizes in the participant information.
course_highlights: The main race features a fast, easy-to-run course.
Beautiful coastal views and routes that largely run in the harbor area
Enthusiastic spectators and musical entertainment at several locations along the course
additional: Bib collection on competition day at Borgholm Sports Hall from 10:00 to 18:00. In the 9 km race there is water along the course; musical entertainment at several locations. Prizes and commemorative plaques/medals are awarded according to class (Victorialoppet receives a commemorative plaque; Victoriajoggen and para classes receive medals; Lilla Victorialoppet receives a medal, ice cream and drinks). Changing facilities and showers: men/boys at Borgholm's Sports Hall, women/girls at Viktoriaskolan's gym hall. Timing is recorded with a disposable chip. From June 15, standard fees apply and late registration on July 15 incurs higher fees; check-in times: 9 km by 18:00, 4 km by 16:45, 2 km/1.5 km by 15 minutes before start.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
description: Västerås Stadslopp is organized by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and invites you to a popular and family-friendly running day in an urban setting on Sunday, June 7, 2026. The event offers races for adults (including 10 km and 2.5 km), children's races in three distances, and a Paralopp for participants with disabilities. There is a team class for four people with a picnic/food bag as the prize, activities for children in Vasaparken, and all participants receive a stadslopp medal. The organizers urge signing up early as the spots for the children's races are limited and have sold out in previous years.
course_highlights: Start/finish near the City Hall (festival area and services at the start).
Children's Races and Paralopp in Vasaparken (selectable courses approx. 200 m, 400 m, or 800 m).
Toilets and water refill stations in front of the City Hall near the start/finish.
additional: The children's races have three distance options (approximately 200 m, 400 m, 800 m) and are limited to a maximum of 400 children. A four-person team receives a food bag from Hemköp Malmaberg (last day for team registration 31 May). Team members do not need to run the same race. Bib numbers are picked up in the days before the race; the bib is attached with safety pins and worn visibly on the stomach or chest. Friskis & Svettis conducts a warm-up about 10 minutes before each race; the Paralopp awards a medal and a goodie bag to participants. No prize ceremony or timing for the 2.5 km; an honorary prize for the top three in the 10 km and 5 km. There is an opportunity for companies to book a tent (5,000 SEK) or a beach flag (2,500 SEK) via henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se. All participants receive a medal and a goodie bag at the finish. There are water stations along the course and activities in Vasaparken during the event.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
location: Gallabergsskogen, Vretstorp, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Vretstorps IF Löpning organizes Gallaberget Trailrun in Gallabergsskogen, with running around Gallabergssjön. The event is an evening race suitable for recreational runners and local runners and is part of the association's summer calendar. Information and registration are presented via the association's page on laget.se, and the organizer warmly welcomes you to forest trails and nature-oriented running.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Gallabergssjön
Evening race (start 18:00)
Nature-oriented trail and forest terrain in Gallabergsskogen
additional: Organizer: Vretstorps IF Löpning. Location in the calendar: Gallabergssjön / Gallabergsskogen. The calendar event is shown on laget.se and the page offers instructions for subscribing via iCal, Google Calendar, and Outlook. On the page there are prompts such as 'Click to register' in news posts, but no direct registration link was found on the crawled pages.

name: Alpaca Race
location: Hisingsparken, Göteborg, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: The Alpaca Race is a challenging trail run in Gothenburg's Hisingen Park, built as laps on a technical course. The race format offers four selectable distances/loops (1, 3, 5 or 10 loops) with substantial elevation gain and is intended as preparation for tough mountain races such as UTMB. The race takes place June 13–14, 2026, with night running for the longest distances and a medal for all finishers. The event is organized by IF Kville, with gathering and a depot at Tuve Ice Hall / IF Kville's clubhouse.
course_highlights: Technical trail course in Hisingen Park / the Tuve area
Loop format: choose 1, 3, 5 or 10 loops (10 loops = 106 km, +6000 meters of elevation)
Course designed for the same elevation gain per kilometer as UTMB (tough elevation profile)
additional: Start and schedule: 10 loops start Saturday at 19:00 (24 h, 20 places), 5 loops start Sunday at 07:00 (12 h, 50 places), 3 loops start at 10:00 (8 h, 50 places) and a 1-loop option with starts around 11:00/15:00 (1–3 h, 100 places). Check-in and allocation of spots before the start, depot/start at IF Kville's clubhouse at Tuve Ice Hall with toilets and changing/shower facilities. Food: grilling and the option to bring your own food; energy drinks and evening staffing are available. A course trial run will be announced separately with its own timing for those who wish. A pre-race run (date may vary); night running period 19:00–07:00; 24 hours / 20 places; grilling/own food at base camp.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
location: Böda Sand, Böda, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a nature-focused trail race on northern Öland with distances of 50 km and 25 km for both men and women. The course goes through classic Öland forests and coastal landscapes and passes, among others, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. The 50 km start is at Böda Sand and the 25 km start is in Byxelkrok, with a joint finish at Böda Sand. Pre-registered participants will receive a T-shirt if they register no later than June 6.
course_highlights: Byrums raukar (coastal cliff formations)
Neptuni åkrar (coastal farmland with views)
Trollskogen (characteristic pine forest in northern Öland)
additional: Location: Sport Camp, Böda Sand (northern Öland). Time: June 13, 2026; 50 km start at 09:00 Böda Sand, 25 km start at 10:00 Byxelkrok; shared finish in Böda Sand. Medal for all finishers. To receive a T-shirt, register by June 6 and indicate shirt size (men/women). Bib collection: Friday, June 12 from 19:00 to 20:00 and race day June 13 from 07:30 to 09:00 (last opportunity for late registration). Payment for late registration: cash, card or Swish. Contact/organizer: Högby IF. Shared finish in Böda Sand; start times 50 km at 09:00 and 25 km at 10:00; registration by June 6, 2026 for preregistration and until June 11 for late registration; preregistration includes a T-shirt.

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race that runs through a primeval forest environment in Örnsköldsvik Municipality and is organized by Björna IF. The race is offered in two distances: the long original race of 19.7 km (start in Backe/Berg, finish at Bigvallen in Björna) and a shorter race at 6.6 km (start and finish at Bigvallen). The course runs partly along the Urskogsleden hiking trail and mainly on easy forest trails over logs and rocks, with occasionally wet and uneven terrain. Urskogsloppet has been organized since 2009 and is always held on the Saturday before Midsummer.
course_highlights: Partly along the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Mainly easy forest trails over logs and rocks - uneven and locally wet underfoot
Checkpoints with fluids and light snacks (long: checkpoints after approx. 6, 13, 15 and 18 km; short: checkpoints at approx. 3.2 and 5 km)
additional: Participation cap: 350. Registration/parking/changing at the school in Björna; for the long race a bus to the start in Backe runs after registration. Personal bags may be left at the start and retrieved at the finish. Possibility to buy food at the school canteen (cost 120 SEK, last day to book food 2026-06-01). Registration must be completed no later than 10:00 on race day (online registration closes 2026-06-10 at 20:00), but on-site late registration may occur if spots are available. Time limits: checkpoint at 6 km closes 1 hour 40 minutes after start, checkpoint at 13 km closes 3 hours after start, and the finish closes 4 hours 10 minutes after start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the gymnasium and the bathhouse. Participation is at own risk. Terrain: mud/easy trails with rocks and brush, sometimes wet and uneven. Competition cap: 350 participants. Registration via Svenskalag.se (Björna IF's club page). Organized together with Lilla Urskogsloppet and the Knatteloppet for children up to 13 years old.

name: Tjejmilen Sälen by EQPE
description: Tjejmilen Sälen is a summer race in a mountain environment with the distances of 5 km and 10 km, which in 2026 will take place in Lindvallen, Sälen on June 13. The course offers varied terrain with mountain trails, technical sections and open views - an experience for both those tackling their first 10-kilometer race and for seasoned runners. The race is female-oriented and combines nature experience with community; timing is offered and can be opted out at registration.
course_highlights: Mountain trails and technical sections in a majestic mountain environment
Marshes and views toward Mellanfjället and Hemfjället
A narrow mountain trail up to Hemfjället with several mountain tarns
additional: Distances: 5 km and 10 km. Timing is offered (can be opted out). Age limits: 10 km from 15 years (or 13 years in adult supervision); 5 km from 13 years (or 11 years in adult supervision). Late registration is possible (subject to availability) up to 2 hours before the first start and is done digitally via the regular registration page. Option to book a bus trip from Stockholm to Sälen. Payment options: online banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Water stations are placed along the course. The distances are 5 km and 10 km; start groups; late registration up to 2 hours before the first start; bus trip Stockholm - Sälen; payment options include bank, card, Swish and Klarna; refunds only in accordance with the insurance policy.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is Sweden's northernmost backyard ultra race, organized from Ursbergets ski cabin in Piteå. The race takes place on a 6,706 m long loop course with a new start every full hour - the first lap starts at 09:00 - where runners must be in the start corral to continue. Together with Piterunners, the organizers create a joint running festival in the midnight sun with simple refreshments and an Nalta Backyard Ultra T-shirt included in the regular registration. All participation is at your own risk and the race follows the rules from bigsbackyardultra.com.
course_highlights: 6,706 m loop course (approx. 6.7 km) with a new start every full hour
Approximately 65 meters of elevation gain; the surface consists mostly of forest trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads and about 500 m of asphalt
The course is marked with signs and tape; the race runs in midnight sun
additional: Registration and bib-number pickup take place 07:30–08:30 at the competition management's tent; a briefing on the race and the rules at 08:30. All fluids and energy are available at the turnaround area (including UMARA sports drink, water, coffee, sandwiches, pickled cucumber, chips, candy, fruit); personal assistance along the course is not allowed. Two smaller changing rooms (one shower) and two toilets are available; the organizers cannot offer supervision/storage of personal belongings. Parking is limited at the running track and at Tolvmansskolan – carpooling is recommended. T-shirt is included in the regular registration (not included for late registration). A team class exists (registered individually with team name) and prize giving occurs when the last runner has finished. Registration 07:30–08:30; no one on the course-odx; T-shirt included with pre-registration; possibility for a 3-person team; results are published on official websites; limited parking.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 33 km, 16 km, 8 km, 0.7 km
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a trail running race that takes place in and around Norra Djurgården and Stockholm with several distances on the event day in June 2026. The course offers a mix of technical forest trails, coastal stretches, countryside and elements of city and sights, and suits both fast international runners and those who want to reach the finish on a full-day excursion. Start and finish are at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater and all finishers receive an annual wooden medal; the organizers also offer food and post-race at the finish. More detailed race information is published on the website and sent to registered participants by e-mail before the competition.
course_highlights: A mix of archipelago, technical forest trails, countryside, urban areas and several viewpoints
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater on Norra Djurgården (easy to reach by subway and bus)
The 80 km route goes through seven municipalities and nine nature reserves; generous time limit (14 hours) and limited number of participants
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater; a wooden medal for all who finish; mandatory to carry a cup/mug or bottle to fill at water stations; GPX file available for download; the 80 km has a maximum time of 14 hours and is limited to 200 participants; more details and the program will be sent by e-mail to registered participants about two weeks before the competition. The final registration day for the distances is 11 June 2026. For the 80 km, mandatory equipment is: a container for at least one liter of water, a cup/mug, a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers' number; the water stations do not have cups.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
description: Flosjön - Edstjärn is a half marathon organized by Edstjärns IK in the Flosjön/Edstjärn area. The race is part of the association's annual event and targets recreational runners and local club participants. On the association's website, the course layout and results from previous years, including split times, are published. For information and contact, the organizer refers to the association's e-mail.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km of trail running between Flosjön and Edstjärn in Dalarna (Gagnef).
The course consists of about 80% trail and about 350 meters of elevation gain.
Organized by Edstjärns IK under the names Walk of Pain and Half Marathon, with a results archive available.
additional: The course layout for Flosjön-Edstjärn is published on the page 'Bansträckning för Flosjön-Edstjärn'. Results from previous races, including split times, are published on the website. The organizer is Edstjärns IK, a non-profit sports club open to everyone; contact via hej@eik.one. The Walk of Pain designation is used; there are results pages for Flosjön-Edstjärn; the 2020 edition was canceled; the 2024 edition has results available.

name: Ljungskileslingan
location: Ljungskile centrum, Ljungskile, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: LjungskileSlingan is a family-friendly recreational race with distances from 300 meters for the youngest up to 10 km. Start and finish are in Ljungskile town center, and the course runs around central Ljungskile and Lyckorna, partly along Ljungskileviken and the promenade. The courses are scenic and only gently rolling, and the race offers a large prize table. The event is organized by Ljungskile Friluftsklubb in collaboration with Hälle IF and is held in connection with LjungskileDagen and Lions loppmarknad.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ljungskile town center
Course follows Ljungskileviken and the promenade toward Lyckorna, scenic and gently rolling
Distances: kids' race 300 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km; large prize table
additional: The event is a festival in connection with LjungskileDagen and Lions loppmarknad with a fair, music and activities. Large prize table - the top three in each class receive prizes and other prizes are drawn among finishers. The race has been organized since 1994 and since 2015 Ljungskile Friluftsklubb and Hälle IF share the organizing. The invitation page states that registration has opened (see invitation for more information). The kids' race for the youngest has been included since 2018; LjungskileSlingan also has connections to LjungskileDagen and has a history of varying distances and organizers before Hälle IF took over in 2024. In 2026 the 10 km will return with a new route.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Warm welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on June 13, 2026! After two previous editions, we return with a family-friendly running festival featuring several different races for all ages and levels. The event offers chip timing, team competition, and an activity area with music and family activities. The number of participants is limited to maintain a cozy and family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children's races: 450 m and 1,700 m
Distance race: 5 km
7.5 km trail mix (trail segments on the course)
additional: Automatic timing with chips and team competition is offered. A service fee is mentioned (12.50 SEK) for registrations. The event area is open 10:00 - 14:00. Late registration 8 - 12 June costs 225 SEK and on-site registration 13 June costs 250 SEK. Music and activities for the whole family; the number of participants is limited. The recreational race is marketed as inclusive for all, but information about registration and distances is missing in the text. Webscorer mentions a manual wave start that may affect the start plan.

name: Blue Mountain TrailRun
location: First Camp Ånnaboda, Ånnaboda, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Blue Mountain Trail Run is a nature- and technically oriented trail race held at First Camp Ånnaboda with four distances (21 km, 15 km, 10 km and 6 km). The courses run on the Bergslagsleden and parts of MTB trails with lake crossings, forest trails and viewpoints such as Sånnabodahöjden. The event is family-friendly and service-oriented with bib pickup, food sales and showers/changing rooms near the competition area. For the 21 km there is an extra competitive incentive: the person who breaks the course record will be rewarded with 5000 SEK.
course_highlights: Steep and technical forest trails along Bergslagsleden and MTB trails
Expansive views from Sånnabodahöjden (266 m above sea level) and several forest lakes along the course
Clear course marking, energy stations at key junctions, and a total elevation gain of about 527 m (21 km)
additional: Bib numbers can be collected no later than 45 minutes before the start; bib pickup opens at 09:00 and on-site registration takes place 09:00–09:15. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the red SM hut about 300 m below First Camp; swimming opportunities at Södra Ånnabosjön. Electronic timing with a sport official on the finger; energy stations on the course; food and snack sales on site. Name and category changes can be made until 9 June 2026 (fee 150 SEK); refund protection offered (17% of the fee). First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin bookings via annaboda@firstcamp.se with the code "TrailRun". A service fee of approximately 10 SEK applies. Registration and bib pickup 45 minutes before start; food and drink available; changing rooms, showers and toilets near the red SM hut at the main parking area; medical kits at the start/finish and at water stations; First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin rental via code TrailRun.

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a new city race on 14 June 2026 with two distances: half marathon (21K) and 10K, with a common start and finish area in Dockan/Varvsstaden. The courses are flat and fast and take you through four distinct zones—from city vibes and parks to the quay district and seaside breeze at Västra hamnen with views of Turning Torso. The race is suitable for both those chasing a personal best and those who want to experience Malmö together with spectators and running joy. The organizer is Malmö Allmänna Idrottsförening (MAI).
course_highlights: Flat and fast course through four zones: city, parks, quay district and seaside
Passes Turning Torso and a long straight stretch along Ribban and Limhamnsvägen
Surface: mostly asphalt, parts with hard-packed gravel in parks and cobblestones in central parts
additional: Registration opens 25 November 2025 and runners can also register via Epassi (wellbeing/health benefit). Start times: 10K first start group 10:00 (last 10:12), 21K first start group 10:40 (last 10:56). Max time: 10K 90 minutes, 21K 3 hours. There is a 3.5 km cut-off on the 10K where runners must pass within 32 minutes after the last start group. Services: water stations with water and sport drink from Umara, medical, medal/fruit/drink at finish as well as toilets along the course. Distance changes are possible for an administrative fee of 95 kr (and when upgrading from 10K to 21K the difference is added). Corporate packages offered with gathering tents, group training and price examples for tents: 25 people 15 000 kr, 50 people 25 000 kr, 75 people 35 000 kr. Distances are 21K and 10K; Epassi wellness reimbursement is accepted as a payment option.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a family-oriented sports event that encourages fathers and their children to move and spend quality time together. The Dadathlon is organised as a series of three discipline-specific races held at different times during the year, and participants can join live events (such as in Stockholm's Hagaparken) or take part virtually. One of the events is a running-with-kids challenge where strollers are explicitly allowed and activities are tracked with an app or sports watch and uploaded to the platform. The event emphasises participation, shared experiences and inspiring photos/videos rather than only competition.
course_highlights: Family-friendly running with kids (strollers allowed)
Live event in Stockholm's Hagaparken with a parallel virtual competition
Three-part series across the year (complete all three to become a full Dadathlon; single-event sign-up possible)
additional: Event supports both live and virtual participation; participants track activity with an app or sports watch and upload results and device activation link to the platform. A leaderboard is available, but prizes are awarded for the most inspiring pictures/videos rather than pure time-based competition. It is allowed to stop your tracking device to take breaks for the child's comfort. The organisers encourage tagging @daddyhoodeurope and using #DaddyHoodDadathlon. Free registration; Hagaparken, Stockholm; Run with kids (1.5 km or 3 km); fundraising for Barncancerfonden.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp is a fast and spectator-friendly 5-kilometer race with start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. On Tuesday, June 16, 2026, the seventh edition will be held with a flat and runnable course that suits both fast runners and recreational participants. The race is lined with music stations and strong crowd support, and after finishing participants are offered a summer plate from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free children's race Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet with several age classes.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
The course is lined with music stations and strong crowd support
additional: Bib distribution: ICA Supermarket Söderköping Monday, June 15, 12:00 - 18:00; other bibs are distributed in the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start. The chip is a flap on the top of the bib and must not be removed for timing. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class is responsible for the warm-up (15 minutes before each start; the children's race warm-up at 16:45). After crossing the finish line ICA Supermarket offers a summer plate; massage is available after the race. Registration: online and on-site; online registration until June 14 at 16:00 according to information, regular late registration (increased fee +50 kr = total 375 kr) applies June 8 - up to one hour before start, and on-site/bib distribution late registration can also be done (the site's news page mentions on-site late registration 345 kr). Course: 5 km through Söderköping; start/finish area in Brunnsparken; chip timing with Racetime; warm-up before the start by World Class; water at start/finish and at 2.8 km; medal for all participants; bag/garment drop-off at start and finish; Lilla Brunnsparksloppet (1.1 km) for children; registration via the website; bibs collected at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Visby — a community festival race to raise awareness for blood donation where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in the Little Blodomloppet. The courses pass Visby’s cultural heritage sites and are open to both recreational runners and teams. The event is locally organized by VIF Gute Friidrott together with the Blood Center in Visby, and it often ends with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km run along Visby’s ring wall and through the inner city
The 10 km includes the seaside promenade, Almedalen, and Visby’s harbor
Beautiful cultural and urban environment with historic views
additional: Team registration is available and costs 1 750 kr through May 26; option to register many participants via an Excel template that can be imported into the registration; the race highlights blood donation and there is information about the blood donor gift; local organizers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, e-mail visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Center in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, e-mail blodcentralen@gotland.se). Three classes: 10 km, 5 km and Lilla Blodomloppet; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby according to information on the page; what’s included: functional T-shirt, bib number and medal; team registration for companies/groups is available as an option; live broadcast from the race on blodomloppet.se.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running festival in the Rynningevikens Nature Reserve in Örebro, held on June 17, 2026. The main race is 7.2 km, mostly easy-to-run gravel road along the water and through the forest, and suitable for runners who want to run fast and for those who want to jog or walk at a summer pace. The course runs past Rävgången and Naturens Hus and finishes with an after-run at Stora Hjortstorps gård, where food, drinks and camaraderie are offered. There is also a KidsRun (approximately 600 m) for children born in 2016 and later.
course_highlights: 7.2 km of mostly easy-to-run gravel road along the water in Rynningeviken
Passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus with evening sun and lake views
Two wooden bridges over Lillån and two longer climbs near Venastugan
additional: Start at 18:30 (warm-up at 18:15, mandatory pre-race briefing at 18:25). KidsRun starts at 17:45 (assembly 17:40). Bib pickup at the secretariat from 16:00; collect no later than 18:10. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out (lost transponder charged 800 SEK); no timing in KidsRun. Water stations/energy at 3 and 5 km; toilets available at the site and at the water stations. No changing rooms or showers on site. After-run at Stora Hjortstorps gård (BBQ 299 SEK including water and coffee, children under 12 at half price). Youth (born 2008 or later) 50% discount; group registration via info@epictrail.se. The course has been described as 7.2 km in the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve; the transponder is borrowed at the split and must be returned (800 SEK if lost); survival food/drink along the course and after-run at Stora Hjortstorps Gård (BBQ buffet 299 SEK including water and coffee); no changing rooms or showers; Kids Run without timing; the registration fee includes start place, bib, timing, medal, sports drink and energy.

name: Borejoggen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagjoggen följer samma priser som Borejoggen, alltså 300:-/person och ytterligare 50:- per person vid efteranmälan.

description: Borejoggen is a traditional Midsummer race in Torsby that welcomes elites, recreational runners, and children. The main race runs on asphalt in central Torsby and is approximately 8.5 km, while Minijoggen is a shorter class (about 1.5 km) for children and youth. There is also Lagjoggen for teams of three where the team's total time counts. The start takes place in the area around Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken (Minijoggen 09:30, Borejoggen and Lagjoggen 11:00) and registration is done via RaceID or at Prima Sport/Herrgårdsparken according to the organizer's information.
course_highlights: Main course about 8.5 km on asphalt in central Torsby
Minijoggen about 1.5 km for children and youth
Hydration stations at 2 km, 5.8 km and finish
additional: Start at Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken. Bib numbers/timing chips are picked up at Prima Sport during Midsummer Week. Changing rooms/showers are available at Björnevi IP and Valbergsstugan; toilets are in Herrgårdsparken and Björnevi IP. Prizes promised (including sprint and hill prizes as well as prize money for the winners); traffic marshals at busy roads and medical care is available at the finish. The course covers 8.5 km on asphalt in central Torsby; start times are Minijoggen 9:30 and Borejoggen/Lagjoggen 11:00; registration takes place via RaceID or Prima Sport; the team class Lagjoggen requires three participants per team; hydration stations are available according to the specific course.

name: Midsommartrail - Möt ljuset
description: Midsommartrail - Meeting the Light is a personal trail run held on the year's longest day, with a focus on the experience. The race starts before dawn so that you can run into daylight along a 30 km course in beautiful forest terrain. The number of participants is limited (max 100) to provide an intimate and considerate atmosphere, and after crossing the finish line the organizers offer a hearty breakfast. Navigation is done with a pre-delivered GPS route and a map at the start, and there are two energy stations along the route.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run at dawn as you meet the light along the course
Two energy stations placed along the course
Navigation with GPS route and map (the runner is responsible for navigation)
additional: Start/finish at the Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22, Sollentuna; easiest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro (1.5 km walk); parking at Sollentuna Golf Club (a 500 m walk) and parking on Ytterbyvägen is not permitted; max 100 participants; breakfast served after the race; registration open until one hour before the start; age limit: 18 years; recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Start time 02:00 on 2026-06-21. 30 km trail run; GPS route and map; two energy stations along the way; breakfast after the finish; hotel discount at Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna with code NIGHTTRAILRUN.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommartrail is an intimate trail race in Sollentuna held on the longest day of the year. The race is 30 km long and starts at dawn to give participants the experience of meeting the summer daylight; the number of participants is limited to maintain an intimate atmosphere. Participants navigate using a GPS route (sent in advance) and also receive a map at the start. After finishing, a hearty breakfast is offered so you can share the experience with the other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run that starts before dawn and reaches daylight
Participants navigate themselves with a GPS route and a map at the start
Two energy stations along the course and breakfast after finishing
additional: Maximum 100 runners. Start/finish at the Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Nearest public transit: commuter train to Rotebro station and about a 1.5 km walk to the venue. Parking is recommended at Sollentuna Golf Club (about 500 m); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not allowed. The participant is responsible for navigation; a GPS route is sent in advance and a map is distributed at the start. Registration is open until one hour before the race starts. Age limit: 18 years. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Seasonal variants include Sommartrail, Hösttrail, and Hundtrail, where the experience and the night-time experience are highlighted as the core of Night Trail Run.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out a little at Böda Sand. It is a tough race in sand and water that suits both those who want to go all in and families who want to have fun, with courses from 500 meters up to 10 km. Everyone who completes receives a medal. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort on June 24.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m up to 10 km
Tough race in sand and water
Medal to everyone who completes
additional: Date: June 24. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46) 485-22200. The event is marketed as family-friendly and recurring in the facility's event calendar. Lodging special offers are available at Böda Sand; late registration is available and the bib number can be picked up from Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a popular 10 km race in Karlstad with elements for all runners—from those pursuing a personal best to those who want to enjoy the camaraderie along the Klarälven. The event offers the classic 10 km, a shorter 5 km, as well as Karlstad Minilopp and Miniminilopp for younger participants. The race starts from Tingvallabron and finishes at Museiparken; the 2026 edition inaugurates SM Week and will be broadcast on SVT. The organizer IF Göta Karlstad welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Start at Tingvallabron
Finish at Museiparken
Route along the Klarälven
additional: Registration notes an estimated running time for seeding is provided at registration; youths born in 2008 or later and students receive SEK 100 discount during certain periods; a team competition is offered for the 10 km (at least six participants per team) - contact tavling@ifgota.se for team registration; payment via PlusGiro (47 37 91-2) with instructions for class and name; gift cards can be purchased via PG and notified to info@ifgota.se; participant information (PM) is sent by e-mail and published on the website; After Run and a concert in Museiparken are included in SM Week's opening; the race is part of SM Week 2026 and will be broadcast on SVT. The race offers 10 km and 5 km as well as Karlstad Minilopp (7 - 12 years) and Miniminilopp (0 - 6 years). Age limit 12 years; dogs are not allowed; walking with a stroller or walker may start in the last start group; participation is at your own risk; no refund of the entry fee; image publication is allowed on websites/social media.

name: St Olavsloppet
description: St Olavsloppet is a three-day relay race that runs from Trondheim to Östersund and is staged in legs over three days. The races include several daily stages (e.g., Day 1: Trondheim – Stiklestad, about 120.6 km) and have alternative start and finish locations such as Stjørdal, Sandvika, Åre and Mörsil. The competition is organized for teams in different classes and rewards participants with a diploma, raffle prizes and a Mini-Olav Medal. Registration is via email and payment instructions for Norwegian, Swedish and international participants are on the registration page.
course_highlights: Day 1: Trondheim - Stiklestad, approx. 120.6 km
Three-day stage format: stages via Stiklestad, Åre and the final destination Östersund
Alternative starting points/stages mentioned: Stjørdal, Sandvika and Mörsil
additional: Registration is via email (Norwegian participants: post@stolavsloppet.no; Swedish teams: larspeterbring@gmail.com). Payment instructions are available: Norwegian participants bank account Sparebank1 SMN; Swedish participants Swish or bank giro; international participants details via Länsförsäkringar Bank (IBAN/BIC) and the payer St Olavsgruppens ideella förening. Discounts for associations/companies signing up multiple teams for "St Olav 340" are indicated (team 2: 25%, team 3: 50%, team 4: 75%, from team 5: 100%). All participating teams in the physical race receive a diploma after finishing and all participants receive a Mini-Olav medal. At previous events the first starting group (about 20 runners) left Trondheim Stadion at the start. The official website contains information about distances, classes, participant info, accommodation and sustainability.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a long-standing community festival that is always held on the first Friday after Midsummer — in 2026 the race will take place on Friday, June 26. The course runs through the sunlit, summer-beautiful Trosa with large crowds and proximity to the water, which contributes to a summery racing and recreational atmosphere. The event has categories for elite, recreational runners, youths and children and offers both the main race 8 900 m and shorter recreational options.
course_highlights: The course runs through the sunlit, summer-beautiful Trosa near the water
The main race 8 900 m plus Jogging/Nordic Walking 4 km and a 700 m children’s race
Start and finish at Trosa Square with a packed crowd and stage activities
additional: Registration portal remains open until the start and payments can be made with Swish or card; alternatively use the Trosa Stadslopp bank giro 488-8335 when paying. Folksam race insurance is offered (e.g., 155 SEK for basic protection, Startklar Plus 275 SEK). Bib-number collection opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The main 8 900 m has time-based start groups (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there is also a 700 m children’s race and prize ceremonies from the stage. The organizers hand out 50 cl Vitamin Well to runners in the 8 900 m and 4 km. Distances also include 700 m and 900 m in the program; Jogging/Nordic Walking at 4 km; night bus information to Stockholm after the race.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail ultramarathon in Bergslagen organized in Hällefors with start/finish at Hurtigtorpet during the weekend of June 26-27, 2026. The event offers courses of 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles and is marketed with slogans such as "Runner's joy", "Both long & gnarly" and "Run. Survive. Brag." - a technical and hilly event for those seeking a tough nature experience. For 2026 the 100-mile class is sold out. The race is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and runners who want to challenge themselves in rocky, rooty and hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail with many climbs; the longer ascents come largely in the second half of the course
Roots and rock slabs that become very slick in wet conditions - trail shoes with a rugged tread are recommended
Checkpoint in Silvergruvan (about 35 km) - possibility to have trekking poles delivered to the checkpoint
additional: Bus: transport from Hurtigtorpet to the start for the 33 km course departs at 10:30, a limited number of seats that must be pre-booked (book no later than 2026-06-20). Accommodation: several local options listed within 5 - 20 km from start/finish. Caravan and motorhome sites are available in limited numbers - notify via info@silverledenultra.se; electricity is available but limited and cannot be guaranteed. No possibility to charge an electric vehicle at the start/finish in Hurtigtorpet. Minimum age for participants is 15 years (the year you turn); relay teams cannot be registered in 2026. For international participants, payment is via the provided IBAN; the order confirmation from the registration system serves as documentation for the wellness subsidy. Early Bird prices are mentioned in the information, but exact amounts are not specified.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a runnable road race — yet set in landscapes that feel like true mountain running. The roads are quiet, often with more reindeer than cars, and the surroundings offer an almost otherworldly stillness. It’s a journey through both nature and history, where every step is buoyed by the vast mountains, the crisp air, and the silence.
course_highlights: Rolling, quiet roads through alpine terrain – a road-race vibe in high-mountain scenery
Passes Fjällnäs, crosses the border to Norway via Vauldalen and reaches the UNESCO town of Røros
Approximately 980 m of total elevation gain; officially measured as 100 miles (161 km); option to leave a drop bag at Ski Lodge after ~115 km
additional: Maximum time to complete the race is 30 hours. The course length is officially measured at 100 miles (161 km) and all runners wear individual trackers.
