There are categories for runners, cyclists, duos, and children, and the event has a clear focus on local producers and a genuine farm environment. Pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup to be used during the race to avoid disposable cups.
course_highlights: Main course is approximately 45 km, about 50/50 gravel and asphalt
Energy stations at several local farms with delicacies and opportunities for farm visits
Opportunity to meet and sample at farms with animals (ostrich, alpacas, and yaks)
additional: Limited number of participants in the main race (300). Online registration is open until August 4; late registration can be done from 09:00 in the start area until 30 minutes before the respective start signal (if spots are available). Pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup that must be used during the race. The children’s race (approximately 700 m or 1,400 m) does not require pre-registration and is free for participants thanks to ICA's sponsorship (children receive a medal and ice cream). Restrooms and showers are available at APPTEKS premises (open approximately 09:30 - 18:30). The running category has timing and prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories; cycling and duo classes have special rules (helmet mandatory, e-bike not allowed, duo pairs may swap unlimited times but must keep a maximum distance of 100 m). Joint warm-up before the start. Energy stations with water and sports drinks; pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup; medals for all; not sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; helmet mandatory when cycling; start/finish in a lit trail environment; medical volunteers; rules on image rights. Sign up via vikbovandan.se/472-2/ or via the registration page on the main website.

name: Kullamilen
location: Höganäs friidrottsarena, Höganäs kommun, Skåne län, Sweden
description: KullaMilen is a welcoming running event in Höganäs with distances for children, recreational runners, and veterans. The race offers 2.5 km for children/youth, 5 km for walking or running, and 10 km (competition and recreational classes) with start and finish at Höganäs Athletics Arena. The competition is organized by Höganäs Athletics together with local clubs and is part of the Skåne Veterans Cup for the veteran classes that choose to compete. The event emphasizes community and the joy of movement, from beginners to seasoned runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Höganäs Athletics Arena; a fast course with lots of running along the Öresund coast
The 10 km is measured and sanctioned by the Skåne Athletics Federation; the 5 km shares the course with the 10 km but turns earlier
The 2.5 km children's course goes partly through Lerbergsskogen; surface is asphalt and gravel, marked by marshals
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at the Race Office at the athletics arena from 09:30 and no later than 30 minutes before the respective start; the bib must be worn on the chest. Water stations are available at approximately 3.5 km and 6.5 km as well as at the finish. Medals for all participants, prizes for the best in each class, and prize draws; prize distribution takes place at the start and finish area. Changing and shower facilities are available about 75 meters from the finish; light refreshments are sold at the arena. Results are published at www.hoganasfriidrott.se and www.kullamilen.se. Medical staff from the Red Cross are on site. Part of the Skåne Veterans Cup; registration is open with a reduced price until April 1.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Jönköping – a charity run to raise awareness of the need for blood donation, where you can walk, jog, or run. In Jönköping, there are timed races of 5 km and 10 km as well as a 5 km walk without timing. For children there is Lilla Blodomloppet (approximately 700 m) with a common start and a medal. The event gathers participants in teams and traditionally ends with a picnic.
course_highlights: Available distances: 5 km and 10 km (timed) and a 5 km walk (untimed)
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 700 m for children up to 12 years, common start and medal; start from Knektaparken
Event area at Knektaparken with a traditional communal picnic after the finish
additional: Team registration consists of 3-5 participants; registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount if indicated at registration. Changes (e.g., from 10 km to 5 km) cost 50 kr for changes and presenting an order-ID during pickup; on the day of registration for the competition (11 August) only Swish or cash payment is accepted. Payment terms otherwise are 30 days with several options (Swish, card via Swedbank Pay, pg, invoice). Team registrations and individual registrations are offered with different prices; discounts for blood donors and an invoice fee. Bib numbers are collected in connection with Hovslätts IK's clubhouse or at the start, and the award ceremony takes place at 19:30.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km) 180 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar (max 15st per anmälan) 900 kr (Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km)

description: Vetlanda City Run is an open and spectator-friendly city race scheduled for 14 August 2026 with start and finish on Storgatan in Vetlanda. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a flat, spectator-friendly loop course, and there are several children and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Bib pickup and late registration take place on Stortorget from 12:00 on race day, and the event is combined with activities and simple food service on the square. We photograph and film during the race, and images may be used in future marketing.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Storgatan in central Vetlanda
Flat, spectator-friendly loop course (5 km or 10 km)
Children's and youth distances from 400 m up to 1.7 km, plus a 1 km Funkis class
additional: Bib pickup and late registration take place on Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. Late registration can be made no later than 30 minutes before the respective start time, and on-site payment can be made with Swish (an extra fee applies for late registration). Timing is done with a chip in the bib by Racetimer, and results are published live on Racetimer's website as well as on OK Njudung's website. The event includes activities and simple food service on the square; the organizer photographs and films during the race. The race includes the option to walk/jog/run at your own pace; on-site late registration for a fee; photography/filming during the race that can be used in marketing.

name: Trail- & Ultravasan (Vasaloppet)
description: Vasaloppet runs a summer week of running and mountain biking, including races such as Ultravasan and Trailvasan. The events take place in mid-August and attract tens of thousands of registered participants each year. On vasaloppet.se there is registration and practical information—the event is run by Vasaloppet (a non-profit organization owned by IFK Mora and Sälens IF).
course_highlights: Part of Vasaloppet's summer week of running and mountain biking
Includes Ultravasan 90 and Trailvasan (10/30) distances in mid-August
Organized by Vasaloppet (owners: IFK Mora and Sälens IF)
additional: Registration is via Vasaloppet's registration pages on vasaloppet.se; early registration provides a lower price. For corporate registrations and group bookings there is foretag@vasaloppet.se. Vasaloppet's customer service can be reached at telephone 0250-392 00 and general contact via info@vasaloppet.se. Ultravasan 90 is part of the Vasaloppstrippeln 90; bib and chip distribution Mora/Sälen; luggage transport to Mora and Evertsberg; medals and prize presentations are promised. Trailvasan 10 has a maximum of 1000 participants, age 11+, and a start time up to 18:15; two water/aid stations along the course.

name: BAMM
location: Björkliden, Kiruna Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: BAMM (Björkliden Arctic Mountain Marathon) is a mountain orienteering competition in the Björkliden/Riksgränsen area where participants compete in pairs (men's, women's, or mixed teams). The competition is conducted in off-trail mountain terrain over large areas and is oriented toward adventure and orienteering in a mountain environment. The event is presented in collaboration with the main partner OMM and contains practical information about travel, lodging, and the program on the competition page. The page targets orienteers seeking a challenging competition experience in an Arctic mountain environment.
course_highlights: Orienteering in off-trail Alpine terrain over large areas
Competition format: pairs (men's, women's, or mixed teams)
Held in the Björkliden/Riksgränsen mountain environment near the Norwegian border
additional: Practical travel information is available on the website: possibility to book transfer from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen (connections to SAS/Norwegian), as well as transfer back. Train travel via SJ to Riksgränsen (about 18 hours from Stockholm) and the Riksgränsen train station is located about 100 meters from Hotell Riksgränsen. The page also contains the program and participant list for BAMM 2026 and information about accommodation/Arctic Skibus. Two-day mountain orienteering in the Björkliden area; mandatory personal equipment and team equipment; about 230 starting teams per edition; BAMM 30 includes transport of tent/sleeping bag equipment for overnight camps; registration via ReadySetGo.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
description: The Tavelsjö Half Marathon takes place on August 15, 2026 and is a pleasant summer event that welcomes both runners and families. In addition to the half marathon, there is a youth race (2.2 km) with timing and Tavelsjö Mini for the children, which makes the whole event family-friendly. Start and finish are located at Tavelsjö Church, and the organizers encourage registering well in advance.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Tavelsjö Church
The youth race is 2.2 km long and timing is used
Family-friendly event with Tavelsjö Mini for the children
additional: Registration is open and must be submitted no later than August 15. The youth race targets ages 8-17, starts at 10:00, has timing, and participants receive a medal and something to eat; a prize is also raffled among the participants. Tavelsjö Mini is a popular children's race and the event offers gift cards that can be purchased via login (delivery within a week after ordering). Registration opens ahead of the race; gift cards are offered; parking is available at Klacken (the club house) between the start and finish; bib numbers can be picked up the week before the race or on race day from 09:00 to 10:45.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a festive evening race on Södermalm held on August 15, 2026 and offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km as well as several children’s and disability-adapted races. The race is characterized by late start times, music, spectators and activities along the course, creating a unique and engaging atmosphere. The 21 km class runs two laps on Midnattsloppet’s 10 km course, and the course is described as relatively hilly. The organizers highlight community, running joy and that the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21 km = two laps on Midnattsloppet’s 10 km course around Södermalm
Relatively hilly course - hills and the district's character
Music, samba rhythms and spectators along the course create a festival atmosphere
additional: Starting location/warm-up: Ringvägen 26. Finish: Hornsgatan 57. The registration fee includes, among other things, a Björn Borg t-shirt (this year's color/print), precise timing, sports drinks and water along the course, as well as a cold Vitamin Well, fruit and an energy bar at the finish; a medal can be purchased when registering and a digital diploma is offered. There is the possibility to use wellness providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) and instructions for a value code; team registrations give 50 kr discount per person. Information about start groups, jerseys and start kits as well as dedicated pages for companies is available on the organizer's website. Digital Midnattsloppet is offered 12/9 - 20/9.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a festival relay race that runs along the classic route from Sälen to Mora. Up to ten runners share a total distance of about 92 km, with legs between 4.5 and 15 km, and the race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners as well as teams from clubs, companies and groups of friends. The start takes place in the village of Berga in Sälen, and the event is one of the oldest competitions of the summer week. Start time for 2026 is 08:00 on August 15.
course_highlights: Cross-country race along the classic Sälen–Mora route
Ten legs of about 4.5–15 km (total around 92 km)
Start in Berga (Sälen) and finish in Mora
additional: Starter envelopes with bib numbers and information letter are sent to the team leader about two weeks before the race; the timing chip is collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen (alternatively at the race office in Mora in the days prior). The registration fee includes bus transport for participants on legs 1 and 2 (a bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked; runners on leg 2 must take the organizer's bus to Smågan). The start corrals open at 07:30 and participants should be on site no later than 07:55; the timing chip is worn as a wristband and the exchange pass is placed visibly in the windshield. Maximum number of participating teams is 600; minimum age 8 years. Start in Sälen/Berga; finish in Mora; exchange points along the course; bib number and chip required; exchange controls and services along the course; start documents and chip are handled by the organizers.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail ultramarathon that starts in Berga by, Sälen, and offers runners the classic Vasaloppet distance in summer-like and scenic environments. The start is at dawn at 05:00 and the course runs via the historic checkpoints toward the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and fäbod environments. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status for 2026 and is part of the Vasaloppet Triple; the maximum number of participants is 2500 and the age limit is from 17 years.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by – experience the sunrise over the mires around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic sections with light pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque fäbod environments
additional: Bib number and chip pickup is in Mora or in Sälen in the days before the race or at the start area. The starting chutes open at 04:30 and your time starts when you cross the start line. Bag transport is offered to Mora and there is the option to send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are fluid stations roughly every five kilometres as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum participants 2,500, training stipends of 60 000 kr to the winners in the women's and men's classes. Ultravasan consists of two ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen - Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg - Mora, approximately 45 km); both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet's Summer Week.

name: 6 sjöar
location: Fjällnora friluftsgård, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Six Lakes is a volunteer-run running event held on 15 August 2026 with start and finish at Fjällnora Friluftsgård outside Uppsala. You can choose between the marathon (42 km around six lakes), the half marathon (21 km around four lakes), 10.3 km, or a shorter 5.5 km course around Ramsen — all courses are well marked and offer varied forest trails and gravel roads. The race is environmentally friendly (few disposable cups, the option to receive a reusable cup or Hydrapouch) and offers free direct buses from Uppsala Resecentrum; the organizers are volunteers. It is a nature-focused race where swimming along the course may be possible in warm weather and where the start times are scheduled so that different distances can be run simultaneously by family and friends.
course_highlights: Marathon around six lakes; half marathon around four lakes – scenic views of several bodies of water.
Easy-to-run courses mostly on small gravel roads and shorter trails, with some technical sections (the 5 km course has tricky trails and bridges).
Opportunity to take a dip along the course in warm weather and water stations on the routes.
additional: Start and finish at Fjällnora Friluftsgård. Start times: Marathon 10:00, Half Marathon 10:30, 10 km 11:00, 5 km 11:30. Race bib can be picked up at Uppsala Resecentrum Thursday - Friday before the race from 11:00 to 19:00 or on-site no later than 30 minutes before the start. Free direct buses from Uppsala Resecentrum (fossil-free fuel) and information/timetable published by the organizers. The race avoids disposable cups—bring your own bottle or get a free reusable cup or Hydrapouch; no free T-shirts but the option to buy after finish. The event is organized by volunteers; questions to info@6sjoar.se and the phone number for registration inquiries are listed on the contact page. The race offers detailed maps and GPX files via the 'Choose Race' page; fewer disposable cups and a reminder to bring your own bottle or use Hydrapouch. Registration takes place online and bib pickup at Uppsala Resecentrum or before the start.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Welcome to Convinistafetten in Stockholm—a festive, team-building relay on Stora Skuggan in Northern Djurgården. The event is held over two late-summer evenings (19–20 August 2026) and each team consists of five people, with each participant running 5 km. There is also a walking class for those who want to walk together. As an extra treat, the title sponsor Convini invites all teams to a picnic after finishing.
course_highlights: Five 5 km legs — each team member runs 5 km
Start and finish area at the exchange zone in Stora Skuggan, Northern Djurgården
Picnic on the grass after the finish (Convini invites all teams)
additional: Registration is per team (5 people). The walking team starts separately and everyone in the walking team walks 5 km together. The team captain registers the team and receives information as well as all five bib numbers mailed home; the last-leg runner collects the picnic box at the picnic tent. The picnic is included in the registration (contents to be announced in May) and extra picnic boxes can be booked for 495 SEK each. There are tent packages (Basic or Premium) to book as add-ons; the order is confirmed and tent placement will be announced before the competition. The age limit to run 5 km is 13 years. A walking class is available; start times are by bib number (e.g., first team 17:30, later 17:33, 17:36); chip timing is in the bib; changing rooms at Frescati Sports Center for 40 SEK; RSIF offers a subsidized member price and the deadline for the discount code is 16 August at 18:00; information on parking and public transport is available.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagblom's Night Run in Kalmar is a night race of 5.0 km that offers an atmospheric running experience along Kalmar's streets with music, lighting and surprises along the course. Start and finish are at Stortorget, and the race is open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who completes the event receives the Night Run medal, and those who are pre-registered by August 16 will also receive the race's unique shirt. The organizer is Högby IF (athletics).
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
5.0 km in an urban setting along Kalmar's streets with music, lighting and surprises
5 km walking class without timing available
additional: Bib number and late registration can be collected at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday 21 August from 18:00; on-site late registration is accepted no later than 1 hour before the start. All participants receive a medal, a drink, fruit and a chocolate bar from ICA MAXI. Payments can be made by card, cash or Swish. Contacts: Högby IF / friidrott@hogbyif.se, Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Walking class 5 km without timing; bib number and late registration in the Högby tent at Stortorget 20 Aug from 15:00-17:00 and 21 Aug from 18:00; unique Night Run shirt for pre-registered by August 16; drinks, fruit and a chocolate bar for all participants.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget vid Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen, Dalarna, Sweden
description: Askes Fjällmaraton is a short and family-friendly mountain race for children born in 2013 and later. The race takes place on Friday, August 21, with a joint start at 18:00 and start/finish on the Torget by Idre Fjäll. The course is 1 km, well marked and without timing; at the finish, a medal and something tasty awaits. All proceeds from Askes Fjällmaraton go to the Viggo Foundation.
course_highlights: Well-marked 1 km course suitable for children
Start and finish on the Torget by Idre Fjäll (joint start at 18:00)
No timing; medal and something tasty at the finish
additional: Registration online until 15 minutes before the start or on-site at the bib-number distribution (payment with Swish); no timing; medal and something tasty at the finish; all proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. Part of the Craft Idre Fjällmaraton weekend with family activities in the Askes area.

name: Mariestads Marathon
description: The race starts along Vänern's shore on a cycle path and is an annual event. If you run 7 km, it's one lap; if you run 21.1 km, it becomes 3 laps back and forth; and if you run 42.2 km, it's 6 times.
course_highlights: Scenic course along Vänern's shore in Mariestad
Start and finish at Snapens Friluftsområde
Offers a 7 km recreational class, 21.1 km (half marathon, including senior divisions and veteran DM), and 42.2 km marathon
additional: Information will be available on the homepage.

images.alt_text: Starten av Mariestads Marathon med löpare vid målbannern.

name: Craft Idre Fjällmaraton
description: Be unstoppable. We believe that it is everyone's right to feel unbeatable at least once. Not in relation to someone else, but in relation to yourself. Unbeatable because you achieved something you didn't think was possible. Because you dared something you didn't think you could. Because you ventured into unknown terrain and won. Won over that little voice that sits and says that you can't.
course_highlights: Technical alpine terrain with rocks and roots that require active footwork
Stunning views of the mountains and forests, including a view of Städjan (1131 m)
Renens Stig 45 km is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour and starts at the square in Idre Fjäll
additional: The Fjällmarathon bus is offered for round-trip transport to the race; recommended accommodation at Idre Fjäll to minimize transportation and have meals near the event; the course requires strength in climbs and flow on trail sections; Renens Stig 45 km is part of the Outnorth Trailtour and is expected to attract many elite runners. Package options include Idre Fjällmaraton package with yoga and a meal package; booking of accommodation and packages is shown in the menu; bus connections to/from the event are offered; live broadcasts and live results via arena and the web.

name: Stockholm Trail
location: Hammarbyhöjdens IP, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Do you dream of winding trails, sunlit rocky ledges and lovely slopes? Stockholm Trail offers several well-marked trail races in the beautiful Nacka Nature Reserve, with start and finish at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, near Stockholm's city center. The course suits both experienced trail runners and recreational runners who want to try off-road running. Welcome to a challenging, sweaty and memorable trail event with encouraging volunteers and good service.
course_highlights: Technical forest trails and beautiful rocky outcrops with stunning views in Nacka Nature Reserve
Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, about a 5-minute walk from the Hammarbyhöjden metro station
Multiple water stations (Umara sports drink) and a bib with your name
additional: Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjdens IP; bib collection can be picked up Friday 21 August at Best Western Park City Hammarby Sjöstad 16:00–19:00 or at the arena from 09:00 on race day. A wooden finisher medal from Raw Cut Studio for finishers. Bag drop-off (monitored, free); possibility for indoor shower and changing. Name change and course change free until 8 August (contact sekretariat@stockholmtrail.se). Age limit 18 years on the 21K; cut-off times: 4 hours for the 21K and 3 hours for the 10K. Water stations with water and Umara sport drink: the 21K has 5 stations, the 10K 3 stations, the 5K 1 station. Premium package with T-shirt and training sessions available; T-shirt can be purchased separately (349 SEK). Results published online immediately after finish; announcer, music and refreshments at the arena. Distances include 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K Fun Run and 2.5K Minitrail; start/finish at Hammarbyhöjdens IP; beverage sales along the course; bag drop and pickup; the finish area offers drinks, coffee and refreshments as well as showers and changing facilities indoors; this year there will be no T-shirt sales at the arena (purchase in Bagheeras shop).

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultramarathon in Lill‑Jansskogen in Stockholm with selectable distances of 50 or 100 miles. The race emphasizes endurance, nature experiences, and community and is run by Nisse and Anna Larsson via the Hjorthagen Ultra SC association. Start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with ample parking and proximity to the subway and buses. Start times are 09:00 for 100 miles and 14:00 for 50 miles.
course_highlights: Magical forest sections in Lill‑Jansskogen
Steep hills and many elevation gains
Start/finish at Stora Skuggans väg 22 with good access to parking and public transport
additional: The time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles and 16 hours for 50 miles. Maximum 100 participants. Start times: 100 miles at 09:00 and 50 miles at 14:00. Proceeds to Suicide Zero.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description: Backyard Ultra runs on a marked loop course measuring 6,706 meters per lap, and each participant has one hour to complete the lap. Then a new start happens every full hour, and as long as you can finish the loop within an hour you remain in the competition. The winner is determined by endurance and finally gets to run a single last lap! A fun race and concept with a very family-like feel and sense of community where many participants set their distance records!
course_highlights: Loop course of 6,706 meters per lap
Time limit 60 minutes per lap - new start every full hour
Start and finish at Havsudden / Brofästet, Hamngatan, Sölvesborg
additional: What is included: entry/start place, medal and energy board (drinks + edible items). The race is run by MJM Challenge (Milos & Marcus). Concept: continue as long as you can complete the lap within 60 minutes; the winner is the 'last one standing'. Previous editions have been described as flat and level with a beautiful environment (previous finish at the Sölvesborg Bridge). Golden Ticket competition for Big Dog's Backyard Ultra in Tennessee according to Umara AB; result indicator from previous years: 54 hours, 43 participants (31 men / 12 women).

images.alt_text: Två män springer under en solig dag vid en sjö.
Deltagare serveras mat vid ett bord utomhus, troligen under ett lopp.
Deltagare springer på en grusväg under ett Backyard Ultra lopp i Sölvesborg.
Två löpare på en grusväg under ett lopp, omgivna av grönska och träd.

name: Säve Trail Run
description: Säve Trail Run is a trail race in Säve where you run on trails, through forest and open moorland, away from asphalt and the city's bustle. You choose between 12 km, 7 km or 2 km – all with varied and challenging terrain. Along the way you will be met by volunteers and cheers that create an encouraging atmosphere, and at the hydration stations there is sports drink from local UMARA. Start and finish are at Säve Sportklubb, where runners, families and friends gather in a simple and genuine atmosphere. Whether it's your first trail race or one of many – you set the pace yourself and the experience is what counts.
course_highlights: Trail paths through coniferous forest with roots and rocks and varied terrain
Three distances: 12 km (red course marker), 7 km (yellow course marker) and 2 km (blue course marker)
Hydration stations along the course and chip-timed by bib number
additional: Start and finish at Säve SK's clubhouse (Tåfjällsvägen 15).

images.alt_text: Säve Trail Run logotyp med träd och berg.
Säve Trail Run logotyp med skog och texten "SÄVE TRAIL RUN SPRING VILT. LEV FRITT".

name: Sandviken Halvmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Entry fee 700 SEK includes race pack, medal, and timing chip.

description: The first edition of the Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and nice residential areas. The course has an elevation gain of only 74 m, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be something for the whole family.
course_highlights: Mostly flat course with a total elevation gain of 74 m and a few gentle hills
Passes the shores of Lake Storsjön and several historic districts (Barrsätra, Sätra, Stensätra, Säljan, Örta)
Combination of city streets and wooded sections; water stations approximately every 4–5 km
additional: The first edition of the Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and nice residential areas. The course has an elevation gain of only 74 m, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be something for the whole family.

images.alt_text: Sandviken Halvmaraton logotyp med texten "GÄSTRIKELAND 2026 SANDVIKEN HALV-MARATHON"

name: Prins Bertils Halvmarathon
description: On August 22 at 11:00, the start of the inaugural Prins Bertil's Half Marathon will take place. A 21.1 km long race with Halmstad's most beautiful trail as its arena. Whether you are a casual runner or an experienced runner, this is a perfect opportunity to challenge yourself and enjoy a wonderful natural experience.

images.alt_text: En naturskön kuststig med stenar och hav, perfekt för terränglöpning.

name: Grinda Trail Run
location: Grinda Sea Lodge, Grinda, Ekerö Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Trail Sprint Unisex 3KM Trail Race 150 kr Add Food (+200 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Trail Explorer Unisex 6.5KM Trail Race 290 kr Add Food (+200 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Trail Terrängmilen Unisex 10KM Trail Race 390 kr Add Food (+200 kr)

description: Grinda Trail Run is a welcoming running event on Grinda in the Stockholm archipelago, organized by Envol Swimrun. You can choose between 3 km, 6.5 km or 10 km - from a family-friendly short distance to a technical and hilly 10 km (Terrain Mile). Start and finish at Grinda Sea Lodge with forest trails, coastal sections and beautiful views over the sea. After the finish, there is an opportunity to enjoy a sauna, a refreshing dip and lunch from Grinda Wärdshus.
course_highlights: Forest trails and rocky coastal sections along the island
Panoramic views of the Stockholm archipelago and the sea
Technical sections with climbs and narrow trails (especially Terrain Mile)
additional: Bib pickup 08:30 - 09:45 at Sea Lodge. Kids Trail (400 m) at 11:30; children under 12 years are free. Award ceremony and lunch at 11:45. Extend the weekend - it's recommended to arrive on Friday; Grinda is reached by ferry or private/taxi boat. Possibility to add a meal package for the trail run (+200 SEK). Bib pickup 08:30 - 09:45; start at 10:00; Kids Trail 400 m; children under 12 years free

name: Blodomloppet – Sundsvall
location: Ungdomsfältet i Södra hamnen, Sundsvall, Sweden
price_range: 5 km: 350–450 kr; 10 km: 350–450 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; lagavgift: 1 750–2 000 kr; blodgivare rabatt: 40 kr
description: Blodomloppet i Sundsvall is a recreational run that highlights the life-saving blood donation and at the same time promotes health and community. The race has moved from Timrå and is held at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, a central and accessible venue with views over the harbor area. The event offers 5 km and 10 km (timed), a walking class, and Lilla Blodomloppet for children, and is part of the national Blodomloppet series. A portion of the registration fee goes back to the local sports activities.
course_highlights: Arena at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen near the small boat harbor
5 km and 10 km courses approved by Friidrottsförbundet; the courses run counterclockwise and pass Selångersån (5 km over the Sporthallsbron, 10 km over Montörsvägsbron)
Lilla Blodomloppet has courses of approximately 600 m and 1,600 m in the harbor area next to the arena
additional: Picnic basket for 5 people is included in the team registration fee; teams can register 5 people but leave 1–2 spots vacant and complete the registration via email no later than 18 August; blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person; payment can be made by card or Swish; on-site late registration for individuals opens at 15:30 on race day (increased fee of 450 kr); the courses are measured and approved by Friidrottsförbundet; Lilla Blodomloppet offers shorter courses of about 600 m and 1,600 m. Courses: 5 km and 10 km adults (counterclockwise); Lilla Blodomloppet in the harbor area (600 m and 1600 m). The arena is Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen. Individual or in teams (5 per team); last registration day 25 August; late registration possible for a higher fee; payment by card or Swish; picnic basket included in the team fee.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Västerås at Rocklunda IP on 26 August 2026 – a recreational race for everyone where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet offers two children’s races (approx. 1,400 m and approx. 500 m) with warm-up and finish under the finish arch. The race is organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation and traditionally ends with a picnic for teams and participants. Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people) and information as well as the PM are on the competition page.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area (the football pitches north of the riding hall).
The 5 km and 10 km courses are marked and have flag marshals deployed.
Lilla Blodomloppet: two children's routes (~1,400 m starting at 17:15 and ~500 m starting at 17:25), finish under the finish arch.
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (a team of 3 - 5 participants; the price always corresponds to 5 participants and a picnic for 5 is included). Teams can be filled up to a maximum of 5 people no later than Monday 24/8 and the last day to register a team is stated to be 19/8; for larger companies there is an option for a corporate page/discount code. Children in Lilla Blodomloppet receive a medal and a finish bag from ICA Maxi Hälla; warm-up in front of the stage at around 17:00 and children choose their distance on site. Registration is binding, no cancellations are accepted, and registration is possible up to 26/8 at 17:30. Course and map materials are available on the competition page (link to map/basemap). Registration via the website or on-site at Rocklunda IP from 15:00; 25 August according to the information page; includes a functional T-shirt, bib number and medal; team registration is allowed for 3 - 5 participants with the last regular registration day on 20 August; course layout and start times will be announced by the organizers.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)
description: NKPG City Norrköpings Stadslopp is organized by Tjalve Friidrott Norrköping and takes place with start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in the heart of Norrköping. The race offers the distances of 5 km and 10 km (10 km is 2 x 5 km) as well as the free children's race Lilla Lundbergsloppet. The course runs through classic Norrköping environments with packed spectator crowds, several music stations and a mix of elite runners and recreational runners. The event features medals and sponsor products at the finish as well as opportunities for team registration and both timing and non-timing options.
course_highlights: Course through city streets in classic Norrköping environments with packed spectator crowds
More than ten music stations along the course for extra encouragement
10 km = 2 x 5 km; start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata
additional: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata at Hötorget. Start times: Lilla Lundbergsloppet from 17:00 (four starts with 15-minute intervals), 10 km start 18:30, 5 km start 19:30. Optional with or without timing for the 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet (approximately 1,000 m) is free and limited to a maximum of 1,100 children; all children receive a medal and a goodie bag. Bib distribution: XXL Ingelsta Tuesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00 and in the partner village near the start and finish area Wednesday 27 August from 15:00 (late registration for the 5 and 10 km possible at the bib distributions). Start lists and information about your bib number will be published from the afternoon of Monday 25 August. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is 1 km free for children; start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata; the course passes Lindens shopping center and includes music stations along the way; Lilla Lundbergsloppet has a maximum of 1,100 children; a medal for all participants and a goodie bag; an official results page is available online.

name: Blodomloppet Halmstad
price_range: 350 kr t.o.m. 11 aug; 1 750 kr för lag om fem personer inklusive picknickkasse

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 750 kr för lag med fem deltagare inkl. picknickkasse t.o.m 11/8

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Halmstad, a recreational run that highlights the life-saving blood donation. Here you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, and there is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families. The event is organized by Halmstad Orienteringsklubb together with the blood centers in Halland, and many teams usually finish with a communal picnic.
course_highlights: Choice of 5 km or 10 km along a coastal course
Finish area with views of the sea at Tylösand
Separate Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families
additional: Registration is sold exclusively through Blodomloppet's website. A team of five participants gets a picnic hamper included. There is an option to buy food, drinks and ice cream at existing kiosks at the start. Companies can rent tents at the finish area via Halmstad Partytält (info@halmstadpartytalt.se). Bag drop-off is available; start and meal information as well as a map and changing facilities are mentioned in the event information; there is a possibility to rent a tent at the finish area.

name: GKN-stafetten 2026 (del av Trollhättan Action Week)
description: GKN Relay is a team relay that is part of Trollhättan Action Week and takes place on Thursday, August 27, 2026. Each team consists of four participants with each runner running about 3 km on a flat course around Trollhättan's canal. The event emphasizes community and team spirit and welcomes both fast teams as well as those who want to jog slowly or walk. After finishing, there is on-site entertainment with live music and a picnic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat course along Trollhättan canal
Relay format 4 x ~3 km (each participant runs about 3 km)
Start/finish at Hansenplatsen, Trollhättan
additional: Registration is via RaceID where the team's contact person creates the registration and specifies the team name and which leg each team member will run; team consists of 4 participants. The event encourages running, jogging or walking and offers on-site entertainment after the finish (live music and a picnic basket). NearYou has a staffing pool on site at Hansenplatsen to assist with replacement runners in case of late dropouts. Location: Hansenplatsen, Trollhättan; competition format: relay 4 x 3 km. Team requires 4 people, each participant 3 km, total 12 km; start time TBA; registration requires team leader, booking code and personal details; payment via Söderberg & Partnerportalen; other fees covered by VIF-Tt.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
distance_verbose: 60 km, 50 km, 32 km, 28 km, 18 km, 14 km
description: Höga Kusten Trail is a two-day trail weekend with five distances that takes you through the Höga Kusten World Heritage Site. The races are aimed at both beginners and experienced participants and combine running, fast hiking, and spectacular views. The event includes race briefs, a mini trade fair with equipment exhibitors, and joint after-trail celebrations at FriluftsByn.
course_highlights: The courses pass through the Höga Kusten World Heritage Site and traverse several dramatic peaks (e.g., Skuleberget).
Five distances with varying terrain and technical sections: Twin Peaks 14k, 3Peaks 18k, Coast to Summits 28/32k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k.
Officials and energy stations along the course; buses from FriluftsByn to the start.
additional: Prior to each distance there is a race brief and there is a mini expo where Icebug and Haglöfs display equipment. The Original 45k has a 12-hour time limit and buses from FriluftsByn go to the start (for example 07:30 - 08:30 for The Original). There are energy stations and volunteers along the course, the option to sell a starting spot in the participants group on Facebook, as well as voluntary insurance via Startklar. After-Trail and communal evenings are included as part of the event, and the event also offers Trail Camps. Participants follow a two-day weekend with five distances; race briefs before each distance; Trail Camp and various pre-/post-events; start and finish locations in FriluftsByn and Skuleberget; the race passes iconic viewpoints within the Höga Kusten World Heritage Site.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
location: Kungliga slottet, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: adidas Stockholm Half Marathon is a half marathon of 21,098 meters that in 2026 will run for the 25th time through Stockholm's inner city. The course is unique with both start and finish in the area between the Royal Palace, the Parliament House, and the Opera, and offers smooth, easy-to-run streets through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm. The first start takes place at 15:30, and the event includes an expo and bib-number pickup in Kungsträdgården 27–29 August, as well as an after-run in Kungsträdgården. The race is open from the year you turn 17, and registration is binding.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the area by the Royal Palace/Norrbro (in the city centre)
A smooth-running course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Passes Hornsbergstrand, Rålambshovsparken and Söder Mälarstrand; detailed kilometer splits are available on the course
additional: Bib-number pickup and Expo in Kungsträdgården 27–29 August; after-run in Kungsträdgården at the finish; registration is binding and the fee is not refunded without valid sports-event insurance via Folksam; payment methods: online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish or invoice via Klarna; last day to report results for seeding: 2 August 2026; late registration (subject to availability) 24–29 August up to 1 hour before the first start. 21,098 km course; start 15:30; expo in Kungsträdgården 27–29 Aug; start/finish at the Royal Palace; after run in Kungsträdgården.

name: Trelleborgsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Klass 1-4, löpning 5 och 10 km : 195 kr vid föranmälan , 270 kr vid efteranmälan (efter 25/8)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Klass 5, gång 5 km : 125 kr vid föranmälan 175 kr vid efteranmälan (efter 25/8)

description: Trelleborgsloppet is a classic city race in Sweden's southernmost city with controlled, approved courses. The event offers 10 km and 5 km for runners, as well as a 5 km walking/pole-walking option, with start at Östervång Stadium and finish in City Park. The race uses gross time timing with a disposable chip and is aimed at both competitive runners, corporate teams and recreational runners. Everyone finishing receives a medal and there is a team competition for companies, associations and groups of friends.
course_highlights: Start at Östervång Stadium, finish in City Park
Calibrated, approved city course (gross time timing)
Distances: 10 km and 5 km (including 5 km walk/pole-walking) with separate bib-number series per class
additional: Timing with a disposable chip (Neptron), gross time. Bib numbers can be picked up no later than 45 minutes before start at Östervång Stadium or at the foyer of Söderslätt Hall on 28/8 from 17:00–19:00. Changing in Söderslätt Hall; clothing is transported by car to the finish (departs once, typically 10:10). Late online registration available up to 45 minutes before start and on-site up to 1 hour before the respective start. Team competition ("Fastest in town") for companies/organizations/friend groups registers via online registration (free of charge). The course is a city race in Trelleborg on gravel paths and sidewalks. Online late registration is available for an increased fee. Bib collection takes place at Söderslätt Hall; timing is done with a disposable chip (Neptron) and results are published on trelleborgsloppet.se.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race that, in 2026, will be held on August 29 and offers beautiful views along Lake Vättern, through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned for fewer elevation meters but preserves a varied profile with natural sections, spectator support and several power zones; the marathon portion ends with an impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge. The event attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children's race, as well as offers for companies and tent packages at the start/finish.
course_highlights: Impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern, Jönköping and Huskvarna with a redesigned course and fewer elevation gains
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 hydration stations along the course plus one at Start/Finish, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: registrations can be made for up to five runners at the same time; race bibs are not mailed out; the marathon course has an interactive map and a PDF to download, power zones and 12+1 hydration stations; the organizer offers tent packages for companies at the start/finish and the possibility to use a wellness grant. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and hydration stations along the course, chip timing, group registrations for up to five runners, and the company village with tents at the start/finish.

name: Festivalloppet
description: Festivalloppet is SK Graal's annual running race in Strömsnäsbruk, following parts of the Lagan River. The race offers the distances of 10 km and 4.8 km, as well as children's and youth classes, and runs through scenic surroundings along the river. The event is characterized by a local and friendly atmosphere where the club, spectators, and volunteers contribute to a good experience. Results, start lists, and information are published on SK Graal's website; the 2025 edition had 173 registered and 167 finishers.
course_highlights: Along the Lagan River in Strömsnäsbruk
Distances of 10 km and 4.8 km
Children's and youth classes and a friendly local atmosphere
additional: Registration and information via links on SK Graal's website; results, start lists, and photos are published there. The 2025 edition had 173 registered and 167 finished.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail adventure for those who like experiences, running and beautiful nature. You choose to run 42 km, 21 km or 10 km and you can also let the children participate in Barnens Fjällmaraton. Along mountain trails, paths, boardwalks and gravel roads you are challenged by nature on your way to the finish and After Run at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is a deluxe running challenge! Experience the joy of running in the mountains with us!
course_highlights: Courses across mountain trails, paths, boardwalks and gravel roads with expansive views
Greater elevation changes: 42 km has about 970 meters of ascent, 21 km about 680 meters
Technical sections such as Storfjällsgraven and along hiking trails with babbling mountain streams
additional: Starting and finishing at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. The race office opens 07:30 - 12:00 on race day. For top-5 placements you must start in the first start group (the prize podium is determined by finish placement, not chip time). Energy stations along the course offer ENERVIT sports drinks, water and light snacks. After the race there is a prize giving and an After Run party at the arena; Friday evening also offers Pasta & Pepp as a pre-race boost and several group warm-ups before each distance. Finish and After Run at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Accommodation options and buffet packages are available via SkiStar Lodge Lindvallen; dinner buffet reservations open closer to the start. The children's race is included as Barnens Fjällmaraton.

images.alt_text: Lycklig löpare med armarna i luften under Fjällmaraton Sälen i vacker fjällnatur.
Deltagare springer i Fjällmaraton Sälen på en träspång genom fjällandskap.
Fjällmaraton Sälen med löpare i naturskön fjällterräng. 10/21/42 km den 29 augusti 2026.

name: Midnattsloppet (Malmö)
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is an evening festival that takes place on August 29, 2026. Choose between 10 km (first start at 21:00) or 5 km (first start at 22:00) with start and finish at Stortorget. The race highlights late start times, music and activities along the course and suits both competitive runners, teams and corporate groups. The event emphasizes the atmosphere, the crowd and the experience rather than just performance results.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in central Malmö
City-centre asphalt course through Malmö with music and activities along the route
Evening/night start with festival atmosphere (10 km at 21:00, 5 km at 22:00)
additional: Practical information: start location and warm-up at Stortorget. The entry fee includes, among other things, an official Björn Borg t-shirt (the 5 km side mentions a shirt), precise timing, energy drink along the course, as well as a bar/fruit at the finish and a digital diploma. A medal can be purchased at registration. Wellness providers: Benifex, Epassi and Benefits (possibility to register via wellness allowance). Team registration and corporate competition are available; there is also a costume class for 5/10 km. Course closure/end: in Malmö the tape is pulled after 6.6 km at 22:26 (runners passing after this are directed and the timing chip may be clipped). Distances: 5 km and 10 km; start and finish at Stortorget; 10 km course around Malmö; start times: 21:00 for 10 km and 22:00 for 5 km; team and corporate classes; theme: Costume; starter kits include a t-shirt (Björn Borg), precise timing, energy drink and fruit as well as a digital diploma; a medal can be purchased; wellness allowance via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits; team registration provides a discount.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 24 augusti - 29 augusti (10.00/13.00) 625 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Longer is a timed race in the Rynningeviken nature reserve outside Örebro where participants run as far as they can in either a three- or six-hour format. The course follows scenic trails along Hjälmaren and Svartån, is relatively technical but fast, and is just a stone's throw from the city center. The competition is open to all running styles and levels—from walking to ultramarathon—and offers a community-filled day with support and energy stations. A separate KidsRun for the youngest participants is also part of the event.
course_highlights: Loop course 2412.5 meters, mostly gravel paths
Two bridges that provide the small elevation gain; start/finish on cobblestones
Last 508-meter loop for final timing (reduces waiting time at the finish)
additional: Start times and mandatory briefings: 6-hour start 11:00 (briefing 10:45), 3-hour start 14:00 (briefing 13:45), KidsRun start 11:30 (briefing 11:15); Location: Gamla Oljehamnen below Naturens hus, parking along Oljevägen; Measurements are taken with a transponder borrowed at bib distribution (lost transponder charged 800 SEK) and final measurement verified with a measuring wheel; No individual timing - results are distance at the time limit; Beverages/sports drink from Umara and a well-stocked energy table (bars, fruit, chips, pickled cucumber, toscakaka, etc.); Changing rooms/showers are not offered; public toilets at the start and after about 1 km; Registration only via partner AnmälMigNu (group/corporate registration via info@epictrail.se); Youth (born 2008 or later) have 50% discount; KidsRun participants receive a medal, Festis and ice cream. Loop distance approx 2412.5 m with two bridges and last 508 m in a loop; energy/water provided (Umara); changing/shower not offered; toilets near the start and after about 1 km. Registration window August 24-29; youth discount 50% for those born in 2008 or later; includes place, bib, timing, unique medal, sport drink and energy along the course; registration via AnmälMigNu; group/corporate registration via info@epictrail.se; cancellation and insurance options as well as personal risk.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a series of mass-participation races organized by Bergsbyns SK, aimed at both enthusiastic recreational runners and elite amateur runners. The running takes place on 29 August 2026 and offers distances for adults (21 km and 12 km) as well as children's distances (2.7 km and 500 m). The races can be run individually or as part of Kraftklassikern, where you complete skiing, cycling and running within the same calendar year. The event is presented as a community festival with a focus on health and camaraderie.
course_highlights: Competitive running distances: 21 km and 12 km
Children's runs: 2.7 km and 500 m
The race can be included in Kraftklassikern (a combination with skiing and cycling within the same calendar year)
additional: Organizer: Bergsbyns SK, address Falmyrvägen 66, 931 53 Skellefteå. Contact by phone +46 (0)910-861 61 and e-mail info@kraftloppet.com. Registration is done via links on the registration page (registration). When you have completed all three races in the same calendar year, inform the secretary before 30 September to receive the Kraftklassiker reward. Follow the event on Facebook for information ahead of the races. Registration via the Registration page; the race takes place on 29 August 2026 in Skellefteå (Bergsbyns SK, Falmyrvägen 66); results links are available for running and other disciplines.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Årsunda IF invites you to the Vikingatrail on Sunday, 30 August 2026 — a trail race with a start at Årsunda IP and a finish at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The courses include 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km mini-race, and information, the invitation, and course materials are published on the event page. Participant information, the information sheet and start lists are updated on the website ahead of the race, and results and photos from previous years are also available. GPX files and maps (as well as elevation profiles via Garmin Connect) are offered for all courses.
course_highlights: Start at Årsunda IP, finish at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård).
Courses in multiple lengths: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km mini-race (the mini-race starts 1 km from the finish with bus transport to the start).
Maps, GPX files and elevation profiles are published; the courses are uploaded as public routes in Garmin Connect.
additional: Information sheet (version 2) updated with information including, among other things, a football match at Årsunda IP, bib numbers for the 1 km race, award ceremony and results. Registered participants and preliminary start lists are published on an ongoing basis, from about a month before the competition. GPX files, maps and elevation profiles are downloadable; the courses are also published as public routes in Garmin Connect. GPX files and maps are available; elevation profiles are planned; start lists, results and photos are updated continually; a bus to the start for the 1 km race is available.
