description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a community festival race with several distances for all ages and levels - 5 km (running/walking), 10 km (timed), and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. The courses run on pedestrian-friendly trails and roads in beautiful, hilly nature and suit both recreational runners, walking groups, and families. You can register individually or in teams (3–5 people) and the race combines exercise with raising awareness of the need for blood donation. After the finish, participants are treated to a picnic and the children receive a shirt and a medal.
course_highlights: 5 km: pedestrian-friendly trails in beautiful, hilly nature
10 km: hilly and challenging course on trails and roads between Ymer and Kype
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 800 m for children up to 12 years, shirts and medals for all
additional: Team registration: 3–5 participants, picnic basket included (extra picnic basket 250 kr). A team can leave 1–2 spots vacant and be completed no later than August 20; the last day for team registration is August 24. Indicate if you are a blood donor for a 40 kr discount. If you want the name on the bib you must register no later than August 10. On-site late registration can be done on site the same day (31 August) no later than one hour before start for an increased fee. The race offers 5 km walk, 5 km run, 10 km run and Lilla Blodomloppet about 1 km; start/finish at Skidstadion and Ymergården; picnic basket included with team registration; option for a T-shirt in functional material and a medal.

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet (5 eller 10 km): 350 kr  t.o.m 12 augusti.

description: Join us to raise awareness of life-saving blood donation at Blodomloppet Växjö on September 2, 2026. The race offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps on a certified 5 km course) as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for the youngest participants. Start and finish are in Linnéparken, and the course is described as flat and fast with strong crowd support along the route. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally ends with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linnéparken in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, and certified 5 km course (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking track for the 5 km walk and its own loop for Lilla Blodomloppet (~600 m)
additional: Registration can be completed individually or in teams (max 5 participants per team). Team participants within the same team can participate in different distances. The last registration day for teams is 26 August 2026. There is an Excel template for mass registrations, and the organizer can assist with a customer-side discount code for companies registering more than 20 participants. Name changes and changes of class/distance cost 50 kr. Registration can be done up to the day of the event, and on-site late registration is possible at Linnéparken (the tent for late registration and bib pickup). Lilla Blodomloppet runs on its own loop in Linnéparken with the same start/finish. Course layout: start and finish in Linnéparken; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration are available; includes t-shirt, bib, medal, and goodie bag; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a three-day trail running stage race in the Ramsvik area of Bohuslän on Sweden’s west coast, covering roughly 75 - 77 km over coastal cliffs, forest trails and beaches. The event is presented as an inclusive outdoor experience with separate starting groups for Walk, Jog and Run, so both competitive runners and those wanting a scenic multi-day hike can participate. Race Village accommodation is organised in cooperation with Ramsvik Stugby & Camping, and family-friendly options such as a Kids Camp with supervised activities are offered. Expect varied, technical terrain and daily stages that showcase the archipelago and coastal villages.
course_highlights: Three stages across coastal cliffs, narrow forest trails and beaches
Daily stages include Ramsvik - Smögen (~25 km), Bohus‑Malmön - Kungshamn (~31 km) and Hunnebo - Ramsvik (~22 km)
Technical rocky peaks, enchanted forests and seaside village passages
additional: Stage maps are provided for each day (Ramsvik - Smögen, Bohus‑Malmön - Kungshamn, Hunnebo - Ramsvik). Kids Camp and family activities; energy stations and mandatory equipment; accommodation and transport information related to Ramsvik

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg takes place on September 5, 2026 and offers a festive evening run of 5 km or 10 km with start and finish at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The races run through the city’s pulse and Avenyn with music, spectators and activities along the course, creating a carnival atmosphere. The event welcomes individual runners, teams and companies and combines competition with a street party at night. The event is marketed as a memorable running experience with late start times and a strong focus on atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two-lap course along Avenyn with start and finish at Gustaf Adolfs torg (10 km; two laps)
Late-evening start that provides a unique night-time atmosphere — the 10 km starts at 21:00
Throngs of spectators, music and activities along the course — carnival atmosphere
additional: Starting location and warm-up at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The 5 km start fee includes, among other things, a Björn Borg T-shirt (this year’s color/print), precise timing, energy drink along the course, and a snack bar and fruit at the finish; a medal can be purchased in connection with registration. Possibility to register via wellness providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits). Cut-off times: 10 km = 90 minutes (calculated from the last start group), 5 km = 45 minutes; there are barrier/turn rules (e.g., stop at Tyska Bron for looping and rules for the second lap). Corporate and team registration as well as the purchase of value codes are available. Start times: 10 km at 21:00 and 5 km at 21:30. The start package includes a T-shirt, chip and the possibility of a medal. Wellness subsidies via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. Corporate and team participation and a course map are available on the website.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women that in 2026 will take place in Södra Djurgården and through Stockholm's city center on September 5. The race is suitable for all levels—from walking to fast running—and is divided into start groups to ensure a smooth race flow. The course offers a spectator-friendly route with both scenic sections and urban surroundings, as well as optional timing and prize money for the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Södra Djurgården and through Stockholm's city center with beautiful surroundings
Strong crowd support along the course and a pulsating atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to about 6 km (start group 12) for those who want
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out; registration is binding. Late registration is possible (subject to availability) digitally up until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: online bank transfer, Visa/MasterCard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Age limit for Tjejmilen Stockholm: from the year you turn 15 (13 years old if accompanied by an adult). The start is divided into 12 start groups and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen-trail and Stockholm City Run); start groups; age 15; possible late registration; dogs not allowed; planning information available on the official page.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon is a well-run half marathon that offers fast sections, varied surfaces and a spectacular finish by the sea. Start and finish are at Dunkers Kulturhus, and the course runs through Helsingborg's historic center, past Kärnan, through Pålsjö skog and Laröd. The course shares large parts with the marathon course, has about 170 meters of elevation, a climb up to Kärnan at 2 km and a long downhill after 19 km. The race is the host of SM Halvmaraton 2026 and offers the possibility to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Dunkers Kulturhus; about 3 km through the historic center including Stortorget and Kärnan
The finish line and final stretch along the sea at Gröningen with celebrations on the quay toward the Øresund
Around 170 meters of elevation in total; a climb up to Kärnan after ~2 km and a long downhill after ~19 km; mostly asphalt with forest and urban sections
additional: SM Halvmaraton 2026 is held in conjunction with the race - participants in SM must represent a club that is a member of Svenska Friidrottsförbundet; There is an option to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag at registration; The bib-number T-shirt must be actively chosen and is specially produced (cannot be exchanged/returned); Group registration can be made via a dedicated group form/link (found on the registration page); The course map shows start/finish, split times, aid stations, toilets, cafés, parking and the Stadsdelsfesten along the route. SM Halvmaraton 2026; approximately 4000 starting places; fundraising for Min Stora Dag; group registration with invoice; bib pickup can be linked to the choice of T-shirt (the T-shirt is non-returnable) according to the registration page.

name: Lydinge Resort Stafett
description: Lydinge Resort Stafett is a team event on two distances - 42.2 km and 21.1 km - where teams of 2-4 people share our beautiful and experiential courses. The start is at Sundstorget in Helsingborg and the courses offer everything from the city center and the landborg to coastal stretches with a finish along Strandpromenaden. The relay has four exchange stations and varying legs in both natural and urban environments, and is offered in the categories men, women, mixed and corporate. The event also collaborates with Min Stora Dag for fundraising for children.
course_highlights: Start at Sundstorget and finish along Strandpromenaden
Exchange stations at locations including Ättekulla, Fredriksdal and Pålsjö skog
Varied course through city, coast and nature reserve
additional: Team size 2 - 4 runners; distances 21,1 km (legs approximately 3,6 - 6 km) and 42,2 km (legs approximately 9 - 12 km); categories: men, women, mixed and corporate; provide teammates' e-post addresses at registration so they receive confirmation by email; larger group registrations via a separate group form; running T-shirt is optional and manufactured to order (picked up at Löplabbet after the race); trial runs are offered (for example, 18 April and 6 June 2026); opportunity to donate to Min Stora Dag at registration. Lydinge Resort Stafett is a team competition with four categories - men, women, mixed and corporate - and offers group registration (invoice). Participants receive a year-design T-shirt that is picked up at Löplabbet in Helsingborg after the race; the T-shirt cannot be exchanged or returned. The collaboration with Min Stora Dag enables fundraising for children in need.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is an exciting and challenging trail race in Göteborg with distances for everyone, from shorter 8 km to longer 33 and 45 km. The courses run on adventurous trails, through lush forest and over rocky slabs and take runners from the outskirts of the city into the wilderness. After the finish, an AfterRun with food, a finisher product and a unique medal awaits. The race emphasizes experience, community and sustainability and is organized with start and finish in Kvibergs Park.
course_highlights: Adventurous trails, lush forest and rocky slabs with spectacular views
Courses pass Bergsjön, Paradiset and parts of Bohusleden (the 33 km goes via Bohusleden)
Technical terrain alternates with easy-running sections and significant elevation gain
additional: Start and finish in Kvibergs Park (assembly there for all races); 33 km starts at Angered Church with a common bus from Kviberg (the bus departs at 10:10); Bib number distribution: Friday at Löplabbet Östra Hamngatan 11:00 - 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 at the event area in Kviberg; AfterRun with food included for participants; Live tracking and split times offered; Registration is individual via partner Race.se and is binding (no refunds); Name changes are free until 2026-08-23, a fee of 200 SEK applies 2026-08-24 - 2026-09-03; The organizers encourage public transport (tram 7 & 11, bus 56 & 510) and there is paid parking available; Distances also include the 33 km start at Angered Church with a shared bus to the start; the course may change and start/finish takes place in Kvibergs Park; hydration and energy stations, mandatory equipment and medical care are on site; maximum and cutoff times are partially indicated in the competition information.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
location: Dammen i Tvärred, Ulricehamn Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail run organized in beautiful forest and terrain around Dammen in Tvärred south of Ulricehamn. You can choose between 7, 17, or 27 km on routes that offer narrow forest trails, moss-covered rock sections, and substantial elevation. The event emphasizes experience, community and running joy, with volunteers, a speaker and on-site service, as well as warm food and a medal for all finishers.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and moss-covered rock sections
Quite hilly course with magical views
Start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred (parking nearby)
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred; parking is nearby. Hydration stations are available along the course (in collaboration with Umara Sports). Hot food is included for all participants after finishing and a medal is awarded to everyone who completes. Free mini-race for the very youngest (start at 10:45) with on-site registration; course preview is arranged on May 3 with several pace groups. Västgötaloppet Trail is part of the Västgötatrippeln (Classic/Skate, MTB and Trail). Competition area – Dammen in Tvärred; the start/finish is central in the area, parking is available nearby, and participants are offered fluids, snacks, a medal and hot food after the race. The 27 km and 17 km have prize presentations; the 7 km race offers raffled prizes. Part of Västgötaloppstrippeln.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity run in southern Sweden with a focus on technical singletracks and community over prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used by the 24h ultrarun; there is also a 51 km and a children's race. The course character is technical and hilly with many small, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity, sustainability, and that a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop - used for the 24h ultrarun (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many small hills
additional: Accommodation: option to sleep in the barn (20-30 spots) or in tents on-site; pre- and post-race social activities include a campfire, BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100-120 kr, 13:00-15:00). 24h runners pass the base camp each lap; special moments for the 24h ("chainsaw segment") - see competition rules. The cut-off for the 24h ultrarun is Sunday, 6 September 2026. The event offers separate toilets/changing rooms and access to feminine hygiene products; support to find a night buddy for dark laps. Swish donation to War Child 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively donate via the respective NGO's website. Registration requires proof of donation to War Child or another NGO; the event includes the possibility of multiple distances and a child-friendly course.

name: LöpRallarn
location: Bottnaryds IP, Bottnaryd, Ljungby Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen and organized by Bottnaryds IF. The run offers shorter distances (noted 7.5 km and 15 km) and attracts both youths and recreational runners – for example, the 2025 edition attracted around 102 participants. The start is held at Bottnaryds IP and the race is conducted as a late-summer activity in the area around Bottnaryd. The organizer presents results and contact via the race's contact email.
course_highlights: A gently undulating loop adjacent to Bottnaryds IP (referenced as an 8 km loop in the Rallarloppen description).
A stretch that follows parts of the old decommissioned railway embankment.
Passes nature areas near Dumme Mosse.
additional: Earlier editions (2025) included both 7.5 km and 15 km, with many youths on the start list; the organizer publishes results via the same website and the provided email. LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series together with RallarLoppet (ski) and CykelRallarn. The Rallarloppen framework is offered around the nature with start and finish at Bottnaryds IP; LöpRallarn is offered in several distances (1 km, 2 km, 7.5 km and 15 km) that suit both recreational runners and competitive runners.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: The Blood Run in Eskilstuna takes place on September 7, 2026 and is organized by Eskilstuna Friidrott. The race offers women's and men's classes at 5 km and 10 km, as well as the Lilla Blodomloppet and the Specialomloppet, and the courses are described as fast and flat. The event is held in Stadsparken and combines a fitness run with the aim of raising awareness for blood donation, among other things through a blood donor gift and a picnic tradition. Information and PM are published on the event page, and registration can be done individually or in teams.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured
Start and event area in Stadsparken
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (max 5 people per team); team participants within the same team may participate in different distances. For larger registrations there is an Excel template to download from the registration page, and the organizer can help with a customer page/discount code for companies with more than 20 participants. A blood donor gift will be distributed at the Unilabs blood donor center's tent in the event area. Bag storage/drop-off is offered (drop-off/pick-up times are listed 17:00–20:00). Course layout: 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet 800 m. Event area with bag drop and picnic bag; participation can take place individually or in teams (maximum 5 people per team).

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual recreational race in Skärblacka that offers a festival for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town with start and finish at Folkets Hus, and there is also a 4 km walking class and the Lilla Barnloppet of 900 meters. The race is open to all levels and is fringed by a generous prize table, lotteries and goodie bags for participants. The organizers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome you to the start line on September 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka with start and finish at Folkets Hus
The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partial trails
4 km walking class (shortened) and the Lilla Barnloppet 900 m near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Bib numbers can be picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday 8 Sept from 11:00–18:00; remaining bib numbers will be issued at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration can be done in connection with the bib-number distribution. All participants receive a goodie bag; a prize table, sprint prize and lotteries take place (including a tire prize, course-record bonus). The walk class was introduced in 2024; bib numbers are picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via RaceID; late registration is valid on race day from 15:30; payment is accepted only by Swish or cash; the chip records the time on the bib; medical care, food and drinks are available on site.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day race (11-13 September 2026) through Sörmland's scenic and biologically rich landscape, with distances from about 8 km up to 100 miles. The races run on technical singletracks, coastal trails and faster sections and suit both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners depending on the chosen distance. The event focuses on the trail experience with local food experiences, talks and a friendly, inclusive organization. The organizers offer GPS tracking, GPX files and service at water stations for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: Course with forest trails and coastal cliffs along Sörmlandsleden
About 300 meters of elevation (22 km) and technical singletrack
Surface: about 85% trail, 10% gravel, 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available for download; live GPS tracking and intermediate/final results are offered. The event is cupless - bring your own cup. In longer distances, a buff, live tracking, GPX, window decal and handmade wooden finishers medal / belt buckle depending on distance are included. There are detailed mandatory kit lists (including 1 liter of water, mobile phone, navigation tools, first aid kit, map, GPS tracker, emergency blanket, rain jacket, headlamp) for 100 km and 100 miles. Early cut-offs and water station positions published; the organizers plan shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (fee around 100 SEK, paid via Swish on site). Night Trail and 2 km children's race are included; start/finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park; bus transfers and GPX tracks are included in the information for the different distances.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race by Bysjön lake in Åtvidaberg, organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses are varied with asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails, with start and finish at Edbergavallen, and offer distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes both recreational as well as competitive runners and teams.
course_highlights: Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails along Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
The 10 km includes a hilly cross-country section (the illuminated loop in Humpa) and is more challenging
additional: Registration is through the link to the registration system; payment via Swish or bank giro (discount codes available online). Bib numbers can be picked up from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; on-site registration from 10:00 (Swish or exact cash). Distance information: 700 m (children, without timing), 1.3 km (children, with timing), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel) and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/terrain/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded for completing the 10th or 20th race (adult classes). Team registration (4 - 6 participants) includes a picnic basket intended for 5 people; team registration can close on September 7 if baskets have run out. A kiosk is available at the competition area. Award ceremony around 12:00 for the 1.3 km and around 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. The distances: 1.3 km, 5 km and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; there is an option for an extra commemorative medal at the 10th or 20th race in the adult classes; team registration 4 - 6 participants; bib pickup at Edbergavallen; ICA picnic basket after finish; kiosks at the competition area; prize distribution according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open communal interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Norasjön in Nora, organized by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in the early part of September and has historically been an important race in the district of Southern Svealand, with DM/VDM status according to the district invitation. The course passes through varied nature around the lake, with open fields, forests and across streams, and offers a route that promotes both competition-focused runners and recreational runners. The race has a long tradition and is a valued part of the region's running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Round - half marathon around the lake
Varied nature along the course with open fields, forests and streams
DM/VDM status in the Southern Svealand district and part of Southern Svealand's Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the start; the distance is a half marathon and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Southern Svealand.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is an established cross-country race organized by IF Hagen on the scenic Billingen in Skövde. The race is offered on a spectator-friendly 4.4 km course that can be run one or two laps, with separate youth class and a toddlers' race for the youngest. The event has a long tradition and recently celebrated its 50th race, with a focus on forest terrain and running joy. Welcoming for both runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Scenic Billingen in Skövde
A spectator-friendly 4.4 km course that can be run one or two laps (8.8 km)
Youth classes at 2.5 km and a special toddlers' race for the youngest
additional: Registration is via Race-ID according to the invitation; PM (preliminary information PM) is published before the race. Late registration is allowed on site, about 45 minutes before the start (according to the previous PM). Results are published under Documents/Results (listed as Raceresult for previous years). The 50th edition of Hagenloppet is mentioned in the text; the race is held in Billingen, Skövde.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a welcoming trail race offered at 5, 10 and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses mix fast pavement with winding trail through beech and pine forests and offer magnificent views of Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed for the experience as much as the performance and suits both recreational runners and more experienced runners. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, finishing down Grännaberbet on a winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trail through beech forest, gravel roads and challenging climbs with magnificent views
additional: Shared start from the square through Gränna to the harbor where timing begins; timing on all distances; a unique medal for all participants; arena and finish area in the center of Gränna with proximity to cafés, eateries and accommodations; the courses may change depending on conditions and permissions. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances 5, 10 and 21 km. The courses may change depending on conditions and permissions.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a Backyard Ultra race held at Ästad Vingård in Varberg. The race follows a 6.7 km loop course that starts on the hour; the first start is at 09:00 and all who make it back restart for the next lap until only one runner remains. The course consists of gravel and grass and offers views of vineyards and lakes. The organizer emphasizes a limited number of spots (200) and that participation is at your own risk.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop course (gravel and grass)
Views of vineyards and lake views along most of the loop
Starts every full hour (Backyard Ultra format), first start at 09:00
additional: Bib number pickup/registration in the start area in the morning (listed as 07:30 - 08:45 / 07:45 - 08:45 in the information). Mandatory equipment: headlamp and personal medicine (headlamp must be used between 20:00 - 07:00). Participants must bring their own cup/mug (no disposable cups provided). Start/finish and competition area are located at Ästad Vingård's staff parking near the high ropes course; the area is limited to 200 participants and participation occurs at your own risk. 200 participants max; registration 07:30 - 08:45; headlamp mandatory 20:00 - 07:00; own cup mandatory; Tailwind beverages; meals at designated times; signage and guidance on site; be careful at crossings and follow the instructions.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26-kilometer trail race in Paradisets Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race features technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks over marshes, and through open pine forest—a demanding but scenic trail event. The distance is a leg in the Outnorth Trailtour, and the race emphasizes community, personal challenge, and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organizer is Trailrunning Sweden AB, and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience southern Stockholm's wilderness.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with climbs and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks over marshes and small tarns, and through open pine forest areas
26 km through Paradisets Nature Reserve – a round in the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: Date for the race is given as September 12, 2026. The event highlights an after-party/finish atmosphere and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organizer is Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as demanding with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks and marshes. The courses are marked with tape and start groups per distance; start times and energy stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; hydration stations and the afterparty in Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
distance_verbose: 6.7 km, Backyard Ultra, Tidslopp, Backyard Ultra
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes Nybro Backyard 12h as part of its annual competition program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format that welcomes runners seeking an ultra challenge in a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes movement, community, and joy in nature and also offers rental and personal training in Nybro. For questions, contact details for Topp & Dröm can be found on their website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Hosted in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
Organizer's focus: movement, community, and joy in nature
additional: Arrangör: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organisationsnummer: 969796-6407. Kontakt-e-post: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish for payment is listed as 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rental (roller skis and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race features a 6,706 m lap, with starts every full hour, and changing rooms/showers nearby; parking at the stadium and a camping site via Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp and bib numbers are collected 06:30 - 07:45 on race day.

name: Södra änggårdsloppet
location: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Södra Änggården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Södra Änggårdsloppet is an inviting trail race in Södra Änggården, held for the third year. The course is approximately 8 km long with about 310 meters of elevation gain and runs through Änggårdsbergen. The starting field is divided into groups so that both competitive runners and recreational runners feel comfortable. The event has a festive atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, a DJ, as well as a medal and a drink for participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km trail race
Approximately 310 meters of elevation gain through Änggårdsbergen
The course runs on forest trails in Södra Änggården
additional: The starting field is divided into groups/waves. Festive atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks and a DJ. Participant packages include a nice medal, sparkling wine at check-in and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. The event time is listed as Saturday 12:00–16:00. Organisers listed as WAI AB (contact: Byhrviktor@gmail.com) and Trailrunning Sweden AB is listed as contact/organiser portal (info@trailrunningsweden.se). An 8 km trail race through Änggårdsbergen with about 310 meters of elevation; starting field divided into groups; festival vibe with smoke fireworks, food trucks, DJ; medal, sparkling wine at check-in and non-alcoholic beer at finish; sign up via the link below.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational running event in Saltsjö-Duvnäs that winds through a beautiful and hilly villa neighborhood. The event is organized by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and has races for children and adults with start and finish at Ringparken. Everyone can participate, whether you are a recreational runner or more competitive, and the event emphasizes community and camaraderie. Registration opens June 1, 2026 and the race takes place on September 12, 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep climbs (including Fogdevägen, Vargungevägen)
The 5 km and 10 km share the same course; the 10 km is run as two laps
Shorter races (1.7 km) and a children's race with start/finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens June 1, 2026. The final ordinary pre-registration typically takes place around September 11; registrations after that are accepted up until race start at a higher fee. Bib numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (no later than one hour before start). The timing chip is attached to the bib; the 10 km races use two bib numbers (one on the front and one on the back). Registration is binding. Registration opens June 1, 2026; the distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km run as two laps); children's start at 11:00 and adult start at about 12:30; bib numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; pre-registration until September 11; the race is seeking volunteers.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott; Ideon Science Park; Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a team relay race held in the Brunnshög and Ideon areas in northeastern Lund. The start, finish and exchange area are located in Nobelparken, and the course winds north toward ESS and through Kunskapsparken before returning to Nobelparken. A team consists of participants in women's, men's, or mixed classes, and each runner covers about 5 km. The event is organized in collaboration between IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village and is well suited for both corporate and student teams as well as families in connection with Nobelloppet and Brunnshögskalaset.
course_highlights: The route goes via Nobelparken, Kunskapsparken and up toward ESS/Max IV
Relatively flat course with about 10 meters of elevation difference
The surface is a mix of gravel and asphalt; views from the hill over northwestern Lund
additional: Team consists of 2–4 people (corporate sources specify 2–4; some texts mention 4); each runner runs about 5 km. Joint start for the first leg at 14:00; other exchange times are based on the team's pace (no maximum time). Facilities to change clothes, store outerwear, as well as food and drink in Nobelparken; medal or sausage after finishing. Recommended mode of travel: tram line 1 to Brunnshögstorget. 4-person team; start, finish and exchange area in Nobelparken (Brunnshög); the route goes toward ESS and Kunskapsparken; late registration on September 1; student price; Mecenat card is mentioned at bib pickup; collaboration between IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years' hiatus, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö - a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event includes four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman and the classic main race Mälarömilen (10 km). Start and finish are at Träkvista idrottsplats, and the event emphasizes community, joy of movement, and fast courses for those who want to compete. There is also the option to register an entire team or company in convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Paved walking paths and park trails
Signage at every kilometer mark
Start and finish at Träkvista idrottsplats; turnaround on the footpath north of the idrottsplats
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is possible on race day for an increased fee. The number of starting spots is limited, and registration is valid only after payment is completed. Timing and bib numbers are used in all classes (exception: Mälarö Knattelopp without timing; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys 9-11 years timing without placement). The event area is located at Träkvista idrottsplats with medical care, a water station just after the start/turnaround, as well as toilets, showers and changing rooms in the KOM-house. Recommended public transport options: bus 177 and 301-311 (stop: Träkvista Idrottsplats). A total cap of 1,000 runners, and all proceeds go back to Mälarö SOK's sports activities. The race offers corporate and team registrations as well as support for teams.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running race in Lidköping organized by Lidköpings VSK. For 2026, the competition is planned for September 13, with start and finish at Rådåsgården and a course through the Rådaskogen recreational trails. Participants can choose between several distances: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km, with different start times. The timing system is handled by C-time and Umara sports drink is served during the races; registration is via RaceID. The race is part of a long tradition that has been organized since the 1960s and also includes a paprika race for younger children.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rådåsgården in Lidköping, with running through fine recreational trails in Rådaskogen
Multiple distances for different levels: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km
Timing provider is C-time and Umara sports drink is served during the races
additional: Rådalunken 2026 is held at Rådåsgården, Lidköping, with several distances and timing and drink sponsorship; a paprika race for younger children is available as part of the event week. Registration is via RaceID and bib collection takes place before the start.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a public and lively relay race in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is a team event for four-person teams where each runner runs a leg of approximately 3 km. The start pistol goes off at 5:00 PM, and there are activities, food sales, and a prize ceremony with a raffle after the finish. The event welcomes everything from elite teams to recreational groups and encourages color and imagination along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team event: 4 people per team, each leg approximately 3 km
Prize ceremony around 6:15 PM and a raffle on the bib numbers
additional: Bib collection takes place at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday, September 11 from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday, September 12 from 11:00 to 13:30 (then in the start- and finish-area). Food sales are available on site and there is an After Run package for the whole team (price 140 SEK). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (hydration stations, performances etc.) and there are attractive prize sponsors and raffles. Teams pick up bib numbers at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually 11:00–13:30 on the days before) and there is an After Run package for the team (e.g., 140 SEK according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID safety guidelines in line with authorities' recommendations and encourages a sustainability focus in thematic elements.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Experience Borås in the best possible way - Spring Kretsloppet! On September 19 we will once again fill Borås streets with runners of all ages, a running festival that must be experienced. Sign up with family, friends, colleagues and run to the finish to the audience's cheers in the heart of Borås City Centre. All courses run on asphalt, relatively flat and in central Borås. A warm welcome to the running festival!
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km through Borås streets and parks
Kids' race 400 m and 2 km with its own finish in City Park
Finish in City Park with a selfie booth and live results display
additional: Registration can be made on the website up to and including race day (no later than 1 hour before start) for the adult runs; The Special Run closes September 16 and has no late registration. Possibility to pre-order Kretsloppet’s function T-shirt (150 SEK, order by August 19), wooden medal (50 SEK, order by September 11) and ICA City recovery bag (70 SEK, order by September 11). Bib number pickup uses QR code and on-site live printing. Group registration/invoicing is offered for companies, schools and organizations. Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; kids' run: 400 m and 2 km; registration via the website; insurance included in the fee; group registration possible; add-ons: function T-shirt (150 SEK), medal (50 SEK), ICA's recovery bag (70 SEK); start certificate and bib number via QR code; rules according to the Swedish Athletics Federation.

images.alt_text: Kretsloppet i Borås löparfest med silhuetter av löpare och logotyp.
Löpare passerar målgångsportal vid Kretsloppet i Borås med publik längs banan.
Löpare i Kretsloppet i Borås som springer på asfalt i stadens centrum.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by IFK Skövde (now managed by IFK Skövde Skidor) with origins dating back to 1966. Since 1993 both men and women compete on the main distance of 10.5 km, and the race has a strong local and historical connection with listed course records. In recent years it has expanded to include categories for younger runners and a Nordic walking class. Welcome to a classic cross-country challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Billingen.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on Billingen's grounds
Main distance 10.5 km (since 1993) on varied terrain
Categories for younger runners (Knatteloppet, Lilla Billingehusloppet) and Nordic walking
additional: Organized by IFK Skövde Skidor. Course records are listed on the site (e.g., Men 10.5 km 31:51, Women 10.5 km 37:44). There is a results archive and separate shorter children's races as well as a Nordic walking class. Cross-country race with course lengths from 1.6 km up to 10.5 km; Nordic walking on all courses; the Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet exist for younger runners; results and registration via links on the Svenskalag site.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

description: Uppsala Running Club welcomes elite runners, recreational runners, and children of all ages to Kung Björnloppet — Uppsala's cross-country race with family at the center. The race is organized at OK Linné's club grounds and offers several distances (10 km, 6 km, trail run, and children's race). The event now has fixed times, bib-number pickup with electronic chips and prize ceremony, and the race's 20th anniversary in 2026.
course_highlights: The course is mostly gravel roads and forest trails, with sections of asphalt.
Three distances: about 10 km, just over 6 km, and a trail run of about 5 km; the courses have kilometer markers.
Water stations: two on the 10 km course, one on the 6 km course; fluids also at the finish.
additional: Bib numbers with electronic chips are collected at Löplabbet, Dragarbrunns Torg 6 on Friday Septem ber 19 from 12:00–18:30 or on race day from 09:00 until one hour before the respective start (30 minutes before the children's races). Those collecting on Friday receive 20% off regular prices in Löplabbet's store (electronics not included). Parking is available for a fee; organizers recommend public transport (bus line 7) or cycling. There are changing rooms and showers but limited space, a kiosk on site, prize ceremony at about 13:30 and prize drawings. Start groups: the 10 km has start group 1 (under 50 minutes) and group 2; the 6 km starts in a single group. Members who have contributed at least one volunteer shift can register without a fee via kb.loppet@gmail.com. Refreshment stations, bib-number pickup at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 6), Swish payments, start times: 11:00 (10 km), 12:00 (6 km), 12:15 (trail); prize ceremony around 13:30; medal for all finishers; parking for a fee; public transport or cycling recommended; no timing in the children's race.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly, city-adjacent running event organized by Löparakademin, with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km, and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest. The courses offer a varied running experience through the Million Programme high-rises, the green spaces of Järvafältet, and Kista’s IT cluster, with start and finish at Jan Stenbeck’s Square adjacent to Kista Galleria. The event emphasizes accessibility and community (including the #RUN4ZERO initiative) and is designed for both recreational runners and those who want to compete on the measured 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment, and a festival-like atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: A precisely measured 5 km course through Kista: high-rise buildings, the green spaces of Järvafältet, and the IT cluster
Start and finish centrally on Färögatan at Jan Stenbeck's Square, adjacent to Kista Galleria
Music stations/DJs and entertainment along the course for a festival atmosphere
additional: Registration is free and includes a medal; registration opens up to and including 17 September (subject to availability). Bib pickup at the competition center in Kista Galleria (store opposite McDonald's): Friday, 19 September 12:00-18:00 and Saturday, 20 September 09:15-13:00 (bib must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start). A water station is available at the finish; medical personnel will be on site. Only the adult class (Kistaloppet 5K) has official timing; other races, including Fun Run, are not timed. Volunteers are expected to be available from about 09:00 to 15:30. Races for the whole family: 5K, Lilla Kistaloppet, Kistaloppet MINI, and Fun Run; registration is free; Lilla Kistaloppet is about 1.6 km and MINI 500 m; medals for all who complete Lilla Kistaloppet; start times and bib pickup at Kista Galleria.

name: Coop Eskilstuna Runt
location: Eskilstuna, Eskilstuna kommun, Södermanlands län, Sweden
description: COOP Eskilstuna Runt is an annual recreational run in Eskilstuna with Coop Eskilstuna as the organizer. The race offers the distances of 5 km and 10 km as well as a kids' race and is described as a festival for runners and families. On the official website there are details about the course and logistics such as registration, timing, bib numbers, start documents and transfers, as well as information about hotels, parking, changing rooms, bag drop and medals. The event is well known in town and encourages participation from both casual runners and families with children.
course_highlights: The distances of 5 km and 10 km
Kids' race for younger participants
Clear logistics with registration, timing and bib numbers
additional: The website contains practical information for runners: time & place, registration fee and registration, timing and cut-off time, bib numbers and start documents, transfer of entry and category change, insurance/refund, hotels, parking, changing rooms & showers, bag drop, toilets, energy stations, medals and prizes, medical services and results. Registration, timing, bib numbers, start documents, transfers, hotels, parking, changing rooms, bag drop, toilets, energy supplements, medals, prizes, medical services, results, terms and conditions.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Kretsloppet i Borås is a festival on the streets of Borås where runners of all ages are invited to run 5 km or 10 km through the city’s streets and parks. For the youngest there are children’s races (400 m and 2 km), and the event ends with a finish in Borås city centre / city park. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and recreational runners and encourages participation in groups with family, friends, or colleagues. The organizer’s text recalls the joyful atmosphere with music, cheering crowds and activities around the race.
course_highlights: Run through Borås streets and parks
Finish in Borås city centre / city park (selfie booth at the finish)
Children’s races 400 m and 2 km specially designed for younger participants
additional: Registration can be made on the website up to the competition day (no later than 1 hour before each race). Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. Payments are by card or Swish; group registrations for companies/organizations are available with invoicing via group account. Pre-orders at registration: Kretsloppet’s functional T-shirt (150 kr, ordered no later than 19 August), wooden medal (50 kr, last pre-order 11 September) and ICA City recovery bag (70 kr, last order 11 September). After registration, a booking confirmation will be sent by e-mail; about one week before the race a start certificate with QR code will be sent that is used at bib-number pickup. Registration for the 10 km closes 30 June; on-site registration is possible up to one hour before start. 5 km registration can be done via the website up to and including race day. Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. A start certificate with QR code and bib number is printed or shown on site. Group registration is available for companies/organizations. Pre-order of add-on products: T-shirt 150 kr, medal 50 kr and ICA Recovery bag 70 kr. Diploma available via the results website.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås offered at multiple distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. Start, lap/turnaround and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse Orientalen, where there are changing facilities, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a varied loop of 10 miles (16.1 km) with technical trails, cross-country tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails and some asphalt. The race is organized by Västerås Löparklubb and offers rewards such as a medal for completing the races and a belt buckle for finishing 100 miles in under 24 hours.
course_highlights: One lap equals 10 miles (16.1 km); the race is run in repeated laps
Very varied surfaces: technical trails, cross-country tracks, gravel road, hiking trail and some asphalt
Urban-friendly course with start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. Start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse Orientalen with changing, showers and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course within 24 hours receive BRR’s belt buckle; others who finish receive a medal. Participants may decline the medal and then the organizer will donate 20 SEK to Doctors Without Borders. Distances include 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra 48 km, 20 miles and 10 miles; the course is permanently marked with red posts; start and finish at Orientalen; a 24-hour time limit for 100 miles; sauna and showers in the clubhouse.

name: Lergöksloppet
location: Råbocka camping, Kronoskogen, Ängelholm Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Lergöksloppet is a non-competitive run organized by FK Snapphanarna on winding trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm. Start and finish are at Råbocka Camping, and the race welcomes children, recreational runners, and competitive runners. After the finish, participants receive a medal and fruit/juice or coffee/tea and a sandwich depending on the category. There are limited shower and changing facilities, and registration can also be done on race day for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Winding trails and forest roads in Kronoskogen
Start and finish at Råbocka Camping
Forest environment near Ängelholm – suitable for both children and recreational runners
additional: Bib numbers are distributed at Råbocka Camping from 9:00 AM on race day. Late registration can be done on race day from 9:00 AM for an additional fee up to 30 minutes before the start. Medals to all finishers; prize for the best woman and the best man. Showers and changing facilities are available to a limited extent. Class 1 can be run together with children at no cost. The race is organized with start and finish at Råbocka Camping and Kronoskogen as the arena; free parking and showers and changing facilities available to a limited extent. After the finish there is an opportunity to dip in the sea near Skälderviken's coastline.

name: Hökensås Trail
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race that will take place on September 20, 2026 in the area around First Camp Hökensås outside Tidaholm. The race offers three course lengths: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km, with start and finish at First Camp Hökensås between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizer CKU6 (Cykelklubben U6) offers the race as part of Motionsloppet, in collaboration with Grebbestad Multisport according to the information. The terrain blends forest roads and trails with roots and stones and offers nature-focused challenges in the Hökensås area.
course_highlights: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km
Start and finish at First Camp Hökensås in Tidaholm
Start times between 10:00 and 14:00
additional: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km; Starts from First Camp Hökensås; Start times 10:00–14:00; Sports drink supplier Umara; Organizer CKU6 within Motionsloppet; Contact: hokensastrail@motionsloppet.se

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city run in Linköping with start and finish in Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration takes place via cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members the race is free with the promo code LGIF2024; other participants' price is listed on the website. The event also seeks volunteers and offers a clear city-round experience in central Linköping.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Trädgårdsföreningen, centrally in Linköping
Urban loop focusing on Linköping's inner city
LGIF2024 campaign makes the race free for LGIF members
additional: The website contains sections on Time & Place, Registration Fee, Registration, Timing, Prizes, Maximum Time, Bib Numbers, Start Certificate, Transfer of Start Position, Class Change, Withdrawal/Insurance, Changing Rooms & Showers, Bag Drop-off, Toilets, Warm-up, Food & Drink, Energy, Medical Care, Results and Terms. Registration via cooplinkopingrunt.se; the LGIF2024 campaign makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are sought.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a cross-country running event in central Trollhättan with start and finish in Folkets Park. The courses run on technical trails and many stairs along the falls and locks area, offering varied, hilly terrain with elements of gravel and asphalt. The event offers several distances for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners—from the Mini Trail for children up to a longer Half Marathon+. We also welcome runners with dogs in dedicated start classes.
course_highlights: Technical twisty trails and heart-pounding stairs in central Trollhättan
Passage by sights such as Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, several locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
Varied hilly terrain with gravel and asphalt sections; an extra loop with more technical trails at 22.5 km
additional: Number bib distribution from 11:30 a.m. at the start (Folkets Park). Marked changing rooms are available at Arena Älvhögsborg (Storgatan 1). Toilets at the start and at the changing rooms. Three aid stations with water and sports drink along the course and an aid station at the finish. Trollhättan Mini Trail (0.8 km) is a children’s race without timing. Both 8.5 km and 14 km are offered with dogs on leashes in separate start groups (in cooperation with MIMsafe). GPX files available; start times according to the PM: Trollhättan Mini Trail at 13:00, other distances at 14:00 and 14:15; aid stations along the course and at the finish; bag storage at start/finish; changing room at Arena Älvhögsborg.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race and is held on the last weekend in September on Lidingö. The weekend offers events for all levels—from a 1.7 km kids' race to the classic 30 km race—and attracts over 30,000 runners to its scenic, hilly courses. The event is both a competitive challenge and a runner’s festival with a Sportmesse where you pick up your bib and meet exhibitors. The nature and the soft tracks are the race’s hallmark.
course_highlights: Undulating, soft tracks through forests and open sections: alternating between flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping trails and steep climbs
TCS Lidingöloppet 30 km: approximately 522 meters of elevation gain
TCS Lidingöloppet 15 km: approximately 250 meters of elevation gain; start at Koltorp and finish at Grönsta Gärde
additional: All finishers receive the TCS Lidingöloppet bronze medal with an annually unique Carl Milles motif; there is a possibility for a silver medal if you have met the silver medal time and started in start group 2 or lower. Diplomas are provided as a PDF in the results email (paper diplomas can be ordered for 50 kr including shipping). Enervit offers fueling service along the course (product depots for a fee). Minimum ages: 30 km = 17 years, 15 km = 15 years (several other age limits apply for other races). The Sports Fair is used for bib distribution and exhibitors. Lidingöloppet is a non-profit, association-run organization (contact: Vasavägen 82, 181 41 Lidingö; phone 08-7652615; e-mail info@lidingoloppet.se). Early Bird discount (20%) has already been deducted in the prices marked with *. Plan your experience: bib, partners and exhibitors are on site. Environmentally friendly travel options: free bus from Ropsten to Lidingövallen, runner buses from several towns across central Sweden, bicycle parking and carpooling. Limited access and few parking spaces during the competition. Seeding race ahead of the weekend: Vårmilen can be purchased as a seeding race (price 100 - 200 kr).

name: TCS Lidingöloppet
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country running event and a festival held on the last weekend in September on Lidingö. Since 1965, runners of all levels gather—from children’s 1.7 km to the classic 30 km race—to challenge hilly, scenic courses. The weekend features several races, a sport fair where you pick up your bib and find running inspiration, and a strong focus on nature and the running experience. We look forward to welcoming participants, volunteers and spectators to Lidingöloppet weekend.
course_highlights: Hilly, soft tracks through forest and terrain (30 km: 522 m elevation gain, 15 km: 250 m elevation gain)
A mix of flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping trails and steep uphill sections
Start in Koltorp and finish at Grönsta Gärde (15 km); classic 30 km course with varied terrain
additional: The sport fair is the place for bib pickup and exhibitors. Bronze medals are awarded to all finishers (annually featuring a unique Carl Milles motif) and silver medals can be exchanged if you have achieved silver-time standards in the correct starting group. Diplomas are available as a free PDF in the results email; paper diplomas can be ordered atregistration for 50 kr including shipping. Minimum ages are stated per race (e.g., 30 km: 17 years, 15 km: 15 years). Enervit offers fueling service/energy depots along the course. A veterans' club and annual awards are offered for recurring participants. Historical results and statistics are available in the Lidingöloppet archive (from 1965), and in 2024 a new team competition format was introduced where teams consist of several runners for each distance.

name: Östgöta Ultra Trail
description: At Östgöta Ultra Trail, the mind is stimulated as the body works, and we have chosen the areas west of Kisa for their beautiful views, trails, and lakes to enhance this. On the way to the finish you will have to go over logs and stones, meet friendly volunteers, and take a boat. When you reach the finish, you will receive food, drinks, and a medal, along with time to chat and hang out with other runners.

name: Frontyard Sölvesborg
description: A Frontyard typically runs on a lap course where time and distance can vary depending on what the organizer decides. Our course is 2.6 km long, with 26 minutes for the first lap; the second lap and the same distance have everyone 25 minutes; the third lap 24 minutes, the fourth lap 23 minutes, and so on. An exciting race and challenge where the aim is to conserve both energy and speed until it really counts. The race is decided when two participants start at the same time and the one who crosses the finish line first wins. How many laps will there be? How many laps do you do?

images.alt_text: Tremedalj med texten Sölvesborgs Frontyard 2024 och romerska siffror.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)
description: Rosa Bandet-loppet is a part of the TCS Lidingöloppet weekend on Lidingö and offers 4 km or 10 km running for Cancerfonden. The start takes place according to Grönsta and Koltorp start times and the courses are soft and scenic. From 2025 there is a new class for ages 9–15 in the 4 km (FP-9-15). 100 kronor of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden, and the option Rosa Bandet-loppet@Hemma exists as a home broadcast. Rosa Bandet-loppet is included in the Lidingöloppet weekend and is part of the Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km on soft courses through Lidingö's scenic terrain
100 kronor of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden
New 4 km FP-9-15 class from 2025 for younger runners
additional: The minimum age for Lilla Lidingöloppet is 7–15 years. Start times are presented with the Grönsta and Koltorp start groups, and rules for warm-up and start corrals are followed closely. 100 kronor of the entry fee goes to Cancerfonden, and Rosa Bandet-loppet is included in the Lidingöloppet weekend and in the Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.

name: TCS Lidingörullet & TCS Lidingöruset, TCS Lidingöfemman
Ekerumsloppet
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, an autumnal cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organized by Högby IF friidrott. The race offers 10 km for adults and about 1.3 km for youths, with starts at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively, and start and finish at Ekerum Resort. Registration closes on 26 September 2026; late registration takes place at bib pickup from 09:00 on race day. The race runs on forest trails in wooded terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Forest trails through wooded terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and about 1.3 km for youths
additional: Cross-country race in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline 26 September 2026; Late registration at bib pickup from 09:00 on race day

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a running event in Tidaholm, Sweden, organized by Motionsloppet. The official information and results are published on motionsloppet.se. The event is promoted via Motionsloppet's Facebook page and advertised as Tidaholm Marathon by the municipality's events page, which indicates that it is a recurring race in the area.
additional: Results are available on motionsloppet.se; the event has been communicated via the municipality's Facebook events page (Tidaholm Marathon).

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 295 kr jubileumspris max 100 platser eller till och med 31 mars

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a family-friendly trail race in the Rya Åsar nature reserve in Borås with several distances for both competitive runners and recreational runners. The race features pleasant trails, challenging climbs, and beautiful views over lakes and cliffs. The event is a festival at the start and finish area with music, exhibitors and a runners lounge. The event has been organized since 2017 and offers both a children's race and sanctioned competitions.
course_highlights: Nice trails and challenging climbs (including Djävulsbacken/Björbotoppen)
Beautiful views with sections by Rya Klint and Fjällsjön; the 24 km course has ~685 m of elevation gain
Varied surfaces: technical trails, gravel roads and the final downhill stretch
additional: Number bib distribution is offered Friday 13:30–18:00 at Glasögonmäster and Saturday 09:45–12:45 at the competition area. Chip timing via Eq Timing; leave bags at the start/finish area. Parking options are at Almenäsvägen, Ryda Sportfält and Knalleland; good bus connections to nearby stops. Runners Lounge and food/coffee on site; changing rooms and showers are available at Borås Camping. Hydration stations: 24 km has 4 depots, 12 km has 2 depots (sport drinks from Umara). Recommended equipment: mobile phone, elastic bandage and trail shoes (especially for 24 km). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; TrailTour participation; Start time 13:00; the 2025 race was moved to October 5 due to a weather warning; Contact and registration via info@ryaasartrailrun.se; Results published on the race's results page.

name: Malmö Marathon
description: A flat and fast course in beautiful Malmö
course_highlights: Joint finish at Ribersborg
Very flat courses (marathon ~28 m of elevation gain, half marathon ~19 m)
The marathon course includes a 7.5 km loop around Ribersborg and runs via Limhamn, Ön and First Camp Sibbarp
additional:
See the website and FAQ 
https://malmomarathon.com/qa/

images.alt_text: Lyckligt par kramas vid mållinjen på Malmö Marathon med Puma-logotyp.
Löpare samlade vid startlinjen för Malmö Marathon.
Löpare korsar mållinjen i Malmö Marathon med armarna utsträckta, publiken hejar på.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: The John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, hilly cross-country race organized from the IKHP cabin on Huskvarna Mountain. The race is offered in several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, as well as several children and youth classes) and runs partly on trails and partly off-trail with substantial elevation gain and technical sections. A special feature is Strutsabacken (the Slalom Slope), where uphill time is measured and Bergatrollet is awarded for the fastest uphill passage. The event is family-friendly with refreshments and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing facilities and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain sections with both on-trail and off-trail surfaces
Strutsabacken (the Slalom Slope) with a separate uphill time and Bergatrollet awarded
View of Lake Vättern and technical downhill running through Ulvadalen
additional: Late registration can be done on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Bib numbers with timing chip are collected at the IKHP cabin no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly throughout the race; the chip does not need to be returned. There are water stations placed along the course (kilometer-marked per distance), changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin, locked valuables storage at bib distribution, and refreshments at start/finish. The organizers offer participants a 'troll menu' after finishing (show your bib). After the race a hamburger is served; water stations along the course; changing rooms and showers; Startklar insurance is available (175 SEK/year); max 500 participants; bib number must be collected no later than 11:00 at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a refreshed, familiar course layout, with start and finish in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organized by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances that appeal to a wide audience — 5 km and 10 km are offered. The event is marketed as one of Sweden's most beautiful recreational races and welcomes recreational runners of all levels to participate on October 3.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadsparken in central Motala.
A refreshed, familiar course layout through central Motala.
Short distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for recreational runners.
additional: Organizer: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as Sweden's most beautiful recreational race. The site urges to mark October 3 in the calendar and notes price levels through 28/9 (next price increase). Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth) and 400 m (toddlers' race). Bib numbers can be picked up at Team Sportia October 2-3. The prize ceremony takes place in Stadsparken around 14:30.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: Förbifartspremiären is a one-off event where you get to run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through tunnel tubes, before the road opens to traffic. The race will be held on October 3, 2026, with start and finish at the new trafikplats Akalla (Vandagatan), and it suits both beginners and experienced runners. It offers a competitive class (approximately 12 km), a recreational class (choose approximately 4, 7 or 12 km), and a walking class (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is promoted as a unique one-in-a-lifetime experience to be among the first to tread the new road.
course_highlights: The course runs both above ground and through tunnel tubes on the new E4.
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange (Vandagatan).
The recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km, so you choose the distance during the race.
additional: Registration opens February 5 at 12:00. The competition's maximum time is 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive class starts at about 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walking) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, telephone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday–Thursday 09:00–15:00 (lunch 12:00–13:00). Payment for private individuals via card, Klarna invoice or Swish; corporate invoicing is offered only for groups of 20+ via a dedicated contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens February 5 at 12:00; the first stage Hjulsta – Häggvik is planned to open by the end of 2026; the entire Förbifart Stockholm is expected to be completed in 2030; start spots are sold through Marathongruppen; the race offers bib number, timing, finish-line services and a medal; approximately 10,000 start spots were sold in the first hour.

name: Hostruset

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700 m Barn 3-7 år 50 kr (80 kr efteranmälan)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 60+ och Motion 150 kr (250 kr efteranmälan)

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race in Örebro with start and finish at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. There is also a 700 m children’s race for ages 3–7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated ahead of the 2026 edition.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers available)
Course officially measured (measured 2024-09-08); timing with an ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from September 29 (increased fee) can be made via the registration system and on competition day (Swish only). Bib numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done with a transponder on the ankle that must be returned (lost transponder charged 400 kr). Very limited parking at the school; it is recommended to carpool or park at Karlslunds motionscentral. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration increases the fee and Swish is used on competition day. Registration is via anmalmig.nu; results are displayed online via Hug Timing.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
description: FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to Vånga Mountain Xtreme on October 4, 2026. Choose between 8, 16, or 40 km trail running with elevation gains of 300, 600, and 1500 meters respectively; the course features a steep Vångabacke, winding trails through wilderness, and views of lakes and quarries. The race is promoted as both beautiful and highly challenging and leaves a lasting impression. For the youngest, there is VMX Kids with free registration on-site.
course_highlights: Steep classic Vångabacke—a short but powerful ascent
Winding trails through wilderness, past small tarns and deep quarries
Total elevations: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1500 m (40 km)
additional: Online registration via the website is open until Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 23:59. Late registration can be made at the arena, subject to availability, up to about one hour before the start; on-site payment is by Swish. Registration is binding and refunds of the start fee are only available through valid insurance (for example Startklar). The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association (Svenska Friidrottsförbundet). Organizer: FK Göingarna. VMX Kids: free on-site registration. Maximum number of participants: 800; online registration open until 2026-09-30 at 23:59; start times: VMX Kids starts at 12:15; maximum times: 3 hours (16 km) and 7 hours (40 km); Startklar insurance recommended; VMX Kids free on-site registration; the race is sanctioned by Svenska Friidrottsförbundet.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Skrylle naturreservat, Södra Sandby, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-oriented race organized by Björnstorps IF with start/finish at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organizers are offering a new, more trail-focused loop course where you can choose to run one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is marketed as a nature-focused and challenging experience on the area’s best trails, and information is updated regularly during the spring. Early bird entry is offered, and there is also a 600 m children's race.
course_highlights: Loop course starting from Skryllegården
More trail-focused; the course uses the area's best trails
Time limit for the 25 km: must pass the 12.5 km mark no later than 12:15 (based on a 10:30 start)
additional: Online registration is possible up to 60 minutes before the start, and on-site registration is also available. On race day, name or class changes can be made for an administrative fee of 100 kr (class change 12.5->56 km 200 kr). On-site you can only pay with Swish. The 600 m children's race is free, awards a medal, and cannot be pre-registered; bib numbers for the children's race can be picked up in connection with registration on the morning of the competition. Parking at Skryllegården will be tight – the organizers encourage carpooling or cycling. New course with trail elements; first start for the 12.5 km is 11:00 and for the 25 km is 10:30. The 25 km has a time limit for completing the loop at 12:15. Register online up to 60 minutes before the start; on-site or class changes are allowed for a fee. On race day you can also register on-site and pay via Swish. Bib-number distribution at Löplabbet in Lund before the race and at Skryllegården on race day. There is bag drop-off, and the 600 m children's race is free.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is organized by Ryssbergets IK and offers several races on the same competition day: 10.0 km, 5.0 km, children's race 2.0 km, and a Walk - Slow Jog - Run option. Registration is via the club's registration page and bib numbers for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. The club encourages participants to review the class divisions and the information for volunteers in advance. The organizer continuously communicates practical information via its website and the contact email.
course_highlights: Course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km (course maps published on the website)
Children's race 2.0 km and Walk - Slow Jog - Run as an alternative
Age/class divisions (see the divisions on the website)
additional: Course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. There is a volunteer sign-up – the organizer requests volunteers and a volunteer's involvement affects the handling of start fees (see the volunteer sign-up). Contact details and postal address: Ryssbergets IK, Kyrkvägen 1, 29535 Bromölla; tel. 0705876711; e-mail info@ryssbergetsik.se. Results published after the competition.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity run that aims to raise awareness of how important physical activity is for mental health. The run is organized by the association Mental Health Run, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. On site in Stockholm, the start and finish are at Sjöhistoriska museet, and the course is a gently runnable 5 km loop around Djurgårdbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to participate regardless of background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual variant.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sjöhistoriska museet on Djurgården
A gentle 5 km loop around Djurgårdbrunnsviken
Course on Djurgården with sea views and urban surroundings
additional: There is a virtual variant of the race (listed as October 10–18, 2026) and the event offers a medal as an add-on at registration as well as the option to donate. Add-ons and medals are shipped within a month after the virtual race has ended. Information about bib numbers and collection is published on the news pages (in previous years bibs could be picked up at Filmstaden Sergel).
