Medal as an add-on and the option to donate to psychiatric research; the medal is shipped within a month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app during the period October 10–18 with a special code and results are shown in the finish area. Timing is done with Racetimer; bag drop-off, accessible toilets and refreshments are available; Nordic walking with poles is allowed and dogs may start further back.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a city race in Örebro that showcases the city's best sides along the Svartån. On 10 October 2026, the distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and an Ullmax KidsRun for children are offered. The race is organized by KFUM Örebro Friidrott with start and services at Tybblelundshallen; information is continuously updated on the organizer's Facebook page. The competition courses are officially measured and the event is conducted according to the rules of the Swedish Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Runs along the beautiful Svartån
Passes the scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses are officially measured (measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Bib numbers are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (ID not required and you can pick up for others). Timing is done with transponders attached to the foot/ankle and must be returned at finish or if the race is stopped; a lost transponder is charged 400 kr. Some participants receive a one-time chip on the bib that does not need to be returned. Changing and valuables drop-off at Tybblelundshallen. Hydration stations, toilets and medical care are available along the course; water and sports drinks are available at 10 km and 21.1 km as well as at the finish. Parents may run with their child in the KidsRun at no cost. The half marathon requires turning 17 years old within the year; 5 and 10 km have no age limit. Registration is via anmalmig.nu; transponder-based timing and bib pickup in Tybblelundshallen; hydration stations along the course; age limit of 17 years for the half marathon; 5 km and 10 km have no age limit.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a classic race that, in 2026, will be run for the 52nd time and offers a marathon and half-marathon with start and finish inside the venerable Slottsskogsvallen. The course was officially measured in 2024 and is a flat, straight loop course that follows the cycle path on the old railway embankment along the coast with a turnaround point at Lilla Amundön. Half-marathon runners run one lap and marathon runners two laps, which provides good opportunities for fast times. The event is organized by Solvikingarna with the competition center at Friidrottens hus.
course_highlights: Flat and straight loop course along the old railway embankment by the coast with a turnaround point at Lilla Amundön
Half marathon = 1 lap, marathon = 2 laps; each kilometer is signposted
Hydration stations every four kilometers offering water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, banana and raisins
additional: The competition center is Friidrottens hus (bib numbers and on-site registration). Start groups: 10:00 Marathon; 10:30 Half marathon (estimated time under 1:45); 10:45 Half marathon (estimated time over 1:45). Hydration stations are located at approximately 4.2 km, 8.4 km, 12.6 km and 16.8 km and offer water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, banana and raisins. After finishing, all participants receive a drink, a banana, coffee/tea and a sandwich. There is an option to have your own fluids/energy transported to the hydration stations. Last registration day is race day 2026-10-10 at 09:00 if the race is not full; it is possible to transfer or sell a start entry via MittLopp up to 2026-10-07 for a fee of 100 SEK. Distance changes can be made up to and including 2026-10-07 or on race day up to one hour before start (possible difference in fee). The minimum age for participation is 17 years during the year. Distances: marathon and half marathon. In 2025 there were over 500 starters (514 participants, 354 finishers) according to the results page. The race is held in October. Start and finish for Diabetes Wellness Göteborg Marathon 2025 were at Slottsskogsvallen.

name: Ultunamilen
description: Ultunamilen is a recreational race in Uppsala that offers the distances of 5 km and 10 km. According to the results list published for the race on 10 October 2026, the men's events are shown in the mentioned distances. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, where registration is handled via SportAdmin. The date of the mentioned edition is 2026-10-10 and results are published in connection with the competition.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Results published (men's events) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows 2026-10-10 as the date and the distances of 5 km and 10 km. Note that external pages (such as the Stockholm update) require login for full information.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half-marathon race organized by Jalles TC Umeå together with IFK Umeå, with start and finish at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) largely follows the Ume River via the island on both sides, and features a partly new, faster section; the course has been measured by SFIF's course measurer and every kilometer is signposted. There are refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water about every four kilometers, chip timing, and shower facilities at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both the 42 km and 21 km, and the 42 km race is run concurrently with the Northern Norrland Championship for seniors and veterans.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Ume River via the island on both sides.
Partially new, faster route; the course has been measured by SFIF's course measurer.
Every kilometer is signposted; refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water about every 4 km.
additional: Timing is by chip (the chip is to be returned at the finish); bib numbers and chips can be collected at Tegs Centralskola no later than 45 minutes before the start. Late registration can be done at the start area via Swish or cash. Showers are available in Jubileumshallen (basement level) for men and women. Prize ceremony: 21 km immediately after finish; 42 km at approximately 16:20 in the auditorium. The entry fee includes a participant medal, an Umara energy bar, coffee and sandwich; Team Sportia Ersboda will raffle a bicycle among those completing the 42 km who are present at the prize giving. Start times (per the 2025 invitation): 42 km at 11:00; 21 km at 11:30. Fees: Half marathon 300 SEK (late registration 400 SEK); Full marathon 500 SEK (late registration 600 SEK). Water every four kilometers, changing facilities and showers in Jubileumshallen. Registration via raceid.com; chip timing and medals included; after the race coffee and sandwich and raffles.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund, Tanum Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a coastal trail race of 22 km that runs from Havstenssund to TanumStrand. The race is the final in the Outnorth Trailtour and is expected to attract the Swedish trailrunning elite for decisive showdowns. The course profile is hilly and offers cliffs, winding paths and expansive sea views along Bohuslän's characteristic coastal landscape. The organizer's text also suggests accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand to complete the weekend.
course_highlights: 22 km trail running along the coast from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Cliffs, piers and coastal views with the scent of seaweed
Winding trails through fishing villages and varied terrain (mountains, forest, sea)
additional: Final in the Outnorth Trailtour; part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia; recommended accommodation and banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort; newsletter offers from partners (including 20% discount on Asics trail shoes via Outnorth). Start in Havstenssund, bus to the start from TanumStrand; orange course marking; some parts narrow/tricky and water conditions at high tide; no shoes with metal studs allowed; bag drop costs 30 SEK; name change for a fee of 200 SEK; dogs not allowed; toilets and shower/change facilities at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården - a fun and challenging cross-country race where the fighting spirit often matters more than a perfect running stride. The course features forest trails, muddy sections, wet parts and technical elements; choose between 5 or 10 km as an adult. For children there are Kalvruset (about 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (about 700 m). The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården features forest trails, muddy passages and wet sections
Choice between 5 km and 10 km for adults; Kalvruset about 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset about 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers in tents are a few minutes' walk from the finish as well as simpler rinse facilities directly after crossing the finish line. There are clothing drop-off stations for clothes that may not be allowed to take home. Kalvruset has a medical first-aid team on site and all children receive a medal with the year. The organizer is Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; proceeds go back to the sport. Group registration for companies; corporate tents and gathering area; proceeds go back to the sport.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
description: Running Lights is an evening race held during the Lights in Alingsås festival and offers a magical, illuminated city environment. The event offers distances for all ages—from Maxi-Knatte and Youth Run to 5 km, 10 km, and a relay 3×1660 m. Start and finish are at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan), and the courses pass through beautifully lit surroundings in central Alingsås. Running Lights is family-friendly and part of the West Swedish Running Cup.
course_highlights: Courses through illuminated urban environments during Lights in Alingsås
Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Distances: Maxi-Knatte 300 m, Energiloppet 600 m, Youth Run 1660 m, Relay 3×1660 m, 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps)
additional: Start times: Maxi-Knatte 16:00, Energiloppet 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 16:45, Stafetten 17:05, 5 km 18:00, 10 km 19:00. Start & finish at Stora torget (Kungsgatan). 5 km is one lap; 10 km is two laps. The races are part of the West Swedish Running Cup. Part of the West Swedish Running Cup; Registration and bib pickup October 9–10; Runner Expo free admission; After Run starts at 19:00 with discount code 'runninglights' for 15% off.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, October 11, 2026 — a fast and well-organized 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby in northwestern Stockholm. The race is flat, measured exactly to 10,000 m, and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and youth. The page contains all information about the course, start, registration and practical information for runners.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on an all-weather track
Two hydration stations along the course
additional: Competition centre is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100), the start takes place on a meadow 400 m from the sports field and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometer away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 years (born 2012 or earlier); children 5–13 years can participate in Lilla Hässelbyloppet. Maximum allowed time is 2 hours. The race is measured by a certified course measurer and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; the event is broadcast live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour and there are pacers (approximately 37:30–60 min). A live stream of the event is offered according to information from the organizer.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nocturnal trail race focusing on the experience and the magic of darkness. Dog Trail is a special class where you get to share the evening with your dog on 5 km or 10 km, and the courses are designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark - the courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is mandatory. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Courses with reflective markers
Flexible start times 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for runners with dogs: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Flexible start times between 18:00 and 19:30 (10 km may start until 19:00). The courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run together with their dog (5 and 10 km).

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka that invites runners of all ages and abilities. The races run through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills on pleasant running trails and roads, offering short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. For the smallest, there is a relatively flat course and the event is arranged as a pleasant day with music, catering and prize presentations. It is promoted as a local and friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling opportunities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills
Lovely running trails and parts on roads - mixed terrain
Three-stage format: 400 m (MICA race), 1,400 m and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; bus from Slussen listed as a transport option. There is plenty of parking and bike parking at the start area. Prize presentations occur continuously and the refreshments will be open. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and a place to park bicycles at the start area; refreshments open.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race runs eight laps around Växjösjön on what the organizers call 'Sweden's fastest course'. The course is very flat (elevation change about 3 m) and mostly paved with about 300 meters of fine gravel; the loop was measured in August 2024. A relay and a children's race are also offered, and the course is marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Very flat course, elevation change about 3 m
Mostly asphalt with ~300 m fine gravel; marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed to traffic, meaning runners share sidewalks and bike paths with pedestrians and cyclists; motor traffic occurs at three locations along the course. The loop was measured in August 2024. There is an option to participate in the relay as a team, and the event also includes a children's race for 2026. The relay consists of four runners who each run two laps; the course is open to pedestrians and cyclists and may share the space with them as well as with motor traffic at three locations.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race in the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organized by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers the distances 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children's race of about 350 m with a medal and no timing. The courses are moderately hilly and consist of a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain and sand running along the coast – participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners and also features team competitions and a maximum cap of 1000 participants.
course_highlights: Moderately hilly terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging climbs, and sand running along the coast
17 km: approx. 60% trail, 25% rough terrain, 15% beach; elevation gain about 310 m
Arena at Strandridaregården, only about 100 meters from the sea
additional: Participant cap: max 1000 participants. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children's race individually 13:00-15:00. Bib number pickup from 10:45 (collect no later than one hour before your start). Cut-off time: the finish closes 2 hours 50 minutes after the 17 km start (3:30 PM) – the last 6 km lap must be started no later than 60 minutes before the finish closes. Arena: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and may only take place according to officials' instructions (tips for carpooling via the race's Facebook group). Secure valuables storage is offered for a fee (20 SEK, cash or Swish). Children's race with medal and free entry; online registration closes on the Wednesday before the race; late registration can be done at the start and finish area; bib pickup no later than 10:45; parking is limited near the arena; water at all stations; electronic timing and you can follow times online.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is a city and nature marathon that travels through historic Uppsala with start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The race combines urban energy in central Uppsala with scenic views along Ekoln, the Fyrisån, and the mounds in Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, and a four-person relay, and also serves as the district championship (DM) in marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and targets both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and central pedestrian streets
The course runs along the shores of Ekoln and the Fyrisån and out to the mounds in Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast, single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half compacted gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib collection 1-16 October at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4-6) and on race day 17 October from 07:30 (latest 45 minutes before start). Registration is accepted via RaceID and Epassi can be used as payment. Maximum entrants: Marathon 1500, Half Marathon 2500, Marathon Relay 150 teams. Anyone registering no later than 15 September 2026 will have their name on the bib. Age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon (born 2009 or earlier). Prize giving at the finish area at 13:00. At the finish area, food and non-alcoholic drinks are provided; relay teams receive a finisher shirt and medal. Recommendation to use public transport or bicycle (bus stops Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus; buses 2 and 7); parking is available within walking distance. DM medals in Marathon and Half Marathon; medal ceremony on the Tuesday after the race; age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon; epassi payment, transfer via RaceID, start times, transport and parking, bag drop, changing/shower facilities, insurance and prizes; registration opens until 12 October 2026 with the possibility to close earlier if the maximum cap has been reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a friendly race in central Jönköping that suits both elite runners and recreational runners. The races, which start at Lillsjöplan, take place on a completely flat and measured course, making them suitable for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) are offered, and the organizers emphasize a good atmosphere with pacers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Team registration provides 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and there are options for group registrations for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap, 10 km = 2 laps
The course is measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and eligible for seeding
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. 5K is run in one lap, 10K in two laps. Pace runners with flags for 40, 45 and 50 minutes on 10K. Register up to 5 runners at a time via regular registration; for more runners there is group registration. Team registration (three people) gives 10% discount and the possibility to win prizes. Start documents will not be mailed. The course and course profile are presented on the map/course-profile page. Date and start time: 17 October 2026, start at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K one lap, 10K two laps; hydration stations with UMARA sports drink and water; bag drop at start/finish; proximity to a parking garage; start list and pacer information; limited bag drop and on-site collection of start documents.

name: XC-race Linköping

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kostar 250 kr fram till och med den 11:e oktober.

description: XC race is an annual cross-country running event in Linköping organized by Linköpings OK. The race offers a marked 5 km loop on varying terrain—from trail to marsh—and appeals to both recreational runners and competitive classes. There are classes for Men 10 km, Women 10 km and Motion 5 km, where the 10 km races run two laps. Start and finish are at Vidingsjö motionscentrum, and the organizer welcomes everyone.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: from trail to marshland
5 km marked loop; the 10 km classes run two laps
Start and finish at Vidingsjö motionscentrum; muddy and challenging terrain
additional: Bib numbers can be collected on competition day from 10:00 at the arena and must be worn visibly on the chest for correct timing. Changing rooms are in LOK-gården; parking is available at both Vidingsjö motionscentrum and LOK-gården. Registration via a link with card payment is possible up to competition day; late registration and payment on-site is done with Swish. Arena at Vidingsjö motionscentrum. Changing in LOK-gården. Parking at Vidingsjö motionscentrum and LOK-gården. Bib numbers collected on competition day from 10:00. Start and finish at the arena. Start at 11:00. Distances: 5 km (marked) and 10 km (two laps).

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail runs focused on the experience of how light and darkness meet. You can choose 5 km, 10 km, or 30 km with start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km you navigate with a downloadable GPS route and map, and the race has energy stations along the route. Welcome to register - all proceeds go to youth sports at the Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Night trail run in the glow of a headlamp, with a course marked by reflective markers
A 30 km run with GPS route and map, with two energy stations
The last part of the 30 km follows the same reflective-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: Flexible start times are available for the 5 km and 10 km within the stated windows (18:00-19:30 for 5 km; 18:00-19:00 for 10 km). For the 30 km you receive the GPS route and map in advance; the race has two energy stations and a maximum time of 4 hours 30 minutes; the last part follows the reflective-marked course. Start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna; the organizer wishes participants to finish by 20:30 and registration is open until one hour before each start. Start 16:00 for the 30 km on October 17, 2026. For 5 km, flexible start applies between 18:00-19:30 and for 10 km between 18:00-19:00; the course follows the reflective-marked course to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, organized on October 17, 2026. The race is a little over 3–3.5 km long with a steep ascent and over 200 meters of elevation, and it is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to challenge themselves. The finish takes place at the top of the hill with a nice view over the city. The Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta children's races are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approximately 3–3.5 km with over 200 meters of elevation gain
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbyhöjden; finish at the top with a view over the city
Intense uphill focus (finish-line services, hydration checks along the course)
additional: Start documents are sent by e-mail (usually about 2 weeks before the race or sooner for late registration). Bib pickup is at the event area Hammarby Fabriksväg (bib pickup is indicated in the information text) and opens from 09:30 according to the participant information. The bib contains a chip and must be worn angled at 45–90°; fasten with safety pins (bring about 4) and write name/phone number and medical information on the back. The race includes timing, a medal, and hydration checks; in the children's races there is a beverage at the finish and a medal. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free uphill training sessions in Hammarbybacken before race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6,706 meters, and the format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00 and a new start every full hour up to a total of 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under one hour to start the next lap; the one who completes the most laps (and is fastest on the last lap) wins in the women's and men's classes. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to test endurance on a technical but easy-to-run loop in the scenic Garnudden. A smaller MiniBackyard is offered for children/beginners with on-site registration and its own start time in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A lap length of 6,706 m with start/finish at Bubblan in Toredal
Surface about 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly seaside promenade around Garnudden
Several longer climbs and a final downhill run plus a flat asphalt section toward the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens March 1, 2026. Rönninge 6h (June 6, 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, registration on-site. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellation is via info@lopklubb.se no later than October 1 with an administrative cost of 45 kr. For the race, hourly starts apply: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00 etc.; last start at 20:00. Laps are registered with a chip (in the 6h race). Coffee/tea is served at 20:00 on the last lap. The race: 6,706 m per lap; up to 12 laps in twelve hours; first start at 09:00, last start at 20:00; surface approx. 80% asphalt/gravel; women's and men's categories. Mini Backyard is organized by KIF Toredal and costs 50 kr on-site.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Halvmarathon is a fast and easy-to-run half marathon in a scenic natural setting with start and finish at Näsby Slott. The course offers coastal views along the Värtan shoreline, a scenic loop around Rönningesjön, and finishing back at the sea with views toward Bogesundslandet. The race is officially measured and organized by Täby IS Friidrott, and is suitable for runners who want to finish the season on a fast and beautiful course. In recent years the race has been very popular with limited spaces, so the organizers encourage early registration.
course_highlights: First ~5 km along the Värtan shoreline with sea views
Scenic loop around Rönningesjön past Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlötens friluftsgård
Approximately 125 meters of elevation; about two-thirds asphalt and one-third gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Slott. Lilla TäbyMaran for children 5 - 11 years (1,2 km) with start times at 10:00 (born 2017 - 2020) and 10:15 (born 2014 - 2016). Sports drink from partner Umara is served at the water stations. The maximum time for the half marathon is 2 hours 45 minutes. Bib collection: Stadium in Täby Centrum from the Wednesday before the race, as well as pickup at the start area 09:00 - 10:45 on race day. The course has about 125 meters of elevation and consists of roughly 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel; water stations along the course with Umara; previously there were about 1500 spots.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen - perhaps this autumn's fastest certified mile race at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs 100% on cycling and pedestrian paths and is fully paved, making the race very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizers donate a sum to Barncancerfonden for each registered runner; prizes are awarded to the top 3 in the women's and men's divisions and there will also be a drawing of about 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Certified measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Association)
100% asphalt on cycling and pedestrian paths - a very fast course
Hydration stations at 5 km and at the finish
additional: There are changing rooms on site, but the organizers recommend that participants arrive already dressed. On-site registration on race day is possible if there are still available spots. The organizers do not award medals and instead donate a sum to Barncancerfonden per registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in the women's and men's categories, and there is also a draw of about 20 prizes. Names and photos from the race day may be published on the club's website and social media. Contact: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Last registration day: October 15. On-site late registration if there is space; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medal will be awarded this year; about 20 prizes drawn among all participants; contact information is provided in the text on the event page.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-centre course that largely follows sidewalks and bike paths through several of Skövde's residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are intended as easy-to-run courses in an urban environment suitable for both recreational runners and competitive runners. There are three distances (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km) with a common start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.
course_highlights: New route largely follows sidewalks and bike paths through residential areas
Passes the ruins of Södra Ryd Church, Vadsboleden, Aspö, Havstena and Billingen/Dälderna
Start and finish at the small parking area by the tennis hall at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde
additional: All distances start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde (the small parking area by the tennis hall). The secretariat can accept late entries, subject to availability, up to 30 minutes before the start; registrations can be accepted from 08:30 on race day. Parking is available at Billingehov's large parking lot. Valuables can be left at the bib-number distribution area and retrieved upon presenting the bib. Terrain: city-centre course on sidewalks and bike paths. Start/finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde. Distances: 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. Parking at Billingehov's large parking lot. GPX files available. Information about the courses may change.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a downhill race held in Norrköping's own slalom slope. The race is described as challenging - in 2024 five tough laps in the slope were completed - and it targets both competitive runners and families through a separate children's race. E2C is the title partner and the event combines competition, children's activities and subsequent prize and photo ceremonies.
course_highlights: Runs in Norrköping's slalom slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024 consisted of five challenging laps in the slope
The children's race 'Lilla Yxbackenloppet' was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19 and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. The 2024 children's race had about 50 participating children who received medals at the finish; the winners received a wreath at the prize ceremony. Photographer Magnus Media took photos that were posted on the race's Facebook page. About 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023 the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children's race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was introduced in 2024.

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne's largest cross-country races, organized by Heleneholms IF in the autumnal Bokskogen in Torup. The race starts from Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course consists of forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience autumn nature. All practical information and the invitation are available on the race's information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn landscape and trails - traditionally the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, classes, registration fees, course description, PM, start list and practical information are available in the left tabs on the race page. Contact for the race: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF's office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two course lengths (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; a course map is available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Kilterrängen
description: Do you prefer trail running over asphalt? Whether you are a curious beginner, a cheerful recreational runner, or an elite runner, Kilterrängen is for you. In autumnal Kil, the 16 km or 6 km long trail race will be decided, with some tough final kilometers filled with hills, including the notorious slalom hill.
course_highlights: 16 km and 6 km trail runs with a shared final section
Technical trail running (Öhmansmilen) with the course's highest point after ~6 km
Last 2 km on a fast, well-lit trail with the final slalom hill
additional: Arena: Frykstastugan in connection with Frykstahöjden; parking at Frykstastugan. The course is permanently marked with red-and-white markings, signs and kilometer signs; follow the instructions of the marshals at road crossings. The first 2 km are easy running downhill, after that technical trail (Öhmansmilen); after ~10 km the course becomes easy running again and sandy sections. The 6 km course consists of the first kilometre plus the last ~5 km of the 16 km course. Please note that it will be winter conditions on race day; trail shoes are recommended. Registration is done via the form under 'anmälan' and is valid only when payment has been made; late registration is possible on-site on race day. The terrain is often wet and soft; trail shoes recommended. Timing with Emit-chip. All runners receive a medal. After finishing there is soup, home-baked bread, as well as showers and a sauna in Frykstastugan; bib number pickup at the secretariat 9:30 - 10:30. Registration is done via the form on the information page and payment is mentioned in the registration instructions.

images.alt_text: Deltagare i terrängloppet Kilterrängen löper längs en sjö under hösten.
Löpare i terränglopp med sjö och höstlöv i bakgrunden.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a recurring running event that in 2026 marks its 50th year and is held on Sunday, October 25, 2026. The event page shows that the race has offered several distances (according to a previous registration form 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km) and that the organizers publish the invitation, PM, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course's scenic character and a challenging 14 km profile. More information and details about the course and the course profile are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Beautiful course layout (linked on the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Multiple distances - 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th year in 2026. The website contains links to a map and course profile as well as previous years' PM, invitation, start lists and provisional results. Earlier registration forms (2020) showed options for distance and which day one plans to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Contents: invitation, PM, start lists, track map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race is traditionally held during the last weekend of October and marks its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Set along the rocky shores of Sweden's Kullaberg, Kullamannen by UTMB® offers trail courses that range from a fast 20 km to a challenging 100-mile test of endurance. Runners traverse rocky headlands, beech and pine forests, and coastal paths with dramatic ocean views, making it an adventure-focused event for trail runners of varying ambitions. The event weekend combines technical coastal terrain, well-supported aid stations and organised race services to welcome both international and local participants.
course_highlights: Rocky coastal trails and cliffs along Kullaberg with ocean views
Runs through beechwood and pine forest singletrack and compact dirt trails
North Shore 20K features narrow beachside paths and a night start (headlamp required)
additional: Minimum ages: North Shore open to runners born 2010 or before. Registration sales windows: UTMB Index holders 18 - 20 Nov 2025 (exclusive), open to all from 20 Nov 2025 until 10 Oct 2026 or until sold out. Registration includes race bib, access to aid stations, baggage transport depending on distance, medical assistance and after-race services. Transfer to a shorter distance allowed until 3 weeks before the event (deadline: 2026-10-10). Bib distribution and expo in Båstad on the event weekend. Races range from 22 km to 100 miles; start in Höganäs, via Mölle and Kullaberg, finish in Båstad; November weather can be tough; DNF-rate 40-60% for 100-milers; Running Stone lottery and direct qualification to UTMB World Series finals.

name: Halloweenloppet
description: Trail run in the dark.
course_highlights: Halloween course: 5 km and 10 km (women/men)
Girls/Boys: 2.5 km
Miniskräckis: kids' / mini course
additional: Distance options according to the course layout page: women/men 10 km/5 km (Halloween course), girls/boys 2.5 km and Miniskräckis for the youngest. Organizer: Falkenbergs OK (contact address on the page: Christer Nelsén, Thomas Thorilds väg 6, 31140 Falkenberg). There is a separate page with registrants for 2025 ("Registered 2025"). Distance distribution: 2.5 km (youths), Miniskräckis for children, 5 km and 10 km; night run in the dark; part of Tour de Falkenberg.

images.alt_text: Belysta skyltar 5 km och 10 km vid mörkt terränglopp.
Deltagare springer på en stig i mörker med pannlampor på Halloweenloppet.
Deltagare med pannlampor springer en mörk skogsstig under Halloweenloppet.

name: Finalloppet Göteborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Parvelbanan, ca 250 m, anmälan endast på plats tävlingsdagen. 40 kr

description: Finalloppet is Western Sweden's largest cross-country race, organized by Göteborgs Skidklubb since 1968 and held at Skatås Motionscentrum in Göteborg. The event offers several distances (19 km, 10 km, 5.3 km, 2.3 km, 1.9 km, as well as Paraloppet and Parvelbanan) for both competitive and recreational runners. The courses alternate between technical trail sections and wider forest roads and are marked with clear arrows and kilometer markings. The organizers gather finish and services at the competition arena at Skatås and offer water stations, medical care, and a post-run patrol on all courses.
course_highlights: The 19 km route has an advanced trail section of about 2,500 meters.
The 10 km route contains a roughly 500-meter-long trail section that is often wet, muddy and rocky.
The courses are marked with orange arrows and colored kilometer markings; the lead groups are guided by a cyclist.
additional: Registration is handled via RaceID (payment by card, Swish or Google Pay and Mobilt BankID). One can register several people at the same time and buy gift cards via RaceID. The organizer offers the optional Startklar-försäkring, which refunds the registration fee in cases of illness/injury/pregnancy. The arena is located at Skatås Motionscentrum with finish and service tents, a medical tent at the finish, and medics at certain water stations (Ugglemossen and Svarttjärn). The after-patrol starts after the last start for each course and is responsible for runners remaining on the course. Donating 50 kronor to Jontefonden at registration; a GPX file is available for download for the 19 km course.

name: Höstmilen
description: Höstmilen is a trail running race in the Kolmård Forests near Åby, north of Norrköping, held on 1 November 2026. The course runs on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic and challenging terrain for both competitors and recreational runners. The organizer is OK Kolmården, and there are three main course options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, as well as courses for children and youths.
course_highlights: Trail running on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running in the scenic and undulating terrain of the Kolmård Forests
additional: Registration closes October 29 at 23:00 online; thereafter there is an opportunity to register on October 31 from 11:00–14:00 at XXL and at the start location on November 1. For the classic Höstmilen, there is a bus to the start from Jurslaskolan to Sörsjön. The Höstmilen PM with practical information is published about a week before the race. The competition classes have only two podium prize classes (Men and Women) for the adult races. A full list of entrants is published on the page 'Anmälda'. Distances and formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km and a children's race (1.4 or 2.0 km); team competition, corporate competition and school competition. The Höstmilen PM and registration are available via hostmilen.nu.

name: Energiruset
organizer: IF Göta Karlstad och Karlstads Energi
description: Energiruset is an evening run in Mariebergsskogen organized in collaboration between IF Göta and Karlstads Energi. The race takes place on Thursday, November 5, 2026, and is family-friendly with selectable distances of 2 km and 5 km. The 5 km includes a competitive class for those who want to measure their strength; the course is largely in a forest environment and some parts lack lighting. After finishing, the organizers treat all participants to sausages with bread.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mariebergsskogen (forest environment)
Parts of the course lack lighting – a headlamp is recommended
Distances of 2 km and 5 km; the 5 km includes a competitive class
additional: Date and place: Mariebergsskogen, Thursday, November 5, 2026. There is an option to purchase a headlamp in connection with registration. A PM with practical information (chip distribution and exact start times) will be published on the organizer's page, and previous PMs are available as a PDF: https://ifgota.se/files/PM_ER_2025.pdf. After the race, IF Göta and Karlstads Energi will treat participants to sausages with bread; for non-competitive participants the course is open during the evening and one can start within a specified time window. The distances are 2 km and 5 km; a headlamp is recommended and can be purchased at registration; some parts of the course lack lighting; start times preliminarily around 18:00; course open during the evening with the possibility to start between two times; after the race, participants are served sausages with bread.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF with distances from children's races up to the half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and the other races run on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö, and also serve as a seed race for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The race center and finish are located at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 Veteran-SM in the half marathon will be held in conjunction with the race. Welcome regardless of level — the race emphasizes running community and clear laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for the 10 km, 1 lap for the 5 km
Easy-to-run, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (as of September 25, 2021) and volunteers are along the course
additional: Start/finish and the race center are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Starts take place at different locations depending on distance; the half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children's race (500 m) at 12:45. The course's traffic rule is right-hand traffic and overtaking occurs on the left side — runners who are not maintaining a high pace are asked to stay to the right. In the relay, exchanges are made with a baton and the exchange area is located adjacent to the lap; there is no late registration for the Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration (for the other distances) is open on race day 08:00 - 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten at 10:30, 10 km at 10:40, 5 km at 10:45, 5 km youth class 12 – 16 years at 10:45, children's race at 12:45. Start locations vary depending on distance. No late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start/finish is at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course consists of a loop with water stations every 5 km in collaboration with Umara. Changing rooms and showers at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from about 09:00. Ahead of race day, free open training sessions will be held on 17 September and 15 October.

name: Skanneloppet
price_range: Fram till 7 oktober: 17,3 km 200 kr; 7,6 km 150 kr; 3,9 km 100 kr. 8 oktober – 24 oktober: 17,3 km 300 kr; 7,6 km 200 kr; 3,9 km 150 kr. 25 oktober – 5 november: 17,3 km 400 kr; 7,6 km 300 kr; 3,9 km 250 kr.
description: Skanneloppet is organized by IS Skanne and takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, with start and finish at Tingvalla nöjespalats in Åstorp. The race is individual with about ten starters per minute and offers three courses for both elites and recreational runners. The courses are hilly and mostly on gravel roads with sections of asphalt and forest trails, and the race suits both young and old. Information about registration and start lists is published on the organizer's website.
course_highlights: Three distances: Red 17.3 km, Blue 7.6 km and Green 3.9 km
Hilly terrain - mostly gravel roads with sections of asphalt and forest trails, especially early on
Water checkpoints marked on the map (yellow circles)
additional: Bib numbers distribution from 08:00 on race day; find your start number in the start list inside Tingvalla and pick it up yourself. No late registration on site. There is no shower or changing room on site (toilets are available). Medical services at the finish and a defibrillator is available. Maximum running time up to about 12:30. Those who register before October 24 will have their name printed on the bib. A memorial plaque to all who complete the race; commemorative medals awarded after the 5th, 10th, 20th, 30th and 40th completed races. Start times between 10:00 and 11:05 with about 10 starters per minute. Start and finish location: Tingvalla Vramsvägen 9, Åstorp. No late registration on site. Shower/change facilities are lacking; toilets are available. Start lists and results published on the IS Skanne page. Bib numbers to be collected on-site from 08:00 on race day for the 17.3 km race.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a cross-country and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, held on November 7, 2026. Choose between 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km) with start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race suits both beginners and experienced runners and offers encouraging pacers, well-stocked water stations, and a festive finish to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and the proceeds go back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (about 800 m from Ropsten T-bana)
Carefully measured courses on mostly asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total +439 m
Ample water stations and lap counting service, as well as clear kilometer markers
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (about 800 m from Ropsten T-bana). Bib distribution, pacer tents, food-/coffee sales, drop-off of outerwear and toilets at the event area. The option to change clothes and shower in a facility for a fee a few hundred meters away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers offered for several finishing times (list per distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (note: final check at the last lap 13:40). Age limits: 10 km from 15 years (13 years with a guardian), half marathon and marathon from 17 years. Some aids and vehicles (staves, inline skates, pram, bicycle, handcycle, racing wheelchair) are not allowed; special conditions apply for escorts/wheelchairs. Proceeds go back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Kroppefjäll Trailrun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900 meter: 0 kr för de allra minsta

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 350 kr för ungdom under 18 år

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 550 kr för ungdom under 18 år

description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun is an evening race at Kroppefjäll B&B in Dals Rostock, where runners in two-person teams are offered three main distance options (42 km, 21 km and 10.5 km) as well as a children's run around the lake. The course is technical terrain with a lot of singletrack and natural trails, and the race has a relaxed, adventurous character with no official timing. After finishing, participants can use the large sauna and take a refreshing dip in the lake, and book accommodations at Kroppefjäll B&B with discounts. The organizers welcome both experienced trail runners and younger participants (Lilla KTR) in a friendly environment.
course_highlights: Approximately 60% singletrack / completely unpaved, 35% gravel road / forest service road, and 5% oil gravel
Competition format: trail running in two-person teams
Lilla KTR: children's race around the lake (about 900 m), option to run 1–3 laps
additional: Bus to the start from Kroppefjäll B&B; GPX file for 21 km; bring your own fluids; bib pickup the days before the race or the evening before; accommodation discounts via Trailrun1/Trailrun2; The Lilla KTR race is held on November 7 at 18:00; last registration day November 4.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Iron Trail and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race is run in varied and characterful terrain – dense forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and older trails – where both grit and running joy are tested. Start and finish are at Hultets Outdoor Recreation Area, Kristinehamn, and the 15 km course partly goes outside the Iron Trail. The organizer Topp & Dröm welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Iron Trail through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and older trails).
Start and finish at Hultets Outdoor Recreation Area, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly goes off the Iron Trail
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets Outdoor Recreation Area; from October 1 the number of spots is limited to ensure a specially designed medal for all participants; the organizer is Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / phone 073-853 75 21) and there are headings for hydration stations and equipment on the information pages. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No mug at hydration stations; bring your own mug. Start and finish at Hultets Outdoor Recreation Area, Kristinehamn. Registration fees are updated over time and from October 1 the number of spots are limited to secure a specially designed medal for all participants.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, seaside rock outcrops, and some of Sweden's finest oak groves around Gränsö Slott. You can choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the kids participate in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to 12 years). The race is open to both timed racing and a Fun Run without timing and encourages a wonderful nature experience — feel free to combine with a spa visit at Gränsö Slott. Welcome to experience Västervik's archipelago from its best side.
course_highlights: Seaside rock outcrops and the Skanvik cliffs along the course
Trails through dense pine forest and valuable oak groves; technically varied sections
The 15 km includes a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km join at the Kroken energy station
additional: Event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Slott. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. First finish expected at about 11:35 and the finish closes at 13:45. The courses are marked with hanging red/white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mostly trails/hiking paths with sections of rocks, terrain and short road passages. Energy stations: the 8 km has one station, the 15 km has two. All children receive a medal and energy after finishing. Registration is online and possible up to one hour before start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration up to one hour before start; energy and hydration stations along the course; timing or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finish around 11:35; finish closes 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Slott.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and marketed as an autumn highlight for trail runners. The race is offered in several distances, making it accessible to both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. The website includes preliminary race information and published courses, as well as information about a practice run ahead of the event. Organizer pages and the registration link are collected on the race's website.
course_highlights: Trail running in Bockeboda Forest - forest terrain near Kristianstad
Multiple distances: approximately 25 km (25 - 26.4 km), 12 km (12 - 12.9 km) and 5 km (5.3 - 5.7 km) depending on the measurement method
Course lengths vary depending on the measurement method
additional: Registration: individual entries and group registrations are mentioned on the page. The website mentions insurance and has a link to registration for previous year's edition (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). There have also been trial runs ahead of the race, and it has previously been communicated that late registration was possible via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad and information about this year's edition is available in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF's page as well as the RaceID page.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultras Trail Race is a pleasant, local trail race organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and mainly consists of beautiful gravel roads and nice trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is in its second year and has a relaxed, welcoming character for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Gathering takes place at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40) and the start goes at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Primarily beautiful gravel roads and fine forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Gathering for information at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/organizing partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course layout for 2025 and 100 starting places fully booked one week before the race; new walking prize 'The Golden Toaster'; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping to Åtvidaberg (alighting at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space, carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpine Marathon is a unique alpine marathon race in the heart of Stockholm, which goes up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is somewhat longer than a regular marathon - a micro ultramarathon which, in the organizers' own words, can also be called Sweden's arguably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly with looped starts/turns and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope. The event is a festive advent celebration organized by Stockholm Multisport Club.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start/turn/finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing toward the top) and up over the Trysil section at the pier
Technical sections: down along the maintenance road, around the chimney, through Indian Park, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organizer: Stockholm Multisport Club. Registration takes place at lap turn/finish (wind shelter in the children's slope). Nearest metro: Hammarbyhöjden. Starting position: start at the bottom of the hill to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID according to the registration page. Registration and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope; bags left at the foot of the hill; tarpaulin in case of rain; toilets behind the parking lot; Everyman’s right applies; results published after the race (top 10 fastest).

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: Sylvesterloppet in Kalmar is a local running classic organized by Högby IF Friidrott and takes place on December 31, 2026. The club's website contains basic information about the race. For officials and volunteers, the club's login system is used for registration.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
Medal and a specially designed hat for all registrants
Walking class 5 km without timing as well as various class divisions
additional: The Kalmar Sylvesterlopp is described as a running classic. Registration for officials/volunteers is via the website's registration form (WordPress) and requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for different classes include P/F 5-13, 0.4-2.0 km, M/K 5 and 10 km, and Walking class 5 km without timing; late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Olofström is a traditional season-ending race organized by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), which in the current course layout has been run in two laps since 2018, and there is also a shorter course of about 5.3 km. The event has long featured finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize presentations in Idrottshallen, which provides a pleasant setting for runners and spectators. The history and club affiliations make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon 10,549 m (run as two laps in the current course layout since 2018)
Shorter course of about 5.3 km remains as an option
Finish, changing rooms, refreshments, and prize presentation in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration takes place via EasyRecord (stated in the invitation). PM and route maps are posted as PDFs on the organizer's pages (invitation, PM, map). The starting list is published separately on the organizer's website. The event has historically had changing facilities, refreshments and prize presentations in Idrottshallen. History and course profile, including start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: Adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometer race in Northern Djurgården in Stockholm that serves as a seed race for the adidas Stockholm Marathon. The race is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK within Marathongruppen and attracts about 5,000 runners. Start and finish are located at Fiskartorpsvägen, with the start area about 500 meters from the Stockholm University metro station, and the course offers approximately 117 meters of elevation gain on a mix of asphalt, gravel, and paving slabs. Premiärmilen is a seed race for the Stockholm Marathon; the registration fee varies between 395 and 645 kronor; the start is tentatively around 11:00, and the maximum time is two hours.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer course in Northern Djurgården that serves as a seed race for the adidas Stockholm Marathon
Start and finish at Fiskartorpsvägen, about 500 meters from the Stockholm University metro station
The course includes approximately 117 meters of elevation gain with surfaces of asphalt, gravel, paving slabs, and a wooden bridge
additional: Seeded race for the adidas Stockholm Marathon; about 5,000 participants; age limit 15 years; tentative start around 11:00; maximum time two hours; Northern Djurgården; start and finish area at Fiskartorpsvägen (about 500 meters from the Stockholm University metro station); elevation gain approximately 117 meters; surfaces: asphalt 64.7%, gravel 29.8%, paving slabs 5.3%, wooden bridge 0.2%; water stations and medical care in the area. Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometer race that goes around Northern Djurgården and is seeded to the adidas Stockholm Marathon. The age limit is 15 years and certain aids such as strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed, with a tentative start time of 11:00 and a maximum time of 2 hours.

name: Hoka Torekov-Båstad Lördag
description: HOKA Torekov–Båstad is a coastal trail run of 21.4 km between Torekov and Båstad with varied terrain and beautiful views over the sea. The race is marketed with the slogan "Breathe freedom" and targets both recreational runners and those who want to challenge themselves in technical trail running. The event is a leg in the Outnorth Trailtour and is also part of the Trails of SWE concept, which attracts elite runners and provides a national competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21.4 km of varied trail running between Torekov and Båstad
Coastal views with sea vistas and nature-oriented running
Part of Outnorth Trailtour / Trails of SWE – varying landscapes (mountains, forests, sea)
additional: The event takes place March 28–29, 2026. Hotel Skansen offers three different accommodation packages for participants. After Run buffet is offered in Hotel Skansen's banquet hall (price SEK 445 per person). Organizer: Trailrunning Sweden AB, Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm. Hotel Skansen offers three accommodation packages and After Run buffet in the banquet hall; booking and package details are available via the hotel's page and the code TRAILBÅSTAD.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the Romeleåsen hills with start and finish at Ekevallen in Genarp. The event offers several distances (10, 25 and 40 km) with substantial elevation gains and is open to both elite and recreational runners. The courses are certified by ITRA/UTMB, and the 40 km serves as SM/VSM for trail short distance; there are hydration and energy stations along the course as well as changing rooms and showers at the competition center. Registration takes place via the indicated registration page, and the registration fee includes the post-race meal (burger/sausage and a drink according to information on the page).
course_highlights: Technical trails on the Romeleåsen hills
Large elevation gains: approximately 160 / 540 / 820 m for 10 / 25 / 40 km
The courses are certified by ITRA and are part of UTMB/World Series; 40 km serves as SM/VSM
additional: Bib numbers are picked up on race day one hour before start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the competition center. Hydration and energy stations are placed along the courses (detailed VK placements and what is offered per distance are on the information page). 25 km is part of Skåne Trailcup; 40 km is SM/VSM, and runners who are members of clubs affiliated with SFIF may participate in SM/VSM according to the rules. First start at 09:30; parking at Ekevallen; hydration and energy stations along the course and at the finish; showers and changing rooms; registration and results via Sportstiming; the post-race meal includes food and drink; a finisher shirt in performance fabric can be purchased for an additional fee.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Växjöloppet is a family-friendly race held in Strandbjörket in Växjö, planned for May 1, 2026. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. Start and finish are at Värendsgatan/Strandbjörkshallen, and the course offers a scenic run around Växjösjön and through the Bokhultet nature reserve. The event is aimed at recreational runners, teams and families and features services such as water stations and bib distribution on site.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; finish at Lagunvallen by Växjösjön
Scenic course that passes Bokhultet (nature reserve with mostly deciduous trees)
Mixed surface: first kilometer on asphalt, then forest road for 10 km/21.1 km, and the last ~3.5 km asphalt around the lake
additional: The last day for online registration is April 30 at 12:00. Late registration takes place at bib pickup on April 30 from 14:00–18:00 at Intersport, Grand Samarkand or in Strandbjörket on May 1 from 08:30–09:15. The 10 km has four water stations (at 1, 3, 5.5 and 6.5 km); the 21.1 km offers water at eight occasions (including 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, 16.5 km). Companies/organizations can request an invoice by contacting vaxjoloppet@ifkvaxjo.se. Team competition and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners; multiple water stations along the course, especially for the longer distances.

name: Västerås Marathon
description: Västerås Marathon is organized on May 1, 2026 and offers three distances: marathon (42 km), half marathon (21 km) and 10 km on a flat and fast course through Västerås and along the shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is GPS-measured and has a low total ascent, which makes the race well suited for personal records and seeding to other marathons. The race passes several local landmarks and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The organizers welcome runners of all levels to a day of community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course along the shores of Lake Mälaren
Passes Lögarängsbadet, Aseatornet, Turbinhuset, Isbrytaren, and The Steam Hotel
Tunnel sections and the steepest hill about 400 m from the start; total ascent approximately 32 m
additional: Start and finish in Vasaparken. Start times: 09:00 (marathon), 10:00 (half marathon), 13:00 (10 km); starts can be divided into groups (e.g., 21k-A 10:00, 21k-B 10:05). Bib-number pickup and bag drop-off opens from 07:00 in the City Hall Restaurant. Hydration stations: 2 on the 10 km, 4 on the half marathon and 8 on the marathon; water and sports drink from Umara. Central station is located about 300 m from start/finish; several city parking options are available. The race can be used for seeding to the Stockholm Marathon (results must be uploaded on the same day).

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly trail race held in Nordens Ark's scenic environment at Åby säteri. On Saturday, May 2, 2026, the event's fifth edition will be held, organized by IK Granit. A wide range of courses are offered for all levels, from 1 km for the youngest to a challenging 30 km for the most persistent. The courses wind through Ekoparken and give participants the opportunity to enjoy the arrival of spring in the park's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses from 1 km up to 30 km
Winding trails through Ekoparken at Åby säteri
Beautiful, scenic views and park setting—signs of spring and cultural-historical features in the area
additional: Organizer: IK Granit. The venue is Nordens Ark, Åby säteri, 456 93 Hunnebostrand. The event is marketed as a festival for both participants and spectators. Para classes are planned; registration via IK Granit's website; the race is held in Ekoparken around Nordens Ark

name: Uddloppet
description:
Uddloppet is a spring race in Karlshamn, Blekinge, aimed at both recreational runners and elite runners. It is a perfect start to the running season and a good gauge of form after winter training 
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Distances:
4 km (09:45)
10 km (11:00)
Half marathon (11:00)
Children's race 400 m (10:30)
Walking class 2.5 km (between 09:00-13:00)
Course layout: A scenic and gently undulating course along the sea and the forest east of Karlshamn. Start and finish at Vägga Idrottsplats 
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Practical info: Parking at Vägga IP, changing and showers in Väggahallen. Bib numbers picked up at Intersport in Karlshamn from Wednesday to Saturday, or on race day at the secretariat 
uddloppet.ifudd.se

The race also offers activities for the whole family with a mascot, prize ceremony, face painting and on-site catering.
course_highlights: Along the sea and through the forest east of Karlshamn
Start and finish at Vägga Idrottsplats
Distances 4 km, 10 km, half marathon and children's race
additional: Start times by distance: 4 km at 09:45; Children's race at 10:30; 10 km and half marathon at 11:00. Parking at Väggahallen or a designated gravel area; secretariat, refreshments and prize ceremony in the start/finish area. The course is offered via start and finish at Vägga Idrottsplats and timing is provided by Racetimer; seeding according to the Swedish Athletics Association. Registration is via Mittlopp.se and bib numbers are collected in Karlshamn (Intersport) before race day. Uddloppet offers the distances 4 km, 10 km and half marathon with seeding in other races; Uddlunken is a walking class of 2.5 km without timing and starts between 9:00 and 13:00, the price is 100:- including a medal. Parking at Vägga IP and changing/shower facilities in Väggahallen.

organizer: Centralföreningen för Gymnastik- och Idrottssällskap i Göteborg

description: Flat course on mostly asphalt around the central parts of Kungsbacka. The world's oldest annual long-distance race, held every year in uninterrupted succession since 1898.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Stora Torget in central Kungsbacka
Two-lap course through the inner-city's pedestrian and bicycle paths
Multiple distances including a half marathon, quarter marathon, and youth and recreational races
additional:
Start at Kungsbacka's Square in central Kungsbacka
Quarter Marathon 12:00
Half Marathon 13:00

images.alt_text: Kungsbackaloppet: Världens äldsta årliga långlopp sedan 1898

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to running experiences on Billingen. This year we will have start and finish at Stadion on Billingens Fritidsområde. The long course is just over 47 km and about 930 meters of elevation gain. The whole northern Billingen area around with fine trails along the mountainside. As a runner you will experience a varied terrain such as deciduous forest, rock ravines, meadows, coniferous forest and in several places beautiful views over the landscape. The surface varies from easy running, asphalt about 6 km, and some more demanding sections.

The middle course, 21 km, runs on the northern part of Billingeleden and reaches about 500 meters of elevation. This course goes on mixed trails, meadow and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, measures just over 200 meters of elevation and runs on trails of varying difficulty and shorter sections of road.

Information about courses and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, at 10:00 – Stadion, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
21 km, at 10:45 – Björnasäter, Lerdala. Bus departs from Billingens Fritidsområde at 10:05.
12 km, at 11:30 – Stadion, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.

Finish:

At Stadion, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
All finishes take place at the stadium.
course_highlights: 47 km across the entire northern Billingen – just over 47 km with about 930 meters of elevation gain
Varied terrain: deciduous forest, rock ravines, meadow, coniferous forest and sections with asphalt (about 6 km)
12 km follows Blå Trollstigen (just over 200 m); 21 km runs on the northern Billingeleden (about 500 m) and participants are bused out from the stadium
additional: Start/finish for 47 km at Billingens fritidsområde (Stadion). 21 km starts in Björnasäter, Lerdala (approximately 12 km from the stadium) and participants are bused out - the bus is included in the registration fee and departs from the south end of the stadium (visible from the secretariat and finish), around 10:05 after the start for 47 km. Course markings: orange pennants and arrows as well as Billingleden's orange marking ("B") for the 47/21 km; 12 km follows Trollstigen's blue markings. The surface varies from easy running to more technical sections; there are also shorter asphalt sections (~6 km). Videos and photos from previous years are linked on the page. Start times: 47 km 10:00; 21 km 10:45; 12 km 11:30. Bus to the start for the 21 km around 10:05. Parking in the large lot; changing/showering in Billingecentret.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a historic race for all ages, with a children's race in the morning and the adult race at 12:30. There are two classes to choose from, 6- and 12-kilometers, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it's not completely flat…), with the start and finish on Ålstensgatan, which yields perhaps Sweden's most magnificent starting line for a running event. In between, running on the streets of Bromma, the feeling is that you are running through gardens in apple blossoms. An experience enhanced by many neighbors coming out to cheer or even setting up their own small refreshment stations or sprinklers—each one cooling in its own way. Among other things, this has given rise to the race's slogan: Stockholm's most charming running race.
course_highlights: 12.0 km officially measured asphalt course shaped like a figure eight (one lap); 6 km and several children's classes also offered
Steep climbs, especially two hills on Grönviksvägen; nice view of Lake Mälaren from Grönviksvägen
Four aid stations along the course (water/sports drink/cola and bananas depending on the station)
additional: Timing is done with a chip on the bib (Racetimer). The start is at Ålstensgatan, with the first 600 m downhill on Ålstensgatan. There is a Stadium Active Zone in the Ålstens School yard with a bouncy castle, climbing wall etc. Minimum age 14 years (runners 16+ prioritized); wheelchairs cannot be accommodated and runners with baby strollers require special permits. Group registration (10+ runners) gives a discount - contact johan@tolvanloppet.se. Water stations exist (4); start/finish area on Ålstensgatan; the 12-km race has been a loop since 2008; HalvTolvan approximately 6 km; registration: last regular registration day 15/5; late registration up to 22/5; on-site registration up to 45 minutes before the race; bib distribution 23/5 from 08:00 - 12:00 in Ålstens School cafeteria; start confirmation will be sent by e-mail; public transport is recommended (Tolvan tram via Nockebybanan); medical care at the finish area.

images.alt_text: Deltagare springer i ett löparevenemang längs en trädkantad gata.
Familj springer Tolvanloppet förbi en spårvagn på Brommas gator.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK organizes for the 53rd time an evening run during Hörby Market with three different distances:

Marknadsloppet 12.6 km: the competitive class starts at 18:30, the recreational class starts at 18:40

Bil-Månsson loppet 6.1 km: everyone starts at 18:50.

CAN-CAN loppet 3.4 km: everyone starts at 19:00.

The race starts and finishes inside the Hörby town, large parts run in forest surroundings.
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, trails. See maps.
Don't miss this opportunity!
course_highlights: Three distances: 12.6 km, 6.1 km and CAN-CAN 3.4 km
Start at Lågehallarna and finish at Folkets Hus in Hörby
Electronic chip-timing and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu - right up to the start of the race.

Late registration can be done at the entrance to Lågehallen (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Directions from National Road 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information about preparations, registration, course, and directions is available at the link:
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

Karta över Hörby Marknadslopps banor med distanser 12,6 km, 6,1 km och 3,4 km.
