name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is this year's most generous race, where running joy meets beautiful nature on Djurgården. With a course that winds along gravel and asphalt roads, the event offers a delightful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 registrants are rewarded with a specially designed shirt, and after the finish line a relaxing After Run with grilling and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens awaits. In addition, a portion of the registration fee goes to Sweden for UNHCR, making every step count – for you and for someone in need.
course_highlights: A lap on scenic trails and asphalt roads on Djurgården's northern and southern sides
The course is measured (10 km)
Markers and views typical of Djurgården – the course blends natural trails and asphalt
additional: Bag drop-off at the start and finish area at Djurgårdsbrunnsbron (the organizer is not responsible for valuables). Unique race shirt can be purchased in connection with registration - order before 1/8 2026 to receive the shirt; it will be collected together with the bib. Pacers are offered for sub60, sub50, sub45 and sub40. After the run: all runners are invited to grilled food after the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed this year. Registration handling (e.g., transfers) is done via Raceid. Charity component; post-race hangout; unique race shirt; start-preparation program mentioned (Uhrbom's program).

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
FK Friskus-Varberg invites you to a running event on Saturday, October 18, with start and finish at Friskusstugan.

Along the course you pass through large parts of Varberg. You run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget with a magnificent view of the sea. The course also goes through several parks/urban forests, including the fine Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen. In addition to the half marathon, there is also a course of 11.5 km.

All information and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se
course_highlights: Running along the beach in Apelviken
Up on Hästhagaberget with a magnificent view of the sea
The course passes through several parks and urban forests, including Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen
additional: Start and finish at Friskusstugan (Träslövsvägen 142B). Late registration available at the competition center until 45 minutes before the start for an increased fee. Bicycle parking at Friskusstugan; no car parking at Friskusstugan - free car parking is available at Varbergs Hospital about 600 m from the competition center (check local parking regulations). Photos of participants may be published. Registration deadline: no later than Sunday, October 11; Late registration: until 45 minutes before the start for an increased fee.

name: Nyårsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för alla barn att anmäla sig till Jumpyard Lilla Nyårsloppet.

description: For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone from elite competitors to enthusiastic recreational runners and children to participate in a winter race on our streets and squares in central Vallentuna. It may be challenging ice, slush, wonderful winter crisp air, or a fast asphalt course waiting for you as participants and spectators. The New Year’s Run is a pleasant occasion to be a little active before the New Year’s Eve meal is eaten and the year is summed up. And as some say, "What you do on New Year’s Eve, you do for the rest of the year"! So take the opportunity to be active, bring a friend and run or jog the course around.
course_highlights: Course through the Himmelstalund area with a section in Folkparken
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km with clear markings and kilometer signs
Start, finish and turnaround at the parking lot outside Stadium Arena
additional: Warm-up on stage at 10:45. Bib pickup at Mio Norrköping on Tuesday, December 30, 14:00-18:00, and remaining bib numbers will be distributed at the start area no later than 30 minutes before the start; late registration is accepted on-site (only Swish). Bib pickup is indoors in the Stadium Arena foyer; the top tab on the bib is the chip. Water is available at the start/finish and at the turnaround for the 10 km. Toilets are inside Stadium Arena, staffed bag and outerwear drop-off is offered, timing is handled by Racetimer, and results are published via a link on the race website. Start at 11:00; registration via RaceID; late registration 345 kr; bib pickup December 30 14–18 at Mio Norrköping or at the start December 31; chip in the upper tab of the bib; medal to all; bag and outerwear drop-off; post-race snacks (ICA Maxi Norrköping).

name: Förslöv Trail
description: Förslöv Trail is a cross-country race at the foot of Hallandsåsen, held on April 3, 2026, with start and finish at Förslöv's Sports Hall. You can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 24 km; all distances share the same first 2 km and the last kilometer. The courses offer varied nature with grassy trails, sections on the Skåneleden, and shorter climbs — suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. After the finish, participants are offered a medal, fruit, and the opportunity to mingle in the event center at the sports hall.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Hallandsåsen, with beautiful nature and views
Variable terrain: grassy trails, sections on the Skåneleden and short climbs
All distances share the same first 2 km and the last 1 km; the first hill comes after about 100 meters
additional: Hydration stations: Umara sports drink and water are placed (5 km: sports drink at 2.5 km; 10 km: sports drink + water at 2.5 km and 7 km; 24 km: sports drink at 2.5, 12 and 20 km + water at 7 and 17 km). Fruit/snacks are available at one station. After the race, participants receive a medal, fruit, and hydration at the event center in the sports hall, which remains open until all participants have finished. Changing rooms are available before and after the race in the same building as the sports hall. Bib numbers can be picked up on race day no later than 20 minutes before your own start (bib numbers are available from 08:30 at start/finish); option to pick up your bib the day before at Stadium Outlet in Ängelholm. Distances: 5 km (325 SEK), 10 km (375 SEK), 24 km (425 SEK). Start times: 24 km at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30, 5 km at 11:00. Start and finish at Förslöv's Sports Hall. Hydration stations: Umara sports drink and water at selected kilometers. After finish: medal and fruit; finish area open until everyone has finished; changing rooms in the sports hall.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan - an appreciated cross-country race during the Easter weekend that suits both elite runners and recreational runners. Start and finish are located at the Ski Cabin in Vänersborg and the main course is about 7 km long with varying surfaces of gravel roads and trails. The race combines an easily runnable first part with a more hilly and challenging ending, and there are also children and youth races so the whole family can participate.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km of varied running along gravel roads and trails
The first part is easy to run and invites speed; the ending is more hilly and challenging
Start and finish at the Ski Cabin in Vänersborg; children and youth races are included
additional: Schedule: 0-6 years start/assembly 09:30; 7-13 years start/assembly 10:00; main race assembly 11:00 (activities listed 11:00 - 13:00). Registration on the activity pages is indicated as open only for the club's members and requires login. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class and all participants take part in drawings.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergets IK welcomes you to Ryssbergsloppet 2026, hosted at Hjortakroksskolan in Sölvesborg. The race is part of the Skånes VeteranCup 2026 and offers several distances for different ages and levels. Starting lists, classifications and courses are published on the club's website. The event is club-driven and welcomes both recreational runners and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Several distances: 1.9 km, 5.1 km, 7.5 km and 12.6 km
Start and finish at Hjortakroksskolan, Sölvesborg
The courses are marked (km markers) and volunteers are at intersections
additional: Bib numbers should be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start; the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup 2026; fluids (water and sports drink) are available at the lap turnaround/finish; prize giving starts at around 12:30; refreshments with coffee and pastries and grilled sausages are offered. Participants should collect race materials no later than 30 minutes before the start. In advance of the competition there is an invitation, classification/entry fee, registration, start list, PM and course maps. The race is part of Skånes VeteranCup 2026.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming race along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg with courses for half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational running as well as a competitive class for the half marathon. The race targets competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and in 2026 Kanallöpet has DM/VDM-status in the half marathon. Start takes place at the Sporthallen in Ljungsbro (half marathon), at the Sjöbacka bridge (10 km) and at Brunneby Musteri (5 km), with finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The organizing clubs are Borensberg IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna.
course_highlights: The race follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg — scenic canal sections
Finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Different starting locations for each distance (Ljungsbro for the half marathon, Sjöbacka Bridge for the 10 km, Brunneby Musteri for the 5 km); common start at 13:00
additional: Transport: A bus is organized from Borensberg to each start location (book and pay at the time of registration); the bus costs 100 SEK and no transport is offered after finishing (option to book on race day at the site). Team registration: A team of 5 runners exists in the recreational classes, price per runner 20% lower than individual registration, team registration only via the internet. Bib numbers can be picked up at the respective starting location. Registration and payment: payment by Swish or bank giro; registration is valid only after payment is received and if payment has not been received within 10 days the registration is canceled. PM with more details will be published later. Trail running along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg; registration and payment via www.kanallopet.com as well as Swish or bank giro; late registration between 11:30 and 12:30; medals including a special medal for participants up to and including 16 years old; no bus transport back after finish.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: Sätermaran 2026 is organized by Säters IF FIK, and the invitation to this year's race is published on the club's website. The club urges runners to review the attached invitation document for full information. For questions, refer to the club's contact email.
course_highlights: The half marathon district championship (Mittsvenska DM) is part of the event.
Offers both distances: half marathon and marathon.
Takes place in Säter, with results from previous years' races published.
additional: An invitation to Sätermaran is available as an attached document on the news page. The competition information on the club's page recommends reading the PM/schedule before travel, that check-in for running events often occurs about 60 minutes before the start of the race, and to bring food and drink as well as rain gear since the competition day can be long. The club asks competitors to wear competition clothing (optional) and refers to the club shop via Intersport for orders. The 2024 edition of Sätermaran was organized as the Mittsvenska DM in the half marathon and showed results for both the half marathon and marathon, indicating the competition's broad scope and local significance.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden's fastest 10 km races and takes place on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. The race is a good opportunity for runners who want to set a new personal best or use the result as seedings for other competitions. Welcome to participate and take the chance for a fast race on a flat course.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned course
Suitable for personal bests and seedings for other races
additional: Three-lap course that mostly runs on cycle paths and will be marked with arrows at every turn. Maximum of 150 participants. Sanctioned by the West Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is an evening race for girls in Slottsparken held on Monday, May 4, 2026 at 6:30 PM. The race is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for girls and is offered in two distances, 2.5 km and a measured 5 km. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams (5 people) – teams receive a picnic after finishing – and the local organizer is MAI. In registration, among other things, a medal, bib, and finish bag are included; timing is optional.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Race in Slottsparken, Malmö — green park environment and evening event
Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; timing can be opted out
additional: Individual registration: medal, finish bag, music quiz + prizes, bib; team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing. Timing for the 5 km is offered but can be opted out (same price regardless of timing). Recommended age: 13 years for the 5 km (11 years with an adult), 11 years for the 2.5 km (7 years with an adult). Training session is organized Thursday, March 19 at 6:30 PM at Lördagsplan, Slottsparken. Registration can be completed digitally up to race day and no later than 1 hour before the first start. Training session in Slottsparken on March 19; Recommended age: 5 km — 13 years (11 years with an adult); 2.5 km — 11 years (7 years with an adult); Registration is digital; contact: varruset@mai.se

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF with start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård (sports ground). The 2026 edition is the 48th and offers classes for toddlers, several youth classes, as well as open 5 km and 10 km for adults. The race is welcoming for both recreational runners and competitive runners, and publishes start and results lists on the club's website and social media.
course_highlights: Combination of road and cross-country
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård (sports ground)
Children and youth courses from about 600 m up to 4 km; adult distances 5 km and 10 km
additional: The last registration day is April 3, 2026; on-site late registration is possible up to 60 minutes before each start signal. Late registration fee for adult classes is +100 SEK (total 400 SEK) and for youth classes +50 SEK (total 225 SEK). By registering, the participant agrees that their name may be published in start and results lists, and that any images may be published on the club's website and social media. Competition rules from the Swedish Athletics Association apply and participation is at your own risk. Registration prices: adult 400 SEK and youth 225 SEK; on-site late registration costs +100 SEK for adults and +50 SEK for youth.

description: Hallarydsloppet is a friendly community festival organized on Easter Monday in Hallaryd and suitable for participants of all ages, from children to veterans. The race offers several distances — 21 km, 9.8 km, 6 km, as well as shorter children's and walking rounds — and largely takes place on gravel roads surrounded by meadows, stone walls and forests. The courses offer beautiful landscapes in the border area between Skåne and Småland and include both open sections and shorter, challenging climbs. A welcoming organizer's note invites runners, joggers and walkers to participate or come and cheer.
course_highlights: Large portions run on gravel roads lined with winding stone walls, meadows, and forests.
Passage over a historic 1870 stone-arched bridge on the 21 km course.
Variable, gently hilly terrain with several distinct climbs (including a steep one of about 30 m and one of about 25 m) and several water stations.
additional: Registration is by email to Hallarydsloppet@gmail.com; please include name, address, class, year of birth and any club affiliation. Payment via bank giro 5436-8543 or Swish 1232141232. Pre-registration must be received by Hallaryds IF no later than March 31, 2026; on-site registration is allowed on race day up to the start with an increased fee of 50:- (no increased fee for youth and walking classes). Start/finish at Hallaryds School (Häradsvägen 3) and bib numbers collected no later than 30 minutes before each start. Timing is via the barcode on the bib. Changing rooms/shower: Women in HIF's club house, men in the school's gym hall. Water/sports drink (Umara, lemon flavor) served at several water stations; see the Courses for exact locations. All finishers receive the Hallarydsloppet plaque; prizes to the first three in each class and a draw for the rest. Registration is via email and payment via bank giro or Swish; pre-registration by March 31, 2026; on-site registration on race day against an additional fee of 50:-; start/finish at Hallaryds School; water supplied at the water stations; prize to the first three in each class; plaque to all finishers.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb
price_range: 349 kr t.o.m 31/1; 449 kr fr.o.m 1/2; anmälan möjlig t.o.m. 30 min innan start
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a well-organized 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken and goes two laps clockwise around Rocksjön. Your result is seedings-based for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, which gives the possibility of a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet. The event is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with IKHP Huskvarna IK and features a family element with Minivarvet for the youngest. Bib pickup and bag drop are available in the start and finish area on race day.
course_highlights: Two laps clockwise around Rocksjön
Start and finish in Knektaparken (bib pickup and bag drop on site)
Family element: Minivarvet 210 m for ages 0-6 held concurrently (on-site registration)
additional: Date: Monday, April 6, 2026. The start and finish area is located in Knektaparken; the course consists of two laps around Rocksjön. Minivarvet for children 0 - 6 years is held the same day (210 m, on-site registration, 80 kr via Swish). The race is seedings-based for Göteborgsvarvet 2026. Seedings rules via Göteborgsvarvet; Minivarvet for children; bib number according to information at registration; start confirmation will be sent by e-mail; bib pickup the day before the race; hydration, showers and changing facilities as well as bag storage available; warm-up before the start.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is an evening run for girls in the Vårruset tour, which in Uppsala offers the distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km is course-measured). Start and finish are at Studenternas IP, and the event is both fitness- and team-friendly with the option to register as an individual or as a team. All those who register individually receive a medal, a finish bag and a bib; team registrations also include a picnic after crossing the finish line. Timing is offered as an optional service in the registration, and results are published only for those who have chosen timing.
course_highlights: Course-measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP (Ulleråkersvägen)
Evening run with both 2.5 km and 5 km options
additional: Registration is digital and possible up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. It is the same price regardless of whether you choose timing or not. Recommended ages: 13 years and older for the 5 km (11 years old if accompanied by an adult), 11 years and older for the 2.5 km (7 years old if accompanied by an adult). Local contact: IF Mantrasport. A team consists of five people and team registration includes a picnic after the finish. Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; age recommendations for the distances; timing can be omitted so that results are not published.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for girls and offers a pleasant spring evening for everyone who wants to run, jog, or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The 5 km course is officially measured, and the race offers a medal, goody bag and bib to participants; timing is optional. Team registrations (five-person teams) are offered a picnic after the finish. Start and finish are at Sanden, Vassbottenleden in Vänersborg, and the event is organized by Vänersborgs SK in collaboration with Vårruset/Marathongruppen.
course_highlights: Distance option of 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km
Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden), Vänersborg
Evening run with a team picnic after the finish
additional: Included: medal, goody bag, bib and (for those who opted for it) timing. Team registration (five people) includes a picnic after finishing. Recommended ages: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with an adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with an adult). Registration is digital and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. It is possible to opt out of timing in the registration; the price is the same regardless of timing. The distance is 2.5 or 5 km (officially measured 5 km course); start and finish at Sanden, Vassbottenleden 46238, Vänersborg; the surface is partly asphalt and partly gravel; timing can be opted out in registration; team registration includes a picnic after finish; music quiz and prizes are included in the experience.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail started in 2015 and can be described as a fitness race where nature, community, and the experience are in focus, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers a fantastic opportunity for all runners, regardless of level, to participate in three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail), and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place in the beautiful natural setting around Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has an elevation gain of 500 meters.
course_highlights: Course on Österlen’s trails - varied trail terrain around Simrishamn/Österlen
Alunbruket passages (passed twice on several distances)
Start/finish and some limited gathering areas at Christinehof Castle (14 km)
additional: Equipment and safety requirements are stated per distance: for example, a windproof jacket or a first-aid blanket, energy, mobile phone (with sufficient battery) for the 14 km; your own mug/drinking vessel (no disposable cup) and UMARA water/sports drink for the 22 km; for the 60 km a waterproof/warm outfit (jacket > 10,000 mm), extra clothing, extra energy and the possibility to leave a drop bag at Bengtemölla (about 32 km). Medical staff are stationed at stations and at the finish (numbers and placement are provided in the respective runner's information sheet). Registration opens according to the page on Saturday, October 25 at 08:00. Registration opens on Saturday, October 25 at 08:00 according to the registration page.

images.alt_text: Löpare springer på stig i Österlens vackra natur.
Löpare springer på en strand under Österlen Spring Trail med en grönskande kulle i bakgrunden.
Karta som visar banan för ÖST 13km, en del av Österlen Spring Trail, med start och mål markerade.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a loop course of 10 km with 400 m of elevation gain. In total, over five laps you reach the ultra distance of 50 km and 2000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail on single track and animal track in dramatic forest! Welcome
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More info is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love to run ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. A perfect mix of trails, climbs, sweat and tears that calls to mind spectacular races in our Swedish mountains as well as in Europe’s Alps. Isaberg 500 also features serpentine sections, long enjoyable downhill runs and stunning views. Between them you enjoy winding trail running through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 offers at least 500 meters of elevation gain and is perfect for you who train for mountain marathons and similar races.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later it was closed due to landslide risk. In 2025, Jättestigen returns under Isaberg500 but under a new name - Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a leg in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail running with varied trails and climbs, technical character reminiscent of mountain and alpine races
Multisport around Isaberg Peak: paddling, MTB and trail running - classes for Solo and Duo
Isaberg Gravel: loop course about 45 km with start/finish in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to 50 years: 3 laps, older/sportive 2 laps, recreational 1 lap
additional: Contact via GI: mobile +46 703 815 118 and email gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Possibility to book guided cycling groups; the organizers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group's needs. Main distance approximately 10.5 km (Trail Tour distance); Kids Trail approximately 2 km with about 150 meters of elevation gain; start time Sunday 12:00; location Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact niklas@isabergtrail.se.

images.alt_text: Löpare klättrar uppför en skogig sluttning under ett terränglopp vid Isaberg.

name: Altorp Ultra
description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop - 'Långa gula'.
~120 m of elevation per loop.
May 10, 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
As many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, friends and family.
course_highlights: 7 km trail loop 'Långa gula' through Altorp Forest
Approximately 100 m of elevation gain per loop
8-hour format – as many laps as you can complete (kids' race ~400 m starts at 09:30)
additional: Kids' race (~400 m) starts at 09:30 and is free. The main event runs from 10:00 to 18:00 (8 h). Food and drinks (burgers, hot dogs, snacks) are offered - free for all runners and available for purchase for other visitors. Strava route is available for 'Långa gula' 7 km. Course records from 2025: men 11 laps (77 km), women 8 laps (56 km). A 7 km loop with ~100 m elevation gain per lap in Altorp Forest; all-day 10:00 - 18:00; kids' race ~400 m; food, drinks, burgers, sausages and music; Strava route available for Långa gula.

images.alt_text: Skogsstig med solljus som silar genom träden, perfekt för terränglöpning.
Skogsstig med solljus som strilar ner genom träden.
En skogsstig med en gul markör på ett träd, perfekt för terränglöpning.

name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a historic recreational race in the heart of Ängelholm. Here participants will encounter city, sea and forest over the same distance. The 5 km race initially offers a delightful park run in the cozy Hembygdsparken. After about 2.7 km the course crosses the Rönne River, continuing along the beautiful river promenade in Nybroskogen. Finally the course turns back over the river, where a sprint awaits before finishing at Tullakrok. Our 10 km course has the same initiation as the 5 km, but turns north after a few kilometers. Here runners are treated to beautiful views over Skälderviken and its harbor, where Kullaberg can be seen in the background. After about 7.7 km the courses converge again, and the runners get to enjoy the beautiful river promenade in Nybroskogen.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Tullakrok (just west of Hembygdsparken); start in the northern part and finish in the southern part
The course runs through cozy residential quarters, lush greenery and coastal sections along the Rönneå
The 10 km has two refreshment stations (at Hamnkrogen after 5 km and at Haradalsbron after 7.7 km); the 5 km has a water station at Haradalsbron after 2.7 km
additional:
Last date for standard registration is May 18, but you can register late up until one hour before the start for each respective race.

Stay updated by following us on Facebook and Instagram
https://www.facebook.com/anglamilen
https://www.instagram.com/anglamilen_angelholm

name: MoraTrail
description:
Trail run in Mora's forests.

organizer: IF Mölndal Fotboll och Mölndal Handboll

name: Mattila Trail Run
description: A new trail race in which you will run on small trails that people have walked on for centuries. The course goes through beautiful scenery, across mires, on boardwalks, through old-growth forest mixed with managed forest. You will encounter some substantial climbs but will have a fantastic challenge and experience in Finnskogen!

Sections across mires and boardwalks
Old-growth forest mixed with managed forest and substantial climbs

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
Nyårsloppet is a perfect way to get moving during the holiday period. It is now the 42nd time Vallentuna Friidrott invites you to run on New Year’s Eve, and the race brings together everyone from elites to those who want to take it a bit easier. A winter race can offer surfaces or fast-running asphalt, you never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecasts and read our information. Statistically, the surface has been favorable for running in the vast majority of years; this is evident if nothing else in the results lists from previous years.

Above all, Nyårsloppet is a pleasant way to come together for a closing of the old year and something to talk about during the celebration a little later in the day.

You are welcome too, see you!
course_highlights: The course runs on an asphalt park path and road in central Vallentuna
Competition center and bib pickup at Rosendal School, South Campus
Winter conditions can vary (ice, slush, winter crisp, or fast asphalt)
additional: Keep in mind that Nyårsloppet is a winter race and the surface can vary from year to year. In some years, studded shoes may be recommended.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset i Halmstad är en del av Sveriges största motionsturné för tjejer och bjuder på härlig vårstämning i Alets naturreservat. Loppet erbjuds i två distanser, 2,5 km och 5 km (5 km är kontrollmätt), och går av stapeln vid evenemangsområdet på det civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen. Alla individuella deltagare får medalj, målpåse och nummerlapp; lag som anmäler fem personer bjuds på picknick efter målgång. Tidtagning erbjuds på 5 km men kan väljas bort i anmälan om man inte vill få sitt resultat publicerat.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is measured
The race takes place in Alets Nature Reserve and along Skepparegatan
Event area at the civilian airfield near Aleskogen
additional: Registration is digital and can be done up to race day (no later than 1 hour before the first start). Recommended age: 2.5 km from age 11 (7 years with an accompanying adult), 5 km from age 13 (11 years with an accompanying adult). Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing. It is possible to opt out of timing so that results are not published; the price is the same regardless of timing. A separate digital race is offered for those who cannot attend in person (medal mailed after the tour). Training session in Halmstad planned April 21 at Motorhalland Skoda at 18:30. Team registration requires five people; medal, goody bag and music quiz with prizes included per registration category; digital registration and post-race picnic available for teams of five.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme - VMX
description:
On 14 September 2025, it’s time for what we’ve all been waiting for, namely Vånga Mountain Xtreme - VMX 2025! In FK Göingarna’s new leadership, the race will live on with the same setup, top-notch organization, and the joy of running!
Three demanding and enjoyable races are offered. Choose between 8, 16, or 40 km of challenging trail running, with climbs of 300 m, 600 m, and 1500 m respectively.
After conquering the grueling Vångabacken, winding trails in pure wilderness await, along small tranquil tarns and deep quarries. A course as beautiful as it is challenging, with start and finish at the foot of Vångabacken!
Registration is open. Will you accept the challenge!?

name: Taube-loppet - Bohusläns vackraste lopp
description:
People, running & community on the wonderful Flatön.
On August 23, 2025 we will host the Taube Run for the fifth year in a row, and it will be the best year yet!
This year we offer, in addition to music, food and a folk festival: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race of about 400 meters, and, new for this year, a combo race of 36 km! That is, all races, excluding the children’s race, in combination. We have had runners who have completed the distance in previous years, but now we formalize the distance. Regardless of distance, you are welcome to Bohuslän’s most beautiful race on Flatön! The races run in the beautiful Bohuslän archipelago landscape in the spirit of Evert Taube. On the beautiful Flatön at Malö strömmar just north of Orust in Bohuslän and the Handelsman Flink celebrated by Evert Taube, these races are held, together with food and entertainment at Flatö School. There is a ferry to the island from both the north and the south.
The course runs across the islands with beach, forest and fields along the route.
This year there are only 150 exclusive places for each race (half marathon or mile) as well as 100 places for the little Taube race and 25 for the combo race. First come, first served.
For the children’s race, registration will open later, and then via www.taubeloppet.se
For more information see the event’s website www.taubeloppet.se/
Start and finish at Flatö School
The competition is organized by the Flatö Association. Timing function performed by ArenaTime
additional:
WHAT IS INCLUDED IN THE TAUBE-LOPPET REGISTRATION?

IN YOUR REGISTRATION YOU GET
medal
diploma (for those who wish)
eenergystations according to map published well in advance of the race on this site
electronic timing with a chip
a incredibly beautiful environment!

DATE
Saturday August 23, 2025

CLASSES
Women 21 km
Men 21 km
Women 10 km
Men 10 km
Children 10 km
Women 5 km
Men 5 km
Children 5 km
Children 0.5 km
Combo 36 km (21 km, 10 km and 5 km in combination)
NB! From age 16, the runner competes in the adult class

ARENA
Flatö School, Flatön. Here you pick up bib numbers and there is competition expedition. Here are both start and finish.

PARKING
Free parking on the grassy areas by Flatö School, although limited in number, so please carpool as much as possible. If you live on Malön, Flatön or Ängön we appreciate if you walk or cycle to the start. Follow signage and instructions from volunteers.

FERRY TO THE ISLAND
You reach Flatön by car ferry from Orust (Fröjdendal) or from Skaftölandet (Dragsmark). The ferry takes only a few minutes and runs two (2) times per hour during the day. The current timetable can be found here: Link

START
Outside Flatö School.
The race will be run in start groups. The final start times will be announced a couple of weeks before the start to registered participants. It is important to be in the starting pen when the start for your group goes, as timing otherwise cannot be guaranteed for your performance.

FINISH
At Flatö Church, which is 100 meters from Flatö School.

RACE EXPEDITION
Here you pick up your bib and can ask questions. The race expedition is located in the Local History Museum at Flatö School.
Opening hours:
Friday 16:00–20:00
Saturday 10:00–19:00

BIB
The bib must be worn visibly on the chest. We provide safety pins, but you are welcome to bring your own; reuse is good! If you register by July 31 we print your name on the bib, so it becomes a personal keepsake and so the audience can call your name when they see you!

TOILETS
Toilets are available at Flatö School and Flatö Church, and after about 6 km at the Market.

BAG DROP
At the Race Expedition there is an opportunity to drop off your bag. We are not responsible for valuables. There are tags in the bag you collect at the Race Expedition to attach to your bag.

OVEROUTER CLOTHING
With your bib you receive a bag for any outerwear. You mark it with one of the labels you receive when you pick up your bib, and drop it off before the start at the Race Expedition.

ROUTE MARKING
The course is marked with tape (orange for 21 km, blue for 10 km & green for the 5 km track), arrows and kilometer signs in the terrain. Some parts are rocky and possibly slippery (depending on high water, for example), so take care! There are easier sections further ahead where you can stretch out and run.

TIMING
Electronic timing from ArenaTime, with one chip per runner, which is presented at ArenaTime directly after the race (and on taubeloppet.se after a day or so)

ENERGY STATIONS
Remember that it is important to continuously take in fluids and energy early in the race! At our energy stations you recharge with new energy so you can keep going. At all stations there are energy drinks and water. Bananas, buns and pickled cucumber are other good things you can refill with. For those who wish there is also food to buy at Flatö School after the race.

MAX TIME/ROPES
At the energy stations a rope is drawn at a specific time. This means you cannot continue the race after that. This is for your safety. If you have passed the last rope in time you can continue toward the finish – the course does not close until everyone is back!
Rope times we use at the Energy Stations:
Energy Station 1 (Björnsund)
Energy Station 2 (Kila)
Energy Station 3 (Lökebacken)
Energy Station 4 (Ängön)

LITTERING
...along the course is of course strictly forbidden and leads immediately to disqualification. At the energy stations there are garbage bags. Remember to sort the waste.

IF YOU HAVE TO DROP OUT
If you are forced to retire for any reason, go to the Race Expedition and inform the staff there that you have dropped out. This is important so that no rescue operation is started when you are actually relaxing in the jacuzzi.

FIRST AID/EMS
At the energy stations there is first aid equipment and a nurse. Medical care is also available in connection with Flatö School, together with a doctor. In case of serious accident or illness – always call 112 immediately!

INSURANCE
For those who wish, the option to purchase Startklar insurance is offered at this link. Here you can also read what protection it contains.

PRIZE GIVING
Everyone who completes their race receives the Taube Run medal and a diploma (the latter emailed to those who wish in PDF format). Prizes will also be awarded to the top three in each class in the form of a trophy in Swedish crystal glass from our local sponsor LifeStone (women’s and men’s classes in all three distances, as well as the children’s class in the 10 km and 5 km races). We also award nice raffle prizes from our other sponsors, and the prize ceremony takes place on the stage at Flatö School after the race (see final time for prize ceremony in the timetable).

AFTER RUN
Saturday afternoon is devoted to a lovely After Run with music in Evert Taube’s spirit and food at Flatö School. Here there is food, sausages and fika to enjoy.

RESULTS
Live results will be available on the website (ArenaTime)

PHOTOGRAPHY AND FILMING
We will have photographers on site who take still and moving pictures, for publication on our social media and websites. If you do not want to appear in pictures, please inform us at: taube-loppet@flaton.se. Include your name and which race it concerns. We respect images where you are clearly identifiable, but not mass images where you are one of many participants. The pictures will then be permanently removed from our channels.
We will also have several webcams placed along the track, and these will be shown on a projector screen at Flatö School, as well as streamed.

REGISTRATION FEE
Like many other races, we have a pricing ladder for the registration fee for Taube-loppet’s various distances. The earlier you register, the more time we have for preparations, medal purchases, timing equipment, staff bookings, etc., and the lower the price.
1 December – 28 February: 21 km 395 SEK, 10 km 350 SEK, 5 km 225 SEK, Combo 595 SEK, Children’s race 50 SEK
1 March – 31 May: 21 km 495 SEK, 10 km 450 SEK, 5 km 250 SEK, Combo 695 SEK, Children’s race 50 SEK
1 June – 22 August: 21 km 595 SEK, 10 km 550 SEK, 5 km 300 SEK, Combo 795 SEK, Children’s race 50 SEK
On-site registration on 23 August: 21 km 695 SEK, 10 km 650 SEK, 5 km 400 SEK, Combo 895 SEK, Children’s race 50 SEK

CONTACT
If you have questions or thoughts? We are at taube-loppet@flaton.se

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet is a peace and solidarity run in Sweden that combines running and walking activities with a message of peace and justice. The events are held in several locations across Sweden, including Umeå, and offer distances of 5 km and 10 km as well as walking categories and mini peace runs for children, making it accessible for both runners and families. Start times vary by location, and results are published without strict timing requirements in some classes. The event encourages participants to start their own Fredslopp, and the proceeds go to peace and solidarity work.

name: Lejonbragden
description: The race takes place on an eight-shaped 10 km course, mostly paved cycle and pedestrian paths, where you pass the aid station every 5 km. This is Sweden's oldest 100 km race! In addition to 100, 50 and 30 km, there is also a DUO class where two runners split the 100 km at their own discretion, in relay format.

name: Tjejstafetten
organizer: Stiftelsen Tjejkraft Tillsammans och Tjejstafetten AB
description:
Tjejstafetten is Sweden's first women's relay race at Stockholm Stadium.
But it's much more than that – it's a new way to make a difference.
Each team that participates donates 500 SEK directly from the registration fee to a total of 9 organizations focused on women, which works out to 100 SEK per person at each relay handoff. We call it the charitable exchange rate.

Welcome to a festival of movement, joy, and community!
additional:
Here's how it works:
You run in teams of 5 girls, and you and your team choose which class you participate in, and whether you will run, jog, or walk the course.

The relay is divided into two classes:
- recreational class 3 km per person with no timing
- competition class 5 km per person with timing.

Start, handoffs, and finish inside Stockholm Stadium with lovely loops through Lill-Jansskogen.

Gather your team of 5 friends, family or colleagues – sign up today!

name: Nordiska Mästarnas Backyard Ultra
description:
Location:
Fyskompaniet Träningscenter at Rattens gränd 1, Bromölla

Venue:
The arena is adjacent to the entrance of Fyskompaniet. The area is asphalt; at the beginning of October we will first know whether we can hold it inside a large warehouse or outside on the asphalt in a large event tent. Start and finish will be out on the asphalt area and there is the possibility to set up your own smaller tents.

Course:
The course is carefully laid out with the following surfaces to maximize the number of laps and is, so far, suitable for 81 laps. Asphalt 2530 m, Grass 152 m, Trail 1301 m, Gravel road/Agricultural road 2700 m, Wooden bridge 23 m with about 30 meters of elevation gain.
Trash bins are located at about 1, 3 & 6 km.
Feel free to check the route in this YouTube video www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBX3idm2zDo; however, the start will differ somewhat from the video depending on how we set the start in October; furthermore the entire course is beautifully colored by the autumn hues.
The whole course is marked with fabric tape with reflectors. The course is also marked with arrows at all junctions or where uncertainty may arise.

Energy station:
There will always be a well-stocked energy station with water, sports drinks, food, snacks and other things you might need to run long distances.

We will also lay out:

Dinner: after 17:00 per lap
Evening snack after 20:00 per lap
Breakfast: between 05:30-07:30 - from Sunday
Lunch: after 11:00 per lap - from Sunday
Etc... etc
We always have vegan and gluten-free options

Changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets:
The changing rooms are located in close proximity to the arena. There are roomy changing rooms for women and men with several showers and a sauna. There are also toilets.

Toilets at the arena area will be in the form of portable toilets; they can be accessed both before and after the start.

Start:
Saturday, 11 October at 10:00

Finish:
When the last runner finishes their last lap

Rules:
We follow the official rules which you can find here ultrasignup.com/register.aspx?did=113992

Timing / results:
Timing is done with a chip worn around the ankle. The time is recorded at the lap portal after each completed lap.

Accommodation:
We have a couple of accommodation suggestions for those traveling some distance

Hotel Iföhus
About 1.3 km from the arena
hotellifohus.se/

Bromölla Camping & Hostel
About 0.8 km from the arena
bromollacamping.se/

There is no possibility to camp inside the arena area.

Spectators:
Please come and cheer on your friends; easiest is to follow them from the start area. There is also a nice environment at Käsebron or along the northern parts along the Lilla Kungsleden.

Race management:
Jimmy Schön: 076 105 73 77
Anna Schön: 073 355 64 68

name: Rosa Bandet-loppet 2025
description:
Nordic Wellness, together with Öresjö Ängar, invites you to the Pink Ribbon Run 2025. We invite you to a day filled with movement, community and joy – all in support of Cancerfonden's Pink Ribbon fundraising.
Date: Saturday, October 25, 2025, 09:30–13:00
Location: Start and finish at the new residential area Öresjö Ängar, Borås (Address: Klättergatan 9-11).
Limited parking, so please travel by public transport.
Bus 150 to Tosserydsvägen stop

Start times
10:00: Toddlers' race – for the smallest, full of pep and energy (approx 350 meters)
11:00: 4 km Run for the public – walk, jog, or run, everyone can participate
11:10: Student race – focused on dressing up. The most creative costume will be crowned
The course stretches 3 kilometers on forest trails, 1 km on asphalt.
Cost
Toddlers' race: 100 SEK
4 km for the public: 150 SEK
Student race: 120 SEK (upon presentation of Mecenat card)
All proceeds go directly to Pink Ribbon.

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description: Run a marathon distance in backyard format! A backyard race that lasts up to 6 hours. One lap of 6.7 km each hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one lap of 8.7 km. Total 42.195 km. If you complete the race you will have run a marathon! First to cross the finish line on the last lap wins. The course largely runs on the fitness loop and is generally accessible, though with moderate elevation changes. Registration is via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race. The children's race is free. See further information on the website.

name: Gävle Adventslopp
description:
Gävle Adventslopp is the winter city race that everyone can participate in, young and old, slow or fast.
With this race we want to inspire running joy even during our colder months!

The start is down by the mini-golf course, the race then goes through the beautiful Boulognerskogen and finishes at the Boulognerskogen Café where we offer hot cordial and gingerbread cookies.
Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class, but there is also a prize draw among all participants.

For our youngest runners we offer Lilla adventsloppet; the course is 500m and starts and finishes near the stage by the Boulognerskogen Café.
Before the race we warm up together with our mascots Snögubben and Renen.

All information and registration can be found at adventsloppet.se

images.alt_text: Gävle Adventslopp vinterlopp med löpare och julbock.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: This year's best race with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is a roughly 3 km, or 6 km long race for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog, or run – you choose! A race you run, walk, or roll in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. So join in on this year's most Christmassy day with community, atmosphere and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The whole city is transformed into a running Christmas party with mulled wine and gingerbread cookies, and of course you get a medal! Buy your entry including the Santa costume today. All proceeds go to children and youths with functional variation, for an active life on their own terms. WELCOME!

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Sollentuna Winter Marathons
description:
Welcome to SWM!
Experience the adrenaline of running on ice! Sollentuna Winter Marathon offers three spectacular races in one day, where Arena Edsvik creates a festive atmosphere and Edsbergs Slott from the 1630s provides a royal setting.

NEW! - Winter X 10K - SOLO
A fast-paced 10K winter race on and around the ice of Edsviken, with up to 4 km of spectacular ice running, before you sprint to the finish at Arena Edsvik. The start gun goes off at 12:00!

Winter Half Marathon 21K - TEAM & SOLO
A beautiful and challenging half marathon on and around Edsviken, with up to 7 km of spectacular ice running. The start gun goes off at 12:00!

Winter 21K - CANICROSS
All dog runners have the chance to test magical ice running with their four-legged buddy! Only 50 spots for dog teams – first come, first served. Free start between 11:45–12:00.

Winter Kids Run by Team Rynkeby Täby 1.5K
A fun kids' race for all born in 2014+ on wintry roads around Edsbergs Slott. All proceeds go directly to Barncancerfonden via Team Rynkeby Täby. Start 11:00.

Together we support Barncancerfonden
Thanks to you we donate up to 25,000 SEK to Barncancerfonden via our volunteers in Team Rynkeby Täby. Many thanks!

RUN ON ICE!
